The Staff Nurse is accountable for the coordination of nursing care, including direct patient care, patient/family education and transitions of care. The Staff Nurse supports professional nursing practice across the continuum of care to meet the needs of the patient and family. The Staff Nurse will understand, support and promote the mission, vision and values of SSMC; provides age-appropriate patient care according to the Nursing Scope of Practice as defined by the regulatory body. The Staff Nurse will adhere to and promote the Professional Nurses Code of Conduct for Abu Dhabi and UAE.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Assessment and Diagnosis: Collects and analyzes assessment data to determine diagnosis/issues:

 Assesses comprehensive data including but not limited to physical, psychosocial, emotional, cognitive, and spiritual needs and interprets assessment information to derive the diagnosis or issues as defined by the patient’s condition.

 Uses evidence-based assessment techniques and instruments in collecting data and validates the diagnosis or issue with the patient, family and healthcare team members as appropriate.

 Prioritizes the data and information collected based on patient’s immediate condition or anticipated needs and identifies potential risks or barriers to the patient’s health or safety.

 Documents the data and information collected in compliance with established guidelines and reflective of the needs of the patient.

  • Planning and Outcomes Identification: Identifies expected outcomes and develops a plan that address health promotion, health restoration and health maintenance to attain expected outcomes.

 Involves patient, family and healthcare team members in formulating a culturally appropriate individualized plan of care.

 Applies evidence-based nursing practices in developing the individualized plan of care to attain expected outcomes and continuity of care.

 Modifies the individualized plan of care according to the ongoing assessment and reevaluation of the patient’s response, status, and outcome indicators.

 Documents the expected outcomes as measurable goals in a manner that uses standardized language or recognized terminology.

  • Implementation and Coordination of Care Delivery:

 Implements the plan of care in partnership with the patient, family and healthcare team members in a timely manner utilizing evidence-based interventions and treatments specific to the needs of the patient.

 Performs treatments and procedures according to established procedural guidelines and protocols.

 Administers medications according to organization policies and procedures.

 Ensures that all components of the individualized plan of care, including modifications, are documented in the patient’s health record.

 Communicates relevant information across all levels of care and organizations.

 Demonstrates a working knowledge of resource consumption and practices within a costeffective framework.

  • Health teaching and health promotion:

 Utilizes teaching strategies appropriate to the individual patient’s condition and learning needs.

 Uses health promotion to support patients and families in developing skills that promote, maintain, or restore healthy lifestyles and self-management support.

 Seeks opportunities for feedback and evaluation of the effectiveness of the strategies used, including teach back.

 Ensures that all components of the health education, relevant to the clinical condition, is documented in the patient health record.

  • Evaluation: Evaluates progress toward attainment of outcomes.

 Evaluates the patient/family’s understanding of and response to the plan of care.

 Utilizes systematic and ongoing assessment data to revise nursing diagnoses, outcomes, and the plan of care.

 Involves the patient, family and healthcare team members in the evaluation process.

 Provides a comprehensive clinical handover/report as required to ensure patient safety.

 Attends patient care rounds, communicates, and updates the attending healthcare provider on changes in the patient’s condition.

 Communicates with the patient care team about ongoing changes in patient’s plan of care and unit activity

 Documents the reassessment of patient status; patient and family participation and understanding; and the rationale for any revision in the plan of care.

  • Evidence-based Practice and Research: Integrates evidence and research findings into practice.

 Utilizes current evidence-based nursing knowledge, including research findings, to guide and evaluate practice.

 Participates in evidence-based and research activities at various levels appropriate to the nurse’s level of education and position.

 Shares evidence-based and research findings with healthcare team members.

 Participates in performance improvement projects for the evaluation and improvement of clinical practice

  • Leadership: Demonstrates leadership behaviors in practice settings, across the profession, and in the community.

 Functions as a professional role model promoting a positive, team-based, organized, and safe work environment.

 Coordinates and supervises delegated activities to assure completion and serve as a resource for other healthcare team members

 Demonstrates critical thinking in priority setting and decision making in response to patient needs.

 Pursues informal and formal leadership opportunities

 Participates actively in organizational shared decision-making situations that improve the nursing practice, organizational performance, and outcomes.

 Supervises practical nurses and junior staff and student nurses to ensure the provision of safe and effective patient care.

Accountabilities

  • Applies the principles of professional codes of ethics that ensure individual rights in all areas of Practice:
  • Maintains a professional and therapeutic nurse-patient relationship and serves as a patient advocate assisting patients and families in developing skills for self-advocacy.
  • Speaks up to question healthcare practices as appropriate for safety and quality improvement.
  • Discloses any observed illegal or incompetent practices and decisions made by potentially impaired health care staff per organizational policy.
  • Evaluates own nursing practice in relation to professional practice standards and guidelines, rules and regulations.
  • Considers factors related to effectiveness, cost, environmental health, and impact on practice and organization.
  • Utilizes current resources related to standards of care, policies and procedures, and patient needs.
  • Navigates and utilizes electronic resources for information retrieval, communication, and documentation.
  • Evaluates factors related to patient safety, effectiveness, availability, and cost when determining practice options.
  • Promotes a practice environment that reduces environmental health risks for staff.
  • Communicates environmental health risks and exposure reduction strategies to healthcare consumers, families, colleagues, and communities.
  • Demonstrates a commitment to continuous learning and education for self and others and mentors healthcare team members for the advancement of nursing practices, the profession, and quality healthcare.
  • Oversees and responds to all levels of emergencies according to the organizations policies and procedures.

QUALIFICATIONS

Experience :-

(Note: Experience requirement waived for graduates of UAE nursing colleges/universities after completion of internship)

  • AND valid/current national license.

The Staff Nurse is accountable for the coordination of nursing care, including direct patient care, patient/family education and transitions of care. The Staff Nurse supports professional nursing practice across the continuum of care to meet the needs of the patient and family. The Staff Nurse will understand, support and promote the mission, vision and values of SSMC; provides age-appropriate patient care according to the Nursing Scope of Practice as defined by the regulatory body. The Staff Nurse will adhere to and promote the Professional Nurses Code of Conduct for Abu Dhabi and UAE.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Assessment and Diagnosis: Collects and analyzes assessment data to determine diagnosis/issues:

 Assesses comprehensive data including but not limited to physical, psychosocial, emotional, cognitive, and spiritual needs and interprets assessment information to derive the diagnosis or issues as defined by the patient’s condition.

 Uses evidence-based assessment techniques and instruments in collecting data and validates the diagnosis or issue with the patient, family and healthcare team members as appropriate.

 Prioritizes the data and information collected based on patient’s immediate condition or anticipated needs and identifies potential risks or barriers to the patient’s health or safety.

 Documents the data and information collected in compliance with established guidelines and reflective of the needs of the patient.

  • Planning and Outcomes Identification: Identifies expected outcomes and develops a plan that address health promotion, health restoration and health maintenance to attain expected outcomes.

 Involves patient, family and healthcare team members in formulating a culturally appropriate individualized plan of care.

 Applies evidence-based nursing practices in developing the individualized plan of care to attain expected outcomes and continuity of care.

 Modifies the individualized plan of care according to the ongoing assessment and reevaluation of the patient’s response, status, and outcome indicators.

 Documents the expected outcomes as measurable goals in a manner that uses standardized language or recognized terminology.

  • Implementation and Coordination of Care Delivery:

 Implements the plan of care in partnership with the patient, family and healthcare team members in a timely manner utilizing evidence-based interventions and treatments specific to the needs of the patient.

 Performs treatments and procedures according to established procedural guidelines and protocols.

 Administers medications according to organization policies and procedures.

 Ensures that all components of the individualized plan of care, including modifications, are documented in the patient’s health record.

 Communicates relevant information across all levels of care and organizations.

 Demonstrates a working knowledge of resource consumption and practices within a costeffective framework.

  • Health teaching and health promotion:

 Utilizes teaching strategies appropriate to the individual patient’s condition and learning needs.

 Uses health promotion to support patients and families in developing skills that promote, maintain, or restore healthy lifestyles and self-management support.

 Seeks opportunities for feedback and evaluation of the effectiveness of the strategies used, including teach back.

 Ensures that all components of the health education, relevant to the clinical condition, is documented in the patient health record.

  • Evaluation: Evaluates progress toward attainment of outcomes.

 Evaluates the patient/family’s understanding of and response to the plan of care.

 Utilizes systematic and ongoing assessment data to revise nursing diagnoses, outcomes, and the plan of care.

 Involves the patient, family and healthcare team members in the evaluation process.

 Provides a comprehensive clinical handover/report as required to ensure patient safety.

 Attends patient care rounds, communicates, and updates the attending healthcare provider on changes in the patient’s condition.

 Communicates with the patient care team about ongoing changes in patient’s plan of care and unit activity

 Documents the reassessment of patient status; patient and family participation and understanding; and the rationale for any revision in the plan of care.

  • Evidence-based Practice and Research: Integrates evidence and research findings into practice.

 Utilizes current evidence-based nursing knowledge, including research findings, to guide and evaluate practice.

 Participates in evidence-based and research activities at various levels appropriate to the nurse’s level of education and position.

 Shares evidence-based and research findings with healthcare team members.

 Participates in performance improvement projects for the evaluation and improvement of clinical practice

  • Leadership: Demonstrates leadership behaviors in practice settings, across the profession, and in the community.

 Functions as a professional role model promoting a positive, team-based, organized, and safe work environment.

 Coordinates and supervises delegated activities to assure completion and serve as a resource for other healthcare team members

 Demonstrates critical thinking in priority setting and decision making in response to patient needs.

 Pursues informal and formal leadership opportunities

 Participates actively in organizational shared decision-making situations that improve the nursing practice, organizational performance, and outcomes.

 Supervises practical nurses and junior staff and student nurses to ensure the provision of safe and effective patient care.

Accountabilities

  • Applies the principles of professional codes of ethics that ensure individual rights in all areas of Practice:
  • Maintains a professional and therapeutic nurse-patient relationship and serves as a patient advocate assisting patients and families in developing skills for self-advocacy.
  • Speaks up to question healthcare practices as appropriate for safety and quality improvement.
  • Discloses any observed illegal or incompetent practices and decisions made by potentially impaired health care staff per organizational policy.
  • Evaluates own nursing practice in relation to professional practice standards and guidelines, rules and regulations.
  • Considers factors related to effectiveness, cost, environmental health, and impact on practice and organization.
  • Utilizes current resources related to standards of care, policies and procedures, and patient needs.
  • Navigates and utilizes electronic resources for information retrieval, communication, and documentation.
  • Evaluates factors related to patient safety, effectiveness, availability, and cost when determining practice options.
  • Promotes a practice environment that reduces environmental health risks for staff.
  • Communicates environmental health risks and exposure reduction strategies to healthcare consumers, families, colleagues, and communities.
  • Demonstrates a commitment to continuous learning and education for self and others and mentors healthcare team members for the advancement of nursing practices, the profession, and quality healthcare.
  • Oversees and responds to all levels of emergencies according to the organizations policies and procedures.

QUALIFICATIONS

Experience :-

Required:

  • a. NLT 2 years clinical experience post qualification in appropriate setting

(Note: Experience requirement waived for graduates of UAE nursing colleges/universities after completion of internship)

Desired:

  • N.A.

Educational Qualification: Required:

  • Bachelor degree in nursing OR
  • Degree in Nursing (minimum two (2) years course duration) AND Registration as a Registered Nurse from Canada, USA, UK, Ireland, South Africa, New Zealand, and Australia
  • AND valid/current national license.
  • AND BLS

Desired:

  • ACLS, PALS relevant to area of specialty

This position is also responsible for demonstrating competency in the behavioral, growth, development and psychosocial needs of patients being treated.

FREQUENCY

Patient care

Develop and implement plan of care, supervise Practical Nurses and collaborate with other health care professionals.

PATIENT CARE

· Performs accurate and complete admission assessments

· Monitors and documents the patient’s condition and the effectiveness of care and/or interventions

· Establishes and implements a care plan based on sound nursing theory, scientific principles, professional judgment and individual patient needs

· Evaluates and updates the patient’s plan of care to facilitate the achievement of planned and expected outcomes

· Administers prescribed medications and treatments in accordance with approved nursing protocol

· Assesses for and plans the educational needs of the patient

· Provides teaching and educational material to patients and/or families, which may include diagnosis, tests and procedures, safe and proper use of equipment, use of medications, injury prevention and nutritional needs

· Monitors and resolves customer service issues and provides feedback regarding satisfaction results to Nursing Leadership

· Maintains confidentiality regarding patients and families

· Interacts with patients, families and other visitors in a courteous, helpful manner

· Facilitates the incorporation of patient safety and Magnet principles into clinical nursing care

· Participates in clinical nursing research and supports CCAD research initiatives

· Keeps abreast of best practice information for nursing profession

CLINICAL / PROFESSIONAL KNOWLEDGE

· Use the knowledge of one’s own role and the roles of other professions to appropriately assess and address the health care needs of the patients and populations served

· Demonstrates commitment to providing evidence based practice care by: adhering to protocols for the care of patient populations in which assigned, reporting needed changes in practice supported by evidence, and participating in evaluating patient outcomes utilizing evidence

· Delegates appropriate components of the nursing care plan to other members of the nursing team

· Maintains confidentiality regarding patient and family information by promoting professional interdisciplinary communication

· Respects Patient Rights and demonstrates behaviors of a Patients’ First Philosophy

· Incorporates the CCAD Professional Practice model and patient safety principles into clinical practice

· Reports errors and near-misses

PROFESSIONALISM

· Leads the caregiver team in the delivery of patient care collaborating with other disciplines to facilitate achievement of planned and expected outcomes

· Apply relationship-building values and the principles of team dynamics to perform effectively in different team roles to plan and deliver patient/population-centered care that is safe, timely, efficient, effective, and equitable

· Communicates with patients, families, visitors and vendors in a courteous, helpful manner, endeavoring to resolve issues at the unit/department level

PRIMARY JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

PATIENT CARE

· Performs accurate and complete admission assessments

· Monitors and documents the patient’s condition and the effectiveness of care and/or interventions

· Establishes and implements a care plan based on sound nursing theory, scientific principles, professional judgment and individual patient needs

· Evaluates and updates the patient’s plan of care to facilitate the achievement of planned and expected outcomes

· Administers prescribed medications and treatments in accordance with approved nursing protocol

· Assesses for and plans the educational needs of the patient

· Provides teaching and educational material to patients and/or families, which may include diagnosis, tests and procedures, safe and proper use of equipment, use of medications, injury prevention and nutritional needs

· Monitors and resolves customer service issues and provides feedback regarding satisfaction results to Nursing Leadership

· Maintains confidentiality regarding patients and families

· Interacts with patients, families and other visitors in a courteous, helpful manner

· Facilitates the incorporation of patient safety and Magnet principles into clinical nursing care

· Participates in clinical nursing research and supports CCAD research initiatives

· Keeps abreast of best practice information for nursing profession

CLINICAL / PROFESSIONAL KNOWLEDGE

· Use the knowledge of one’s own role and the roles of other professions to appropriately assess and address the health care needs of the patients and populations served

· Demonstrates commitment to providing evidence based practice care by: adhering to protocols for the care of patient populations in which assigned, reporting needed changes in practice supported by evidence, and participating in evaluating patient outcomes utilizing evidence

· Delegates appropriate components of the nursing care plan to other members of the nursing team

· Maintains confidentiality regarding patient and family information by promoting professional interdisciplinary communication

· Respects Patient Rights and demonstrates behaviors of a Patients’ First Philosophy

· Incorporates the CCAD Professional Practice model and patient safety principles into clinical practice

· Reports errors and near-misses

PROFESSIONALISM

· Leads the caregiver team in the delivery of patient care collaborating with other disciplines to facilitate achievement of planned and expected outcomes

· Apply relationship-building values and the principles of team dynamics to perform effectively in different team roles to plan and deliver patient/population-centered care that is safe, timely, efficient, effective, and equitable

· Maintains confidentiality with patients and families and adheres to Mubadala Code of Conduct

· Demonstrates active participation in resource stewardship

· Provides feedback on strategies to decrease costs, adherence to safe staffing models, and use of high-cost resources

INTERPERSONAL COMMUNICATION

· Work with individuals of other professions to maintain a climate of mutual respect and shared values

· Communicate with patients, families, communities, and other health professionals in a responsive and responsible manner that supports a team approach to maintaining health and treatment of disease

· Communicates with patients, families, visitors and vendors in a courteous, helpful manner, endeavoring to resolve issues at the unit/department level

· Communicates patient clinical information clearly and accurately, documenting pertinent information in medical record and ensuring complete documentation of patient care

· Engages patient and family in hand-off of clinical information and planning daily plan of care as appropriate

PRACTICE-BASED LEARNING AND PERSONAL DEVELOPMENT

· Accountable for establishing, maintaining and evaluating one’s own lifelong learning needs

· Committed to the development of fellow caregivers, Emirati nationals, and one’s profession

SYSTEM-BASED PRACTICE AND SYSTEM IMPROVEMENT

· Participates in safety education programs and cause analysis as required

· Reports needed changes in practice supported by evidence

· Participating in research or quality improvement initiatives

ROLE LEVEL ACCOUNTABILITIES

· Adheres to CCAD’s standards as they appear in the Code of Conduct and Conflict of Interest policies

In view of the evolving needs and opportunities within CCAD, this position may be required to perform other duties as assigned and reporting relationships may vary.

Scientific Engagement and Marketing Lead – Healthcare Diagnostics

We are seeking an experienced Scientific Engagement and Marketing Lead with a strong background in healthcare marketing and scientific event management to establish and lead our medico-marketing function and drive revenue growth. This role combines strategic scientific and marketing leadership with hands-on execution, with a particular emphasis on planning and executing high-quality scientific meetings, symposia, and educational programs for healthcare professionals.

As our first dedicated medico-marketing professional, you will build the function from the ground up, working closely with our sales team to increase our revenue within 12 months through HCP engagement, relationship building, and educational initiatives.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Scientific Meeting & Event Management (60%)

Planning & Strategy:

  • Design and execute annual calendar of scientific meetings, symposia, webinars, and educational programs
  • Develop scientific agendas aligned with clinical priorities and our test menu capabilities
  • Research emerging topics in diagnostics, genetics, and functional medicine relevant to target audiences
  • Establish CME accreditation for educational programs with DHA/MOHAP where applicable

Speaker & Faculty Management:

  • Identify and recruit key opinion leaders (KOLs), specialists, and subject matter experts as speakers
  • Manage speaker relationships including invitations, briefings, and follow-up
  • Coordinate speaker logistics (travel, accommodation, honorariums at fair market value)
  • Develop speaker agreements ensuring compliance with UAE healthcare regulations
  • Brief speakers on presentation requirements, timing, and audience profile

Event Production & Execution:

  • Source and negotiate with venues, caterers, AV providers, and event suppliers
  • Manage event budgets
  • Coordinate all event logistics: invitations, registration, materials, signage, catering
  • Oversee on-site event management ensuring professional execution
  • Manage virtual event platforms for webinars and hybrid events
  • Ensure compliance with all venue, safety, and regulatory requirements

Event Marketing & Promotion:

  • Create event marketing campaigns including email invitations, social media promotion, and direct outreach
  • Work with sales team to drive HCP attendance and maximize registration
  • Develop post-event follow-up sequences to nurture leads and maintain engagement
  • Measure event ROI through attendance, engagement, and subsequent referral patterns

CME & Compliance:

  • Navigate DHA/MOHAP CME accreditation processes
  • Ensure all scientific content is evidence-based and compliant with healthcare regulations
  • Maintain documentation of educational program attendance and evaluations
  • Ensure events comply with MOHAP Code of Ethics regarding HCP engagement

2. Marketing Strategy & Leadership (15%)

Strategic Planning:

  • Develop and execute comprehensive 12-month marketing strategy aligned with revenue goals
  • Define target HCP segments and create tailored marketing approaches
  • Conduct competitive analysis and market research
  • Establish marketing KPIs and tracking mechanisms
  • Manage annual marketing budget

Brand Development & Positioning:

  • Establish brand positioning as a center of excellence for advanced diagnostics and genetic testing
  • Develop brand guidelines, messaging frameworks, and value propositions
  • Oversee visual identity and ensure brand consistency across all touchpoints
  • Position lab as thought leader in genetic testing and functional medicine

Partnership Development:

  • Identify and develop strategic partnerships (insurance companies, corporate wellness, medical centers)
  • Create co-marketing programs with partners
  • Negotiate partnership agreements with legal and management oversight
  • Manage partner relationships and measure partnership ROI

3. Sales Enablement & Support (15%)

Sales Team Collaboration:

  • Develop sales enablement materials (presentations, brochures, battle cards, case studies)
  • Conduct weekly marketing-sales alignment meetings
  • Train sales team on new campaigns, messages, and materials
  • Support major account pursuits with custom presentations and proposals

4. Digital Marketing & Content (10%)

Content Strategy & Creation:

  • Develop content marketing strategy (blog posts, white papers, case studies, videos)
  • Create educational content for HCPs on clinical utility of tests
  • Write and distribute monthly newsletters and email campaigns
  • Produce thought leadership articles and scientific summaries
  • Oversee video production (lab tours, test explanations, HCP testimonials)

Digital Presence Management:

  • Manage company website, HCP portal, and online test ordering system
  • Execute SEO/SEM strategy to drive organic and paid traffic
  • Lead social media strategy (primarily LinkedIn for B2B HCP engagement)
  • Manage email marketing campaigns with segmentation and automation
  • Implement and monitor LinkedIn advertising campaigns
  • Track digital analytics and optimize campaigns based on data

Technology & Tools:

  • Manage marketing technology stack (CRM, email platform, analytics, design tools)
  • Ensure integration between marketing automation and CRM systems
  • Generate performance dashboards and reports

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

Education:

  • MBA or Medical degree

Experience:

  • Minimum 3-5 years of medico-marketing experience in healthcare, diagnostics, pharmaceuticals, or medical devices
  • Minimum 2-3 years of hands-on scientific meeting/event planning and execution
  • Proven experience in B2B healthcare marketing
  • Demonstrated success in HCP engagement and relationship marketing
  • Experience managing marketing budgets

Technical Skills:

  • Expert-level event planning and project management skills
  • Proficiency in digital marketing (SEO, SEM, social media, email marketing)
  • Experience with marketing automation platforms (HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar)
  • Strong content creation skills (writing, editing, presentation design)
  • Knowledge of design tools (Adobe Creative Suite, Canva, or similar)
  • Data analysis and reporting capabilities
  • Social media management platforms (Hootsuite, Sprout Social, or similar)

Regulatory & Compliance:

  • Strong understanding of UAE healthcare regulations (MOHAP, DHA, DOH)
  • Knowledge of ethical guidelines for HCP engagement and medical marketing
  • Experience navigating CME accreditation processes
  • Understanding of pharmaceutical/medical device promotional codes (IFPMA, EFPIA principles)

Industry Knowledge:

  • Understanding of diagnostic testing, laboratory services, and healthcare delivery
  • Familiarity with genetic testing, functional medicine, or advanced diagnostics (preferred)
  • Knowledge of UAE healthcare ecosystem and market dynamics
  • Understanding of B2B healthcare sales cycles and decision-making processes

KEY COMPETENCIES & PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES

Core Competencies:

  • Scientific Event Management Excellence: Exceptional ability to plan, organize, and execute professional scientific meetings from conception to completion
  • Attention to Detail: Meticulous approach to event logistics, timelines, and deliverables
  • Project Management: Strong ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously with competing deadlines
  • Stakeholder Management: Skilled at managing relationships with KOLs, speakers, vendors, and internal teams
  • Strategic Thinking: Ability to connect marketing activities to business outcomes
  • Data-Driven Decision Making: Uses analytics to optimize campaigns and demonstrate ROI
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Works effectively with sales, operations, and clinical teams

Personal Attributes:

  • Self-Starter: Proven ability to build marketing functions from the ground up
  • Entrepreneurial Mindset: Comfortable working in a startup-like environment with limited resources
  • Results-Oriented: Track record of meeting and exceeding marketing and revenue goals
  • Excellent Communicator: Superior written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Professional Presence: Confidence to interact with senior physicians and healthcare executives
  • Adaptable: Flexible and responsive to changing business needs and priorities
  • Culturally Aware: Understanding of UAE business culture and healthcare environment
  • Ethical: Unwavering commitment to compliance and ethical marketing practices

LANGUAGE REQUIREMENTS

  • English: Fluent/Native (required) – written and spoken

Participating in internal meetings pertaining to infection prevention and control.

Facilitating integration of infection prevention and control activities within and across departments.

Management of Clinical Practice

Building relationships with staff, peers and colleagues to support interdisciplinary and interdepartmental planning, aimed at improving patient outcomes.

Liaising with senior infection preventionist to provide clinical consultations to nurses, physicians and allied health professionals related to infection prevention and control.

Demonstrating knowledge of microbiological and epidemiological principles and isolation precautions when addressing the purchase of resources (e.g., personal protective equipment).

Updating HAAD with information regarding the reportable infectious diseases, endemic and epidemic situation in the community.

Assisting In Surveillance And Epidemiologic Investigation

  • Collecting surveillance data pertaining to healthcare associated infection.
  • Reviewing the surveillance data with the senior infection preventionist.
  • Participating in analyzing and interpreting surveillance data within the team.
  • Facilitating implementation of appropriate actions to clinicians and administrators targeted to reduce or eliminate infectious risks in patients and staff.
  • Performing active surveillance on targeted device and procedure associated infections in the hospital and following up on epidemiological importance organisms/diseases.

Assisting the senior infection preventionist in performing outbreak investigations

  • Facilitating contact tracing related to exposure of patients or/and healthcare workers to communicable diseases
  • Preparing and maintaining confidentiality of all aspects of infection prevention and control surveillance data collection and storage.

Preventing/controlling The Transmission Of Infectious Agents

  • Promoting and implementing infection prevention and control guidelines/standards that improve patient outcome and reduce healthcare-associated infections.
  • Investigating and studying trends in infection prevention and control practices, liaise with the senior infection preventioist for recommendations and changes required for performance improvement.

Support the activities of an employee/occupational health

Disaster Preparedness

Response – Biological

Participating in Disaster Preparedness and Biological Response Plan –including, but not limited to:

  • Collaborating with seniors on recommendations to reduce potential for infections transmision and sharing such recommendadtions
  • Ensuring personal protective equipment resources are available at all times
  • Coordinating with multidiciplinary team in effectively utilizing resources during an disaster (i.e isolation rooms)
  • Participating identifying dedicated units to accommodate known or suspected patients with bioterrorism-related disease, or emerging infectious disease
  • Participating in conducting annual drills related to Disaster Preparedness and Biological Response
  • Demonstrating effective reporting process for a biological disaster (communication with SEHA OCC, HAAD, CDC, Police, etc.)

Participating in executing environmental decontamination after a bioterrorism attack

Providing infectious disease disaster plan education and training to the staff

Demonstrating knowledge for early detection of an infectious disease disaster through active or passive surveillance

Liaising with senior infection preventionist for recommending strategies for handling potentially contagious individuals and implementing environmental controls to prevent or limit the emergence or spread of communicable diseases

Maintaining knowledge on effective interventions that can be implemented when standard practices cannot be achieved during a disaster (when resources may be limited)

Pandemic preparednes and response

Monitoring pandemic alerts issued by HAAD CDC, MOH, WHO, etc., if a pandemic is declared:

  • Facilitating communication and implemention of necessary precautions applicable to the physical setting.
  • Performing process and/or outcome surveillance activities to identify infections that cause or have potential to cause an outbreak
  • Participating in epidemiological investigation
  • Implementing routine practices and precautions to prevent the transmission of infection

Communication

Using information technology to access, transmit and produce information as necessary.

Assisting in producing infection prevention and control reports and surveillance monitoring in a timely manner (i.e., monthly).

Collaborating with multidisciplinary team by providing effective communication and timely feedback in improving quality and patient safety.

Performance Improvement/Risk Management

Supporting in ongoing educational programs within the organization.

Monitoring compliance with International and HA-AD Patient Safety Goals.

Plans, implements, supervises, and evaluates the delivery of patient-centred care within established institutions’ policies, procedures, guidelines, and standards of professional nursing practice in the Operating Room. Coordinates the care needed for a patient with different disciplines. Replaces nurses when sick leave arises. Ensures this is done through the management of human, financial and other resources; professional development of oneself and subordinates; involvement in strategic planning and fostering interdisciplinary and collaborative relationships. Enforces Joint Commission International (JCI) requirements, including but not limited to International Patient Safety Goals, and national and international standards.

Responsibilities

General:

  • Assists nursing staff in the development of clinical decision-making and problem-solving skills through case consultation, clinical demonstration, case review, bedside rounds, etc.
  • Acts as a role model in the application of standards and philosophy of nursing practice.

  • Assumes responsibility for infection control, safety, and comfort of patients.

  • Oversees collaboration with multidisciplinary health care team and coordination of medical and nursing management of patient care.
  • Evaluates all nursing activities related to patient care.
  • Evaluates the integration of the nursing process: identification of patient problem(s), implementation of plan of care and evaluation of patient progress toward desired outcomes(s).
  • Provides direction and guidance in the delivery of patient care, incorporating outcomes and research evidence to guide practice.
  • Promotes, oversees, and monitors unit patient /family education processes.
  • Monitors compliance for accurate reporting and documentation of all patient care.

  • Demonstrates responsibility for meeting Joint Commission International Accreditation (JCIA) mandatory education (e.g., fire, safety, infection control and others).

  • Promotes incident and customer complaint reporting to improve patient and family care.
  • Investigates all incidents and customer complaints.
  • Initiates risk management processes suited to the needs of patients in the unit.

Operational Management:

    • Ensures proper skill mix.

Staff Development and Management:

  • Conducts ongoing assessments of staff educational needs and establishes in-service/development programs to meet these needs.
  • Coordinates the development, implementation, and expansion of learning opportunities/skills development for all the unit staff.
  • Monitors and assesses staff knowledge of emergency care.
  • Facilitates opportunities for nursing staff to improve and/or expand clinical knowledge and skills.
  • Identifies needs and implements staff education activities for the use of new equipment and /or technologies.
  • Assesses and monitors staff competency.
  • Coordinates competency–based validation of nursing staff for unit-specific procedures.
  • Collaborates with other departments (Human Resources and Clinical Educators etc.) towards the development and coaching of subordinates to accomplish unit goals and objectives.

Unit Specific:

  • Prepares Chest Tubes:

Qualifications

  • Must hold a minimum of a valid Basic Life Support (BLS) Certification or others according to the scope of practice.
  • Post Graduate Qualification in Nursing Management/Advanced Clinical Speciality preferable.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE:

  • Minimum of three (3) years of Managerial Experience in Operating Room Nursing.
  • Knowledge of Joint Commission International Accreditation (JCIA).
  • Skills in Leadership and Management.
  • Ability to speak and write in English fluently.
  • Ability to speak and write in Arabic preferred.

A physician may work in one or more areas of specialization, such as anesthesiology, family and general medicine, internal medicine, and pediatrics.

  • Prescribing medications or therapies.

Reporting to the Executive Director of AI & Data, you will play a vital role in shaping PureHealth’s future by fostering a culture of innovation and accelerating the adoption of groundbreaking AI solutions across the organization’s provider network. You should be a strong leader with the ability to identify trends, technologies and articulate a vision that translates to concrete initiatives and plans.

Strategic Foresight & Technology Scouting:

  • Scan the global healthcare landscape to identify and evaluate emerging AI technologies, scientific discoveries, and innovations that have the potential to transform healthcare delivery.
  • Provide strategic insights into the potential impact of new technologies and their applicability to PureHealth’s unique context.
  • Conduct market research and feasibility studies to assess new AI solutions and recommend those that could deliver high impact and can be integrated within existing solutions.

Science-Based Innovation:

  • Partner with leading research institutions, universities, and technology providers to establish meaningful collaborations that will help drive data and AI-related advancements.

  • Provide technical guidance to the engineering team to enhance the quality and accuracy of deployed AI solutions.

AI Solution Evaluation & Validation:

  • Collaborate with the technical teams to define methods for evaluating new Al algorithms and solutions, ensuring the proper validation, and clinical utility.
  • Assess the potential impact and risks associated with the implementation of different Al solutions, and provide strategic guidance on technology selection and deployment.
  • Develop and implement a framework for ensuring ethical and responsible use of AI across the organization.

Collaboration and Knowledge Sharing:

  • Work closely with the leadership, business, and clinical teams to advocate for strategic technology initiatives and to ensure that new solutions are aligned with the organization’s mission and vision.
  • Present research findings and recommendations to both technical and non-technical audiences, enabling leadership to make informed, impactful decisions.
  • Contribute to cross-functional collaborations, ensuring a holistic approach to AI implementation across diverse areas of the organization.

Qualifications:

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Ph.D. or equivalent doctoral degree in a relevant field, such as Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Biomedical Engineering, Bioinformatics, or a related discipline.

Preferred Qualifications:

Ensures both personnel and vehicle readiness and availability to respond to accident or sudden illness or emergencies.

Responsibilities

  1. Responds to the medical emergency calls, drives to the scene and provides basic life support to the victims before they are transported to the hospital. 
  2. Evaluates the nature and extent of illness/injury to determine the right course of actions. Conduct patient assessment, 3 Lead ECG-suggestive.
  3. Provides medical aid such as AED, CPR, provide spinal motion restriction, ventilation, control severe bleeding; prevent shock, bandaging wounds, etc., to stabilize their condition. 
  4. Administration of activated charcoal, oral glucose and oxygen. 
  5. Constantly assesses the patient enroute to the emergency facility, administers additional care as indicated or directed by medical control. 
  6. Maintains vehicles and medical and communication equipment and replenishes first-aid equipment and supplies.
    1. Restocks all supplies in the ambulance and replace used blankets, linens and other supplies. 
    2. Cleans all equipment following appropriate disinfecting protocols.
  7. Continuously reassures the patient enroute to the emergency facility. 
  8. Assists all EMT paramedics in efficient advance life support care system. 
  9. Performs direct illness/injury assessment, provides basic emergency pre-hospital patient care to the ill and injured prior to and during ambulance transfer, and transfer of information to receiving facility.
    1. Maintains operational and functional readiness of ambulance unit, medical and other equipment, to ensure continuum of emergency services. 
  10. Works closely with communications officers, field supervisors, emergency department and other hospital personnel, the police department the fire dep’t., and other individuals, to deliver basic emergency and non-emergency medical services to the general public. 
  11. Respond to calls from communications dispatcher, use appropriate radio communication skills, use most expeditious route with the goal to locate the patient needing emergency services in the shortest response time possible.
  12. Assists in lifting, carrying, transporting patient to ambulance and on to a medical facility, reassuring patients and bystanders, avoiding mishandling patient and undue haste, and to provide additional emergency care following established protocols. 
  13. Follow established departmental policies, procedures and objectives, continuous quality improvement objectives, and safety, environmental, and/or infection control standards in the performance of duties.
    1. Inspect and clean ambulance and equipments; to review and restock all medical equipment to ensure their completeness and operational readiness at all times, in consultation and collaboration with field supervisor, and in compliance with safety and infection control regulations and standards. 
  14. Conducts scene size-up.
  15. Conduct primary and secondary patient examinations.
  16. Take and record vital signs.
  17. Utilize non-invasive diagnostic devices.
    1. Properly use of oropharyngeal & nasopharyngeal airway devices.
  18. Open and maintain airway by positioning the patient’s head.
  19. Provide CPR & rescue breathing for infant, children, and adults.
  20. Provide care for soft tissue injuries and control bleeding through direct pressure.
  21. Provide care for suspected fractures.
  22. Immobilization using spinal board, cervical collar, and splints.
  23. Calm down the victim’s family members.
  24. Ventilate with a non-invasive positive pressure delivery device.
  25. Provide care for suspected shock patients
  26. Perform blood glucose monitoring.
  27. Administer Epinephrine Auto Injector only for anaphylaxis or automatic injection device for anaphylaxis.
  28. Administer aspirin for suspected myocardial infarction.
  29. Operate bag valve mask device with reservoir.
  30. Perform cardiac defibrillation with an automatic external defibrillator.
  31. Perform upper air way suctioning.
    1. Understands the use of body substance isolation.
  32. Understands basic medical-legal principles.
  33. Functions within only the scope of care as defined by state, region and local regulatory agencies.
  34. Complies with regulations on the handling of the deceased, notifies authorities and arranges for protection of property and evidence at the scene.
  35. Determine that the vehicle is in proper mechanical condition.
  36. Maintains familiarity with specialized equipment used by service.
  37. Attends continuing education and refresher training programs.
  38. Complete a clear and accurate pre-hospital emergency care report from all patient contacts and provide copy of the report to the senior EMT.
  39. Perform Cardiac monitoring-3 Lead.
  40. Administer Medication via Intramuscular, Intranasal, Intravenous and via Nebulizer.
  41. Insert Intravenous Cannula and administer Crystalloids. 

Qualifications

  1. A Valid DOH License/ Exam passed as EMT in Abu Dhabi.
  2. Graduate of internationally recognized EMT – Basic course or equivalent with minimum 4 weeks (6 Weeks) duration and valid BLS Certification & PHTLS.

  4. Currently licensed in country of origin and with DOH license to practice in Abu Dhabi, UAE. 
  5. Excellent communication skills in English is Mandatory, Knowledge in Arabic language will be desirable but not necessary.
  6. Preference to candidate with UAE driving License.

Surgical technologists,  also called operating room technicians, assist  in surgical operations under the supervision of surgeons, anesthetists, registered nurses, or other surgical personnel. Surgical technologists are members of operating room teams, which most commonly include surgeons, anesthesiologists, and circulating nurses

Responsibilities

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  1. To assist in preparing the room for surgery
  2. Responsible for having surgical instruments, sterile bandages and linens, needed fluids, and other equipment ready for the operation. 
  3. To assist doctors by handing them the needed instruments during surgery and for supply of equipments and readiness of equipments and supply of drugs to Anesthetist. 
  4. Delivering specimens to hospital laboratories for analysis, and after operations they take patients to the recovery room and ensure safe transfer of patient from operating room to ward or other unit.
  5. Keep abreast of the progress of and knowledge to maintain the highest standard of professional competence.

OSH  ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

General:

  1. Responsible to be familiarize, comply and implement the OSHAD-SF& NMCSH Al Ain Internal OSHMS policies and procedures/SOP’s relevant to their department.
  2. Staff should notify/report all OSHMS hazards, incidents, accidents and near misses within the premises of NMCSH Al Ain to their supervisor or department OSH Facilitator as per the incident reporting protocol of NMCSH Al Ain.
  3. Staff are responsible to assist with the preparation of departmental risk assessment activities and implement the control measure within the timeframe.
  4. Staff are responsible to attend applicable department OSHMS training.
  5. Staff are not allowed to tamper or misuse any NMCSH Al Ain equipment’s and its property.
  6. Comply with all OSH instructions, safe working procedures and signages within the premises of NMCSH-Al Ain.
  7. Be familiar with emergency and evacuation procedure.
  8. Not willfully or recklessly endanger anyone’s health and safety;
  9. Make proper use of all machinery, tools, substances, etc., safety systems and of all Personal Protective Equipment provided for use at work.
  10. Participate in required OSH inspection, audit and OSH monitoring programs.

Specific:

  1. Comply with OSHAD, DOH, FNAR and NMCSH policy/procedures related to Radiation/Laser Safety.
  2. Display commitment for limiting the radiation exposure by wearing appropriate PPE (E.g. Lead Apron) during radiation/laser procedures.

QUALIFICATION, LICENSURE, EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE, SPECIAL  SKILLS

Nurse Specific Responsibilities:

  • Adhere to Proper Manual Handling Techniques – Consistently apply safe manual handling practices in all patient care activities to minimize the risk of injury to oneself and patients.

  • Reduce Slip, Trip, and Fall Hazards – Actively mitigate risks of slips, trips, and falls by maintaining a clear and hazard-free environment, wearing supportive, non-slip footwear, and promptly removing obstacles from walkways.
  • Ensure Equipment Safety and Report Malfunctions – Verify that all equipment used in patient care is in safe working condition before each use. Promptly report any malfunctions or safety concerns according to facility protocols.
  • Initiate Emergency, Safety, and Fire Safety Protocols as Needed – Follow established protocols for emergency situations, including safety practices and fire safety measures, and respond to incidents in accordance with OSH and hospital guidelines.

  • Performs patient assessment using appropriate, problem-focused, and age-specific assessment techniques.

  • Completes yearly, the critical care nursing competencies (basic).

  • Performs wound dressing and changes within the scope of practice.

  • Assists in mesotherapy procedures
  • Performs HydraFacial treatment within the scope of practice.

Laser Technician:

  • Maintains a safe environment/area during the operation of a LASER.
  • Performs LASER as per certification, competency or licensing and as outlined in duties.
  • Reports to the Supervisor immediately when a change in condition or practices may lead to potential hazards.
  • Reports potential exposure incidents and accidents to the Supervisor and the Employee Health nurse.
  • Ensures reflective surfaces are covered adequately to avoid unintended laser reflections.
  • Ensures patient informed consent is obtained and the patient is given a copy of the safety instructions.

  • Degree in Nursing (minimum two (2) years course duration) and Registration as a Registered Nurse from Canada, USA, UK, Ireland, South Africa, New Zealand, and Australia

This position is responsible for planning, organizing, directing and evaluating the Nursing Informatics efforts at CCAD across the continuum of care. Assumes responsibility for the design and development, implementation and ongoing administration of nursing information systems for the Chief Nursing Officer. Provides consultation to the CNO department regarding recommendations for improvements related to informatics and clinical practice. Oversees all projects related to clinical information systems and serves as nursing liaison to IT. Works with key stakeholders to integrate electronic applications into CCAD operations in order to provide quality care and cost efficient services which are aligned with CCAD priorities.

POSITION DIMENSIONS

Reports directly to Director, Nursing Education and Professional Development

Reports indirectly to Executive Director of Nursing Operations

ROLE INTERACTS DIRECTLY WITH

TITLE/DEPARTMENT

FREQUENCY

TYPE OF INTERACTION

Nursing Institute

Regularly/As needed

KEY DECISIONS THE ROLE MAKES AND THE EXTENT OF THE IMPACT OF THE DECISION

How to integrate IT solutions into nursing practice, whether the solution be an improvement to current practice or new to the hospital. Impact could be as broad as hospital wide or as local as improving individual experiences.

PRIMARY JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

PROFESSIONAL KNOWLEDGE

  • Collaborates and partners with CCAD leaders and key stakeholders in identifying and implementing innovative models and best practices within clinical informatics.
  • Provides facility vision, leadership and technical advice related to clinical applications, process and workflow design, data management and related processes.
  • Provides strategic and tactical leadership to manage the impact of changes on clinical applications on the delivery of patient care and member services, including escalating change requests, planning upgrades, facilitating planned downtime, communicating changes to end users and leadership, and translating impacts and training needs to Nurse Education for training purposes.
  • Advocates use of clinical applications and directs development and implementation of changes to EPIC to improve quality, care experience, and efficiency across the continuum of care.
  • Manages clinical applications to achieve a high level of customer satisfaction w/ emphasis on customer service and highest standards of quality and innovation.
  • Develops plans and implementation for new and revised information systems, ensures communication among employees, and facilitates adherence to established programs and policies
  • Coordinates and facilitates on-going clinical application evaluation including: user accuracy, data integrity, and system reliability.
  • Develops and implements action plans as needed to support user accuracy, data integrity and system reliability.
  • Participates in change evaluation and supports users in maintaining changed processes. Participates in the process of seeking methods for improvement of patient care and controlling costs for rendering care through the use of information technology.
  • Serves as a liaison between operations and other teams to communicate and facilitate system modification to meet user needs.
  • Serves as a nursing informatics resource to individuals and teams throughout the facility.
  • Identifies and resolves workflow issues through analyzing workflows, rounding on units, and conducting ad-hoc training, and ensuring appropriate utilization of clinical applications.

ROLE LEVEL ACCOUNTABILITIES

  • Adheres to CCAD’s standards as they appear in the Code of Conduct and Conflict of Interest policies

In view of the evolving needs and opportunities within CCAD, this position may be required to perform other duties as assigned and reporting relationships may vary.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS AND WORK ENVIRONMENT

Typical physical demands include: a high degree of manual dexterity to sufficiently perform computer functions on a keyboard, produce materials on a PC and operate basic office equipment, normal or corrected vision and hearing, extensive sitting, standing and/or walking, mobility sufficient to visit with departments or employees throughout CCAD and lift up to 12 Kg

ORGANIZATION-WIDE COMPETENCY ASSESSMENT REQUIREMENTS

All employees will embrace the CCAD mission, vision and values and be responsible for adhering to the core values of the institution, including: Patient’s First, Collaboration, Mutual Respect, Quality, Patient Safety, Integrity, Cultural Sensitivity and Compassion.

All employees are also expected to meet the standards of performance outlined in the Organization-Wide Competencies listed below as applied to the position.

  • Customer Service Orientation includes attitude, behavior, interpersonal skill and problem solving that enable an employee to respond to internal and external customer needs and expectations in a positive manner. Adaptability including teamwork, flexibility needed to fulfill job responsibilities, adapting to changes in work environment and accepting supervisory feedback. Efficiency and Effectiveness includes quantity and quality of desired work, as well as organization skills necessary to perform successfully. Essential Job Requirements includes adherence to all relevant policies, procedures and guidelines affecting the work environment, as well as maintenance of required competencies and communication skills. Managerial Responsibilities includes overall accountability for assigned work group relative to operational goals, personnel requirements and budgetary constraints.

QUALIFICATION & EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS

ESSENTIAL

Education

  • Bachelors Degree in Nursing, IT or healthcare related field is required
  • Master’s Degree in Nursing or IT is preferred

Experience

  • Minimum of 4 years of informatics experience in a health care environment is required.
  • Demonstrated knowledge and skills in allied health management
  • Demonstrated knowledge and skills in quality improvement and patient safety
  • Demonstrated knowledge and skills in clinical research & evidence implementation.
  • Desiging EPIC interactions and workflows

Certification and Licensure

  • Valid and current national license is required
  • BLS is required from AHA or an equivalent organization, or must be obtained within 3 months of employment
  • ACLS, PALS relevant to area of specialty is required, from AHA or an equivalent organization; or must obtain within 6 months of employment
  • EPIC certification

Job Specific Skills and Abilities

  • Strong organizational, collaboration and time management skills
  • Ability to effectively communicate and/or make presentations to a large, diverse audience
  • Ability to speak and write in English is required
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, Excel, EPIC required

Job Description:

As a member of the Microbiology Quality Control team, you will be responsible for conducting a range of microbiological tests to ensure compliance with regulatory and internal quality standards. Your key responsibilities will include:

Microbiological Testing & Analysis:

  • Perform testing of sterile samples including Sterility, LBPC (Limulus-Based Pyrogen Test), and BET (Bacterial Endotoxin Test) with proper documentation.
  • Conduct testing of non-sterile samples, such as Microbial Limit Test (MLT) and Bioburden, along with accurate record-keeping.
  • Perform microbiology assay testing and document results in compliance with GMP.
  • Carry out microbiology culture testing including maintenance, sub-culturing, Growth Promotion Testing (GPT), and microbial identification.

Water & Environmental Testing:

  • Perform water testing, release analysis, and related documentation.
  • Conduct environmental monitoring in classified areas across Julphar production plants and microbiology labs, ensuring accurate and timely documentation.

Lab Support Activities:

  • Execute various microbiology lab support activities including equipment monitoring, cleaning validations, and media preparation.
  • Monitor equipment and area temperatures using Vaisala/SIRIUS systems.
  • Ensure real-time documentation and compliance for all assigned tasks.
  • Handle sample and result entries, reservation creation, and notification processes in SAP.

Compliance & Documentation:

  • Adhere strictly to Good Laboratory Practices (GLP), Data Integrity, and Good Documentation Practices (GDP).
  • Prepare and review Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and support microbiology-related qualification/validation documentation.
  • Participate in internal and external audits and promptly report any deviations, OOS (Out of Specification), OOL (Out of Limit), or excursions.
  • Manage documentation and deviation handling through eQMS (Amplelogic system).

Safety & Best Practices:

  • Follow all safety protocols and ensure a clean and compliant laboratory environment.
  • Ensure full compliance with company policies, GMP, and regulatory guidelines.

Core Competencies:

  • Strong sense of accountability and ownership
  • Highly disciplined, motivated, and well-organized
  • Excellent process compliance and implementation skills
  • Effective time and task management
  • Proficient English communication skills (verbal and written)

Qualifications & Functional Knowledge:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Microbiology or other Biological Sciences
  • 4–6 years of relevant experience in a pharmaceutical microbiology lab (preferably in sterile and non-sterile product testing)
  • Proficient in computer applications including MS Word, Excel, and PowerPoint
  • Familiarity with SAP, eQMS (Amplelogic), and temperature monitoring systems like Vaisala/SIRIUS is a plus

The Staff Nurse will adhere to and promote the Professional Nurses Code of Conduct for Abu Dhabi and UAE.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Assessment and Diagnosis: Collects and analyzes assessment data to determine diagnosis/issues:

 Assesses comprehensive data including but not limited to physical, psychosocial, emotional, cognitive, and spiritual needs and interprets assessment information to derive the diagnosis or issues as defined by the patient’s condition.

 Uses evidence-based assessment techniques and instruments in collecting data and validates the diagnosis or issue with the patient, family and healthcare team members as appropriate.

 Prioritizes the data and information collected based on patient’s immediate condition or anticipated needs and identifies potential risks or barriers to the patient’s health or safety.

 Documents the data and information collected in compliance with established guidelines and reflective of the needs of the patient.

  • Planning and Outcomes Identification: Identifies expected outcomes and develops a plan that address health promotion, health restoration and health maintenance to attain expected outcomes.

 Involves patient, family and healthcare team members in formulating a culturally appropriate individualized plan of care.

 Applies evidence-based nursing practices in developing the individualized plan of care to attain expected outcomes and continuity of care.

 Modifies the individualized plan of care according to the ongoing assessment and reevaluation of the patient’s response, status, and outcome indicators.

 Documents the expected outcomes as measurable goals in a manner that uses standardized language or recognized terminology.

  • Implementation and Coordination of Care Delivery:

 Implements the plan of care in partnership with the patient, family and healthcare team members in a timely manner utilizing evidence-based interventions and treatments specific to the needs of the patient.

 Performs treatments and procedures according to established procedural guidelines and protocols.

 Administers medications according to organization policies and procedures.

 Ensures that all components of the individualized plan of care, including modifications, are documented in the patient’s health record.

 Communicates relevant information across all levels of care and organizations.

 Demonstrates a working knowledge of resource consumption and practices within a costeffective framework.

  • Health teaching and health promotion:

 Utilizes teaching strategies appropriate to the individual patient’s condition and learning needs.

 Uses health promotion to support patients and families in developing skills that promote, maintain, or restore healthy lifestyles and self-management support.

 Seeks opportunities for feedback and evaluation of the effectiveness of the strategies used, including teach back.

 Ensures that all components of the health education, relevant to the clinical condition, is documented in the patient health record.

  • Evaluation: Evaluates progress toward attainment of outcomes.

 Evaluates the patient/family’s understanding of and response to the plan of care.

 Utilizes systematic and ongoing assessment data to revise nursing diagnoses, outcomes, and the plan of care.

 Involves the patient, family and healthcare team members in the evaluation process.

 Provides a comprehensive clinical handover/report as required to ensure patient safety.

 Attends patient care rounds, communicates, and updates the attending healthcare provider on changes in the patient’s condition.

 Communicates with the patient care team about ongoing changes in patient’s plan of care and unit activity

 Documents the reassessment of patient status; patient and family participation and understanding; and the rationale for any revision in the plan of care.

  • Evidence-based Practice and Research: Integrates evidence and research findings into practice.

 Utilizes current evidence-based nursing knowledge, including research findings, to guide and evaluate practice.

 Participates in evidence-based and research activities at various levels appropriate to the nurse’s level of education and position.

 Shares evidence-based and research findings with healthcare team members.

 Participates in performance improvement projects for the evaluation and improvement of clinical practice

  • Leadership: Demonstrates leadership behaviors in practice settings, across the profession, and in the community.

 Functions as a professional role model promoting a positive, team-based, organized, and safe work environment.

 Coordinates and supervises delegated activities to assure completion and serve as a resource for other healthcare team members

 Demonstrates critical thinking in priority setting and decision making in response to patient needs.

 Pursues informal and formal leadership opportunities

 Participates actively in organizational shared decision-making situations that improve the nursing practice, organizational performance, and outcomes.

 Supervises practical nurses and junior staff and student nurses to ensure the provision of safe and effective patient care.

Accountabilities

  • Applies the principles of professional codes of ethics that ensure individual rights in all areas of Practice:
  • Maintains a professional and therapeutic nurse-patient relationship and serves as a patient advocate assisting patients and families in developing skills for self-advocacy.
  • Speaks up to question healthcare practices as appropriate for safety and quality improvement.

Position Overview:

The ABA Therapist at an Early Intervention Center will provide individualized therapy services to children with disabilities, using evidence-based techniques to support the development of critical skills, reduce maladaptive behaviors, and improve overall functioning. The ideal candidate will have to be fluent in both Arabic and English to effectively communicate directly with children, their families, and interdisciplinary teams to ensure effective treatment plans and monitor progress over time.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Therapy Implementation

  • Deliver individualized ABA therapy programs to children with a variety of disabilities (e.g., autism spectrum disorder, developmental delays).
  • Implement behavior intervention plans (BIPs) based on assessments and treatment goals.
  • Teach skills in areas such as communication, socialization, daily living, academic tasks, and motor skills using ABA techniques like discrete trial training (DTT), natural environment teaching (NET), and reinforcement strategies.

2. Progress Monitoring:

  • Collect and record data on each child’s progress according to treatment plans.
  • Track behavioral data, skill acquisition data, and other relevant measurements to monitor outcomes.
  • Prepare progress reports and assist in the analysis of the data to adjust therapy approaches as needed.

3. Collaboration:

  • Work closely with a multidisciplinary team, including other therapists, psychologists, and educators, to ensure holistic care for children.
  • Engage with families to provide updates, share strategies, and ensure consistency of interventions at home.
  • Support and educate parents in reinforcing the skills learned during therapy sessions at home.

4. Behavioral Support:

  • Provide intervention to reduce challenging behaviors such as aggression, self-injury, tantrums, or non-compliance.
  • Use positive behavior support techniques to encourage the development of more adaptive and functional behaviors.

5. Training and Development:

  • Participate in ongoing professional development to stay up-to-date with the latest research and best practices in ABA therapy.
  • Train and mentor other team members if necessary, in ABA therapy practices.

6. Reporting and Documentation:

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of therapy sessions, progress, and behavioral incidents.
  • Complete and submit regular reports on children’s progress to supervisors, parents, and other professionals involved.

Education and Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Psychology, Special Education, Behavior Analysis, or a related field (ABA certification preferred).
  • RBT (Registered Behavior Technician) certification, BCaBA (Board Certified Assistant Behavior Analyst), or BCBA (Board Certified Behavior Analyst) certification is highly preferred.
  • Fluency in Arabic and English (both written and spoken).
  • Certificate of Equivalency from Ministry of Education, UAE is mandatory.
  • Proven experience in implementing ABA therapy programs for children with disabilities, particularly autism spectrum disorder (ASD).
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build rapport with children, families, and colleagues.
  • Interested Candidates may send their resumes to recruitment@starzuae.com.
