Medical Advisor, R&I, Gulf

AstraZeneca is a global, science-led, patient-focused biopharmaceutical company that focuses on the discovery, development, and commercialisation of prescription medicines for some of the world’s most serious diseases. But we’re more than one of the world’s leading pharmaceutical companies.

Role Summary

A hybrid role (at least 50% in the field), Medical Advisor provides scientific expertise in highly strategic therapeutic area and builds/ maintains AZ scientific leadership. The role involves working extensively with external stakeholders to forge strong relations and foster scientific and strategic partnerships with major hospitals and institutions/ authorities in their assigned territory and non-traditional stakeholders (E.g. policy and decision makers, payer groups, government researchers and others) to help bridge the gaps, strengthen healthcare ecosystem, improve treatment outcomes that enable patient access to quality care.

Medical Advisor provides strategic inputs and is involved in the development of brand/ medical strategy and LCM and takes the lead in the design and implementation of medical activities aligned with Strategy. The role exerts therapeutic area leadership with cross-functional team with particular attention to decision on transforming care. The role also involves other internal responsibilities such as delivery of medical education and clinical support to medical professionals, training sales teams and acts as a buddy for new Medical Science Liaison (MSL) and mentor for existing MSLs by providing operational and compliance guidance based on Global/ Local standards.

The role may take responsibility as reviewer for activities and promotional materials and may lead Medical Information and Pharmacovigilance within a particular market.

What You’ll Do

Design and deliver Medical strategic plan

  • Work closely with Medical Affairs Leadership and cross functional teams to provide inputs to medical and brand strategies.
  • With strong understanding of the market and healthcare systems. Identify opportunities and initiate discussion of potential strategic, scalable, and sustainable clinical practice transformation initiatives that can impact on patient access to quality care.
  • Develop and implement KEE engagement plan in collaboration with Medical Affairs Leadership.
  • Develop and implement pre-launch medical plan/ activities for new products at least 2 years prior to planned launch in the country to address key clinical and scientific challenges.
  • Act a strategic partner of brand team on life cycle management plan and actions.
  • Leverage technology, available data or dashboards to drive data-driven decisions to support internal discussions and external engagements.
  • Collect, share and provide inputs on field and external stakeholder insights and perspectives in medical and brand internal strategic discussions and communicate internally on actionable items as appropriate.
  • Ensures own knowledge of best practices and new relevant developments are kept up to date and communicates with medical team, and cross functional team as appropriate.

Build, enhance, and maintain advocacy of Key External Experts (KEEs)

  • Identify, prioritize, and expand KEEs to include non-traditional stakeholders (E.g. policy and decision makers, payer groups, government, researchers, and others) based on scientific/clinical expertise and practice change influence within a specific hospital and institution/ authorities, and engage in robust scientific discussions and medical advancements in a balanced, objective, and accurate way.
  • Identify, and prioritize accounts based on patient care pathway and map the multidisciplinary team and maturity.
  • Provide AZ with an understanding of the local medical community, clinical practice trends, HCP insight and real or perceived gaps in current scientific knowledge, patient journey, and disease management.
  • Foster scientific partnerships with KEEs to help advance disease understanding and to achieve evidence-based changes in medical practice that are consistent with Medical Affairs strategy & objectives, such as:
  • Interact in the field with the medical community in the context of various medical projects such as clinical trials, Non-Interventional Studies, Investigator Sponsored Studies (ISSs), scientific exchange.
  • Identify potential speakers and train speakers as appropriate for local events.
  • Lead/ co-lead the planning and execution of advisory board meetings.
  • Present scientific data to HCPs in both group (Medically led meetings) and one on one setting.
  • Facilitate continuing medical education events for HCPs.
  • Support evidence generation in the region aligned with the medical strategy of disease area and brand.

Build and implement scientific programs and partnerships to address unmet medical needs in priority disease area(s)

  • Collect and share actionable insights that enhance the value and appropriate use of AZ products and disease management to internal stakeholders.
  • Lead in strategic planning meetings and medical-scientific presentations with medication access stakeholders, institutional decision makers and other external stakeholders to drive better clinical decisions and enhance medication accessibility within the assigned hospital or institution. These discussions are scientific in nature and must be clearly separated from promotional and/ or other business discussions.
  • Organize and facilitate scientific events on healthcare institutions and their multi-disciplinary teams related to the therapeutic area to ensure holistic approach to patient care within their hospital and institution.
  • Embed a comprehensive healthcare system and patient experience understanding in prioritized hospitals and institutions to transform care and improve patient outcomes.
  • Support Clinical team in the selection of appropriate investigators and sites to optimize quality and delivery.
  • Collaborate with KEEs on study proposals (ESR or Local Study), including study design and feasibility, and/ or publication of interest to AZ.

Act as scientific expert in priority disease area for internal stakeholders and mentor to other Medical Affairs team members

  • Demonstrate expertise and knowledge of AZ products, emerging therapies, competitors, patient and treatment trends, clinical trials, and scientific activities within the disease area and continuously updates this expertise and knowledge.
  • Provide the AZ internal stakeholders with an understanding of the local medical community, clinical practice, trends and real or perceived gaps in current scientific knowledge and medical treatment options/ guidelines through periodic therapeutic area and product trainings.
  • Provide scientific support at AZ sponsored educational events.
  • Co-lead and execute regional medical activities during the product launch processes.
  • Support and provide advice to a team of MSLs to ensure excellence in execution of role and activities and compliance to local and global standards.

Corporate responsibility and Medical Information and Governance

  • Review activities and materials to ensure compliance with internal policies and procedures.
  • Respond to unsolicited requests for information about unapproved AZ products or unapproved uses of approved products, presenting such information in an objective, well balanced, substantiated manner that is scientific in tone and content, free of promotional messages, truthful, and is not misleading.
  • Demonstrate appropriate response and documents the provision of accurate, scientific data in response to unsolicited scientific questions posed by healthcare providers with Company Policies, and applicable laws, regulations, and ethical standards.
  • May lead in the management of medical information and pharmacovigilance within a particular market.
  • Ensure compliance with AZ Code of Ethics, corporate governance, audit requirements, guidelines, industry codes, policies and procedures, and discloses potential breach.
  • Ensure that company confidentiality is maintained (i.e. intellectual property, product, strategic and salary information)
  • Ensure that all conducted activities are done in accordance with local legislation and corporate standards.
  • Report health/ environment/ wellbeing related accidents, adverse events, and conflict of interest as per respective procedures and on a timely manner.

Essential For The Role

  • Bachelor’s degree in medicine or pharmacy is required
  • Post-graduate master’s degree is an advantage
  • Minimum of 2 years of solid and consistent performance in Medical Affairs role
  • Strategic and scientific mindset
  • Successful experience of driving cross-functional projects
  • Extensive experience in relationship and stakeholder management
  • Extensive knowledge of the latest technical and regulatory developments
  • Excellence Communication, Influence, Planning and Organizational skills
  • Excellent Scientific knowledge
  • Ability to develop strategic partnerships

Desirable for the role

  • Respiratory and Immunology experience.
  • Acts independently, is willing to take on challenges, and can say no to stakeholders when necessary
  • Sets high standards of work and makes others accountable for achieving outstanding performance

Why AstraZeneca?

At AstraZeneca we’re dedicated to being a Great Place to Work. Where you are empowered to push the boundaries of science and unleash your entrepreneurial spirit. There’s no better place to make a difference to medicine, patients, and society. An inclusive culture that champions diversity and collaboration, and always committed to lifelong learning, growth, and development. We’re on an exciting journey to pioneer the future of healthcare.

So, what’s next?

  • Are you already imagining yourself joining our team? Good, because we can’t wait to hear from you.
  • Are you ready to bring new ideas and fresh thinking to the table? Brilliant! We have one seat available, and we hope it’s yours.

Position: Senior Consultant – Obstetrics & Gynecology

Department: Women’s Health

Location: Military Medical City Hospital (MMCH), Qatar

Reports To: Head of Women’s Health / Chief Medical Officer

The Senior Consultant in Obstetrics & Gynecology is responsible for delivering high-level consultant-led care across the full spectrum of women’s health services, with particular expertise in advanced gynecology, minimally invasive surgery, and robotic-assisted procedures.

The role includes clinical leadership, surgical excellence, mentorship of junior physicians, and contribution to service development within a governmental tertiary-care setting.

Key Responsibilities

1. Clinical Care

  • Provide comprehensive obstetric and gynecologic care.
  • Manage complex gynecologic and high-risk obstetric cases.
  • Participate in consultant on-call coverage.
  • Ensure adherence to evidence-based clinical practice.

2. Advanced Surgical Practice

  • Perform advanced minimally invasive gynecologic procedures, including: Laparoscopic hysterectomy, Myomectomy, Endometriosis surgery, Ovarian cystectomy, Pelvic reconstructive procedures.
  • Perform and/or lead robotic-assisted gynecologic surgeries.
  • Support development and expansion of the robotic surgery program.
  • Implement standardized surgical pathways and ERAS protocols.

3. Leadership & Mentorship

  • Supervise and mentor Specialists and Junior Consultants.
  • Lead multidisciplinary case discussions.
  • Participate in clinical audits, morbidity & mortality reviews.
  • Support teaching and CME activities.

4. Quality & Governance

  • Ensure compliance with Qatar MoPH (DHP) licensing requirements.
  • Maintain high standards of documentation.
  • Contribute to accreditation and quality improvement initiatives.
  • Promote patient safety and risk management practices.

5. Service Development

  • Contribute to strategic growth of Women’s Health services.
  • Collaborate with anesthesia, neonatology, and surgical teams to optimize outcomes.
  • Participate in service line planning and performance monitoring.

Qualifications

  • Medical Degree (MBBS / MD or equivalent).
  • Recognized Board Certification in Obstetrics & Gynecology.
  • Fellowship or advanced training in Minimally Invasive Gynecologic Surgery (MIGS) and/or Robotic Surgery.
  • Minimum 8–10 years post-board clinical experience.
  • Documented surgical logbook demonstrating advanced laparoscopic and robotic procedures.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Arabic-speaking.
  • Experience in tertiary-care or governmental hospital settings.
  • Previous leadership experience (Unit Lead / Deputy HOD / Program Lead).
  • Academic or research involvement.
  • International fellowship (European / American / German Board preferred).

Core Competencies

  • Advanced surgical expertise in laparoscopy and robotics.
  • Strong clinical judgment in complex cases.
  • Leadership and team management skills.
  • Commitment to evidence-based medicine.
  • Effective communication skills (Arabic & English preferred).
  • Patient-centered care approach.

The physician will oversee occupational health services for clinical and non-clinical staff, ensuring compliance with Qatar Ministry of Public Health regulations and international occupational health standards.   • Assess fitness for duty for healthcare and administrative staff.
  • Manage occupational injuries, exposures, and work-related illnesses.

  • Provide vaccination programs and immunity verification for staff.

  • Establish and manage the Staff Health Clinic operations.
  • Develop clinical protocols aligned with occupational health standards.
  • Maintain confidential employee health records.

  • Support ergonomic assessments and workplace adaptation.

  • Qatar MoPH regulations
  • International occupational health standards
  • Hospital accreditation requirements (JCI / equivalent)
  • Maintain documentation and reporting for internal and external audits.

5. Health Promotion & Education

  • Develop staff wellness programs.
  • Conduct awareness sessions on workplace safety and prevention.
  • Promote mental health and burnout prevention initiatives.

Qualifications

  • Medical Degree (MBBS / MD or equivalent).
  • Board Certification or Fellowship in Occupational Medicine.
  • Valid license or eligibility for licensure with Qatar MoPH (DHP).
  • Minimum 5 years’ experience in occupational health, preferably within a hospital or healthcare setting.

  • Experience in governmental or military healthcare settings.

Core Competencies

  • Strong regulatory and compliance knowledge.
  • Excellent documentation and reporting skills.

  • Strong communication skills (Arabic & English preferred).

The Field Doctor Lead is responsible for conducting on-site hospital visits to medically assess inpatient cases and evaluate the clinical justification for admissions and admission extensions. The role focuses on ensuring medical necessity, optimizing length of stay, supporting timely and safe discharges, and generating measurable cost savings for the TPA and its clients.

What You Do

Clinical Review & Case Assessment

  • Review inpatient cases extracted from the system according to defined roving and case selection criteria.
  • Conduct on-site hospital visits to assess the medical necessity of admissions and requested extensions of stay.
  • Evaluate diagnosis, treatment plans, investigations, progress notes, and clinical outcomes against medical guidelines and policy coverage.
  • Determine whether continued hospitalization is clinically justified or if alternative care or discharge is appropriate.

Hospital Coordination & Communication

  • Liaise professionally with treating physicians, nursing staff, and hospital administration to discuss case status and recommendations.
  • Provide clear, evidence-based medical opinions while maintaining positive provider relationships.
  • Support alignment between clinical best practice, policy terms, and cost-effective care.

Reporting & Documentation

  • Prepare and submit comprehensive medical roving reports, including findings, recommendations, and outcomes.
  • Clearly document decisions related to admission continuation, discharge, or alternative management plans.
  • Ensure accurate, timely, and complete documentation in line with internal policies and regulatory requirements.

Discharge Optimization & Cost Containment .

  • Actively contribute to early and appropriate discharge planning where clinically safe.
  • Recommend step-down care, outpatient management, or home care when applicable.

Clinical Duties:

  • Provides specialist clinical psychological assessments and diagnosis for patients referred to the team based upon the appropriate use, interpretation and integration of complex psychological data from a variety of sources including psychological and neuropsychological tests, self-report measures, rating scales, direct and indirect structured observations and semi-structured interviews with patients, family members and others involved in the patient’s care.
  • Provides clinical formulations and comprehensive written reports regarding assessments completed or tests administered.
  • Provides specialized clinical psychological input to the patients including assessment results and proposed clinical psychological interventions for psychological, behavioral and learning challenges. Implements plans for the formal clinical psychological treatment and/or management of a psychological problems, based upon an appropriate conceptual framework of the problems, and employing methods of proven efficacy, across the full range of care settings.
  • Implements a range of clinical psychological interventions, adjusting and refining psychological formulations drawing upon different explanatory models and maintaining a number of provisional hypotheses.
  • Provide evidence-based interventions.
  • Evaluates and makes decisions about treatment options taking into account both theoretical and therapeutic models and highly complex factors concerning historical and developmental processes that have shaped the individual.
  • Reviews relevant medical records to understand cases better.
  • Provides specialist clinical psychological advice, guidance and consultation to other professionals contributing directly to patient’s formulation, diagnosis and treatment plan.
  • Provides individual group therapy in variety of settings as needed. Makes sure that patient and family participation and input is integrated with the overall treatment plan.

Roles and Responsibilities

Basic Purpose of the role:

The Case Management Manager is responsible for leading and overseeing care management services to ensure the coordination of healthcare access and continuity of care for beneficiaries, particularly high-risk patients and those requiring complex or extended treatment.

The role ensures the effective implementation and monitoring of evidence-based clinical practice guidelines, supports timely and appropriate care delivery, and oversees the management of approvals for additional services and treatment extensions for inpatients in alignment with regulatory and payer requirements.

This position requires a qualified healthcare professional with a minimum of five years of clinical experience, capable of ensuring compliance with applicable Council of Health Insurance standards and organizational policies while enhancing patient outcomes and overall beneficiary experience.

Key responsibilities of the role

Managerial/Administration:

  • Lead the implementation and improvement of case management protocols within the Rehabilitation and Long-Term Care department.
  • Develop and implement policies and procedures related to case management and care coordination in alignment with hospital standards and regulatory requirements.
  • Collaborate with the finance department to manage cost control, insurance pre-authorizations, and reimbursement processes.
  • Ensure accurate documentation of patientcare plans, discharge summaries, and case management records.
  • Participate in budget planning and resource allocation specific to rehabilitation and long-term care services.
  • Oversee the development of individualized care plans that align with medical, psychological, and social needs of long-term and rehabilitative patients.
  • Act as a liaison between patients, families, physicians, nursing, allied health professionals, and external care agencies.
  • Supervise a multidisciplinary team of case coordinators, social workers, and administrative support personnel.

Technical:

  • Lead and oversee the assessment and evaluation of patients clinical, functional, and psychosocial needs upon admission, throughout hospitalization, and at discharge to ensure the development and implementation of individualized, multidisciplinary care plans in collaboration with physicians, nurses, therapists, and social workers.
  • Ensure effective coordination of healthcare services for ensured beneficiaries in compliance with applicable regulatory and payer requirements.
  • Oversee the coordination of access to care and continuity of care for high-risk patients and individuals requiring complex or extended treatment plans.
  • Ensure the implementation and monitoring of evidence-based clinical practice guidelines to promote quality, safety, and standardized care delivery.
  • Supervise and coordinate the approval process for additional inpatient services, treatment extensions, and medical necessity reviews in alignment with insurance policies and regulatory standards.
  • Monitor and manage length of stay, utilization patterns, and resource allocation to optimize bed capacity, operational efficiency, and cost-effectiveness while maintaining quality of care.
  • Coordinate closely with insurance providers, Revenue Cycle Management, and billing departments to facilitate timely authorizations, approvals, and reimbursement processes.
  • Participate in and contribute to clinical audits, utilization reviews, risk management activities, and continuous quality improvement initiatives related to rehabilitation and long-term care services.
  • Ensure accurate documentation, compliance tracking, and reporting of case management activities in accordance with Council of Health Insurance standards and organizational policies.
  • Perform additional tasks and duties as assigned, within the scope of the individual’s knowledge, skills, and abilities.

Quality & Safety:

  • Ensure adherence to hospital policies, Saudi health regulations, and international best practices for quality and safety in rehabilitation and long-term care.
  • Participate in the development, implementation, and evaluation of quality improvement initiatives and safety protocols.
  • Monitor and report on patient safety incidents, adverse events, and outcomes related to rehabilitation and long-term care services.
  • Conduct regular audits and compliance checks related to case management and care standards.

Education:

  • Advocate for patient rights and ensure culturally sensitive care aligned with Saudi Arabian norms and patient preferences.
  • Educate patients and families on care plans, safety practices, and rehabilitation goals to empower informed decision-making.

Compliance guidelines

Complying with Policies, Procedures and Practices of Facilities and other Regulatory Requirements:

  • Ensure all case management activities align with the hospital’s internal policies, Saudi Ministry of Health regulations, and other relevant healthcare regulatory frameworks (e.g., CBAHI standards).
  • Serve as an advocate for patients’ rights and needs while balancing compliance requirements. Facilitate communication between patients, families, healthcare providers, and insurance companies.
  • Keep updated on local healthcare laws, accreditation requirements, and best practices. Implement necessary changes in processes to meet evolving regulations and standards.

Maintaining Confidentiality:

  • Maintain strict confidentiality of all patient information, adhering to hospital policies, Saudi health data protection laws, and ethical standards. Handle sensitive patient records and communication with utmost discretion.
  • Ensure accurate, timely, and secure documentation of case management activities, interventions, and patient outcomes in compliance with legal and institutional requirements.

Promoting Customer Service Standards:

  • Act as the primary liaison between patients, families, healthcare providers, and hospital departments to address concerns promptly and empathetically, promoting a patient-centered experience.

Adhering to the Occupational Health and Safety, Materials Management and Maintenance Standards:

  • Identify potential safety risks in rehabilitation and long-term care settings and implement appropriate preventative measures.
  • Collaborate with the Maintenance Department to ensure all rehabilitation and long-term care equipment and facilities are well- maintained and functional.

Ensuring Personal Effectiveness:

  • Engage in continuous professional development to stay current with

rehabilitation and long-term care best practices and regulations in Saudi Arabia.

The Staff Nurse is accountable for the coordination of nursing care, including direct patient care, patient/family education and transitions of care. The Staff Nurse supports professional nursing practice across the continuum of care to meet the needs of the patient and family. The Staff Nurse will understand, support and promote the mission, vision and values of SSMC; provides age-appropriate patient care according to the Nursing Scope of Practice as defined by the regulatory body. The Staff Nurse will adhere to and promote the Professional Nurses Code of Conduct for Abu Dhabi and UAE.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Assessment and Diagnosis: Collects and analyzes assessment data to determine diagnosis/issues:

 Assesses comprehensive data including but not limited to physical, psychosocial, emotional, cognitive, and spiritual needs and interprets assessment information to derive the diagnosis or issues as defined by the patient’s condition.

 Uses evidence-based assessment techniques and instruments in collecting data and validates the diagnosis or issue with the patient, family and healthcare team members as appropriate.

 Prioritizes the data and information collected based on patient’s immediate condition or anticipated needs and identifies potential risks or barriers to the patient’s health or safety.

 Documents the data and information collected in compliance with established guidelines and reflective of the needs of the patient.

  • Planning and Outcomes Identification: Identifies expected outcomes and develops a plan that address health promotion, health restoration and health maintenance to attain expected outcomes.

 Involves patient, family and healthcare team members in formulating a culturally appropriate individualized plan of care.

 Applies evidence-based nursing practices in developing the individualized plan of care to attain expected outcomes and continuity of care.

 Modifies the individualized plan of care according to the ongoing assessment and reevaluation of the patient’s response, status, and outcome indicators.

 Documents the expected outcomes as measurable goals in a manner that uses standardized language or recognized terminology.

  • Implementation and Coordination of Care Delivery:

 Implements the plan of care in partnership with the patient, family and healthcare team members in a timely manner utilizing evidence-based interventions and treatments specific to the needs of the patient.

 Performs treatments and procedures according to established procedural guidelines and protocols.

 Administers medications according to organization policies and procedures.

 Ensures that all components of the individualized plan of care, including modifications, are documented in the patient’s health record.

 Communicates relevant information across all levels of care and organizations.

 Demonstrates a working knowledge of resource consumption and practices within a costeffective framework.

  • Health teaching and health promotion:

Provide individualized medical nutrition therapy (MNT) through a multi-disciplinary approach for inpatients and or outpatients in SSMC

MNT is implemented according to the American Dietetic Association (ADA) Nutrition Care Process (NCP), which provides a framework for the Clinical Dietitians to individualize care, taking into account the patient’s needs and values and using the best scientific evidence available to make decisions.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Responsible for Medical Nutrition Therapy (MNT) and thus assess patients using the Nutrition Care Process (NCP) which is a systematic approach to providing high-quality nutrition care. The NCP consists of four distinct, interrelated steps: Nutrition Assessment, Nutrition Diagnosis, Nutrition Intervention, and Nutrition Monitoring and Evaluation.
  • Record all assessments and interventions of all patients as per facility policies and procedures.
  • Discuss and/or refer complex cases to Senior Dietitians/Supervisor for guidance to ensure high- quality evidence based nutrition care.
  • Practicing within the expressed limits of established policies and procedures and approved competencies
  • Liaising with ward and food service staff concerning nutritional care plan, goals and dietary requirements of inpatients on a daily basis.
  • Participate in medical rounds and provide MNT to patients starting at the highest priority level.
  • Active participation in the staff development activities, discharge planning, patient education and other patient care related activities as designated in the approved staff competency privileges.
  • Contributing to the Quality Improvement Projects of the Department/hospital where appropriate.
  • Communicates individual nutritional care plans to other health care providers as a member of a health care team.
  • Maintains professional growth and development through completion of required departmental competencies, participation & contribution to Continuous Professional Development activities.
  • Contributes to the development of Patient Education Materials.
  • Assist in the preceptorship of the Dietetic interns and the undergraduate Dietetic Students.
  • Contribute institutional and outside awareness campaigns, and media where appropriate and approved.

Accountabilities

  • Involved in the implementation of department policies and the annual business plan
  • Ensures patient receives the evidenced based highest standards of care as per the department policies, procedures, protocol and standards.
  • Practicing within the limits of expressed and privilege established by the department leaders.
  • Adheres and contributes to departmental & organization Stewardship initiatives.
  • Documentations of all the details of patient care in the appropriate approved formats.
  • Maintain the required records of patient care activities as per the requirements of the Department and the institutional policies.

QUALIFICATIONS

Experience :-

Required:

  • NLT 3 years’ experience as clinical dietitian in an acute care facility.

Desired:

  • N.A.

  • Bachelor of Science in Dietetics
  • OR Bachelor of Science in Nutrition and Dietetics
  • OR Bachelor of Science in Clinical Nutrition and Dietetics
  • OR Bachelor’s degree in Health Science with a major in Nutrition + Post-graduate diploma or master in Dietetics
  • AND Active member of a Nutrition Society or Association
  • AND Current National license or/ Registration.

Desired:

  • N.A.

To conduct all Neurodiagnostic studies independently or under the supervision of a senior technologist.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Explains the test procedure to the patient to obtain the patient’s cooperation necessary for a complete examination.
  • Measures and accurately applies electrodes in a timely manner, according to the International 10-20 System. Ensure that electrode impedance meet laboratory standards.
  • Performs EEG record according to the standards of the laboratory (routine, sleep, and bedside).
  • Performs long-term video monitoring EEG in epilepsy monitoring unit.
  • Performs Evoked Potentials such as Visual, Brainstem, and Somatosensory studies with high quality results.
  • Performs Nerve Conduction Study in a highly skilled and patient-appropriate manner and assist physician during EMG procedure.
  • Implements alternative methods or adjust controls of the machine to obtain optimal recording.
  • Distinguishes between normal and abnormal test results – describes and annotates all manifestations and changes observed during tests.
  • Recognizes artifacts and perform proper steps to eliminate, monitor or document.
  • Obtain a comprehensive patient history gathering appropriate information from all sources.
  • Writes and prepares comprehensive technical EEG and EMU summary description.
  • Maintains a necessary inventory of supplies for an assigned room or workstation, rotation of stock in an orderly fashion and eliminating outdated items.
  • Participates in technical conferences and meetings

Accountabilities

  • Performs technical solutions to equipment’s problems when needed while performing an EEG
  • Cleans and maintain the equipment after each procedure according to hospital’s infection control policy
  • Obtain a satisfactory EEG recording to aid physician in their interpretation

QUALIFICATIONS

Experience :-

Required:

  • N.A.

Desired:

  • N.A.

Educational Qualification: Required:

  • Associate degree (minimum 2-year curriculum) in the field of Applied Sciences, Neurophysiology or Biophysics/Physiology or equivalent

Desired:

  • Expected to take ABRET exam after completing an internship

Description

The staff nurse is accountable to the Ward Sister for the delivery of high quality care of the patients at Dallah Hospital. The post holder is responsible for ensuring attainment of agreed clinical standards and professional development supported by colleagues and the Director of Nursing.

During the time period for which she is responsible, assesses the overall needs of the individual patients, assists in preparation and implements the nursing care process as indicated to ensure optimal patient care.

Day-to-day activities can include:

Apply monitoring devices such as electronic fetal monitors and other unit instruments.

Admitting, discharge and document patients data.

Give bed bath to very ill patients and prevention of pressure ulcer.

Serve and feed patients.

Participate in the development and implementation of education programmed for patients, their families and others about post discharge care programs.

Assign and supervise health care assistant.

Create therapeutic relationship between patients, relatives, family and others.

Prepare equipment’s and assists in examination and treatments, and clean equipment after use.

Escorts to other departments / units are required.

Monitors stock levels of consumables for re-ordering.

Assist in ensuring safe keeping of patient belongings and valuables in accordance with agreed policy.

Care for dead and manage bereavements.

Maintains continuity of care during take-over and handover reports, ensuring that the communication is clear and accurate at all times.

Ensures that doctors? orders and patient management plans are followed and that appropriate steps are taken, including immediate notification of the resident on-call, of any deterioration from the expected course of the patients condition.

Ensures that the appropriate records of the patients? progress are maintained according to the hospital policies and procedures.

Ensure the safety of the patient, relatives and staff. Reporting untoward incident / accident / staff sickness to the Sister / Charge Nurse.

Maintain current knowledge of medications and their correct administration based on patient clinical conditions. Calculate, prepare, monitor, discontinue fluids and medication drips. Reports adverse reaction to medications.

Take an active role in the prevention and control of infection.

Contribute to the induction of new staff acting as a mentor when appropriate.

Participate in the Quality Improvement Program within his / her area of responsibilities.

Be committed to further development of own clinical skills and knowledge actively seeking learning opportunities as appropriate.

Ensures that the record of all drugs, IV fluids, etc. , is up-to-date as required by the Pharmacy, and ensures that the rules and regulations governing the storage and custody of scheduled drugs and narcotics are strictly observed at all times.

Maintain skill and knowledge in using various medical devices such as ECG machine, Defibrillator, Infusion and Syringe Pump, CTG machine, Electronic fetal monitors, other Gyne instruments and other equipment machine used in OPD / ER.

Maintain skills and knowledge by participating various nursing education programs, in-service training, nursing symposium, workshops & etc.

Ensure that the necessary financial records are maintained for the Finance Department.

Staff should be competent as follows:

Insert a urinary catheter and provide care for the patient with indwelling catheter.

Provides appropriate care for patient receiving enteral feeding.

Safely applies, adapts, removes orthopedic cast.

Provides care for patient with neurological deficit.

Provide education and monitoring for patient receiving anticoagulant therapy.

Demonstrates the required knowledge, skills and attitude in the safety use of therapeutic devices and immobilization.

Provides care for patient with fluid imbalance.

Demonstrates safe pre and post operative care for surgical patients.

Safely remove staple or sutures.

Provides care for patient with total knee and hip replacement.

Assess fetal heart rate patterns by using the electronic fetal heart monitoring.

Provide appropriate post-partum care.

Participate in patient and family education to help patients and families to better understand and participate in their care and make well informed care decisions. This job description is not an exhaustive list of accountabilities and activities. Job incumbents may be required to perform additional job-related tasks and duties as assigned.

Requirements

Two years post-basic experience, six months of which must be in the specialty

Previous experience in Middle Eastern healthcare.

Good command of English Language

Appropriate qualification and statutory nursing registration in the country from where recruited. BSN / RN.

Post-basic course qualification in the specialty.

Valid BLS certificate.

A world-class Medical Affairs organization is critical to our Company’s mission to save and improve lives. It is committed to advancing medical practice through the proper implementation of our innovative drugs and vaccines with a vision to be the most trusted, science-driven and patient-committed medical affairs organization in the industry and a mission to communicate and generate medical evidence to help those responsible for health-care decisions make informed choices that improve access and health outcomes for patients around the world.

We are looking for Gulf Oncology Medical Advisor, who will be responsible for local Oncology Franchise Medical Strategy & Planning, local Scientific Leader and Key Decision Makers engagement and planning, collaborative activities with local Oncology Societies/Scientific community, local Promotional & Non-promotional compliance for Oncology activities, materials & programs, Medical Training.

Major Responsibilities

Medical activities

  • Ensure regular scientific updating for cross-functional team.
  • Provide medical input including patient flow analysis to the assigned tumor types
  • Proactively communicate the science behind our Company’s Oncology portfolio to scientific leaders in terms of locally registered products & reactively respond to their queries on our Company’s pipeline.
  • Providing medical/scientific robust support with full collaboration with Policy & Access to facilitate formulary inclusions/ reimbursement.
  • Ensure regular scientific updating for Sales & Marketing team.
  • Construct & execute valuable scientific education activities to position our Company as a partner to the oncology scientific community
  • Conduct input seeking activities (ex Group Input Meetings) for proper understanding of local epidemiology & management patterns across indications, according to our Company’s, local & international compliance guidelines/regulations.
  • Conducts medical training to the Oncology Commercial, Market Access, Sales & Regulatory functions.
  • Ensures all Oncology promotional & non promotional activities/programs in Gulf countries are executed in a compliant manner according to Company’s regulations/codes/SOPs in adherence with Local & International compliance regulations/standards.

Clinical Research, Local Data Generation and Pharmacovigilance

  • Supports Clinical research & local data generation activities for Global, regional & local studies
  • Identification of appropriate local sites / investigators for Oncology clinical research programs.
  • Ensures timely reporting of adverse events & assists local Pharmacovigilance team in assessment & completion of required data for optimal reporting.

Requirements

  • Physician, Dentist or Pharmacist educational or working background.
  • Oncology/Hematology experience is highly preferred.

Senior Brand Manager, Rare Disease, Gulf

AstraZeneca is a global, science-led, patient-focused biopharmaceutical company that focuses on the discovery, development, and commercialisation of prescription medicines for some of the world’s most serious diseases. But we’re more than one of the world’s leading pharmaceutical companies.

Role Summary

AstraZeneca is accelerating the expansion of our geographical footprint in rare diseases following the acquisition of Alexion in 2021. Rare diseases are a high-growth therapy area with rapid innovation and significant unmet medical need. Over 7,000 rare diseases are known today – yet less than 1% of them have an approved treatment.

As we are currently positioned as a Rare Disease leader, we seek a Rare Diseases Senior Brand Manager to join our Commercial Team in UAE. The Senior Brand Manager is a full-time position, responsible for developing and implementing rare disease brand strategies for Gulf Markets.

The selected candidate will work very closely with the Gulf Franchise Head to deploy and adapt the AZ brand strategy to the local market, including tactics and execution.

The role reports to the Franchise Head.

The Senior Brand Manager will develop strategy for assigned portfolio: brand planning process, brand positioning in context of competitive landscape (messages, programs, key initiatives).

What You’ll Do

  • Develops and coordinates implementation of marketing programs for assigned brand(s)including cost management
  • Ensure launch readiness and planning of key activities pre/post launch. Builds solid marketing mix through delivery of appropriate channels. Proposes and supports design of appropriate programs to deliver excellence in customer experience
  • Develop robust understanding of the patient journey to design tailored programs tackling the gaps within, with special attention to patient finding activities
  • Leads forecast during the business planning process. Input to market research plan and monitors KPIs for brand dashboard
  • Contributes for development and implementation of KOL management plan
  • Lead identification and development of marketing best practices and support implementation on the local market
  • Demonstrates business ethics and ensure active respect of values, business ethics, local laws, policies and Marketing procedures. Ensures all activities and responsibilities are carried out in compliance with the high standards of ethics and integrity required by the Code of Conduct, supporting Policies and Standards and Company Values to protect and enhance long term performance and reputation
  • Manage advertising and other support agencies in implementing global communication tools and in developing local marketing materials, including promotional materials for the field team.
  • Establish and maintain quality and trustful contacts within the relevant medical community, with opinion leaders, influencers and deciders, in compliance with local requirements: have frequent contact with field team, HCP and KOLs
  • Support field teams’ execution of promotional events from concept design to content delivery
  • Other duties within position’s scope, as assigned by Line Manager

Essential For The Role

  • Science degree and or master’s degree in a scientific discipline
  • Minimum 8 years of pharmaceutical experience

  • Proven new product launch experience, including launch readiness and leading the cross-functional team (CFT) from 12 months pre-launch through post launch
  • Experience in shaping ecosystem for diagnosis & management of complex disorders.
  • Availability for travel within Gulf Markets
  • Resilience to work effectively in a fast-changing environment
  • Able to act and influence at a senior level
  • Evidence of excellent skills in communication, presentation, influencing and projects tactical management

Desirable for the role

  • Previous Haematology /or Nephrology/ or Neurology/ or Rare Endocrine marketing experience is a plus
  • Rare disease experience.
  • Experience in niche markets/orphan drugs.
  • Experience in Gulf markets is other than UAE
  • Solid leadership profile, potential to develop in a more senior role
  • Excellent KEE management

Why AstraZeneca?

At AstraZeneca we’re dedicated to being a Great Place to Work. Where you are empowered to push the boundaries of science and unleash your entrepreneurial spirit. There’s no better place to make a difference to medicine, patients, and society. An inclusive culture that champions diversity and collaboration, and always committed to lifelong learning, growth, and development. We’re on an exciting journey to pioneer the future of healthcare.

The Call Centre Manager (CCM) will be accountable for defining, delivering, and continuously improving our call centre strategy as the organisation grows. They will leverage both people and technology to build an operation that is efficient, scalable, and consistently maintains the highest standards of quality.

The CCM will lead a team of Advisors and Team Leaders responsible for all inbound and outbound patient & consultant communication, ensuring seamless and accurate booking of appointments into our LIPS clinic and other hospitals where our consultants operate.

The role requires strong operational leadership, excellent communication skills, and a strategic mindset to ensure the call centre is equipped to support our expanding services while delivering an exceptional patient & consultant experience.

The Contact Centre will grow significantly over the coming years, as more Consultants use the Battersea site and additional facilities are added. The CCM must work with other teams and Managers to ensure this growth is managed efficiently through accurate resource planning, recruitment and training.

The CCM will be responsible for ensuring agent skills and knowledge are up to the required standard at all times and that targets are fairly set and achieved. They will also manage productivity and quality levels using prescribed processes and documentation. Regular management reporting will be a key feature of the role, so a strong understanding of data analysis and good report writing and presentation skills will be important to gain support for the operation.

This role requires excellent communication skills, strong management and motivational ability, and the ability to handle a variety of tasks efficiently.

Key Responsibilities

1. Patient Communication & Customer Experience

– Oversee all inbound and outbound patient interactions across all channels including calls, emails, and whats app, ensuring timely response, focus on FCR, and ensure accurate logging of data.

– Ensure the team communicates professionally at all times and consistently exceeds patient expectations.

– Address and resolve any issues impacting team performance or patient–consultant communication promptly.

2. Appointment Booking & Workflow Management

– Oversee accurate scheduling of appointments across all services.

– Ensure effective matching of patients with appropriate consultants.

– Manage secure handling of payments and booking confirmations.

3. Sales Performance & Service Promotion

– Drive a performance culture where Advisors confidently promote LIPS services & internal pathways to increase booking conversion.

– Identify opportunities to promote and services to new and existing clients.

– Coach the team to apply assertive and ethical customer service techniques.

4. Information, Data & Performance Management

– Ensure accurate and confidential recording of all patient information.

– Use call centre systems and telephony data to optimise productivity.

– Define KPIS’s and Metrics that focus on experience and efficiency

– Produce regular operational reports with insights and actions.

5. Cross-Team Collaboration & Support Services

– Work with internal teams to support scalable growth.

– Coordinate with the Cairo Operations Centre for bookings and overflow.

– Ensure adherence to updated operational processes.

6. Quality Assurance, Feedback & Continuous Improvement

– Monitor quality and productivity through structured QA processes.

– Review patient and consultant feedback and drive corrective actions.

– Support recruitment, training, and development.

– Review existing tooling and make recommendations based on industry trends

Basic Purpose of the role

The Specialist Physician is responsible for leading and supervising the delivery of high quality evidence-based care; effectively and efficiently diagnosing, managing and treating all patients placed under the post holder’s care.  The Specialist Physician is expected to be an example of clinical excellence within his or her specialty and to provide leadership and training for junior medical staff. 

Key responsibilities of the role

Supports, implements, and follows Reem Hospital’s departmental and divisional initiatives, policies and procedures

Ensures comprehensive documentation in the Medical Record to accurately reflect the patient’s diagnosis and treatment to enable good clinical practice and optimal, accurate patient billing

Demonstrates understanding of key principles of PM&R including the concepts of impairment, activity limitations, participation restrictions and the role of the interdisciplinary team
Demonstrates understanding of basic science relevant to PM&R including anatomy, physiology, kinesiology and ergonomics
Demonstrates ability to perform and document a complete and appropriate PM&R History and Physical Examination.
Formulates and implements comprehensive medical, functional and psychological problem list for PM&R patients with a goal-oriented management plan that utilizes team member’s skills optimally.
Demonstrates compassionate and patient-centered care
Demonstrates understanding of the aging process and its effects on physiology and biomechanics.
Demonstrates understanding of childhood growth and development including developmental milestones.  
Demonstrates effective clinical problem solving and judgement.
Demonstrates effective, appropriate, timely and efficient prescription of therapeutic interventions including:
Rehabilitation therapies
Mobility aids
Orthotics and Prosthetics
Exercise and physical modality prescription
Pharmacotherapies
Demonstrates insight into own limitations and effective, appropriate, and timely consultation of other health professionals as needed for optimal patient care.
Monitor patient’s condition and progress and re-evaluate treatments as necessary
Interact with patients and their family members to help them understand the formation of the care plan
Provide and manage long-term and comprehensive medical care for adult and pediatric cases
Provide clinical support to Specialists when required
Take on-call duty outside of scheduled working hours 
Coverage of Rehab clinics
Leads the interdisciplinary team to ensure high quality, safe patient care Creates an environment where team members are encouraged to voice concerns and share their expertise
Participates effectively in interdepartmental relationships for the provision of quality care.
Partners with others in activities to improve patient safety 
 

Other responsibilities

Helps lead quality improvement within the Department

Facilitates good cross-functional communication to optimize patient care

Supports a culture of regular audit and encourages the use of audit results for improving clinical practice

Supports the reporting, investigation, and response to untoward incidents
Fosters a culture of learning, development and continuous improvement across the Department by:
Promoting and assisting in the instruction, guidance and supervision of junior medical staff 

Facilitating the provision of  essential training relevant to clinical staff in the specialty

Showing commitment to Continued Medical Education (CME)

Promotes and participates in clinical research and publication

Keeps abreast of the current, relevant literature and the latest trends and technologies in the industry
 

Compliance guidelines

Complying consistently with facility policies, procedures and practices and ensuring alignment with Reem Hospital policies

Completing and maintaining regulatory requirements including: licensure and certification and other mandatory training within established time frames
Maintaining confidentiality with regards to any information exchanged or received in the current capacity of role in accordance with Reem Hospital policy
Communicates clearly with the patient and with the permission of the patient, their family, on all aspects of the patient’s condition and treatment

Rounds on the patient on a regular basis that considers the patient’s condition and good clinical practice

Minimizes patient waiting time to the extent that this is practicable.  Seeks to alert the patient in advance if a committed time is delayed

Must be compassionate and courteous at all times
Adhering to requirements of the Occupational Health and safety guidelines and infection control guidelines

Understanding and adhering to emergency preparedness plans/policies
Participates in medical conferences and meetings inside and outside of Reem Hospital

Maintains CME requirements

Develop a personal program of self-study and professional growth with guidance from the medical staff 

Actively participate in Hospital committees and task forces as assigned by the Head of Department 

Maintains good relationship with the other departments and colleagues 

Continuously adhere to Reem Hospital Dress and Grooming Policy for medical professionals 
 

Qualifications, Certifications and Experience

Required:
Qualification from Tier 1 OR Qualification from Tier 2
Current national license or equivalent
Certified proof of yearly CME
Required:   Completed training in the specialty of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation (PM&R)
HAAD license

Tier 2: NLT 4 years full-time employment as a Specialist or equivalent post board certification (includes years in fellowship training) in internationally accredited institute.

experience

Job Description – General Dentist

Job Title: General Dentist

Department: Dental Services

Reports To: Dental Director / Medical Director

Location: Dubai, United Arab Emirates

Job Summary

The General Dentist is responsible for providing comprehensive preventive, diagnostic, restorative, and therapeutic dental care to patients of all ages. The role involves diagnosing and treating oral diseases, promoting oral health, and delivering high-quality, patient-centered dental services in accordance with Dubai Health Authority (DHA) regulations, hospital policies, and internationally accepted clinical standards.

Key Responsibilities

Clinical Responsibilities

  • Perform comprehensive dental examinations and oral health assessments.
  • Diagnose and treat dental diseases, oral infections, and disorders of the teeth, gums, and oral cavity.
  • Develop individualized treatment plans based on clinical findings and patient needs.
  • Provide preventive dental care, including oral health education, scaling, polishing, and fluoride treatments.
  • Perform restorative dental procedures, including:
    • Dental fillings (composite and amalgam where applicable)
    • Inlays and onlays
    • Crown and bridge preparation
    • Temporary restorations
  • Perform routine tooth extractions and manage uncomplicated dental emergencies.
  • Diagnose and manage periodontal diseases, referring complex cases to a Periodontist when necessary.
  • Perform root canal treatment for uncomplicated endodontic cases within the scope of practice.
  • Diagnose and manage oral lesions, referring suspicious cases for specialist evaluation when appropriate.
  • Prescribe medications, including antibiotics and analgesics, in accordance with DHA regulations.
  • Provide emergency dental care for pain, trauma, infections, and other urgent dental conditions.
  • Refer patients to dental specialists when advanced treatment is required.

Diagnostic Responsibilities

  • Interpret dental radiographs, including:
    • Periapical X-rays
    • Bitewing X-rays
    • Panoramic (OPG) radiographs
    • Cone Beam CT (CBCT), where applicable
  • Assess oral pathology and formulate appropriate treatment plans.
  • Maintain accurate clinical records and treatment documentation.

Patient Care

  • Deliver compassionate, ethical, and patient-centered dental care.
  • Educate patients on oral hygiene, disease prevention, nutrition, and post-treatment care.
  • Obtain informed consent before all dental procedures.
  • Maintain patient confidentiality and ensure a positive patient experience.
  • Monitor treatment outcomes through appropriate follow-up visits.

Infection Prevention & Safety

  • Adhere to infection prevention and control protocols, including sterilization and disinfection procedures.
  • Ensure compliance with standard precautions and occupational health and safety requirements.
  • Maintain a safe, clean, and organized clinical environment.
  • Properly dispose of sharps and clinical waste according to hospital and DHA guidelines.

Multidisciplinary Collaboration

  • Collaborate with Dental Specialists, Dental Hygienists, Dental Assistants, Oral Surgeons, Orthodontists, Prosthodontists, Endodontists, Periodontists, and other healthcare professionals.
  • Participate in multidisciplinary case discussions when required.
  • Coordinate patient referrals and continuity of care.

Quality & Compliance

  • Maintain complete, accurate, and timely Electronic Medical Records (EMR).
  • Comply with DHA regulations, hospital policies, ethical standards, and clinical governance requirements.
  • Participate in clinical audits, quality improvement initiatives, and accreditation activities.
  • Report clinical incidents and adverse events according to hospital policy.

Professional Development

  • Participate in Continuing Medical Education (CME) and Continuing Professional Development (CPD) activities.
  • Maintain professional licensure and certifications.
  • Stay updated with advances in dental materials, technology, and evidence-based clinical practices.
  • Participate in departmental meetings and mandatory hospital training.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor of Dental Surgery (BDS), Doctor of Dental Medicine (DMD), Doctor of Dental Surgery (DDS), or an equivalent dental qualification from a recognized institution.
  • Valid Dubai Health Authority (DHA) License or DHA Eligibility Letter as a General Dentist.
  • Current Basic Life Support (BLS) certification.

Experience

  • Minimum 2–3 years of clinical experience as a General Dentist after internship.
  • Experience in restorative, preventive, and emergency dental care.
  • Previous experience in a DHA-licensed dental clinic or hospital is preferred.

Knowledge & Skills

  • Strong knowledge of general dentistry principles and evidence-based treatment protocols.
  • Proficiency in restorative dentistry, preventive care, and routine oral surgical procedures.
  • Ability to interpret dental radiographs and diagnostic investigations.
  • Competency in Electronic Medical Records (EMR) and dental practice management systems.
  • Excellent communication and patient counseling skills.
  • Strong clinical judgment and attention to detail.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team.
  • Knowledge of DHA regulations, infection control, and healthcare quality standards.

Key Competencies

  • Patient-Centered Care

  • Communication and Interpersonal Skills

  • Professionalism and Ethics
  • Teamwork and Collaboration

  • Commitment to Quality Improvement

Working Conditions

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Job Description: Consultant Family Medicine

Location: Dubai, United Arab Emirates

Healthcare Setting: Outpatient Clinics / Multi-specialty Hospital / Primary Care Centers

Reports To: Chief Medical Officer (CMO) / Medical Director

Licensing Authority: Dubai Health Authority (DHA)

Job Purpose

The Consultant Family Medicine provides comprehensive, continuous, and patient-centered primary healthcare services to individuals and families across all age groups, genders, and disease entities. This role focuses heavily on preventive medicine, early disease detection, lifestyle modification, and the evidence-based management of acute and chronic conditions within an integrated, multidisciplinary healthcare system.

Key Responsibilities

1. Clinical Excellence & Patient Care

  • Deliver comprehensive primary care consultations, detailed clinical assessments, and physical examinations for pediatric, adult, and geriatric patient populations.
  • Diagnose and manage a wide spectrum of acute illnesses, minor injuries, and complex, multi-system chronic conditions (e.g., Type 2 diabetes, hypertension, dyslipidemia, asthma, and metabolic disorders) in accordance with local and international evidence-based guidelines.
  • Formulate, implement, and monitor individualized, long-term patient care and treatment plans, ensuring robust follow-up and continuity of care.
  • Perform minor outpatient procedures appropriate to the scope of family medicine (e.g., joint injections, minor wound care, skin biopsies, and basic cryotherapy).

2. Preventative Health & Wellness

  • Design and execute preventive healthcare strategies, including routine health screenings, age-appropriate immunizations, cancer screenings, and early wellness interventions.
  • Provide dedicated lifestyle counseling on nutrition, weight management, smoking cessation, stress reduction, and physical activity to optimize patient longevity and metabolic health.

3. Care Coordination & Collaboration

  • Act as the primary patient advocate, coordinating seamless referrals to tertiary specialists, diagnostic services, and allied health professionals when medically indicated.
  • Collaborate closely with a multidisciplinary clinical team (including nurses, specialists, and pharmacists) to deliver integrated, high-quality healthcare.

4. Clinical Governance & Administration

  • Maintain flawless electronic medical records (EMR) and clinical documentation in strict compliance with DHA regulations, Joint Commission International (JCI) standards, and institutional policies.
  • Participate actively in clinical governance, peer reviews, quality improvement initiatives, and patient safety audits.
  • Contribute to internal continuing medical education (CME) programs and stay current with advancements in primary care medicine.

Requirements & Qualifications

Licensing & Education

  • Basic Medical Degree: MBBS or equivalent from a recognized university listed in the World Directory of Medical Schools.
  • Specialty Qualification: Completion of formal higher professional training and Board Certification/Specialty Certificate in Family Medicine. Recognized Tier 1 or Tier 2 qualifications include:
    • USA: American Board of Family Medicine (ABFM)
    • UK: Certificate of Completion of Training (CCT) / MRCGP
    • Canada: Fellowship of the College of Family Physicians of Canada (CCFP)
    • Australia/NZ: Fellowship of the Royal Australian College of General Practitioners (FRACGP)
    • Arab Board / Local Equivalents: Arab Board Specialization or equivalent recognized by the DHA PQR (Professionals Qualification Requirements).
  • DHA License: Must hold an active DHA Consultant License or a valid DHA Eligibility Letter as a Consultant in Family Medicine.

Experience

  • Tier 1 Pathway: Minimum of 2 years of post-specialty continuous practice in a recognized multidisciplinary or hospital setting.
  • Tier 2 Pathway: Minimum of 5 to 8 years of verified postgraduate clinical experience in the specialty.
  • Proven track record working within culturally diverse patient environments.

Key Competencies

  • Exceptional diagnostic, therapeutic, and clinical judgment.
  • Advanced patient-centric communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong familiarity with Dubai’s insurance workflows and regulatory documentation standards.

Standard Compensation & Benefits in Dubai

  • Competitive, tax-free basic salary (often structured with performance-based productivity incentives).
  • Comprehensive family medical insurance and malpractice/professional indemnity coverage.
  • Housing allowance or premium accommodation support.
  • Annual return flight tickets to home country for the physician and immediate family.
  • End-of-service gratuity and CME leave support.

Department

Psychiatry

Job Summary

The Licensed Clinical Psychologist is responsible for providing comprehensive psychological assessment, diagnosis, and evidence-based therapeutic interventions for children, adolescents, adults, and families experiencing a wide range of mental health, emotional, behavioral, and psychological conditions. The Clinical Psychologist works collaboratively with psychiatrists, physicians, and multidisciplinary teams to deliver patient-centered care while ensuring compliance with Dubai Health Authority (DHA) regulations, ethical standards, and hospital policies.

Key Responsibilities

Clinical Responsibilities

  • Conduct comprehensive psychological assessments using clinical interviews, standardized psychological tests, behavioral observations, and evidence-based assessment tools.
  • Diagnose mental health disorders in accordance with the DSM-5-TR and other accepted clinical guidelines.
  • Develop individualized treatment plans tailored to each patient’s clinical needs and goals.
  • Provide evidence-based psychotherapy, including but not limited to:
    • Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT)
    • Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT)
    • Dialectical Behavior Therapy (DBT)
    • Solution-Focused Brief Therapy (SFBT)
    • Trauma-informed therapy
    • Family and couples therapy (where appropriately trained)
  • Monitor treatment progress and modify interventions as clinically indicated.
  • Maintain accurate and confidential clinical records within the electronic medical record (EMR).
  • Identify and manage patients at risk of self-harm, suicide, abuse, or violence, following hospital safeguarding and escalation procedures.
  • Refer patients to psychiatrists, physicians, or other healthcare professionals when appropriate.
  • Provide psychological support for patients with chronic medical illnesses and complex health conditions.

Psychological Assessment

  • Administer and interpret psychometric assessments within the psychologist’s scope of practice.
  • Conduct cognitive, personality, behavioral, neuropsychological (where qualified), and emotional assessments.
  • Prepare comprehensive psychological reports for clinical, occupational, educational, insurance, or medico-legal purposes when required.
  • Provide feedback sessions to patients and families regarding assessment findings and treatment recommendations.

Patient & Family Education

Multidisciplinary Collaboration

Experience

Business Introduction We manufacture and supply reliable, high-quality medicines and vaccines to meet patients’ needs and drive our performance.

Our network of 37 medicines and vaccines manufacturing sites delivered 1.7 billion packs of medicines and 409 million vaccine doses in 2024 to help make a positive impact on the health of millions of people. Our supply chain is not just core to our operations; it’s vital to bringing our innovations to patients as quickly, efficiently and effectively as possible. Technology is transforming how we manufacture medicines and vaccines, enabling us to increase the speed, quality and scale of product supply.

We need the very best minds and capability to help us on our journey to make more complex products, harnessing the power of smart manufacturing technologies including robotics, digital solutions and artificial intelligence to deliver for patients. Position Summary You will join a team that ensures the quality and safety of products through reliable laboratory testing and strong collaboration with manufacturing, quality assurance, and supply partners. You will perform analytical testing, investigate deviations, and help improve lab processes. We value clear thinkers who work safely, communicate openly, and coach others. This role offers clear technical growth, meaningful impact on patient health, and aligns with GSK’s mission of uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. Responsibilities This role will provide YOU the opportunity to lead key activities to progress YOUR career. These responsibilities include some of the following: – Perform routine and non-routine analytical testing following approved methods and procedures. – Record and review results, prepare Certificates of Analysis, and support batch release activities. – Investigate out-of-specification results and deviations, document findings, and follow up on corrective actions. – Maintain laboratory equipment and support qualification, calibration, and preventive maintenance activities. – Follow good laboratory practices, safety rules and regulatory requirements to protect product quality and people. – Support continuous improvement initiatives to increase lab efficiency, data integrity, and reduce waste. Why You? This role is on-site in Egypt. Hybrid or remote working is not available due to laboratory and operational requirements. Basic Qualification We are seeking professionals with the following required skills and qualifications to help us achieve our goals: – Bachelor’s degree in Pharmaceutical Sciences, Chemistry, Biology, or a related scientific discipline. – Minimum of 2 to 3 years’ hands-on experience in an analytical or quality control laboratory. – Practical experience with common analytical techniques such as HPLC, UV, dissolution, titration, or wet chemistry. – Working knowledge of good manufacturing practice (GMP) and good laboratory practice (GLP). – Clear written and verbal communication skills in English and Arabic to document results and work with colleagues. – Strong attention to detail, good record keeping, and basic computer skills for data entry and reporting. Preferred Qualification If you have the following characteristics, it would be a plus: – Experience in the pharmaceutical or biotech industry in a regulated environment. – Familiarity with method validation, stability testing, or instrument qualification. – Experience using laboratory information management systems (LIMS) or electronic data capture systems. – Training or exposure to data integrity principles and regulatory inspection preparedness. – Fluency in English with strong report writing skills. – Demonstrated experience in continuous improvement, lean methods, or problem-solving tools. What we offer You will work with experienced colleagues who value inclusion and development. You will receive on-the-job coaching, structured training, and opportunities to build technical and leadership skills. You will do work that matters, helping ensure safe and effective supply for patients. How to apply If you are ready to grow your career and make a real impact, we want to hear from you. Please submit your application and include an up-to-date CV and a brief note explaining why this role is right for you. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and encourage those who value teamwork and inclusion to apply.

Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most.
