Galderma is the emerging pure-play dermatology category leader, present in approximately 90 countries. We deliver an innovative, science-based portfolio of premium flagship brands and services that span the full spectrum of the fast-growing dermatology market through Injectable Aesthetics, Dermatological Skincare and Therapeutic Dermatology. Since our foundation in 1981, we have dedicated our focus and passion to the human body’s largest organ – the skin – meeting individual consumer and patient needs with superior outcomes in partnership with healthcare professionals. Because we understand that the skin, we are in shapes our lives, we are advancing dermatology for every skin story.

We look for people who focus on getting results, embrace learning and bring a positive energy. They must combine initiative with a sense of teamwork and collaboration. Above all, they must be passionate about doing something meaningful for consumers, patients, and the healthcare professionals we serve every day. We aim to empower each employee and promote their personal growth while ensuring business needs are met now and into the future. Across our company, we embrace diversity and respect the dignity, privacy, and personal rights of every employee.

At Galderma, we actively give our teams reasons to believe in our bold ambition to become the leading dermatology company in the world. With us, you have the ultimate opportunity to gain new and challenging work experiences and create an unparalleled, direct impact.

Job Title: Medical Scientific Liaison (MSL)

Location: Dubai

With a unique legacy in dermatology as well as decades of cutting-edge innovation, Galderma is the leading company solely dedicated to skin and advancing the future of dermatology. For this purpose, the Medical Scientific Liaison (MSL) is a key internal expert, providing a field-based scientific and clinical support to healthcare professionals to maintain a high level of medical, scientific and technical knowledge and expertise in relation to Dermatology & Aesthetics with a focus in UAE (KSA as needed support.)

  • Play a key role in successfully launching new treatment options for treating various dermatoses and support A&C
  • Support and facilitated field force education and training to ensure seamless implementation of medical strategies
  • Act as the primary point of contact for new products in therapeutic dermatology and A&C business (including internal and external medical-scientific projects, non-interventional and investigator-initiated trials – IIT)
  • Building relationships and maintaining very close contact with medical experts and local representatives of scientific societies, 80 % of time allocated to field activities.
  • Collaborate with the team to implement medical-scientific strategies, focusing on developing central/key strategies for clinical studies and other projects
  • Establish strong cross-departmental relationships, working closely with medical office/affairs staff, marketing teams, and sales teams
  • Actively participate in congresses, staying updated with the latest findings in relevant indication areas and market trends while providing expert insights to the organization

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Goals

  • Advance science and standards of care for patients and healthcare providers.
  • Enhance Galderma’s scientific credibility with national and regional key thought leaders (KTLs/KOLs).
  • Act as the main point of contact for KTLs/KOLs to facilitate medical-scientific projects, clinical studies, NIS, and investigator-initiated trials (IITs).
  • Identify, develop and maintain contact with local, regional and national KTLs/KOLs and experts through internally approved field engagement plans
  • Develop and maintain collaborative relationships with KTLs/KOLs and academic centers in the therapeutic area to ensure access to current medical and scientific information and to facilitate Galderma research and educational priorities and strategic initiatives

Information & Support

  • Ensure that KTLs/KOLs can access all the practical and clinically relevant information and solutions they need to use Galderma’s products efficiently and safely
  • Interact with, and support the needs of, Tier 1, 2 and 3 external experts
  • Work to communicate information and facilitate dialogue about Gladerma’s compound in development (Nemolizumab) in a strictly scientific, non-promotional manner, and in full compliance with applicable national laws and regulations, guidelines, Galderma’s policies and procedures and accepted standards of best practice
  • Independent organization and implementation of advisory boards
  • Carry out and support sales force education and training courses
  • Deliver credible scientific and medical Slide kits to physicians, healthcare providers and other stakeholders as needed
  • Attend relevant scientific meetings and conferences
  • Support scientific dialogue and collaborations in the areas of research, medical and scientific exchange, including facilitation of requests for scientific and medical information
  • As appropriate and needed; produce, review, and update internally approved scientific presentations for assigned therapeutic areas
  • Maintain a high level of scientific knowledge to ensure credible dissemination of scientific information and informed scientific dialogue with KOLs/KTLs
  • Gather and generate actionable insights through: Attending congresses, engaging with external stakeholders, staying updated in relevant scientific literature, preparing summaries, and presenting key perspectives to Galderma teams including competitor analyses

Collaboration & Communication

  • Close interdepartmental cooperation with the medical office staff and relevant marketing & sales teams
  • Support internal teams such as sales and marketing to develop their scientific expertise through the delivery of scientific update presentations
  • Work collaboratively and cross-functionally with other in-field members while retaining functional independence
  • Communicate and interact with the Global and International Medical Affairs teams
  • Serve as a point of contact within the Medical Affairs Team for KTLs/KOLs within the UAE in order to satisfy their needs for scientific knowledge in a therapeutic area and, when requested, relevant Galderma medicines, to support their safe, effective and appropriate use
  • Participate in the selection process to identify appropriately qualified thought leaders Galderma would wish to engage in collaborative efforts – such as potential research collaborations, or educational and advisory roles (Advisory Boards, Congresses, Symposia, etc.) while ensuring a high level of scientific or educational integrity in these collaborative efforts

Compliance & Legal Guidance

  • Ensure that all activities and interactions are conducted with due regard to all applicable local, global and national laws, regulations, guidelines, Galderma’s policies and accepted standards of best practices
  • Support Galderma research by identifying investigators, undertaking scientific exchange and providing feedback and insight to medical and clinical teams
  • Respond to unsolicited requests for medical and scientific information
  • Utilize modern technology platforms to maximize efficiency and effectiveness and limit travel requirements. Ensure the integrity of the scientific data used in promotional claims and materials, if requested
  • Adhere to all company policies and procedures including but not limited to Code of Conduct, fleet, IT and confidentiality
  • Other duties as assigned by management.

Qualifications & Skills

  • Medical, Pharmacy, or higher degree (e.g., MSc, PhD) in Life sciences.
  • Dermatology, Aesthetics, or Immunology-Biologics experience is desirable.
  • Several years of relevant medical, research, or pharmaceutical/biotech experience preferred.
  • Experience liaising with medical professionals and opinion leaders.
  • Proven ability to develop and present scientific/medical content to diverse audiences.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills.
  • Skilled in meeting planning, facilitation, and technical platforms.
  • Ability to work effectively in a team-oriented, matrix environment.
  • Highly organized, able to prioritize, and adapt in a dynamic environment.
  • Ability to build credibility and relationships with medical professionals.
  • English: spoken and written as a second language for scientific purposes

Our people make a difference

At Galderma, you’ll work with people who are like you. And people that are different. We value what every member of our team brings. Professionalism, collaboration, and a friendly, supportive ethos is the perfect environment for people to thrive and excel in what they do.

Commercial Excellence & Business Operations – HealthCare
 

The Commercial Excellence Specialist strengthens Radiometer’s commercial operating system by enabling data-driven execution across Sales, Marketing, Service, Supply Chain, and Operations. The role is accountable for the hands-on running and continuous improvement of core commercial tools and performance routines—primarily CRM (SFDC / MS CRM), Power BI dashboards, KPI governance, and data quality standard work.

Operating in a highly cross-functional environment, the Specialist partners closely with the Commercial Excellence Manager and key stakeholders to ensure commercial visibility, adoption discipline, and decision-ready insights. This includes supporting daily/weekly/monthly performance cadences, driving tool usage compliance, and ensuring accurate, timely reporting into Radiometer global requirements (L3 KPIs, global submissions).

Ultimately, the role helps Radiometer Saudi Arabia improve forecast accuracy, funnel rigor, customer responsiveness, and commercial execution consistency, using Danaher Business System (DBS) principles (visual management, daily management, problem solving, and standard work).

Overall Challenges (What makes this role critical)

  • Data quality and “single source of truth”
  • Inconsistent CRM hygiene, missing fields, duplicate accounts/opportunities, and non-standard definitions create “dashboard noise.”
  • The business loses trust in reporting when outputs don’t match reality—so adoption drops.
  • Adoption discipline and change management
  • CRM and BI tools only work when used consistently.
  • Sales/Service teams may view CRM tasks as admin work—so the challenge is driving behavior change, not just building reports.
  • KPI clarity and governance
  • Misaligned KPI definitions across functions (Sales vs Service vs Supply) can lead to conflicting narratives.
  • The Specialist must keep KPI logic stable while still improving it—without disrupting the cadence.
  • Speed of execution vs accuracy
  • Leadership needs quick insights, but rushed analytics leads to wrong decisions.
  • The role must balance timely reporting with controlled validation and reconciliations.
  • Cross-functional coordination under pressure
  • Unplanned demand, stock constraints, allocations, quality holds, and registration gaps require fast coordination.
  • The Specialist often becomes the operational “connector” between Sales, Planning, Manufacturing, QA/RA, and Customer Service.
  • Systems dependency and regional/global alignment
  • Reliance on global/other operating company teams (e.g., Beckman SFDC team) can slow fixes and enhancements.
  • The Specialist must translate business needs into clean requirements and manage expectations locally.
  • Executive-ready storytelling (not just dashboards)
  • Dashboards don’t speak for themselves; leaders need context, exceptions, and actions.
  • The Specialist must convert data into insights, root causes, and follow-up actions aligned with DBS problem-solving.

DAR Engineering is looking for a highly skilled Biomedical Site Engineer to join a major Healthcare Enterprise Project Management Office (EPMO) in Riyadh.

This role is both site-focused and governance-driven, responsible for establishing, standardizing, and implementing biomedical installation and Testing & Commissioning (T&C) processes across healthcare projects throughout Saudi Arabia.

The position will play a critical role in strengthening national healthcare project delivery by formalizing biomedical integration frameworks and ensuring safe, compliant, and operationally ready hospital facilities.Key Responsibilities/Deliverables:

  • Develop and standardize installation procedures, checklists, and inspection protocols for medical equipment across hospital projects.
  • Establish biomedical coordination workflows between contractors, vendors, and engineering disciplines.
  • Ensure full compliance with applicable regulatory and technical standards, including the Saudi Building Code (SBC), Ministry of Health regulations, manufacturer specifications, and relevant international healthcare standards (such as HTM and NFPA, where applicable).
  • Support the Testing & Commissioning Department in creating:
    • Biomedical pre-commissioning procedures
    • Functional performance testing protocols
    • Integrated systems testing frameworks
    • Site acceptance testing (SAT) standards
  • Develop structured documentation templates for T&C reporting.
  • Standardize handover and operational readiness procedures for medical equipment systems.
  • Monitor on-site installation of medical equipment to ensure:
    • Proper utility coordination (power, gases, data, HVAC).
    • Compliance with design intent and approved shop drawings.
    • Integration with BMS, ICT, and other hospital systems.
  • Conduct inspections and witness testing activities.
  • Identify and mitigate risks related to biomedical system implementation.
  • Participate in high-level coordination meetings within the EPMO.
  • Ensure biomedical alignment with cost, schedule, and quality baselines.
  • Conduct periodic audits of biomedical installation and T&C practices across active projects.
  • Lead technical workshops to ensure consistent interpretation of standards.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives in biomedical delivery frameworks.
  • Ensure proper documentation for regulatory inspections and final authority approvals.

Qualifications and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Biomedical Engineering or related field from a recognized university
  • 13+ years of professional experience in healthcare projects.
  • Proven exposure to large hospital developments or medical cities.
  • Experience in GCC healthcare infrastructure projects preferred.
  • Bilingual Communication: Exceptional command of both Arabic and English, with the ability to draft professional correspondence and technical documents in both languages.

Technical Competencies:

  • Extensive experience in hospital and healthcare facility design (acute care, tertiary hospitals, specialty clinics, medical cities).
  • Strong expertise in:
    • Medical equipment installation and commissioning
    • Hospital utility coordination (medical gases, UPS, IPS, nurse call, etc.)
    • Operating theatres & ICU equipment integration
    • Diagnostic and imaging equipment readiness
  • Sound knowledge of hospital operational workflows.
  • Familiarity with BIM-based coordination environments.
  • Understanding of risk-based commissioning in healthcare facilities.

What We Offer:

  • A chance to work on landmark projects in Saudi Arabia.
  • Collaborative and supportive work environment.
  • Competitive salary and benefits package.
  • An engaged and supportive team that are passionate about encouraging each other to succeed.
  • Work for a company who values their employees and recognizes their contribution.

We understand that to accomplish our goals, we must work as a team and rely on the efforts of every team member. We want team members to start their day with a sense of purpose and end it with a sense of accomplishment.To Apply:

If you believe you have the skills, knowledge, and experience to fulfil this role, please submit your application online by clicking ‘Apply’.

Riyadh-based candidates preferred, but relocation support is available for the right talent.

DAR Engineering is an Equal Opportunity employer committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, race, color, religion, age, marital status, gender identity, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law.What’s Next?

Once your application has been submitted and reviewed, our Talent Acquisition team will contact shortlisted candidates.

Our selection process typically comprises two interview stages per vacancy, ensuring a comprehensive evaluation while providing candidates with the opportunity to engage with two members of the hiring team at each stage. The initial interview is generally conducted virtually, while the final stage often takes place in person at the office, aligning with the role’s location.

That said, we prioritize flexibility, tailoring our approach to accommodate the specific needs of both the position and the candidate.

Thank you for considering a career with us. We encourage you to regularly check for updates and explore future opportunities with DAR Engineering. Best of luck!

The ideal candidate is technically strong, highly analytical, and capable of driving continuous improvement across multi-system environments while collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders.

Performance, Quality & Compliance

  • Review and enhance policies, procedures, SOPs, and internal controls to ensure accuracy and regulatory alignment.
  • Conduct regular quality audits across transactional, process, digital, and regulatory areas.
  • Ensure compliance with all relevant regulatory requirements.
  • Lead corrective actions, root-cause analysis, and risk remediation.
  • Identify operational risks affecting accuracy, SLAs, TAT, or customer experience and implement mitigation measures.

Operational Governance

  • Oversee end-to-end policy admin workflows and ensure proper process governance.
  • Validate and approve process changes while assessing downstream impact.
  • Conduct impact assessments for system changes, regulatory updates, and product amendments.
  • Establish and monitor KPIs, dashboards, and quality performance metrics.
  • Manage escalations related to complex or high-risk operational cases.

Systems & Technical Validation

  • Lead validation of system enhancements, UAT cycles, regression testing, and automation initiatives.
  • Work closely with IT, Digital and Product teams to ensure core systems and portals reflect accurate policy admin rules and benefit structures.
  • Maintain integrity of master data, including products, benefits, setups, regulatory submissions.

Training & Change Management

  • Assess capability gaps and define targeted training for policy admin teams.
  • Deliver training on systems, processes, product rules, benefit mapping, quality standards, and regulatory requirements.
  • Maintain a policy admin knowledge hub with SOPs, guides, and validation frameworks.
  • Lead change management initiatives for product launches, regulatory changes, and system rollouts.

Stakeholder Collaboration

  • Collaborate with Product, Underwriting, Sales, Customer Care, Provider Relations, Finance, IT, and Regulatory teams to ensure smooth end-to-end policy administration processes, resolve operational issues, and support accurate and compliant policy setup and servicing.
  • Represent policy admin in governance forums, audits, regulatory inspections, and key decision meetings.
  • Provide structured reporting, dashboards, and RCA insights to senior leadership.

Audit & Regulatory Readiness

  • Lead and coordinate internal/external audits and regulatory inspections.
  • Prepare audit documentation and ensure timely implementation of corrective actions.

Data, Analytics & Reporting

  • Generate insights using quality dashboards, accuracy trends, TAT performance, and error analysis.
  • Identify systemic issues and improvement opportunities through pattern and trend analysis.
  • Produce monthly governance reports highlighting performance, risks, and action plans.

Operational & Technical Responsibilities:

  • Ensure adherence to internal controls and regulatory guidelines.
  • Act as the senior escalation point for complex cases requiring technical judgment.
  • Maintain and enhance operational guides, checklists, and validation tools.
  • Support business continuity readiness during peak periods and major rollouts.

Essential Requirements:

Education & Experience

  • 5–7 years of experience in policy administration, operational quality, or health insurance operations.
  • Strong experience in performance management, quality assurance, compliance, and end-to-end policy admin workflows.
  • Experience in multi-system environments and involvement in system or process transformation initiatives.
  • Certifications in Lean, Six Sigma, or Quality Management are an advantage.
  • Experience working across varied regulatory environments is preferred.

Technical Skills

  • Strong understanding of policy issuance, renewals, endorsements, benefit structures, membership updates, and validation controls.
  • Good understanding of underwriting principles, benefit mapping, and data accuracy management.
  • High proficiency in Excel, Power Query, dashboards, and data analysis tools.
  • Strong analytical, auditing, and RCA capabilities.
  • Excellent documentation skills (SOPs, validation sheets, process guidelines).

Leadership & Behavioural Skills

  • Strong leadership and ability to influence across teams.
  • High level of ownership, accountability, and attention to detail.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, high-volume environment.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.

ملخص الوظيفة

نحن نبحث عن مندوب طبي يلعب دورًا محوريًا في بناء علاقات قوية مع مقدمي الرعاية الصحية (HCPs) في المنطقة المخصصة. سيكون تركيزك الأساسي على تقديم حلول مؤثرة لدعم مقدمي الرعاية الصحية في تحسين نتائج صحة المرضى. توفر هذه الوظيفة فرصًا للنمو المهني والتطوير، وفرصة لإحداث تأثير ملموس، بما يتماشى مع مهمة GSK لتوحيد العلم والتكنولوجيا والموهبة للتغلب على الأمراض معًا.

المسؤوليات الرئيسية

كمندوب طبي، ستقوم بـ:

  • بناء والحفاظ على علاقات موثوقة مع مقدمي الرعاية الصحية لدعم احتياجات مرضاهم.
  • تنفيذ استراتيجيات GSK في منطقتك باستخدام التواصل الفعّال والموارد المعتمدة.
  • إجراء مناقشات علمية واجتماعات جماعية مع مقدمي الرعاية الصحية لمشاركة الرؤى والمعرفة.
  • تقديم ملاحظات في الوقت المناسب حول اتجاهات السوق والرؤى لدعم اتخاذ القرارات التجارية.
  • ضمان أن جميع الأنشطة تتوافق مع سياسات GSK واللوائح المحلية وإجراءات التشغيل القياسية.
  • إدارة موارد الشركة بمسؤولية وتحسين استخدامها.

المؤهلات الأساسية

لتحقيق النجاح في هذا الدور، يجب أن تكون لديك:

  • درجة البكالوريوس في الصيدلة.
  • رخصة سارية كمُعتمد صيدلي.
  • خبرة تصل إلى سنتين في المبيعات أو دور مشابه يتعامل مع مقدمي الرعاية الصحية (يُشجع الخريجون الجدد على التقديم).
  • مهارات تواصل وعلاقات شخصية قوية.
  • القدرة على العمل بشكل مستقل وإدارة الوقت بفعالية.

على الرغم من أنها ليست مطلوبة، فإن المهارات والخبرات التالية تعتبر ميزة:

  • خبرة في العمل مع شركات الأدوية متعددة الجنسيات.
  • معرفة بعمليات البيع والتوزيع.
  • إتقان أدوات تحليل البيانات وإعداد التقارير.
  • الإلمام بتطبيقات البرمجيات مثل Excel وPowerPoint وWord.
  • رخصة قيادة سارية.

Scope:

As the Haematology Medical Affairs Manager, you will play a pivotal role in translating GSK’s scientific innovation into meaningful clinical impact for patients with haematological malignancies during the critical launch phase of our portfolio. Acting as the medical conscience for the franchise within the country, you will partner with cross-functional colleagues to drive real-world evidence generation, educate healthcare professionals, and ensure alignment with regulatory and pharmacovigilance requirements — all while amplifying patient-centric outcomes and demonstrating GSK’s commitment to improving standards of care in haematology.

We manufacture and supply reliable, high-quality medicines and vaccines to meet patients’ needs and drive our performance.Our network of 37 medicines and vaccines manufacturing sites delivered 1.7 billion packs of medicines and 409 million vaccine doses in 2024 to help make a positive impact on the health of millions of people. Our supply chain is not just core to our operations; it’s vital to bringing our innovations to patients as quickly, efficiently and effectively as possible. Technology is transforming how we manufacture medicines and vaccines, enabling us to increase the speed, quality and scale of product supply.We need the very best minds and capability to help us on our journey to make more complex products, harnessing the power of smart manufacturing technologies including robotics, digital solutions and artificial intelligence to deliver for patients.

Operational Quality Officer

You will help ensure high-quality manufacturing and compliance on the shop floor. You will work closely with production, quality and engineering colleagues. We value attention to detail, clear communication and a practical mindset. You will grow through hands-on experience, coaching others and supporting investigations. This role gives you the chance to make a real impact on patient safety while building your quality assurance career at GSK.

Responsibilities:

This role will provide YOU the opportunity to lead key activities to progress YOUR career. These responsibilities include some of the following:

  • Monitor production activities to confirm compliance with Good Manufacturing Practices and GSK quality standards.
  • Review batch documentation for completeness, accuracy and adherence to approved procedures.
  • Sample and release intermediate, bulk and finished materials following approved plans.
  • Support investigations for deviations, out-of-specification results and customer complaints, including gathering facts and contributing to root cause analysis.
  • Participate in internal audits and routine self-inspection activities and track corrective actions to closure.
  • Coach operators and production teams to embed a quality mindset and improve operational practices.

Why you?

 Basic Qualifications:

We are looking for professionals with these required skills to achieve our goals:

We are seeking professionals with the following required skills and qualifications to help us achieve our goals:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Pharmacy, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Chemistry, Biology or a related science degree; or equivalent professional qualification.
  • Minimum 1 year of experience in a regulated manufacturing or quality environment
  • Practical knowledge of current Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP).
  • Strong documentation skills with attention to accuracy and completeness.
  • Clear verbal and written communication skills in Arabic and a good command of English.
  • Willingness to work on-site and participate in shift-based operations as required.

Preferred Qualifications:

If you have the following characteristics, it would be a plus:

If you have the following characteristics, it would be a plus:

  • 2 or more years’ experience in operational quality, production quality or quality assurance.
  • Familiarity with batch record review, sampling plans and in-process control testing.- Experience with internal audits, deviation management and CAPA systems.
  • Understanding of validation concepts (IQ/OQ/PQ) and basic equipment qualification.
  • Basic computer skills including MS Word and Excel and familiarity with electronic quality systems.
  • Experience coaching or training production teams to improve compliance and performance.

Working pattern

This position is on-site at our manufacturing site. The role may require shift work and occasional weekend support to align with production schedules.

What we value

We look for people who act with integrity, take ownership and collaborate openly. You will be supported to learn and develop through hands-on coaching and formal training. We welcome candidates who value inclusion, speak up when something matters, and help create a safe and respectful workplace.

Ready to apply?

If this role matches your strengths and career goals, we would love to hear from you. Apply now to join our Operational Quality team and help us unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.

Leads and oversees all home healthcare medical supplies stores to ensure continuous, safe, and cost-effective availability of medical consumables, basic medications, IV solutions, vaccines, and related materials for home care services.

Manages storekeepers, inventory systems, cold chain, and coordination with Dallah Health shared services and central stores. Ensures that all supply-chain practices comply with Dallah policies, CBAHI/JCI standards, and regulatory requirements, supporting uninterrupted operations for nurses, physicians, and allied health professionals.

Roles and Responsibilities

Key Accountabilities

Organizational Accountabilities

• Ensure work is performed based on approved policies, processes, procedures, and instructions.

Functional Accountabilities

Operational Leadership & Supervision

• Supervises day-to-day operations of all home healthcare stores across branches and shifts.

• Allocates duties and schedules for storekeepers to ensure proper coverage (morning/evening).

• Monitors adherence to policies, procedures, and standard work for receiving, storage, issuing, and documentation.

• Conducts regular walkthroughs of stores to check organization, cleanliness, safety, and compliance.

Inventory Management & Stock Optimization

• Sets and reviews par levels and reorder points for all key items in coordination with Nursing, Supply Chain, and Finance.

• Reviews consumption trends, stock movements, and variances to reduce stock-outs, overstock, wastage, and expired items.

• Approves and consolidates store requisitions to Dallah Central Store and follows up on pending deliveries.

• Oversees monthly, quarterly, and annual physical inventory counts and reconciliations with the inventory system.

• Identifies slow-moving and near-expiry items and implements redistribution or usage plans with clinical teams.

Receiving, Storage & Cold Chain Oversight

• Ensures all incoming supplies from Dallah Central Store and approved vendors are checked (codes, quantities, batch numbers, expiry dates, integrity).

• Ensures proper storage conditions are maintained for all items based on type, safety, and infection prevention requirements.

• Oversees cold chain management for vaccines and other temperature-sensitive items, including:

◦ Temperature monitoring and documentation.

◦ Escalation and corrective action for any excursions.

◦ Implementation of backup and contingency plans.

• Ensures FEFO/FIFO stock rotation is consistently applied in all stores.

Issuing, Kits & Support to Clinical Operations

• Designs and standardizes issue processes and request forms (manual/electronic) for all clinical teams.

content.rendered:
The Consultant Physician holds a senior position responsible for providing exemplary, comprehensive, and evidence-based medical care within their designated specialty. The role requires leadership in clinical governance, the supervision and training of junior medical staff, and active participation in quality improvement initiatives. The consultant ensures the highest standard of patient care for both inpatient and outpatient services, participates in on-call rotations, and guarantees strict adherence to all Department of Health regulations and SEHA Hospital policies in Abu Dhabi, UAE.

Key Responsibilities

  • Clinical Excellence: Lead and supervise the delivery of high-quality, evidence-based care, effectively diagnosing, managing, and treating all patients within the post holder’s specialty.
  • Patient Care: Conduct patient examinations, take detailed medical histories, order and interpret diagnostic tests, prescribe medications and therapies, and develop comprehensive treatment plans. This includes leading ward rounds and managing both inpatient and outpatient cases.
  • Supervision and Training: Oversee the clinical activities of junior medical staff (specialists, GP’s and Residents), and actively participate in their instruction, guidance, and supervision.
  • Multidisciplinary Collaboration: Liaise with other medical specialties and support services and participate in multi-disciplinary meetings to ensure holistic patient care.
  • On-Call Coverage: Participate in and ensure the provision of out-of-hours (on-call) coverage on a rotational basis, including evenings, nights, weekends, and public holidays.
  • Documentation and Compliance: Accurately and clearly document all relevant clinical information in a timely fashion. Comply with all hospital, departmental, and DOH policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements, including infection control and patient safety standards.
  • Quality Improvement: Participate in clinical audits, performance management systems (including peer review), and proactive risk management to foster continuous improvement in patient outcomes.
  • Communication: Communicate clinical information to patients and their families in a timely and compassionate manner, ensuring informed consent is obtained for procedures.

Qualifications and Requirements

  • Education: An MBBS or equivalent degree from a recognized medical school, followed by the successful completion of a structured specialty training program (e.g., North American/European Board Certification, Fellowship of a Royal College, or equivalent qualification from a DOH-approved ‘Tier 1’ or ‘Tier 2’ country). A postgraduate qualification such as MD, MS, or DNB is generally required.
  • Experience: A minimum of 3-7 years of post-specialty clinical experience, depending on the qualification and tier level, in a recognized multidisciplinary setting. Experience gaps of more than two years require specific DOH approval or a return-to-practice program.
  • Licensing: Eligibility of or a valid DOH (Department of Health Abu Dhabi) license to practice in Abu Dhabi is a mandatory legal requirement. The process involves:
  • Primary Source Verification (PSV): Mandatory verification of all educational and professional documents through the Data Flow Group.
  • DOH Exam: Successful completion of the DOH license exam unless exempted based on Tier 1 qualifications/experience.
  • Good Standing Certificate: A valid certificate from the current/previous licensing authority.
  • Skills: Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, strong leadership abilities, problem-solving skills, and a commitment to continuous medical education (CME/CPD).
  • Language: Fluency in English and Arabic is required, and competence in other languages is often a distinct asset.

The Occupational Therapist will support students with developmental, physical, and emotional challenges, enabling them to participate effectively in school activities and achieve their academic and social potential. The role involves working closely with students, teachers, parents, and other professionals to develop and implement tailored therapy plans.

  • Assess students’ abilities, challenges, and needs through observation, standardized tests, and consultations.
  • Develop individualized therapy plans to improve motor skills, sensory integration, and daily functioning in the school environment.
  • Provide one-on-one or group therapy sessions to address fine and gross motor skills, sensory processing, and self-regulation.
  • Collaborate with teachers to modify classroom environments and tasks to support students’ learning and participation.
  • Train school staff and parents on strategies and techniques to assist students in achieving their goals.
  • Monitor and document student progress, adjusting therapy plans as needed.
  • Participate in Individualized Education Plan (IEP) meetings to provide input on student progress and future goals.
  • Promote inclusive practices and help students develop independence in academic and social settings.
  • Stay updated on best practices and advancements in pediatric occupational therapy.

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in occupational therapy from an accredited institution.
  • Valid professional license or eligibility to obtain a license in Abu Dhabi (DOH/HAAD).
  • Experience in pediatric occupational therapy, preferably in a school setting.
  • Strong knowledge of developmental milestones and common childhood conditions such as autism, ADHD, and learning disabilities.
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills to interact with students, parents, and school staff effectively.

Skills And Competencies

  • Proficient in developing and implementing therapy plans tailored to individual needs.
  • Skilled in using therapeutic tools and equipment to facilitate student engagement.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a multidisciplinary team.
  • Compassionate and patient, with a commitment to helping students succeed.

Additional Requirements

  • Active DHA ,MOH or DOH License

Rare Disease Medical Partner, Neurology, Gulf

AstraZeneca is a global, science-led, patient-focused biopharmaceutical company that focuses on the discovery, development, and commercialization of prescription medicines for some of the world’s most serious diseases. But we’re more than one of the world’s leading pharmaceutical companies.

Role Summary

AstraZeneca is accelerating the expansion of our geographical footprint in rare diseases following the acquisition of Alexion in 2021. Rare diseases is a high-growth therapy area with rapid innovation and significant unmet medical need. Over 7,000 rare diseases are known today – yet less than 1% of them have an approved treatment.

The Rare Disease Medical Partner (RDMP) is a senior field-based scientific and strategic leader responsible for driving medical excellence and shaping the rare disease ecosystem in alignment with AstraZeneca’s vision of pioneering innovation for patients with high unmet needs.

Building on the foundations of the Medical Science Liaison (MSL) role, the RDMP extends beyond scientific exchange to deliver integrated medical impact and transforming patient care — spanning early diagnosis initiatives, real-world evidence generation, medical education leadership, strategic stakeholder engagement, and cross-functional decision support.

You will partner with healthcare professionals, academic centers, policy makers, patient groups, and payers, ensuring science translates into meaningful patient outcomes across the Gulf region. You will report to the Medical Manager, Neurology, Gulf and act as a trusted medical leader within the cross-functional brand team.

What You’ll Do

Medical Leadership & Strategy

  • Serve as the strategic medical partner to the cross-functional brand and launch teams, co-shaping regional medical strategies and evidence plans.
  • Translate global medical strategies into actionable local implementation roadmaps across diagnosis, treatment, and patient pathways.
  • Identify and lead medical opportunities that support disease awareness, early identification, and optimized care pathways in collaboration with key centers and national stakeholders.

Advanced Stakeholder Engagement

  • Build and sustain deep, scientifically credible partnerships with Key External Experts (KEEs), academic networks, and regional Centers of Excellence.
  • Partner with national societies, government bodies, and advocacy organizations to shape rare disease policy and education frameworks.
  • Lead or co-create multi-stakeholder programs (registries, referral networks, etc.) that drive measurable patient impact.

Evidence Generation & Insight Leadership

  • Drive real-world data (RWD) and investigator-initiated research opportunities aligned with medical strategy.
  • Lead local data-to-insight translation, synthesizing field intelligence, disease trends, and competitor developments to inform strategic decision-making.
  • Ensure medical input into value dossiers, health-economics projects, and access narratives where scientifically appropriate.

Medical Education & Scientific Exchange

  • Lead the design and execution of disease-state and scientific education programs, ensuring evidence-based, non-promotional delivery.
  • Support thought-leader development through train-the-trainer, speaker development, and expert-led roundtables.

Launch & Lifecycle Excellence

  • Act as medical launch lead in assigned indications, coordinating readiness, training, and data-driven engagement across the field team.
  • Co-create and implement diagnostic and care-pathway initiatives with hospitals and diagnostic labs to reduce time to diagnosis.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams (Marketing, Market Access, Patient Experience, and Corporate Affairs) to ensure medical integrity in all initiatives.

Internal Leadership

  • Provide strategic medical input in cross-functional planning and governance forums.
  • Lead internal capability-building sessions, driving a culture of evidence, insight, and ethics.
  • Act as medical owner for key regional projects, dashboards, and medical KPIs.

Essential For The Role

  • Advanced degree (MD, PharmD, or PhD preferred; MSc in Medical or Biological Sciences considered with strong experience).
  • 3+ years of experience in Medical Affairs or equivalent, with at least 2 years in rare disease or specialty therapeutic areas.
  • Proven track record of scientific leadership, medical project ownership, and cross-functional influence.
  • Deep understanding of clinical practice patterns, diagnostic algorithms, and referral dynamics within rare diseases.
  • Demonstrated excellence in real-world evidence generation, stakeholder mapping, and insight synthesis.
  • Strong analytical, project management, and presentation skills.
  • Fluency in English (Arabic an advantage).
  • Willingness to travel regionally across Gulf (50-70%).

Desirable For The Role

  • Experience in launch-phase or early-access programs within a rare disease environment.
  • Active involvement in registries, early diagnosis campaigns, or medical education networks.
  • Understanding of Gulf health-policy and reimbursement landscapes.
  • Recognized leadership in cross-functional or above-market collaborations.

Why AstraZeneca?

At AstraZeneca we’re dedicated to being a Great Place to Work. Where you are empowered to push the boundaries of science and unleash your entrepreneurial spirit. There’s no better place to make a difference to medicine, patients, and society. An inclusive culture that champions diversity and collaboration, and always committed to lifelong learning, growth, and development. We’re on an exciting journey to pioneer the future of healthcare.

So, what’s next?

  • Are you already imagining yourself joining our team? Good, because we can’t wait to hear from you.
  • Are you ready to bring new ideas and fresh thinking to the table? Brilliant! We have one seat available, and we hope it’s yours.

Where can I find out more?

  • Follow AstraZeneca on Instagram
  • Follow AstraZeneca on Facebook

As a Planetree-aligned organization, we foster a supportive and empowering work culture. Our network also includes Fakeeh MediCenters across Dubai for accessible primary care, the tech-enabled Fakeeh Smart Clinic for hybrid physical and virtual care, and Fakeeh DaySurge, focused on minimally invasive, same-day procedures.

Aligned with our organizational values and PCC goals, we value professionals who bring experience in community engagement or corporate social responsibility (CSR), as such backgrounds reflect our shared commitment to meaningful social impact and community upliftment.

Job Profile:

The Senior Charge Nurse in Mental Health services is responsible for delivering high-quality, efficient, and effective psychiatric nursing care. This role includes overseeing daily operations, supervising nursing staff, and collaborating with the multidisciplinary team to optimize patient outcomes. The Senior Charge Nurse ensures the smooth functioning of mental health units while also providing direct care to patients with psychiatric needs.

1. General Responsibilities:

I.    GENERAL RESPONSIBILITIES:
Clinical Leadership:
•    Inpatient and Outpatient Unit Oversight: Provides strategic leadership for both inpatient mental health wards and outpatient clinics. Ensures alignment in care protocols and consistent quality of mental health services across both settings
•    Supervision of Multidisciplinary Teams: Leads a multidisciplinary team that includes psychiatric nurses, therapists, social workers, and support staff. Promotes collaboration between inpatient and outpatient teams to ensure continuity of care
•    Workforce Planning and Development: Manages staffing levels for both settings, ensuring that the right mix of skills is available to meet patient needs, including managing on-call rotations and handling staffing challenges unique to mental health care
•    Crisis Management Leadership: Serves as the key leader in managing mental health crises, including psychiatric emergencies in both inpatient and outpatient settings, such as acute psychosis, suicidal ideation, or aggressive behavior
•    Lead and manage nursing staff, ensuring high standards of care are maintained.
•    Coordinate patient care activities, ensuring appropriate nurse-to-patient ratios.
•    Serve as a resource and role model for clinical staff, and junior charge nurses providing guidance and support.
•    Ensure compliance with hospital policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements.
•    To deputize for Nurse Manager in his/her absence.
•    Provides strategic leadership for the nursing team in multiple ambulatory care units, overseeing complex workflows and patient care processes across various outpatient services.
•    Engages in succession planning and mentoring junior charge nurses to build leadership capacity.

Patient Care Management:
•    Ensure timely and accurate documentation of patient care activities.
•    Facilitate effective communication among the healthcare team, patients, and families.
•    Address patient and family concerns promptly and professionally

Job Specifications:

JOB REQUIREMENTS

Education Qualifications:

  • Graduate of an accredited school of nursing holding a BSc Nursing /Diploma of Nursing, not less than 4 years study duration
  • Advanced Degrees (Preferred): A Master of Science in Nursing (MSN) with a focus on mental health or psychiatric nursing is often preferred for leadership roles.
  • Certifications in Mental Health: Certification in Psychiatric-Mental Health Nursing (PMHN) from an accredited body (e.g., the American Nurses Credentialing Center or equivalent) is highly valued.
  • Current license in country of origin
  • UAE DHA License 

Professional Experience:

  • Minimum 5 years of continuous nursing experience in UAE or from home country
  • 3-5 years of experience in psychiatric or mental health nursing, including both inpatient and outpatient settings.
  • Minimum 3 years’ experience in senior position.
  • Previous overseas experience is advantage but not required

Licensure/Certification:

  • Current RN license from a recognized accredited professional body
  • Has a valid BLS, ACLS certification

Competencies:

  • People and Operations Supervision
  • Accountability & Role Understanding
  • Valuing Diversity
  • Abilitty to manage stress
  • Adaptability & Resilience
  • Compassionate and Effective Communication
  • Quality Oriented
  • Taking Responsibility
  • Teamwork
  • Accountability & Role Understanding with Accreditation Knowledge
  • Patient-Centered Care & Therapeutic Communication
  • Ability for Mental health risk assessment
  • Ability to manage acutely ill psychiatric patients

  • Quality Improvement: Participate in clinical audits, performance management systems (including peer review), and proactive risk management to foster continuous improvement in patient outcomes.
  • Communication: Communicate clinical information to patients and their families in a timely and compassionate manner, ensuring informed consent is obtained for procedures.

Qualifications

Qualifications and Requirements

  • Education: An MBBS or equivalent degree from a recognized medical school, followed by the successful completion of a structured specialty training program (e.g., North American/European Board Certification, Fellowship of a Royal College, or equivalent qualification from a DOH-approved ‘Tier 1’ or ‘Tier 2’ country). A postgraduate qualification such as MD, MS, or DNB is generally required.
  • Experience: A minimum of 3-7 years of post-specialty clinical experience, depending on the qualification and tier level, in a recognized multidisciplinary setting. Experience gaps of more than two years require specific DOH approval or a return-to-practice program.
  • Licensing: Eligibility of or a valid DOH (Department of Health Abu Dhabi) license to practice in Abu Dhabi is a mandatory legal requirement. The process involves:
  • Primary Source Verification (PSV): Mandatory verification of all educational and professional documents through the Data Flow Group.
  • DOH Exam: Successful completion of the DOH license exam unless exempted based on Tier 1 qualifications/experience.
  • Good Standing Certificate: A valid certificate from the current/previous licensing authority.
  • Skills: Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, strong leadership abilities, problem-solving skills, and a commitment to continuous medical education (CME/CPD).
  • Language: Fluency in English and Arabic is required, and competence in other languages is often a distinct asset.

Head of Early Asset, OBU, International

Are you ready to turn breakthrough science into high impact launches across diverse markets, accelerating access for patients who need new options most? This role sits at the critical junction between discovery and delivery, converting mechanism of action, biomarkers and clinical profiles into clear, value-maximizing pathways that work in the real world.

You will lead how our earliest oncology assets progress from Phase 2 decisions through registration and launch, shaping evidence, access and diagnostic strategies that reflect local standards of care and payer expectations. In a setting that empowers local ownership, you will bring entrepreneurial thinking to complex, fast-moving environments, so that each decision advances both patient outcomes and business performance.

Accountabilities

  • Asset Strategy Ownership: Set the International Oncology asset strategy from Phase 2 decision points through Phase 3 and COMMID, translating mechanism of action, biomarker strategy and clinical profile into viable, value-maximizing launch pathways by market archetype.
  • Governance and Influence: Chair the International Oncology Early Asset forum and lead International input to GPTs; provide science-based recommendations into ILT and support LSPC preparations on wave plans, indication sequencing and launch/no launch propositions.
  • Decision Frameworks: Own Oncology-specific iLVA policy, criteria, and templates; define explicit no-go thresholds and fast-track pathways to enable timely, data-driven decisions.
  • Evidence Strategy and Trial Influence: Shape Phase 3 and registration-enabling program designs to reflect International standards of care, comparators, biomarker prevalence, and subpopulation needs; ensure PROs/HRQoL and other endpoints align with HTA requirements. Co-create and secure execution of an International evidence plan (including RWE, pragmatic studies, EAPs and post-authorization commitments) to address payer and guideline decision drivers in priority markets. Also, anticipate and guide CMC and supply considerations; stability, shelf life, cold chain, pack/label needs, critical to International launch feasibility.
  • Market Access and Value Strategy: Co-create pricing, access, and reimbursement strategies with Regional Market Access and HEOR; align on surrogate endpoint acceptance, indirect comparison needs and risk-sharing constructs suitable for emerging and mature markets. Define the International value proposition and clinical narrative by tumor type and line of therapy; ensure payer-ready evidence, economic models and value dossiers are available in line with wave plans.
  • Companion Diagnostics Enablement: Co-lead the International CDx strategy—regulatory pathways, lab accreditation, assay availability and data integration; direct partnerships with diagnostic companies and lab networks to secure test availability aligned to launch.
  • Risk Management and Decision Execution: Maintain a comprehensive risk register across clinical, regulatory, access, CDx, CMC and supply domains; assign owners and mitigation timelines, escalating trade-offs to governance as needed. Conduct scenario planning and sensitivity analyses for wave plans and uptake assumptions; ensure assumptions are reflected in RBU/QBR/ABU planning and supply synchronization.
  • International Cross-Functional Leadership & Capability Building: Lead the International Oncology Cross Functional Team (Commercial, Medical, Regulatory, Market Access/HEOR, Diagnostics, CMC/Supply, Finance, Digital); ensure clear accountabilities and delivery against iLVA and wave plan milestones.
  • Portfolio Shaping and BD Integration: Evaluate Oncology BD/licensing opportunities for International strategic fit, scientific differentiation and access feasibility; contribute to due diligence and integration planning.
  • Therapy Area Strategy: Shape the International Oncology TA strategy with the VP OBU International, including investment prioritization, indication lifecycle planning and post-launch optimization.

Essential Skills/Experience

  • Advanced scientific qualification (MD, PhD, or PharmD; strong MSc with extensive Oncology leadership considered)
  • Deep Oncology expertise with hands on impact on late-stage strategy (solid tumours and/or hematologic malignancies), including biomarker/CDx strategy and evolving standards of care
  • Proven senior leadership integrating science and commercial strategy to influence Phase 3 design, evidence generation and access outcomes across multiple International markets
  • Strong command of clinical data interpretation, comparative effectiveness, HEOR principles and RWE methods relevant to HTA/payer decision making in Oncology
  • Demonstrated influence at senior governance (GPTs, ILT; LSPC preparation) with a track record of securing alignment on complex, science driven trade-offs
  • Exceptional analytical and strategic skills to synthesize ambiguous data, run scenario planning and make decisive recommendations
  • Extensive matrix leadership: directing cross functional, above country teams and coaching Oncology capabilities in diverse healthcare systems

Desirable Skills/Experience

  • Above country leadership spanning both mature and emerging markets; familiarity with regulatory and HTA archetypes beyond US/EU5
  • Experience scaling companion diagnostics (regulatory approvals, lab network enablement, quality systems, data/reporting)
  • Established networks with KEEs/guideline contributors and experience with payer/HTA scientific advice
  • Experience assessing and integrating Oncology BD assets

Here your decisions directly shape how cutting-edge oncology medicines reach patients sooner, with real ownership to adapt for local standards of care and payer needs. You will work at the forefront of a strong pipeline, leveraging big data and real-world evidence while learning from colleagues across continents.

The Regional Account Partner reports directly to the Regional Business Manager and will work closely with the cross-functional team to ensure a coordinated and effective approach to account management and patient access.

The Regional Account Partner will be responsible for promoting Rare Disease medicines with healthcare professionals (HCPs), identifying new patients and patients-on-therapy opportunities, presenting compelling value propositions, and recommending patient-centric solutions. Beyond the typical promotional focus on prescribers and treaters, this role will place strong emphasis on the patient journey, engaging referral specialties to enhance diagnosis, referral pathways, and timely identification of eligible patients. The RAP will also work closely with Market Access to help ensure treatment accessibility and support patients in accessing life-changing medicines.

In doing so, this role will develop strategic and mutually beneficial relationships with healthcare professionals, Key External Experts (KEEs), and other stakeholders, grounded in a deep scientific understanding of the rare disease area and AZ’s therapeutic solutions, in order to identify the best opportunities for the assigned portfolio and deliver meaningful outcomes for patients.

  • Account planning: Develop insight-based account plans for all top accounts and treatment centres in the respective specialty; represent the territory in regular reviews and account plan discussions.

  • Cross-functional execution: Lead development and implementation of customer-focused and patient-centred tactics developed in collaboration with Marketing, Medical, Market Access, and Patient Advocacy, supporting HCP education and patient-oriented solutions across targeted specialties.
  • Organizational and pathway insights: Build an in-depth understanding of key account structures and regional patient pathways (including referral networks and diagnostic flows) to support disease awareness, timely diagnosis, safe and effective use of our medicines, and patient journeys across all targeted diseases.
  • Scientific engagement: Create value for HCPs by discussing the latest, in-label scientific data using approved promotional elements; organize hospital promotional meetings and regional education/speaker sessions in line with SOPs and local regulations.
  • Access & Reimbursement and Tender management: Work proactively and collaboratively with Market Access teams to accelerate and streamline patient funding, formulary listing, tender process to ensure products availability, when public tenders arise in the territory, collaborate closely with the Key Hospital Account Manager.
  • Compliance and ethics: Always act ethically per the policies and local regulatory frameworks, collect and communicate pharmacovigilance information according to AZ procedures; ensure appropriate utilization for patients receiving AZ medicines, where required.
  • CRM and reporting: Ensure timely, accurate input of relevant information into CRM systems; deliver complete reporting and presentation of account plans, including KPIs, to leadership.

Essential For The Role

  • Bachelor’s degree in pharmaceutical science.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in pharmaceutical industry, out of which 2 years of experience in the Speciality care .
  • Experience in UAE institution.
  • Proven experience in patient journey mapping, with ability to identify gaps and high-impact leverage points across diagnosis, referral, and access pathways.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify diagnostic, referral, access, and treatment gaps and translate findings into actionable strategic initiatives.
  • Proven experience to work with Market Access teams to accelerate and streamline patient funding, formulary listing, tender process to ensure products availability, when public tenders arise in the territory, collaborate closely with the Key Hospital Account Manager.
  • Deep understanding of referral-driven care models, diagnostic delays, and stakeholder interdependencies.
  • Strong capability to generate actionable insights and continuously integrate account-level stakeholder feedback into cross-functional team (CFT) strategy

Desirable For The Role

  • Positive and solution-oriented attitude
  • To be passionate and self-driven
  • Entrepreneurial approach
  • Experience in Private Sector
  • Experience in Rare Disease Therapy Area
  • Experience in any other gulf country ( other than UAE)

Why AstraZeneca?

At AstraZeneca we’re dedicated to being a Great Place to Work. Where you are empowered to push the boundaries of science and unleash your entrepreneurial spirit. There’s no better place to make a difference to medicine, patients, and society. An inclusive culture that champions diversity and collaboration, and always committed to lifelong learning, growth, and development. We’re on an exciting journey to pioneer the future of healthcare.

So, what’s next?

The Consultant Physician holds a senior position responsible for providing exemplary, comprehensive, and evidence-based medical care within their designated specialty. The role requires leadership in clinical governance, the supervision and training of junior medical staff, and active participation in quality improvement initiatives. The consultant ensures the highest standard of patient care for both inpatient and outpatient services, participates in on-call rotations, and guarantees strict adherence to all Department of Health regulations and SEHA Hospital policies in Abu Dhabi, UAE.

Key Responsibilities

  • Clinical Excellence: Lead and supervise the delivery of high-quality, evidence-based care, effectively diagnosing, managing, and treating all patients within the post holder’s specialty.
  • Patient Care: Conduct patient examinations, take detailed medical histories, order and interpret diagnostic tests, prescribe medications and therapies, and develop comprehensive treatment plans. This includes leading ward rounds and managing both inpatient and outpatient cases.
  • Supervision and Training: Oversee the clinical activities of junior medical staff (specialists, GP’s and Residents), and actively participate in their instruction, guidance, and supervision.
  • Multidisciplinary Collaboration: Liaise with other medical specialties and support services and participate in multi-disciplinary meetings to ensure holistic patient care.
  • On-Call Coverage: Participate in and ensure the provision of out-of-hours (on-call) coverage on a rotational basis, including evenings, nights, weekends, and public holidays.
  • Documentation and Compliance: Accurately and clearly document all relevant clinical information in a timely fashion. Comply with all hospital, departmental, and DOH policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements, including infection control and patient safety standards.
  • Quality Improvement: Participate in clinical audits, performance management systems (including peer review), and proactive risk management to foster continuous improvement in patient outcomes.
  • Communication: Communicate clinical information to patients and their families in a timely and compassionate manner, ensuring informed consent is obtained for procedures.

Qualifications and Requirements

  • Education: An MBBS or equivalent degree from a recognized medical school, followed by the successful completion of a structured specialty training program (e.g., North American/European Board Certification, Fellowship of a Royal College, or equivalent qualification from a DOH-approved ‘Tier 1’ or ‘Tier 2’ country). A postgraduate qualification such as MD, MS, or DNB is generally required.
  • Experience: A minimum of 3-7 years of post-specialty clinical experience, depending on the qualification and tier level, in a recognized multidisciplinary setting. Experience gaps of more than two years require specific DOH approval or a return-to-practice program.
  • Licensing: Eligibility of or a valid DOH (Department of Health Abu Dhabi) license to practice in Abu Dhabi is a mandatory legal requirement. The process involves:
  • Primary Source Verification (PSV): Mandatory verification of all educational and professional documents through the Data Flow Group.
  • DOH Exam: Successful completion of the DOH license exam unless exempted based on Tier 1 qualifications/experience.
  • Good Standing Certificate: A valid certificate from the current/previous licensing authority.
  • Skills: Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, strong leadership abilities, problem-solving skills, and a commitment to continuous medical education (CME/CPD).
  • Language: Fluency in English and Arabic is required, and competence in other languages is often a distinct asset.

Clinical Costing Analyst (SEHA HQ)

Under guidance from the Corporate Clinical Costing Manager, the Corporate Clinical Costing Analyst is responsible to support Corporate Clinical Costing Manager in day to day tasks. Responsibilities include, but are not limited to, execute monthly HCPSCs costing with coordination of regional costing analysts; v alidate and upload monthly payroll and VIP templates in CostPro; Close SEHA HQ cost module on monthly basis, assist the Manager in developing costing case studies.

Strong measurement skills, high level of logic, reasoning power and analytical experience would be pre-requisites to understand and quantify the numerous components of health care.

Demonstrates high level of competency in understanding of the clinical costing, and its operations across SEHA, to deliver value-added consulting.

Responsibilities

Decision Support for Senior Management

  • Allocate overhead costs to relevant direct cost departments using appropriate allocation bases.
  • Ensure completeness and accuracy of data supporting overhead allocations.
  • Close the SEHA HQ cost module on a monthly basis.

Clinical Costing System – CostPro

  • Coordinate with regional costing analysts for monthly closure of costing books.
  • Execute monthly HCPSCs costing in coordination with regional teams.
  • Validate and upload monthly payroll and VIP templates into CostPro.
  • Maintain and update common Relative Unit Values (RUVs), such as laboratory and imaging.
  • Support regional costing analysts in resolving data quality and system-related issues.
  • Assist the Manager and Senior Analyst in preparing periodic costing reports and analyses.

Projects and Programs

  • Maintain the costing Talabi system and track all incoming costing requests.
  • Map new cost centers to new or existing cost departments.
  • Map accounts to appropriate cost types in alignment with costing standards.

Department Operations & Business Continuity

  • Escalate issues and risks appropriately to ensure continuity of operations.
  • Support team members and provide coverage during absences or vacations as requested.
  • Attend SEHA team meetings, committees, and working groups as required.
  • Support the Manager in developing status reports and operational updates.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Mentoring and Training

  • In support of Emiratization initiatives, supervise, train, guide, and mentor National Developees and other team members.

Contributing to Team Effectiveness

  • Collaborate closely with the Corporate and Regional Costing teams.
  • Actively contribute to continuous improvement of costing processes and reporting.

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong analytical, logical reasoning, and quantitative skills.
  • High level of competency in clinical costing concepts and healthcare financial operations.
  • Strong understanding of clinical costing systems and end‑to‑end costing processes.
  • Attention to detail with the ability to work accurately under monthly closing timelines.
  • Effective communication and stakeholder coordination skills.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a multi-site, matrix environment.

Qualifications

Qualifications Required:

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Business Administration/Operations/Accounting/Finance/Commerce/Economics or relevant field OR Diploma in relevant field with 5 years of post-qualification experience.

Desired

Master’s degree or equivalent professional accountancy qualification with 3 years of post-qualification experience.

Required Experience

Minimum of 2 years of Health care experience in a core business function with significant exposure and experience finance functions.

About Us

Abu Dhabi Healthcare Company (SEHA) is the largest and most comprehensive healthcare network in the UAE that was established in 2007 with the objective of operating all public hospitals and clinics across the Emirate of Abu Dhabi.

SEHA is committed to delivering world-class healthcare services using the most advanced diagnostics and systems across its network of public healthcare centers and hospitals in addition to partnering with global leaders in healthcare, including world renowned organizations such as the Mayo Clinic.

About The Team

SEHA is the largest and most comprehensive healthcare network in the UAE and owns and operates all the public hospitals and clinics of the Emirate of Abu Dhabi. SEHA was established to provide UAE residents, citizens, and tourists with integrated, outstanding healthcare services following the highest international quality and safety standards. SEHA is a key player in Abu Dhabi’s wider healthcare sector reform and is responsible for public healthcare facilities as it aims to make its public healthcare delivery comparable to the finest healthcare systems in the world.

Job Category: Allied Health

Position Type: Full Time

Years of Experience: 5 years and above

Summary

Physiotherapists have the knowledge, skills and competencies to support individuals and populations across the continuum of care, including health promotion and illness prevention, self-management, treatment and rehabilitation.

He/she will assess the impact of injury, disease or disorders of movement and function, and promote, restore and prolong physical independence by enhancing a patient’s functional capacity. He/she assesses and treats individuals across the lifespan who have illness, injury or disability affecting the neuro-musculoskeletal, cardiopulmonary, vascular, and neurological systems; they also promote wellness and increased quality of life through education, specialized programming and a holistic approach to care.

The role of the Physiotherapist includes, but is not limited to:

  • Assessment of clients with actual or potential impairments, pain, functional limitations, disabilities or other health related conditions using detailed history taking, as well as specific tests and measures for screening, establishing a diagnosis and monitoring change.
  • Diagnosis resulting from assessment findings and clinical reasoning to determine abilities, functional needs and potential for change.
  • Planning intervention strategies that address prognosis and follow-up and incorporates the application for selected approaches and techniques supported by the best evidence available and then communicating the plan to the patient and interdisciplinary team.
  • Physiotherapy intervention typically includes the development of a patient management program that encourages independence and uses various methods, techniques and education to produce changes in the patient’s functional status consistent with assessment findings, diagnosis and prognosis.
  • Implementing selected interventions safely to relieve pain; achieve and maintain health and fitness, functional independence and physical performance, and manage the identified impairments, disabilities and limits to participation.
  • Evaluation of health status as a baseline for monitoring or to determine the result, impact or effectiveness of physiotherapy intervention.
  • Screening for chronic and secondary conditions to promote prevention and early intervention.
  • Consulting with patients and provide professional advice and solutions as part of an interdisciplinary interprofessional team.
  • Program development, delivery and evaluation to support health and wellness for individuals, families, or groups.
  • Research that encompasses the application of critical inquiry, as well as participation in or assessment of findings from research activities.
  • Case management related to planning, directing, organizing and monitoring service delivery and effective utilization of resources.
  • Communication with patients, team members and other stakeholders to achieve collaboration and service coordination.

Requirements

  • Essential
  • Bachelor’s degree in Physiotherapy from an accredited institution
  • Licensed to practice or actively registered as Physiotherapist under MoPH in home country.
  • 1 to 3 years’ experience in a hospital setting with outpatient clinic and inpatient service.
  • Proficient level in English language.
  • Good knowledge and use of Microsoft suite and spreadsheets.
  • Ability to work in an interdisciplinary team environment
  • Ability to prioritize, manage time effectively and be flexible in a very active work environment.
  • Ability to critically appraise primary literature and use best practice health care literature databases.
  • Preferable
  • Female Arabic-speaker, DHP licensed
  • BLS or ACLS or CPR certified
  • 3 to 5 years’ experience in a hospital setting with outpatient clinic and inpatient service.
  • Completed post-graduate education or Master’s degree holder, western-trained/qualified, in areas such as advanced Physiotherapy techniques, Orthopaedics, health promotion, disease prevention and chronic disease management, Sports Rehabilitation, Women’s health.
  • Post-graduate training in areas such as orthopaedic manual therapy, dry-needling, women’s health and/or pre/post-natal rehabilitation
  • Familiarity with the development of fitness programs or holding an accredited personal fitness training certification (from ACSM, ACE, etc.) highly desirable
  • Experience with, or willingness to receive training in electronic medical record software; and familiar with internet-based literature searching databases.

The role ensures compliance with local health authority regulations, accreditation standards, and evidence-based infection control practices to minimize healthcare-associated infections (HAIs) and ensure patient, staff, and visitor safety.

Key Responsibilities

1. Infection Prevention & Control Program

  • Develop, implement, and regularly update infection control policies and procedures.
  • Ensure compliance with national and international infection prevention standards.
  • Monitor adherence to infection control protocols across all departments.

2. Surveillance & Monitoring

  • Conduct ongoing surveillance of healthcare-associated infections (HAIs).
  • Collect, analyze, and interpret infection data and trends.
  • Prepare and present regular infection control reports to management.
  • Investigate outbreaks and recommend corrective and preventive actions.

3. Training & Education

  • Conduct infection control orientation for new staff.
  • Provide regular training sessions on hand hygiene, PPE use, isolation precautions, and waste management.
  • Promote infection prevention awareness campaigns.

4. Audits & Compliance

  • Perform regular infection control audits (hand hygiene, sterilization, environmental cleaning, etc.).
  • Monitor sterilization and disinfection processes.
  • Ensure compliance with regulatory bodies and accreditation requirements.
  • Support internal and external audits.

5. Policy Implementation & Risk Management

  • Participate in risk assessments and quality improvement initiatives.
  • Develop action plans to address identified gaps.
  • Collaborate with department heads to implement corrective actions.

6. Occupational Health & Safety

  • Monitor staff immunization status.
  • Manage exposure incidents (needle stick injuries, blood/body fluid exposure).
  • Provide guidance on post-exposure prophylaxis protocols.

7. Environmental & Waste Management

  • Oversee biomedical waste management practices.
  • Ensure proper cleaning, disinfection, and sterilization standards are maintained.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Nursing (BSN) or equivalent.
  • Valid Nursing License.
  • Certification in Infection Prevention and Control (preferred).
  • Minimum 2–3 years of clinical nursing experience (ICU or acute care preferred).
  • Prior experience in infection control is an advantage.
