The Senior Medical Sales Representative plays a critical role in driving NCH’s healthcare and nutraceutical business by leading field execution within assigned territories while elevating the quality of customer engagement and commercial performance. Building on the core responsibilities of a Senior Medical Sales Representative, this role combines advanced scientific knowledge with strong commercial acumen to deliver sustainable growth, strengthen brand positioning, and deepen partnerships with healthcare professionals.

In addition to managing key accounts and achieving sales targets, the Senior Medical Sales Representative is expected to act as a role model within the field team, contributing to coaching junior representatives, sharing best practices, and providing high-quality market insights. The role supports strategic initiatives by influencing prescribing behaviour, identifying growth opportunities, and ensuring all activities are executed in full compliance with UAE healthcare regulations and NCH standards, while consistently embodying NCH’s Culture DNA of client-centricity, integrity, collaboration, trust, and practicality.

Roles and Responsibilities

Territory Management and Sales Planning

  • Develop and execute a comprehensive territory strategy aligned with brand objectives, ensuring achievement of sales targets and sustainable growth.
  • Own territory performance by analysing KPIs, identifying gaps, and implementing corrective actions to maximise productivity and ROI.
  • Prioritise high-value accounts and optimise coverage plans to enhance reach, frequency, and impact of field activities.
  • Contribute to forecasting and demand planning by providing accurate, data-driven field inputs.

Customer Engagement and Scientific Promotion

  • Deliver high-quality, insight-driven scientific detailing tailored to the needs of healthcare professionals, moving beyond standard product promotion.
  • Position products effectively within therapeutic areas by linking clinical evidence to patient outcomes and practice needs.
  • Lead complex discussions with key prescribers, pharmacists, and stakeholders, demonstrating strong therapeutic expertise.
  • Leverage both face-to-face and digital channels to maximise engagement and reach.

Relationship Management and Partnership Building

  • Build and manage strategic relationships with key opinion leaders, high-potential prescribers, and institutional accounts.
  • Identify and unlock cross-selling and portfolio expansion opportunities within key accounts.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to healthcare professionals, strengthening long-term partnerships and brand loyalty.
  • Support tender and institutional business initiatives where applicable, ensuring alignment with commercial strategy.

Market Intelligence and Business Insights

  • Analyse competitor activity, prescribing trends, and market dynamics to identify opportunities and risks.
  • Translate field insights into actionable recommendations for Marketing, Medical, and Commercial teams.
  • Provide structured feedback to support brand strategy refinement and campaign effectiveness.
  • Contribute to territory and brand-level business reviews with data-backed insights.

Events, Training, and Professional Education

  • Lead participation in scientific congresses, workshops, and educational events, ensuring strong brand presence.
  • Support the planning and execution of round tables, speaker programmes, and awareness initiatives.
  • Deliver impactful presentations to healthcare audiences, enhancing brand credibility and engagement.
  • Continuously upgrade scientific and market knowledge to remain a credible and trusted expert.

Cross-Functional Collaboration and Compliance

  • Ensure strict adherence to MOHAP, DHA, and internal compliance guidelines across all activities.
  • Collaborate closely with Marketing, Medical Affairs, and Regulatory teams to ensure alignment of messaging and execution.
  • Maintain accurate and timely CRM reporting, ensuring high-quality data for decision-making.
  • Champion NCH’s Culture DNA by embedding client-centricity, integrity, collaboration, trust, and simplicity in daily interactions.

Coaching, Mentoring & Field Excellence

  • Support onboarding and coaching of junior Medical Representatives to elevate overall team capability and performance.
  • Share best practices in call planning, objection handling, and customer engagement to drive consistency in execution.
  • Act as a role model in professionalism, scientific knowledge, and ethical promotion.
  • Contribute to building a high-performance, collaborative field culture aligned with NCH values.

Must-Have Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Pharmacy, Medicine, or a related scientific discipline; postgraduate qualification in Business or Life Sciences is an advantage.
  • 5 to 8 years of progressive experience in pharmaceutical, nutraceutical, or healthcare sales within the GCC, with a proven track record of consistent target achievement.
  • Demonstrated experience in managing key accounts, influencing prescribing behaviour, and driving territory growth.
  • Prior exposure to multiple therapeutic areas, with the ability to handle complex product portfolios and scientific discussions.
  • Experience in mentoring or supporting junior team members is preferred.
  • Valid UAE driving license and willingness to travel across assigned territories.

Measures of Success

  • Builds strong, trust-based relationships by understanding customer needs and delivering tailored solutions.
  • Demonstrates ownership, resilience, and accountability while maintaining the highest ethical standards.
  • Works effectively across functions, adapts quickly to change, and contributes to collective success.
  • Acts with honesty, reliability, and professionalism to build long-term partnerships with stakeholders.
  • Communicates clearly, solves problems efficiently, and focuses on actions that deliver measurable impact.

Insurance & Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) Director

Job Summary The Insurance & RCM Director is responsible for the strategic and operational management of all relationships, contracts, and agreements with medical insurance companies. This role aims to maximize revenue, expand the center’s payer network, and optimize the Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) process. The director will oversee medical approvals, claims, and rejection, while analyzing rejection root causes (medical or technical) to maximize acceptance rates and drive annual revenue growth in alignment with the Center’s financial goals.

Key Responsibilities Contract Management & Strategic Partnerships:

  • Policy Review & Optimization: Regularly review and evaluate current insurance policies to protect the Center’s financial interests and secure optimal reimbursement rates.
  • Network Expansion: Identify, negotiate, review and establish new contracts and agreements with medical insurance companies and third-party administrators (TPAs) not currently in the network.
  • Relationship Management: Build and maintain strong, long-term strategic relationships with key stakeholders at insurance firms to secure competitive pricing and favorable terms.

Operational Management (Claims & Approvals)

  • Approvals & Claims Supervision: Oversee the end-to-end workflow of medical approval requests and ensure accurate, timely submission of financial claims to payers.
  • Rejection Management: Analyze the root causes of medical and technical rejections and implement corrective action plans to minimize rejection and steadily increase the “Approval Rate.”
  • Financial Reconciliation: Follow up on collections, settlements, and aging accounts receivable with insurance companies to resolve discrepancies and accelerate cash flow.

Financial Analysis & Revenue Growth

  • Revenue & Profitability Analysis: Analyze the revenue share and financial performance of each insurance provider to identify high-yield versus low-performing payers.
  • Annual Growth Targets: Develop and execute strategic pricing and negotiation tactics to ensure sustainable annual revenue growth from insurance channels.
  • RCM Cross-Functional Collaboration: Coordinate closely with clinical and ancillary departments (Physicians, Nursing, Pharmacy) to improve medical documentation and data quality, directly accelerating the revenue cycle and eliminating revenue leakage.

Reporting

  • Periodic Reporting: Prepare and present comprehensive performance reports (weekly/monthly/quarterly) to executive management, highlighting RCM efficiency, rejection/approval metrics, payer-specific growth, and strategic recommendations.

Job Requirements & Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in medicine & surgery, Pharmacy, Healthcare Management, or a related field. A Master’s degree (MBA/MHA) or professional certification in health insurance/RCM is highly preferred.
  • Experience: Minimum of 5 to 7 years of progressive experience in medical insurance management within a major hospital or specialized medical center. Prior experience in oncology or chronic disease centers is a significant advantage.
  • Negotiation Skills: Proven track record of successfully negotiating high-value medical contracts and securing profitable terms for healthcare providers.
  • Analytical Skills: Advanced capability in financial data analysis, utilizing key performance indicators (KPIs) to drive operational decisions.
  • Regulatory Knowledge: Deep understanding of local health insurance laws, regulations (e.g., Council of Health Insurance – CHI rules), and medical coding standards (such as ICD-10-AM).
  • Strong leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills to bridge the gap between clinical teams and insurance corporations.
  • Full professional proficiency in both Arabic and English (written and spoken).
  • Advanced proficiency in Hospital Information Systems (HIS) and data analysis tools (such as advanced MS Excel or BI tools).

Job Description

The neurosurgeon provides neurosurgical patients with pre-operative care, including diagnosis, operative care of all major and minor procedures in the field of neurosurgery and postoperative care.  The neurosurgeon also provides preventive care of patients according to approved procedures as part of an integrated program of curative/preventive services.

Responsibilities

  1. Provides comprehensive and diligent neurosurgical care to all assigned patients including pre- and post-operative care and such neurosurgical procedures as are within incumbent’s competence.
    1. Performs professional duties at the OPD at which outpatient neurosurgical care is to be rendered to patients.
    2. Provides consultation services to physicians and other surgeons and assumes after-hours responsibility for the care of neurosurgical cases and makes daily rounds for those hospitalized.
    3. Refers to, or consults with, other neurosurgeons on those cases that require more specialized diagnostic or therapeutic procedures.
    4. Adheres to the Bylaws and Rules and Regulations of the Medical Department and assures that work performed is in keeping with the established standards of the Joint Commission on Accreditation of Hospitals.
    5. Consults with the anesthesiologist on the choice of anesthesia to be used.
    6. Maintains complete and accurate records of all cases.
    7. Participates in and contributes to in-service activities such as lectures, conferences and rounds.
    8. Keeps confidentiality of the patient’s disease.
    9. Keeps a high standard in the neurosurgical field by attending meetings of neurosurgery, reviewing specialized journals and updated literature and keeps a high medical and ethical standard as required by the NMC Royal Hospital DIP, Dubai rules and regulations.
    10. Participates and contributes to all the quality assurance activities of the service (e.g. monthly mortality and morbidity conference, peer review, audit and chart review).

Qualifications

  1. Graduation from an approved medical school.
    1. Plus one year of internship and at least four years of an approved residency in neurosurgery in an approved training program.
    2. At least three years of experience in all fields of neurosurgery including traumatic neurosurgery.
    3. The neurosurgeon must have the Certificate of the American Board of Neurosurgery or equivalent certificate, e.g. the Fellowship of the Royal College of Surgeons in Neurosurgery or other equivalent certificate.
    4. Current license in country of origin with Consultant Neurosurgeon DHA license to practice in Dubai, U.A.E.
    5. Must have a thorough knowledge of medical ethics, with particular reference to the obligation to maintain the confidentiality of his work; personality which inspires confidence and trust in his patients; and adhere to Bylaws, Rules and Regulations of the Medical Organization.
    6. Excellent command of oral and written English. Knowledge of Arabic language is desirable but not essential.
    7. Communication, interpersonal skills as applied to interaction with co-workers, superiors, patients & families.

Job Description

The SLT works as part of a multidisciplinary pediatric rehabilitation team to develop individualized, evidence-based intervention plans that support the child’s communication, functional participation, independence and quality of life across home, educational and community environments.

The role includes management of children with complex conditions such as cerebral palsy, autism spectrum disorder, developmental delay, ADHD and other pediatric conditions. Intervention may include speech and language therapy, feeding and swallowing management, augmentative and alternative communication (AAC), assistive communication technology and caregiver education, according to the individual needs of the child.

The therapist collaborates closely with families, caregivers, educators, physicians and the multidisciplinary rehabilitation team to ensure coordinated, family-centered care and consistency of therapeutic strategies across the child’s environments. Services are delivered in accordance with Department of Health (DOH) requirements, organizational policies and procedures, and the professional scope of practice for Speech and Language Therapy.

Responsibilities

  • Conduct comprehensive, age-appropriate speech, language, communication, feeding and swallowing assessments for children with developmental, neurological and neurodevelopmental conditions, including cerebral palsy, autism spectrum disorder, ADHD and developmental delay.
  • Develop and implement individualized, evidence-based treatment plans with measurable functional goals that support communication, learning, participation, feeding, independence and quality of life across home, educational and community environments.
  • Use standardized assessments, clinical and play-based observation, caregiver and educator interviews, and functional communication measures appropriate to the child’s age, diagnosis and needs.
  • Provide intervention for speech sound disorders, receptive and expressive language difficulties, social communication needs, fluency, voice, cognitive-communication, oral-motor, feeding and swallowing difficulties within professional scope and competency.
  • Assess functional communication abilities and, where clinically indicated, use appropriate pediatric tools such as the Communication Matrix and other validated measures.
  • Assess the need for augmentative and alternative communication (AAC) and recommend appropriate low- and high-tech communication systems based on the child’s communication, motor, visual and cognitive abilities.
  • Contribute to assessment and trials of AAC access methods, including direct access, switches and eye-gaze technology, in collaboration with Occupational Therapy and the wider multidisciplinary team.
  • Work collaboratively with Physicians, Physiotherapy, Occupational Therapy, Dietetics, Psychology, educators, inclusion teams and other relevant professionals to support coordinated multidisciplinary assessment, goal setting and intervention.
  • Observe children within their educational or functional environments, where appropriate, to identify barriers to communication, learning and participation and recommend practical strategies, communication supports and environmental modifications.
  • Collaborate with educators, inclusion teams and learning support staff to integrate therapy recommendations and communication strategies into the child’s daily routines and learning environment.
  • Provide family-centered care and actively involve parents and caregivers in goal setting, home programs, caregiver education and carry-over of communication, feeding and AAC strategies.
  • Provide caregiver and educator training to support consistent use of therapeutic strategies and communication systems across the child’s environments.
  • Participate in multidisciplinary case conferences, progress reviews, care planning and discharge or transition planning, providing relevant clinical recommendations and progress updates within consent and confidentiality requirements.
  • Monitor progress using appropriate pediatric outcome measures and revise intervention plans according to clinical findings, functional progress, family feedback and multidisciplinary recommendations.
  • Maintain timely, accurate and comprehensive documentation of assessments, treatment sessions, progress, communication, cancellations, reports and discharge planning in accordance with legal, professional and organizational requirements.
  • Identify developmental, safeguarding or clinical concerns and escalate or refer appropriately in accordance with organizational policies and procedures.
  • Support education, awareness and community outreach activities for families, educators and other stakeholders related to pediatric speech, language, communication, feeding and swallowing needs, including participation in school fairs, awareness campaigns and community events to promote early identification and access to Speech and Language Therapy services.
  • Apply evidence-based practice and current research to clinical decision-making and maintain ongoing competency in pediatric rehabilitation, AAC, feeding and swallowing management.

Qualifications

metas.experience: Minimum of 2 years’ Speech and Language Therapy experience, with pediatric clinical experience

Job Description

Provides direct patient care, conducts a patient assessment and re-assessment, and establishes patient goals and care plans for physiotherapy services using different therapeutic techniques without or with the utilization of assistive medical devices and/or equipment. Promotes patient’s physical wellness and treatments that include the ability to move, to prevent or reduce pain, to enable and restore function and prevent physical disability. Collaborates and establishes working relationships along with other clinical individuals and/or multi-disciplinary teams to discuss the patient’s goals and plan of care to prevent the loss of physical functionality and mobility before it occurs by identifying the treatment, developing fitness and wellness-oriented programs to maintain a healthier and more active lifestyle of individual patients.

Treats patients according to the established goals and plan of care which are clinically indicated, appropriate and prescribed by the Consultant and/or the Physician and agreed upon by the patient and/or patient’s caregiver and following the clinical policy and procedures of the department. Provides clinical and technical support to Junior Physical Therapists, Physiotherapy Assistants, Occupational Therapists, Nurses, Speech Pathologist, Respiratory Therapist and visiting student interns when required.

Responsibilities

Quality and Accuracy:

  • Understands the hospital mission, and vision and excellent customer service following the correct patient care processes, clinical standards and practices of physiotherapy services.
  • Communicates process and the chain of command structure in reporting patient-related incidents, complaints and/or other related issues of concerns.
  • Demonstrates full compliance and competence to the American Hospital Dubai and Physical Therapy Department’s clinical policy and procedure including patient and equipment safety and the prevention and control of infection required to provide patient care.  
  • Performs independently the assigned clinical and technical tasks with confidence, the ability to prioritize tasks and perform critical thinking following the hospital and the department clinical policy and procedures.
  • Performs initial and comprehensive patient care assessments follow-up assessments and re-assessments following the American Physical Therapy Association (APTA) clinical standards and guidelines.  
  • Performs the initial and comprehensive patient care assessment and follow-up assessment and re-assessments that include, cognitive score assessment (GCS), cardio-respiratory assessment of patient’s vital signs (HR, BP, RR, and SPO2), Musculoskeletal assessment (ROM/MMT), pain score assessment (VAS/FLACC), integumentary assessment (swelling, bruising), the risk for fall, patient care goals, patient care plans, patient care outcome and patient education.  
  • Provides the appropriate physiotherapy services and/or physiotherapy modalities as clinically indicated and/or based on the patient’s clinical diagnosis and/or current presenting symptoms.    
  • Applies the appropriate physiotherapy modalities based on the patient care plan following the correct treatment frequency, time duration and the device settings and/or intensity and/or frequency required during the patient’s treatment.  
  • Selects and executes the appropriate measurement procedures and/or tools to assess the patient’s clinical status, such as joint ROM tests, manual muscle tests, and functional and coordination tests before, during and after each patient treatment. 
  • Selects and executes the appropriate supportive and assistive devices and/or equipment preventing possible harm and/or injury to the patient and/or damage to the equipment.
  • Provides the patient, the patient’s relative and other medical staff with physiotherapy clinical and technical education whenever required.  
  • Performs and monitors the department’s Quality Measures requirements and participates in Quality Improvement activities and other department projects.
  • Reports all patient care-related incidents and/or customer service complaints to improve patient care services.
  • Assists the department in the initiation and reviews of the department’s clinical policy and procedure whenever required.

Quantity and Organizational Skills:

  • Provides physiotherapy services equivalent to twenty-six (26) sessions and/or Current Procedural Terminology (CPT) codes and with each session limited to 15 minutes that may include any of the following modalities listed below:
    • Patient Initial Assessment and Re-assessment
    • Cryotherapy/Heat Therapy
    • Manual Therapy
    • Massage Therapy
    • Transcutaneous Electrical Nerve Stimulation (TENS)
    • Therapeutic Exercises
    • Ultrasound Therapy
    • Interferential Therapy
    • Mechanical Traction Therapy
    • Electrical Current Therapy
    • Gait Training Therapy
    • Lymphatic Edema Therapy
  • Participates in the department staff meetings and unit projects, and implements/evaluates creative approaches to meeting goals.
  • Performs additional duties and/or tasks as specified and/or assigned by the Director, Asst. Director, ARC Manager, ARC Team Leader and/or the ARC Senior Physiotherapist.
  • Assists as a clinical resource to the patient, patient’s relatives and/or caregiver, junior Physiotherapists, Occupational Therapist, Nursing, Speech Pathologist and other medical staff. 
  • Ensures full compliance with the safety requirements of physiotherapy medical equipment, performs functional and calibration checks and ensures that all medical equipment for repair is reported to the Biomedical Engineer and the follow-up repair required is processed and completed. 
  • Maintains the availability of physiotherapy medical equipment for patient utilization, performs daily and monthly inventory and ensures that this equipment is placed and/or stored in the designated areas.   
  • Ensures full compliance with the safety and availability of physiotherapy medical supplies minimizes medical supplies losses and reports to the Materials Management Department all supply replacements, expiry and losses requirements.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree of Science in Physiotherapy and/or Bachelor of Science in Physical Therapy
  • Current license of practice in country of origin or country point of hire and/or Dubai Health Authority (DHA), United Arab Emirates

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE:

  • Minimum of two (2) years of experience post-certification as a Junior Physiotherapist/Physical Therapist
  • Excellent English verbal and written communication skills

Overview

M42 delivers comprehensive healthcare services across the full continuum of care; from primary care to advanced specialty treatments. With a global presence spanning more than 480 facilities in 27 countries and a dedicated workforce of over 20,000 professionals, M42 is uniquely positioned to redefine the future of healthcare on a global scale.

Since its inception in 2010, National Reference Laboratory (NRL) has expanded from a single standalone reference laboratory to a network of 12 state-of-the-art facilities across the United Arab Emirates. NRL provides world-class diagnostic services to the M42 network and partners with more than 250 clients from a wide range of market segments, including private and government hospitals, medical centers and clinics, corporate organizations, and other reference laboratories.

As a Senior Medical Laboratory Technologist – Anatomical Pathology, you will play a key role in delivering high-quality diagnostic laboratory services by performing and overseeing complex histopathology procedures. You will ensure excellence in specimen processing, quality assurance, and regulatory compliance while supporting continuous improvement, mentoring junior staff, and collaborating with pathologists to provide accurate and timely patient diagnoses.

Basic Function

Provides the full range of ophthalmological care to all Saudi Aramco employees and their eligible dependents.  Participates in the planning and implementation of integrated preventative-curative medical care programs.

Scope

Responsible for evaluating, diagnosing and treatment in the field of ophthalmology, including medical and surgical conditions of the eye: ordering general and specific tests to diagnose and manage eye condition; performs non-invasive and invasive procedures, performs elective and emergency surgery, as expected within the scope of Ophthalmologist and Sub-specialist.  Performs YAG and Argon laser applications.  Reports to and receives administrative guidance from the physician manager, Ophthalmology Services Unit.

Principal Contacts

Has daily contacts with patients and their families, physicians, specialist, nurses, allied health staff and clinical administrators.

Principal Duties

  1. Performs complete eye examination, assessment, determines and/or implements the treatment plan and discusses with the patient and /or his/her family, the eye findings, management, expected results of the treatment and possible complications.
  2. Follows patient through their illness at appropriately spaced intervals.
  3. Completes patient and other medical records promptly and accurately, indicating diagnosis, treatment and action.
  4. Maintains strict confidentiality of patient’s medical records.
  5. Performs elective and emergency surgeries as expected within the scope of Ophthalmologist.
  6. Cover on calls as per the schedules.
  7. Performs both YAG and Argon Laser therapy.
  8. Refers patients to the appropriate services including Ophthalmology Sub-specialists.
  9. Participates in case discussions with the Sub-specialists.

Education

  • Graduation from an approved medical school.
  • Board Certification by Saudi, American Board, Canadian Royal College of Physicians, or equivalent.
  • Ophthalmology board certification from a recognized training program by SCFHS & JHAH HR.

Experience

  • Three years of practice in the field of Ophthalmology after the board, with proof of expertise.
  • Must hold a valid SCFHS license

Certifications/Other requirements as applicable

  • Excellent command of the English language, both verbal and written.
  • Ability to adjust to group practice in a medical environment.

In conjunction with the Chair of Triad/Dyad plan, direct, and control the administrative, financial and operational activities of the Triad/Dyad.  The Administrator will work collaboratively with JHAH leadership and the Chair of Triad/Dyad to develop the strategic plan, set direction, and insure that all aspects of the plan are accomplished, meet all targets, ensuring ongoing evaluation of the organization’s growth and development and quality of care.  Provide administrative leadership to the Chair of the Triad/Dyad and the physicians and staff in formulating and achieving departmental and units objectives.

Scope

  • Responsible for administrative aspects of inpatient and outpatient operations for the service line including access to care, facilities management and human resource management.
  • Oversees financial development and management of operating budgets, capital budgets and contract activities for the service line.
  • Participates and coordinates the business planning, new program development, financial modeling, program implementation and assessment / reporting of new program outcomes with Triad / Dyad leadership. 
  • Assess and streamline current service, redefine product lines and work collaboratively to integrate services across clinical, support and ancillary departments.
  • Identify and achieve Center of Excellence status for specific service line divisions and product lines.
  • Assess business and health care environments to develop service line strategic plan and effective positioning of clinical services to the current and future patient population.
  • Focus on patient centered care and experience through operations, workflow and service line administration.
  • Provides timely and accurate communication of departmental status to Hospital leadership, Departmental leadership, and staff members. 
  • Assure that policies, procedures, plans and regulatory requirements are in place and adequate to maintain operations for safe and appropriate patient care and departmental objectives.
  • Represents and participates in multiple executive and management level meetings and committees on behalf of the service line.
  • May have direct supervision responsibilities for assigned staff members.

Principal Contacts

Internal: Daily interaction with Triad / Dyad leadership and service line staff. Interactions with support departments including but not limited to Finance, Facilities Management, Supply Chain Operations, Pharmacy, Radiology, Laboratory Services, Human Resources, Patient Services, Access and Security. Exposure and communication to multiple internal committees and executive leadership.

External: Interactions with the vendor/ supplier community, government agencies, referring providers and external professional organizations.

Principal Duties

I.Patient Centered

  1. Monitor customer satisfaction and facilitate / develop plans to achieve service line excellence.
  2. Address patient and provider complaints and ensure their prompt resolution.
  3. Develop strategic and operational plans based on the Patient Experience to enhance satisfaction.
  4. Participate in organizational and service line Patient Experience committees, task forces and projects.
  5. Responsible for the achievement of service line and organizational Key Performance Indicators (KPI)
  6. Monitor the external environment and patient referral to recommend new, expanded or reallocated services for optimal Patient Experience.
  7. Liase with the district locations on service offerings and patient experience.
  8. Develop service line patient centered strategic plan in coordination with Triad / Dyad leadership.
  9. Develop Centers of Excellence within the service line (certified and non-certified)

II.Timely

  1. Ensure prompt patient access to outpatient and inpatient services.
  2. Monitor and assist in the optimization of service line inpatient length of stay (LOS)
  3. Routinely review and update outpatient templates, provider schedules, resource utilization to optimize the patient wait time and service availability.
  4. Assess patient downstream services and wait times outside of the service line (Lab, OR, Radiology)
  5. Develop process improvements for optimal wait times and maximized resource utilization
  6. Develop business plans and financial models for new programs, expanding or contracting current services, redefining product lines or services.
  7. Assess, monitor and report new and changes in clinical services for variation and success.
  8. Work collaboratively within JHAH to streamline current services and integrate services across clinical, support and ancillary departments.

III.Efficient

  1. Oversee the service line budget process and assure that assumptions and forecast for both expense and revenue budgets are accurate, timely and realistic during the course of the fiscal year.
  2. Participate in the capital budgeting process reviewing proposed capital replacement program and providing new business case justification for service line capital requests.
  3. Allocate resources and develop efficiencies to improve and maintain the services of the service line and to ensure positive financial performance.
  4. Analyze and report service line variance and financial performance reports routinely including discrepancies, interventions and corrective actions.
  5. Monitor cost per EMR, encounter and other relevant expense ratios and develop/ implement plans to achieve improvement to community benchmarks.
  6. Coordinate the development of strategic and operational plans to optimize external medical referrals and support appropriate EMR migration.
  7. Routinely review resources (physical space, medical equipment, information technologies, human capital) and determine areas of optimization and efficiency through process improvement activities such as lean, six sigma and project management

Principal Duties (cont’d)

IV.Engagement

  1. Assist Triad / Dyad Chief with physician recruitment and retention, physician credentialing, and job actions.
  2. Monitor employee engagement and establish service line specific employee engagement plans, updating progress routinely.
  3. Provide leadership and participation in service line team building and contributing to the overall morale of Johns Hopkins Aramco Healthcare.
  4. Develop and execute service line marketing and public relations efforts focused on the local and regional community, professional / academic partners and potential employee recruits.
  5. Support clinical innovation and research in the service line through budgeting, business planning, marketing, human resource management and project management.
  6. Represent the service line in the professional community supporting collaborative relationships with other providers, networks, third-party payers, researchers and other partners.

V.Safe / Effective

  1. Collaborate with the Triad / Dyad leadership on the establishment, review and monitoring of service line policies, procedures, plans, guidelines and regulatory requirement.
  2. Monitor and report service line safety information and data on a routine basis including interventions and corrective actions.
  3. Act as administrative liaison to operational services, such as housekeeping, facilities management, nutrition, supply chain, clinical engineering, etc., to support operations and high quality delivery of care.
  4. Support shareholder collaborations with Distinguished Faculty and subject matter expert visits.
  5. Collaborate with Patient Safety Officers to ensure optimal patient safety and quality activities across the service line.
  6. Assist in establishing an inclusive, responsive and safe environment for providers, staff and patients.

Education

  • Master degree is preferred.

Minimum 10 years’ relevant experience.

  • Knowledge of hospital finance, administration, and clinical delivery
  • Knowledge of physician group practice or IPA operations
  • Knowledge of managed care/population health
  • Knowledge of clinical quality metrics

  • Demonstrated leadership qualities required
  • Demonstrated multidisciplinary team development skills

  • Intermediate to Advanced Computer Skills (Word Processing, Spreadsheet, Presentations etc.)
  • Preferred experience with SAP or other health care specific ERP systems
  • Healthcare, Business Management or Project Management Certifications preferred.

M42 delivers comprehensive healthcare services across the full continuum of care; from primary care to advanced specialty treatments. Leveraging cutting-edge health technologies and precision medicine, we ensure the highest standards of effectiveness, efficiency, and patient-centered outcomes. With a global presence spanning more than 480 facilities in 27 countries and a dedicated workforce of over 20,000 professionals, M42 is uniquely positioned to redefine the future of healthcare on a global scale.

Danat Al Emarat is a world-class specialty women’s and children’s hospital in the Emirate of Abu Dhabi. It offers advanced medical services across specialties including Neonatology, Pediatrics, Obstetrics & Gynecology, and Women’s Health. The hospital is one of the very few to encompass a dedicated Fetal Medicine Department along with a full-fledged Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU) in the UAE. This has established Danat Al Emarat as a regional referral center for women with high-risk pregnancies, supported by its Level III NICU providing care for the most fragile newborns.

Danat Al Emarat Hospital is seeking a Consultant in Pediatrics to join its highly specialized women’s and children’s healthcare facility in Abu Dhabi. The role involves delivering advanced, patient-centered pediatric care across inpatient and outpatient settings, ensuring excellence in clinical outcomes while supporting the hospital’s commitment to family-focused care.

Perform diagnostic procedures, interpret radiographs, ultrasound, and CT and MRI images and perform interventional procedures within limits of the assigned privileges.

Child And Adolescent Psychiatrist

About ACPN

(ACPN) is the leading subspecialist mental health and neuroscience institution, having opened its doors in Abu Dhabi in 2008. Over the past 16+ years, ACPN has grown from a one clinic into a multi-site network spanning Abu Dhabi, Dubai, and Al Ain — having touched the lives of over 100,000 patients and earning JCI accreditation as a mark of its unwavering commitment to international quality standards.

Our multidisciplinary team of psychiatrists, neurologists, psychologists, and therapists — the majority of whom are Board-certified or trained in the US and Europe — delivers world-class, evidence-based care across the full spectrum of mental health and neurological conditions. ACPN holds an A+ rating from DAMAN Health Insurance and maintains full licensure with DOH and DHA.

We aspire to be the most prominent Neuroscience and Mental Healthcare provider in the Middle East — and our Children’s Neuroscience Services and dedicated child/adolescent programs are central to that mission.

The Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced, compassionate, and driven Child and Adolescent Psychiatrist to join our growing clinical team. This is an exceptional opportunity to practice at a well-resourced, internationally recognized center where you will work alongside a collaborative multidisciplinary team to deliver transformative care to young patients and their families across the United Arab Emirates.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct comprehensive psychiatric evaluations and diagnostic assessments for children and adolescents (ages 4–17) presenting with a wide range of mental health conditions.
  • Develop and implement individualized, evidence-based treatment plans including psychopharmacology, psychotherapy modalities, and family-centered interventions.
  • Manage ongoing patient caseloads with regular follow-up consultations and medication management as needed.
  • Collaborate with psychologists, therapists, neurologists, and pediatricians within the multidisciplinary team to deliver holistic, coordinated care.
  • Provide diagnostic and consultative services for neurodevelopmental conditions including ADHD, autism spectrum disorder, and learning difficulties.
  • Offer crisis assessment and acute mental health support for pediatric patients when required.
  • Participate in psychoeducation and support sessions with families and caregivers.
  • Contribute to ACPN’s academic and CME activities, including conferences, masterclasses, and institutional research initiatives.
  • Maintain meticulous clinical documentation in compliance with DOH/DHA regulatory standards and JCI accreditation requirements.
  • Uphold ACPN’s patient-first ethos and the highest standards of clinical ethics and confidentiality.

Qualifications & Requirements

Essential

  • MD or equivalent medical degree with specialization in Psychiatry.
  • Completed fellowship or subspecialty training in Child and Adolescent Psychiatry.
  • Board certification (ABPN) or equivalent European/UK Board certification highly preferred.
  • Minimum 3 years of post-fellowship clinical experience in child and adolescent psychiatry.
  • Eligible for licensure with the Department of Health (DOH) or Dubai Health Authority (DHA).
  • Proficiency in English; Arabic language skills are an advantage.

Preferred

  • Experience with neurodevelopmental disorders (ADHD, ASD, intellectual disabilities).
  • Familiarity with eating disorder assessment and management in young populations.
  • Prior experience working in a multicultural or expatriate patient environment.
  • Interest or experience in academic psychiatry, research, or CME contributions.

What We Offer

  • Competitive tax-free remuneration package commensurate with experience.
  • Relocation support.
  • Comprehensive medical insurance for you and your family.
  • Visa sponsorship and license processing support.
  • A collaborative, multidisciplinary clinical environment with peer support and supervision.
  • Access to ACPN’s flagship CME.
  • Opportunity to contribute to meaningful and growing children’s mental health services in the region.
  • A stable, long-established institution with a strong reputation and loyal patient base.

Company Description TherapyMantra is a global online therapy platform dedicated to transforming access to mental healthcare across 40+ countries, including the USA, UK, Canada, and India. The organization provides individual counseling, couples and family therapy, child counseling, and workplace mental health programs through a large network of licensed psychologists, counselors, and therapists. Backed by $15M in funding from Impanix Capital, TherapyMantra has supported over 100,000 clients and 500 organizations in improving emotional well-being. Its secure, user-friendly platform offers 24/7 support via video, chat, and app-based tools, along with flexible scheduling and regional language support. Clients also benefit from self-help tools, meditation resources, and community support designed to promote resilience and long-term healing.

Role Description This is a part-time, remote role for an OCD Therapist/Psychologist at TherapyMantra. The professional in this role will provide online, evidence-based assessment and treatment for individuals experiencing Obsessive-Compulsive Disorder and related conditions, using modalities such as CBT, ERP, and other scientifically validated approaches. Day-to-day responsibilities include conducting comprehensive intake assessments, developing individualized treatment plans, delivering therapy sessions via secure video or chat, and monitoring client progress with structured measures. The role involves maintaining accurate and timely clinical documentation, collaborating with a multidisciplinary team as needed, and participating in case discussions or supervision where applicable. The therapist/psychologist will also educate clients and families about OCD, offer relapse-prevention strategies, and contribute to a supportive, client-centered therapeutic environment.

Qualifications

  • Strong foundation in Psychology and Mental Health, with expertise in anxiety disorders, OCD, and evidence-based treatment approaches.
  • Clinical skills in Counseling and Psychological Assessment, including intake evaluations, diagnosis, treatment planning, and outcome monitoring.
  • Relevant education and training in Medicine or clinical disciplines (e.g., MD/DO with psychiatry training, PhD/PsyD in Clinical Psychology, or equivalent qualifications, as applicable to jurisdiction).
  • Current professional license or registration (where required by local regulations) to practice independently or under supervision in mental health services.
  • Demonstrated experience delivering online or telehealth-based therapy, with comfort using digital platforms and maintaining data privacy and confidentiality.
  • Excellent interpersonal, communication, and empathic listening skills, with a client-centered, culturally sensitive, and non-judgmental approach.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote setting, manage a part-time caseload, and maintain reliable internet access and a private workspace.
  • Experience with CBT/ERP for OCD, trauma-informed care, or group therapy is highly beneficial.

Nurse Practitioner – Women’s Services

Job Description

JOB SUMMARY

The Nurse Practitioner – Women’s Services is a licensed independent practitioner who is responsible for managing health problems and coordinating age-appropriate health care for the patient. S/he is part of the innovative care team that will meet the individual needs of the patient and their family. The APN practices in accordance with MOPH Department of Healthcare Practitioner rules and regulations and the APNs professional body’s standards of care providing evidence-based best practice care in an age-appropriate care model. Included in their scope of practice is performing histories, examinations, ordering appropriate diagnostic and therapeutic tests and procedures along with prescribing pharmacological and non-pharmacological interventions. The Nurse Practitioner – Women’s Services manages chronic patient conditions. S/he is instrumental in providing patient and family education. The Nurse Practitioner – Women’s Services is an active and respected member of the Healthcare team designed to meet the individual needs of the patient and her family. The Nurse Practitioner – Women’s Services takes key responsibility as a patient advocate and ensuring referral of the patient when necessary.

The Nurse Practitioner – Women’s Services provides comprehensive, patient-centered healthcare services to women across the lifespan. The role focuses on preventive care, reproductive health, antenatal care, contraception counseling, menopause management, urogynecology services, and urodynamic assessment.

Responsibilities

KEY ROLE ACCOUNTABILITIES

  • Knowledge of advanced nursing practice must be at a formal level of education including board certification. Applicant must have a professional mastery of the scope of professional practice. 
  • Undertakes considerable independent judgment with direct impact on the patient’s health, well-being and satisfaction within authority and own job scope.
  • Works as part of the provider team, the APN sees patients within their scope of practice creating other care opportunities for the physicians

Clinical Practice

  • Functions independently to evaluate and treat patients with complex acute, critical and chronically ill patients, according to written guidelines as defined by the nurse practitioner’s professional scope of practice as defined by the MOPH Department of Healthcare Practitioner and in adherence with Sidra’s agreed upon scopes of practice. 
  • Performs age-appropriate histories on new patients. 
  • Performs physical examinations including pelvic and breast examinations, including pap smear sampling.
  • Provides routine antenatal assessments and monitoring for low-risk pregnancies.
  • Conducts maternal health screening including blood pressure monitoring, fetal assessment, and risk evaluation, including DVT risk assessment.
  • Educates expectant mothers on pregnancy health, nutrition, lifestyle, and birth preparation.
  • Identifies pregnancy complications and refer to obstetricians when necessary.
  • Provides counseling on contraceptive options including hormonal, non-hormonal, and long-acting reversible contraception.
  • Prescribes and manages contraception in accordance with clinical guidelines.
  • Inserts and removes contraceptive devices where credentialed (e.g., IUDs, implants).
  • Supports patients in family planning decisions and reproductive health management.
  • Assess and manage symptoms related to perimenopause and menopause.
  • Provides counseling on hormonal and non-hormonal management options.
  • Prescribe and monitor hormone replacement therapy (HRT) where appropriate.
  • Provides guidance on bone health, cardiovascular risk, and lifestyle interventions during midlife.
  • Performs pertinent physical exams with assessment of the normal and abnormal findings on new patients
  • Assess and manage pelvic floor disorders including urinary incontinence and pelvic organ prolapse.
  • Performs urodynamic assessments and assist with diagnostic evaluation of urinary dysfunction.
  • Provides conservative management strategies such as pelvic floor therapy education and bladder training.
  • Collaborates with urogynecology specialists for complex cases and surgical referrals. 
  • Delivers preventive healthcare services including Cervical cancer screening (Pap smear / HPV testing), Breast health assessment, Sexual health screening, Osteoporosis risk assessment.
  • Provides health screening programs and wellness consultations.
  • Promotes disease prevention and early detection strategies.
  • Provides counseling on: Sexual health, Reproductive health, Lifestyle and nutrition, Weight management, Mental health awareness.
  • Encourages healthy behaviors and long-term wellness
  • Obtains age-appropriate interval histories on return patients.
  • Performs focused examinations on return patients. 
  • Performs or requests and evaluates diagnostic studies as indicated upon evaluation of the patient 
  • Prescribes appropriate pharmacological and non-pharmacological treatment modalities. (Obtains countersignature on prescription from the supervising physician for medications not included in the approved formulary)
  • Where appropriate and skilled prescribes physical therapy and other rehabilitation treatments as required.
  • Performs designated procedures after demonstrating competency and according to written standardized procedure where applicable.
  • Facilitates the patient’s transition within and between health care settings: admissions, transfers and discharges and completes appropriate documentation.

Therapist – Occupational I (Neurology/Neurodisability)

Job Description

We are recruiting a Junior OT in Neurology/Neurodisability!

The OT I Neurology/Neurodisability will cover a specialist outpatient caseload of patients from 0-18 with complex acute and chronic neurological diagnoses with support and supervision from the OT Senior for Neurodisability.  They will also play a role in tertiary level Movement Disorders (advanced tone management), Brachial Plexus Injury (BPI) and Neuromuscular Multidisciplinary clinics.   Skills and knowledge in the management of tone in the upper extremity using splinting, casting, modified constraint induced movement therapy (mCIMT) and Botox are advantageous for any candidates applying.  This role is a junior practitioner in the team with support for complex Neurodisability provided by the OT Neurodisability Specialist 

The OT I – Neurology/Neurodisability is responsible providing tertiary level outpatient neurology and neurodisability OT services to pediatric patients at Sidra Medicine.  This will include patients with Cerebral Palsy, Neuromuscular and Neurometabolic disorders, and Brachial Plexus Injury.  The post holder will assess, plan, implement and evaluate therapy programs for children under their care using evidence-based practice, working autonomously with guidance and indirect supervision for the OT II (Senior OT). You will work in in close collaboration with the MDT Teams for each diagnostic group and other members of the allied health care team to provide evidence-based care by integrating research with practice.

Responsibilities

Clinical

  • Provides in-patient and out-patient occupational therapy care as appropriate to the clinical working area assigned under the supervision of the Senior Occupational Therapist (Occupational Therapist II).
  • Provides therapy care that is patient centered including setting meaningful goals for independence in daily activities.
  • Provides high quality, evidenced based patient care including assessment and occupation based treatment.
  • Uses appropriate clinical outcome measures to evaluate effectiveness of care.   
  • Where appropriate modifies task, person or environment to enable participation in daily occupations such as bathing or dressing.
  • Where appropriate assess the patient for adaptations and use of specialist equipment. 
  • Liaises with the appropriate occupational therapy services in the community and provides transfer/discharge information
  • Educates the patient/family and other members of the health care team regarding the occupational therapy plan
  • Documents all relevant information correctly, appropriately and in a timely manner as per occupational therapy documentation standards
  • Acts as an advocate by empowering children and their families to make informed choices by providing them with information and support and directing to the relevant support services when appropriate.
  • Provides appropriate cross cover into other specialist clinical areas as required, ensuring they have the required skills and competencies to do so.
  • Demonstrates an understanding of evidence-based healthcare methodology and its ability to positively impact patient outcomes.
  • Participates in the integration and evaluation of research into practice.
  • Participates in patient and clinical staff education programs. 
  • Utilizing a professional practice framework and evidence based care, identifies improvements while minimizing risks, creating care that is optimal for our patients and families
  • Promotes a safe environment and safe patient care by embracing a safety culture and identifying areas of risk to Occupational Therapy Supervisor. Complies with policies for personal and patient safety and for the prevention of healthcare associated infections.

Professional Practice

  • Provides documented evidence of own performance and maintenance of skills with appropriate continuing professional development activities consistent with the position. 
  • Responsible for maintaining a Qatar Council for Healthcare Practitioners Continuing Professional Development Profile for licensure. 
  • Responsible for maintaining up to date mandatory Life Support Training requirements as directed by MoPH and Sidra (e.g. BLS, AED etc).
  • Participates in service activities that contribute to excellence in outcomes, a positive patient experience and a healthy professional environment. 
  • Contributes to the achievement of clinical quality outcome indicators and patient satisfaction. 
  • Participates in quality improvement activities linked to occupational therapy strategic priorities and professional practice model. 
  • Participates in the promotion and maintenance of effective communication and teamwork. Treats colleagues, patients, and visitors with dignity and respect at all times
  • Actively welcomes and where appropriate provides support and participates in orientation activities for new staff.
  • Contributes to a learning environment participating and presenting staff education to occupational therapy or clinical peers (eg. Journal club, in-service education etc.) 
  • Responsible for completing their supervision agreements, readiness for supervision sessions and maintaining accurate supervision records. 
  • Notifies clinical senior in a timely manner of scheduled and non-scheduled staff absence, collaborating with appropriate colleagues to minimize disruption to service and patient care. 
  • Follows all organizational policies and procedures. 
  • Adheres to Sidra’s standards as they appear in the Code of Conduct and Conflict of Interest policies
  • Adheres to and promotes Sidra’s Values

In view of the evolving needs and opportunities within Sidra, this position may be required to perform other duties as assigned and reporting relationships may vary.

Qualifications

Academic/Professional qualification/Training

Essential:

Bachelor’s degree from an accredited program in Occupational Therapy 

2+ years of relevant clinical experience 

Further CPD in Neurodisability is an advantage

Licensure or Registration from country of origin if applicable and eligibility for licensure in Qatar is essential

Desirable

Further CPD in Neurodisability is an advantage

Essential

Knowledge of pediatric neurology, particularly acquired brain injury and cerebral palsy

Knowledge of child development and the impact of neurological conditions on this

Experience as an OT working with children or adults with neurological conditions and complex disability

Desirable

Training and experience in the management of the upper limb as it relates to neurological conditions including CP, Brachial Plexus injury and neuromuscular disorders

Job Description
The Registered Dietitian I is responsible for providing safe and effective clinical nutrition & dietetic care to Women and Children within Sidra Medicine. The individual works closely with the multidisciplinary team to provide patient care that is integrated and compatible with the patient-focused medical goals and objectives. Primary responsibilities include application of the Nutrition Care Process (NCP) including completion of the nutrition assessment, determination of the nutrition diagnosis, developing and implementing nutrition intervention(s), and monitoring and evaluating of the patient’s progress.

The Registered Dietitian I provides preceptorship and training for Graduate Associates and Registered Diet Technicians and works under the supervision and mentorship of a Registered Dietitian II. The Registered Dietitian I will undertake rotations in various clinical specialties completing competencies in these areas under the supervision of a Registered Dietitian II. S/he is an integral part of the multidisciplinary team as part of this s/he will attend any relevant MDT meetings (discharge planning, case conferences).

The Registered Dietitian I works within the Dietitian Scope Practice governed by the Qatar Council for Healthcare Professions (QCHP) and maintains professional competency and skills required for professional practice and ongoing QCHP licensing. The competency framework includes the following standards; Professional and Ethical Practice, Clinical Practice, Leadership and management, Education, Learning and Development and Research and Improvement.

Responsibilities
Nutrition Assessment

Conducts a nutrition assessment when warranted by a patient’s needs or conditions.
Performs relevant anthropometric and body composition measurements; may include and not limited to height, length, weight, head circumference, knee height and mid-upper arm circumference.
Reviews dietary intake for factors that affect health conditions and nutritional risk.
Supervises dietetic technician’s data collection activities.
Evaluates health and disease condition for nutrition-related consequences.
Evaluates psychosocial, functional, and behavioral factors related to food access, selection, and preparation; physical activity; and understanding of health condition.
Evaluates patient/client/group’s knowledge, readiness to learn, and potential for changing behaviors.
Calculates estimated nutritional requirements based on approved best practice guidelines by which intake will be compared.
Identifies possible problem areas for making nutrition diagnoses.
Observes client/patient for nonverbal and verbal cues that can guide and prompt effective interviewing methods.
Determines appropriate data to collect.
Selects assessment tools and procedures (matching the assessment method to the situation) and applies assessment tools in valid and reliable ways.
Distinguishes relevant from irrelevant data and important from unimportant data, and validates the data.
Organizes and categorizes the data in a meaningful framework that relates to nutrition problems.
Determines when a problem requires consultation with or referral to another provider.

Nutrition Diagnosis

Finds patterns and relationships among the data and possible causes for the nutrition problem.
Prioritizes the relative importance of problems for patient/client/group safety.
Documents the nutrition diagnostic statement in PES (problem, etiology, and signs/symptom) or PE format.

Nutrition Intervention

Formulates and determines a plan of action that is focused on the etiology of the problem and known to be effective based on best current knowledge and evidence from Evidence-Based Nutrition Practice Guidelines.
Assesses educational needs and provides nutrition counseling based on individual needs, including nutrient requirements, knowledge and abilities, and medical, economic, and social situation.
Evaluates achievement of learning objectives by the patient and/or family. Provides appropriate follow-up in accordance with the patient’s treatment goals, referring patients for community or home health services as appropriate.
As needed, delegates or coordinates nutrition plan of care with other healthcare professionals.
Confers with patient/client/group, other caregivers or policies, and program standards in developing the intervention(s).
Defines the intervention plan by writing the nutrition prescription and defining the time and frequency of care including intensity, duration, and follow-up.
Identifies resources and/or referrals needed.
Implements the nutrition intervention, including communicating the plan of nutrition care.
Provides appropriate follow-up in accordance with the patient’s treatment goals, referring patients for outpatient counseling and community or home health services as appropriate.
Collects data and modifies the plan of care as needed.

Nutrition Monitoring and Evaluation

Utilizes monitoring and evaluation techniques that consider the varied needs of age-specific populations as well as cultural, religious, and ethnic concerns.
Monitors progress through checking patient/client/group understanding and compliance with plan; determines whether the intervention is being implemented as prescribed; provides evidence that the plan/intervention strategy is or is not changing patient/client/group behavior or status; identifies other positive or negative outcomes; gathers information indicating reasons for lack of progress; and supports conclusions with evidence.
Measures outcomes through selecting outcome indicators that are relevant to the nutrition diagnosis or signs or symptoms, nutrition goals, medical diagnosis, and outcomes and quality management goals and use of standardized indicators. Evaluates effectiveness and measures progress toward outcomes of nutrition interventions.
Evaluates outcomes by comparing current findings with previous status, intervention goals, and/or reference standards.

Documentation, Communication, and Continuation of Care

Documents relevant, accurate, and timely information performed in steps in the Nutrition Care Process in the patient’s medical record or electronic medical record.
Determines continuation of care based on whether the patient/client/ group has met intervention goals or is not at this time able/ready to make needed changes.
Communicates and influences treatment interventions determined by the medical team through interdisciplinary meetings, rounds, medical conferences, and nutrition-related in-services.
Works cooperatively with foodservice staff to ensure conformance to nutrition prescriptions.
Serves as a resource to medical staff and allied health personnel on nutrition issues.
Assists in the education of graduate associates, Diet Techs and interns. Plans learning experiences, teaches, and evaluates performance.

Compliance

Demonstrates accountability for the proper use of patients’ protected health information as per Sidra’s policy.
Ensures that care delivered to each patient is in accordance with Dietitian Scope Practice governed by the Qatar Council for Healthcare Professions (QCHP).
Assists in achieving compliance with the Joint Commission International, Ministry of Public Health (MoPH) or other accrediting agency standards to continuously improve the safety and quality of care to the public and to the organization’s performance improvement.

Business Functions

Maintains productivity standards and practices effective time management and prioritizing tasks.
Maintains accurate record-keeping of daily clinical activities/stats, including information for scheduling and billing.
Participates in the orientation and training of Graduate Associate, interns and dietetic technicians

Performance Improvement

Participates in and/or initiates continuous quality improvement activities for Dietetic service.
Participates in planning and developing nutrition-related policies, procedures, and guidelines.
Conducts in-services and educational presentations to hospital/department staff.
Assists in developing and revising patient education materials, clinical forms, protocols and pathways
Supports and promotes the organization’s infection control, safety, risk management, and customer/guest relation programs.

Professional Development

Participates in nutrition research studies and communicates findings through reports, abstracts, presentations, and publication.
Maintains QCHP licensure and continuing education requirements.
Participates in annual and mid-year reviews which include plans for professional growth and developmental goals including participation in professional organizations and activities, workshops, seminars, and staff development programs.
Participates in regular clinical supervision with supervisor.
Participates in departmental and interdisciplinary meetings, task forces, and projects.
Responsible for maintaining up to date mandatory Life Support Training requirements as directed by MoPH and Sidra (e.g. BLS, AED etc).

Skills/Abilities:

Knowledge of the Nutrition Care Process and ability to apply all steps of the process.
Comprehensive knowledge and application of nutrition services and medical nutrition therapy.
Critical thinking to integrate facts, informed opinions, active listening, and observations.
Decision making, problem solving, and collaboration.
Ability to communicate effectively in both written and verbal form to patients, public, hospital and medical staff, and physicians
Ability to function independently on assigned patient care units.
Ability to counsel and educate others.
General knowledge of nutrient analysis, word processing, and spreadsheet software.
Adheres to Sidra’s standards as they appear in the Code of Conduct and Conflict of Interest policies
Adheres to and promotes Sidra’s Values

ESSENTIAL

Education

Bachelor’s Degree in Science with a postgraduate diploma in Dietetics or
Bachelor’s Degree in Science and a Masters or postgraduate Degree in Dietetics
Current Dietetic License from country of origin

Job Description
The Clinical Nurse is responsible for competently providing safe and effective direct care. The Clinical Nurse assesses care needs, plans, implements and evaluates programs of care to include patients and families. The Clinical Nurse is responsible for ensuring that all duties are carried out to the highest possible standard, aligned to Sidra Standards of Practice.

The Clinical Nurse participates in the supervision, orientation and training of staff and is responsible for education of patients, families and students. The Clinical Nurse is professionally accountable to the Chief Nursing Officer.

Practices within the DHP Scope of Practice according to licensure within the State of Qatar
Provides total individualized patient care and assumes responsibility and accountability for assessing, planning, implementing and evaluating care, discharge planning for each patient.

Independently initiates escalation of issues following the chain of command, utilizing resources as needed.

Demonstrates collaborative and respectful behavior
