Position Overview:

To provide high-quality, evidence-based inpatient and outpatient oncology care under the supervision of Consultant and Senior Specialist Medical Oncologists, supporting the delivery of comprehensive cancer services across King’s College Hospital. The post holder will assist in the assessment, investigation, diagnosis, treatment, and ongoing management of patients with malignant and benign haematological and oncological conditions within granted clinical privileges.

The role supports consultants in coordinating patient care across inpatient, outpatient, day-care, and emergency settings, ensuring timely clinical review, continuity of care, multidisciplinary collaboration, and adherence to established clinical pathways, hospital policies, and international best practices. The post holder is expected to participate in clinical governance, quality improvement, medical education, and service development while maintaining the highest standards of patient safety, professionalism, and compassionate care.

Key Accountabilities:

Clinical

  • Provide comprehensive assessment, investigation, diagnosis, treatment, and follow-up of oncology patients within the scope of granted clinical privileges and under consultant supervision.
  • Support Consultant and Senior Specialist Medical Oncologists in the day-to-day management of inpatient, outpatient, and day-care oncology services.
  • Conduct daily ward rounds, review patient progress, and coordinate ongoing management plans in collaboration with the supervising consultant.
  • Recognise and initiate management of oncology-related emergencies, ensuring timely escalation to senior clinicians.
  • Monitor patients receiving systemic anti-cancer therapies and supportive treatments, identifying treatment-related complications and coordinating appropriate management.
  • Coordinate multidisciplinary care with surgical, radiation oncology, haematology, pharmacy, palliative care, radiology, pathology, nursing, and allied health teams.

Clinical Governance & Personal Development

  • Attend relevant departmental meetings, MDTs, and clinical discussions unless on approved leave.
  • Participate in clinical audit, quality improvement initiatives, morbidity and mortality reviews, and risk reporting.
  • Maintain active involvement in clinical governance, incident reporting, and improvement planning.
  • Uphold Good Medical Practice as per UAE licensing authorities and UK standards.
  • Maintain up-to-date CPD activities, courses, and study days in line with revalidation requirements.

Administrative

  • Effectively manage own time, workload and resources.
  • Comply with the UAE medical health authorities’ requirements in order to maintain medical licence.
  • Contribute to the development and maintenance of computer-based patient records.
  • Ensure confidentiality in all aspects of data management relating to patients, carers, colleagues, and other healthcare workers.
  • Maintain business confidentiality outside the organisation with respect to financial, clinical and administrative activities of King’s College Hospital & Clinics.
  • Ensure proper escalation and documentation of adverse events, near misses, or complex cases.

Managerial

  • Assume other administrative or clinical duties as needed
  • Be willing to deputise and delegate when appropriate.
  • Support colleagues with the smooth running of the Hospital & Clinics by providing cover and assistance, during periods of absence.
  • Welcome calls (although infrequent) from the management team, and physician on duty while out of working hours.
  • Participate in orientation of new junior staff when requested.
  • Assist in the financial management of King’s College Hospital & Clinics-. by:
  • Working effectively with individuals in other agencies to meet patients’ needs.
  • Utilising the organisation’s resources appropriately and efficiently.
  • Whilst at all times looking ensuring the delivery of high-quality care to agreed standards continually review working practices to provide the most efficient use of resources.

Education & Qualification, Experience, Training, Knowledge & Skill

Education & Qualification

  • UAE Medical Health Authority License (DHA).
  • MBBS Required
  • Master’s degree/Post Graduation/ Diploma in related specialty is an advantage.

Experience

  • Minimum 3–5 years of post-qualification clinical experience in Medical Oncology within an acute hospital setting, with experience in the management of inpatient and outpatient oncology patients.
  • Experience working within a multidisciplinary team, supporting the delivery of systemic anti-cancer therapies, oncology emergencies, and evidence-based cancer care under consultant supervision.

To support and demonstrate our NMC Nursing Mission, Vision, and Values: 

Our Nursing Vision: At NMC Healthcare, we are committed to providing clinical excellence through safe, compassionate, and individualized care to every patient, every time. 

Our Nursing Mission: To exemplify clinical excellence, every NMC nurse will seek to: 

  • Do the right thing 
  • Be the patient’s advocate 
  • Be open and transparent 
  • Deliver safe, compassionate care 
  • Recognize the uniqueness of each patient 
  • Contribute to an outstanding patient’s experience 
  • Engage with and contribute to, a learning culture 
  • Lead and influence changes in healthcare 

Our Nursing Values: We will achieve this through our core values: 

  • Safety 
  • Excellence 
  • Ethics 
  • Trust 
  • Collaboration 

Responsibilities

Assistant Nurse/Midwife will:  

  • Under the supervision of the Registered Nurse / Registered Midwife, contribute to the overall planning and delivery of nursing/midwifery care for patients ensuring a patient cantered approach to care.  
  • Under the direction of the Registered Nurse/ Registered Midwife, assist in the activities of daily living for patients in accordance with the patient care plan e.g. distribution of patient meals and assisting patients with hygiene needs.  
  • Maintain a high standard of nursing/midwifery care for patients, working within evidence-based guidelines and unit specific competencies. 
  • Demonstrate service excellence and act as a patient advocate to support the patients’ dignity and rights at all times.  
  • Ensure the Registered Nurse/ Registered Midwife is informed of vital sign observations and care provided for patients and document appropriately. 
  • Observe and report changes in the patient’s condition and reactions to different aspects of care to a Registered Nurse/Registered Midwife immediately. 
  • Respond to emergencies according to the organization’s policies and procedures 
  • Facilitate post discharge clinic visits and/or tests as required including scheduling follow-up and referral appointments 
  • Help arrange patient transportation as required. 
  • Maintain flow of documents for scanning if needed. 
  • Provide direct patient care according to the therapeutic plan and individual patient needs as directed by the patient care plan under supervision of a Registered Nurse/ Registered Midwife.  
  • Provide appropriate information to assist the Registered Nurse/ Registered Midwife, in the preparation and maintenance of an effective patient care plan.  
  • Record in the patient’s official record a detailed report of care given which reflects the therapeutic plan and specific aspects of the patient care plan under direction of Registered Nurse/ Registered Midwife.  
  • Reinforce instructions given to the patient by the physician and Registered Nurse/ Registered Midwife, and refers new needs for instruction to the Registered Nurse/ Registered Midwife.  
  • Initiate emergency assistance as per policies and procedures and perform Basic Life Support as per regulatory requirements and scope. 
  • Perform other duties as assigned by the Registered Nurse/ Registered Midwife, and within the scope of practice  
  • Ask questions when in doubt for clarification by the Registered Nurse/ Registered Midwife. 
  • Escalate to and seek expert advice from colleagues when unable to or not competent to undertake required care. 

Qualifications

Essential: the post holder must 

  • Have an appropriate license to work as an assistant nurse/assistant midwife in the relevant regulatory health authority with all the qualification and experience these mandates. 
  • Manage their own professional re-licensure. 
  • Hold a valid American Heart Association Basic Life Support Provider card.  
  • Be willing to work across departments when necessary  
  • Be able to communicate clearly and effectively in English (spoken and written) 

DESIRABLE: The post holder should have: 

  • Evidenced ability to work as part of an inter-professional team 
  • Organizational and administrative skills with which to use the electronic medical record platform for clinical documentation 
  • Be able to communicate effectively in Arabic

The role also involves collaborating with prescribers and other healthcare professionals, assisting in the implementation of pharmacy policies and procedures, and supporting a clean, organized, and compliant work environment.

A Phlebotomist is a healthcare professional responsible for collecting blood samples from patients for laboratory testing, transfusions, research, or blood donation purposes. They play a vital role in the diagnostic process by ensuring accurate specimen collection, proper labelling, safe handling, and timely transportation of samples. Phlebotomists work closely with patients of all ages, providing compassionate care while maintaining strict infection control and patient safety standards. Their attention to detail, technical expertise, and interpersonal skills contribute significantly to accurate diagnosis and quality patient care.

Responsibilities

  • Collect blood samples from patients through venipuncture, capillary, and finger-prick procedures.
  • Verify patient identity and confirm test requests before specimen collection.
  • Prepare patients for blood collection procedures and explain the process to reduce anxiety.
  • Ensure proper labeling, handling, and transportation of specimens to the laboratory.
  • Maintain strict infection prevention and control practices, including the use of personal protective equipment (PPE).
  • Follow safety protocols for the handling and disposal of sharps and biohazardous materials.
  • Monitor patients during and after blood collection for any adverse reactions, such as dizziness or fainting.
  • Maintain accurate records of specimen collection and patient information.
  • Ensure all equipment and collection supplies are properly stocked, maintained, and sterilized as required.
  • Comply with healthcare facility policies, quality standards, and regulatory requirements.
  • Collaborate with laboratory staff, nurses, physicians, and other healthcare professionals to ensure timely and accurate diagnostic testing.
  • Assist with specimen processing, packaging, and preparation for transport when required.
  • Provide compassionate, professional, and patient-centered care at all times.
  • Participate in quality improvement initiatives and ongoing professional development activities.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Medical Laboratory Technology, Medical Laboratory Science
  • DOH/DHA/MOH license

Licensed Practical Nurses (LPN) are healthcare practitioners responsible for delivering and organizing basic nursing care to individuals, families and groups within diverse settings collaborating with various healthcare professionals. LPNs primarily care for those with relatively stable and predictable health conditions. They can also provide care to patients and families with more complex needs in consultation and coordination with other healthcare professionals.            

Responsibilities

  • Practices autonomously, safely, competently, and ethically along the continuum of care in situations of health and illness across a person’s life course.

  • Provides healthcare services for the:
  1. Promotion, maintenance, and restoration of health, with a focus on patients with low-acuity, stable, and predictable states of health
  2. Prevention, treatment, and palliation of illness and injury, with a focus on low-acuity, stable, and predictable disorders and conditions, primarily by: 
  • Assessing health status
  • Planning, implementing, evaluating, and documenting practical nursing care.

  • Providing basic comfort care
  • Listening to patient concerns and discussing the care provided

Job Description

The Specialist – Poison Control Center works under minimal supervision to provide assessment, case management advice and follow-up care for emergency and instructional telephone calls received by the poison control center from the general public or health care professionals.

In conjunction with the Manager and Director of the poison control center, the Specialist – Poison Control Center identifies operational and clinical improvements that may enhance poison center functions and efforts of the clinical toxicology service.

Responsibilities

  • Provides verbal and written sound clinical information and case management advice in response to emergency and informational telephone calls and consultations to the clinical toxicology service.
  • Obtains pertinent and appropriate information from the caller in order to independently determine the seriousness of the poisoning incident and assess the caller’s level of understanding/state of mind.
  • Based on the seriousness of the incident and the caller’s level of cognition, independently determines whether the poisoning incident can be handled by the poison control center or whether the poisoning victim should be seen by a health care provider.
  • Answers caller inquiries with complete, concise and relevant recommendations for action in terms that are appropriate to the calling party’s level of understanding.
  • Initiates follow-up calls to assess patient status and alters case management recommendations as appropriate.
  • Documents all calls and consultations on the poison control center’s computerized medical record system.
  • For consultative cases, provides telephone and/or bedside management recommendations as necessary. Conducts rounds and follow-up on consultative cases under oversight of supervising medical toxicologist. 
  • Precepts PharmD students, Pharmacy residents, emergency medicine residents, and any other trainees undergoing a toxicology rotation. Prepares and delivers lectures on poisoning topics to internal and external audiences.
  • Participates in the educational courses provided by the poison control center and Section of Clinical Toxicology.
  • Investigates case history, researches medical literature and consults appropriate sources to provide informed and proper treatment and triage recommendations and develops protocols that are medically and economically appropriate.
  • Develops and provides reference information regarding availability and toxicology of new drugs. 
  • Communicates with on-call staff concerning medical and toxicological-related issues.
  • Prepares information for and attends case conference meetings, in-service sessions and staff meetings.

Job Description

The Consultant Breast Surgeon is responsible for providing specialized surgical care for patients with benign and malignant breast diseases. The role includes the assessment, diagnosis, surgical management, postoperative care, and long-term follow-up of breast conditions. The consultant works within a multidisciplinary breast care team to ensure evidence-based, patient-centered treatment while maintaining the highest standards of clinical quality and safety.

Responsibilities

  • Assess, diagnose, and manage patients with benign and malignant breast diseases.
  • Perform comprehensive breast examinations and clinical assessments.
  • Evaluate patients presenting with breast lumps, nipple discharge, breast pain, skin changes, and abnormal breast imaging findings.
  • Develop individualized treatment plans based on clinical guidelines and multidisciplinary recommendations.
  • Perform breast-conserving surgery (lumpectomy/wide local excision).
  • Perform mastectomy procedures, including skin-sparing and nipple-sparing techniques where appropriate.
  • Perform sentinel lymph node biopsy and axillary lymph node dissection.
  • Perform excision of benign breast lesions and other breast surgical procedures.
  • Coordinate reconstructive surgery with Plastic and Reconstructive Surgeons when indicated.
  • Manage breast emergencies, postoperative complications, and surgical follow-up.
  • Participate in breast cancer screening and early detection programs.
  • Provide survivorship and long-term follow-up care.

Diagnostic Responsibilities

  • Interpret mammography, breast ultrasound, MRI, and other breast imaging studies in collaboration with Radiology.
  • Correlate imaging findings with clinical examination and pathology.
  • Review biopsy and histopathology reports.
  • Recommend further diagnostic investigations where clinically indicated.
  • Participate in multidisciplinary breast meetings (Tumor Board).

Patient Care

  • Counsel patients regarding diagnosis, treatment options, risks, benefits, and expected outcomes.
  • Obtain informed consent before surgical procedures.
  • Provide compassionate support for patients diagnosed with breast cancer.
  • Educate patients on postoperative care, recovery, surveillance, and lifestyle modifications.
  • Maintain patient confidentiality and ethical medical practice.

Administrative Responsibilities

The American Academy of Cosmetic Surgery Hospital is a specialized medical and cosmetic facility in Dubai Healthcare City, focused on delivering high-quality care, services, training, and public awareness in aesthetic medicine. Its multidisciplinary team includes internationally recognized dermatologists and cosmetic, plastic, reconstructive, head and neck, oral, and maxillofacial surgeons. The hospital is the first in Dubai Healthcare City to receive Joint Commission International (JCI) accreditation and has been recognized among the top 100 small and medium enterprises in Dubai. Patients and their families benefit from boutique, hotel-like accommodations that prioritize privacy and comfort, with comprehensive services from consultation through recovery in one location. The hospital also operates a world-class education center that hosts congresses, trainings, workshops, and public education events.

Role Description

The Pharmacist is responsible for ensuring the safe, effective, and accurate dispensing of medications to patients and clinical areas, in accordance with regulatory standards and hospital policies. This full-time, on-site role in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, involves reviewing and validating prescriptions, checking for drug interactions and allergies, and counseling patients on proper medication use and potential side effects. The Pharmacist collaborates closely with physicians, nurses, and other healthcare professionals to optimize pharmacotherapy and support patient care plans. Daily tasks include maintaining and monitoring medication inventory, overseeing storage conditions, preparing and compounding medications when required, and contributing to infection control and safety initiatives. General Practitioner

Full-time · Dubai, UAE · Home Healthcare & Telemedicine

About Vervé Wellness DXB

Vervé is a concierge private health practice in Dubai. We deliver physician-led care directly to our clients — at home, in the office, or wherever they are — supported by structured diagnostics, IV therapy, and long-term clinical programmes. 

The role

You will be the physician our clients see most often. You will manage everyday presentations end to end — in person on home and office visits, and remotely by teleconsultation — and you will deliver and oversee the clinical services at the core of our practice: IV therapy, blood testing, and routine diagnostics. You will work alongside our nursing team and escalate complex cases to the Medical Director. This is a hands-on generalist role in a non-clinic setting: you go to the patient, or via tele consult – not the other way around.

What you will do

• Assess, diagnose, and manage everyday acute and chronic presentations for a private client base, on home, hotel, and office visits across Dubai.

• Deliver scheduled teleconsultations, including follow-ups and results reviews, with clear documentation of every encounter.

• Prescribe, supervise, and administer IV infusion therapy safely, including client assessment, formulation suitability, and management of adverse reactions.

• Order and interpret blood panels and routine diagnostics; perform or supervise phlebotomy on visits; communicate results and next steps to clients directly.

• Work closely with registered nurses on visit planning, clinical handovers, and follow-through on orders and prescriptions.

• Maintain complete, timely clinical records in our practice management system.

• Escalate red-flag and complex cases to the Medical Director and refer onwards to specialists where appropriate.

• Uphold DHA home healthcare regulations, infection control standards, and medication management protocols on every visit.

Requirements

• MBBS, MD, or equivalent primary medical qualification.

• Active DHA license as a General Practitioner, or DHA eligibility with credentialing in progress.

• Minimum 3 years’ post-registration experience in general practice, family medicine, or emergency/acute care.

• Confident, current competency in IV cannulation, infusion therapy, and phlebotomy.

• Comfort practicing independently outside a clinic environment, with sound judgement on when to escalate.

• Experience with electronic medical records handling.

• Fluent professional English; excellent bedside manner with a discerning international clientele.

• BLS/ACLS certification (current).

It helps if you have

• Prior home healthcare or concierge medicine experience

• An interest in preventive, functional, or longevity medicine — our clinical programmes are built on it.

• Additional languages relevant to an international client base.

Why this role

You will practice medicine the way it should be practiced: adequate time with every patient, senior clinical support, and a model built around outcomes rather than throughput. You will work within a growing practice at the center of preventive and longevity medicine in Dubai, with structured clinical programmes, modern diagnostics, and a team that takes standards seriously. Compensation is competitive and discussed at offer stage.

Job Advertisement – Saudi General Practitioner (GP) – Dialysis Unit

We are seeking a dedicated and compassionate Saudi General Practitioner (GP) to join our Dialysis Unit and contribute to delivering exceptional patient-centered care. The successful candidate will work closely with nephrology consultants, nursing teams, and multidisciplinary healthcare professionals to provide high-quality chronic hemodialysis services and ensure compliance with clinical and regulatory standards.

Position Title

* Saudi General Practitioner (GP) – Dialysis Unit

Key Responsibilities

The duties and responsibilities of this position include, but are not limited to:

* Perform comprehensive admission examinations for all newly referred patients and accurately document clinical findings.

* Conduct and document patient assessments, including vital signs, physical and mental health status, dialysis orders, and compliance with prescribed dietary and medication regimens.

* Provide chronic hemodialysis therapy and formulate dialysis treatment plans through various vascular access methods while adhering to all applicable safety protocols for patients with End-Stage Renal Disease (ESRD).

* Assess patients daily and maintain accurate clinical documentation.

* Participate in unit rounds with consulting physicians and discuss patient treatment plans as required.

* Inform the Senior Physician of any significant changes in patients’ medical conditions and the actions taken.

* Follow Senior Physician instructions regarding individualized patient treatment plans.

* Perform clinical procedures and modify patient prescriptions as requested by the Senior Physician.

* Evaluate patients upon request from nursing staff and provide appropriate medical interventions.

* Document all treatments, follow-up plans, and clinical progress in patient medical records.

* Complete comprehensive annual patient reviews and present findings during regular unit meetings after consultant review.

* Develop competencies in specialized nephrology-related procedures under senior staff supervision.

* Monitor and analyze laboratory investigations, identify abnormalities, and initiate appropriate actions.

* Perform Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation (CPR) and other emergency medical procedures when required.

* Initiate emergency treatment plans and ensure complete and accurate documentation.

* Participate in mandatory in-service education programs, including CPR certification, Health & Safety training, disaster preparedness, and fire drills.

* Participate in clinical audits and contribute to continuous quality improvement initiatives and clinical outcome implementation.

* Participate in departmental educational activities, including medical rounds, tutorials, and journal clubs.

* Report incidents or situations that may compromise patient, visitor, or staff safety through the appropriate chain of command.

* Deliver high-quality patient care in a respectful, compassionate, and professional manner.

* Attend all mandatory onboarding and ongoing training programs.

* Ensure compliance with organizational policies, procedures, safety regulations, and clinical standards.

* Collaborate effectively with nursing, clinical, and administrative teams.

* Perform administrative and clerical duties as required.

* Participate actively in the center’s on-call duty roster.

* Provide coverage across dialysis centers within Saudi Arabia when required and acknowledge that the assigned workplace may change based on operational needs.

* Adhere to all company policies and procedures, including quality measures, medical KPIs, CBAHI standards, and all applicable Saudi healthcare regulatory requirements.

⸻

Education and Qualifications

Applicants must possess:

* A Bachelor of Medicine and Surgery (MBBS) degree from an accredited institution.

* A valid professional classification and license issued by the Saudi Commission for Health Specialties (SCFHS) as a General Practitioner or Nephrology Resident.

* Valid license to practice medicine in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

⸻

Experience and Requirements

* Minimum of two (2) years of professional clinical experience following internship or postgraduate medical training, preferably in Internal Medicine and/or Nephrology.

* Experience in dialysis or nephrology services is highly desirable.

* Proficiency in both written and spoken English and Arabic. Candidates without Arabic fluency may only be considered in exceptional circumstances.

* Excellent communication, teamwork, and clinical decision-making skills.

* Ability to work effectively under pressure and in demanding clinical environments.

* Physically fit and medically able to perform duties that may require extended working hours, mobility, and emergency response activities.

⸻

Why Join Us?

* Opportunity to work within a specialized dialysis and nephrology healthcare environment.

* Collaborative multidisciplinary team culture.

* Continuous professional development and training opportunities.

* Commitment to clinical excellence, patient safety, and regulatory compliance.

Apply now and become part of a healthcare team dedicated to improving the lives of patients through exceptional renal care.

Job Description

An employee of the American Hospital Dubai is expected to promote the mission and philosophy of the hospital by acting in a caring, courteous and confidential manner towards patients, visitors, colleagues and staff by performing their duties and responsibilities according to the expected standards in order to fully meet patient care needs.

Responsibilities

Imaging Systems Leadership and Governance

  • Leads the technical administration, configuration, integration, maintenance, and optimization of PACS, RIS, VNA, enterprise viewers, image exchange platforms, voice recognition solutions, advanced visualization tools, and other clinical imaging applications.
  • Establishes imaging system standards, operating procedures, governance controls, service expectations, and technology roadmaps in alignment with clinical priorities, enterprise architecture, and organizational strategy.
  • Serves as the senior technical and functional subject matter expert for clinical imaging systems, advising IT leadership and clinical stakeholders on platform capability, system design, integration, optimization, and technology investment.
  • Coordinates the imaging applications support function, provide technical direction to analysts and vendors, and ensure issues are appropriately prioritized, investigated, escalated, and resolved.

Clinical Workflow and Systems Optimization

  • Analyzes end-to-end imaging workflows from order entry and patient scheduling through modality acquisition, image interpretation, reporting, distribution, archiving, and clinical review.
  • Collaborates with radiologists, cardiologists, technologists, nurses, physicians, and operational leaders to translate clinical requirements into safe, standardized, and efficient system workflows.
  • Leads optimization initiatives addressing modality worklists, patient and study reconciliation, hanging protocols, report distribution, critical-results communication, image availability, turnaround time, and diagnostic user experience.
  • Evaluates system enhancement requests, identify workflow risks and dependencies, and recommend solutions that improve patient safety, clinical productivity, service quality, and operational performance.

Integration and Interoperability

  • Oversees DICOM, HL7, FHIR, IHE, and API-based integration between imaging platforms, modalities, the Electronic Medical Record (EMR), clinical systems, reporting solutions, patient portals, and external health information exchanges.
  • Coordinates onboarding, testing, validation, and production deployment of imaging modalities and systems, ensuring correct patient identification, order matching, data exchange, image routing, and clinical availability.
  • Manage imaging data migration, consolidation, lifecycle management, and archive strategies while ensuring data integrity, accessibility, retention, and continuity of historical patient information.
  • Support secure exchange of imaging records with external providers and regulatory platforms, including applicable NABIDH integration and organizational interoperability requirements.
  • Ensures all clinical systems training aligns with JCI standards, International Patient Safety Goals (IPSG), DHA regulations, and hospital policies.

Implementation, Testing and Change Management

  • Leads imaging technology projects including new implementations, upgrades, migrations, integrations, replacements, expansions, and activation of new clinical locations or imaging services.
  • Develops functional and technical requirements, implementation plans, risk assessments, test scripts, validation criteria, cutover plans, downtime procedures, and post-go-live support arrangements.
  • Coordinates unit, integration, regression, performance, and user acceptance testing, ensuring clinical workflows and patient safety requirements are validated before production deployment.
  • Maintains controlled change-management processes and ensure all configuration changes, releases, interfaces, and system enhancements are appropriately reviewed, approved, documented, tested, and communicated.

Service Reliability and Technical Support

  • Monitors system availability, interface performance, storage capacity, image-routing queues, application performance, database health, and service trends to maintain reliable 24/7 imaging operations.
  • Leads investigation and resolution of complex incidents involving missing images, mismatched studies, patient identity errors, failed interfaces, modality connectivity, reporting interruptions, archive retrieval, and application performance.
  • Coordinates with infrastructure, database, networking, cybersecurity, Biomedical Engineering, vendors, and clinical teams during critical incidents, planned maintenance, downtime, and system recovery.
  • Maintains support escalation procedures, knowledge resources, service documentation, and on-call readiness to minimize disruption to diagnostic and clinical services.

Data Security, Compliance and Business Continuity

  • Collaborates with Information Security to manage access controls, privileged accounts, audit logs, vulnerability remediation, secure image exchange, encryption, third-party access, and cybersecurity risks affecting connected imaging systems and modalities.
  • Develops, tests, and maintains imaging-system business continuity, disaster recovery, downtime, backup, restoration, and high-availability procedures in coordination with infrastructure and clinical stakeholders.
  • Supports accreditation surveys, regulatory inspections, internal audits, risk assessments, and corrective action plans related to clinical imaging technology, information management, and patient safety.

Vendor, Asset and Financial Coordination

  • Manages technical relationships with imaging-system vendors, service providers, modality suppliers, and implementation partners, ensuring contractual obligations, support services, response times, and deliverables are achieved.
  • Contributes to business cases, technical evaluations, requests for proposal, vendor selection, contract reviews, capital expenditure planning, licensing forecasts, storage projections, and total-cost-of-ownership assessments.
  • Maintains an accurate inventory of imaging applications, interfaces, licenses, devices, software versions, dependencies, support agreements, certificates, and planned lifecycle replacements.
  • Reviews vendor performance, recurring incidents, system utilization, licensing, maintenance costs, and improvement opportunities to support responsible technology investment.

Performance Monitoring and Continuous Improvement

  • Establishes and monitors imaging technology performance indicators covering availability, incident response, interface reliability, image accessibility, report turnaround support, storage utilization, user satisfaction, project delivery, and system optimization.
  • Analyzes service data, user feedback, recurring incidents, workflow delays, capacity trends, and audit findings to identify and implement sustainable improvements.
  • Prepares operational reports, project updates, risk summaries, technology recommendations, and performance dashboards for IT and clinical leadership.
  • Participates in clinical informatics governance, imaging committees, digital transformation initiatives, quality improvement programs, and other organizational projects as assigned.

Qualifications

QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Health Informatics, Medical Imaging, Radiologic Technology, Computer Science, Information Technology, Biomedical Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Master’s Degree in Health Informatics, Information Systems, Healthcare Administration, Digital Health, or a related field preferred.
  • Professional certification or formal training in PACS administration, imaging informatics, DICOM, HL7, healthcare integration, project management, cybersecurity, or relevant vendor technologies is preferred.
  • Current or previous professional registration in Radiologic Technology or another clinical imaging discipline is advantageous.
  • Advanced knowledge of PACS, RIS, VNA, enterprise viewers, modality worklists, voice recognition, image exchange, advanced visualization, and imaging workflow.
  • Strong knowledge of DICOM, HL7, FHIR, IHE Radiology integration profiles, healthcare interfaces, image lifecycle management, and clinical-system interoperability.
  • Knowledge of imaging infrastructure, storage, virtualization, cloud architecture, networking, cybersecurity, disaster recovery, database concepts, and system monitoring.
  • Strong understanding of radiology and other clinical imaging workflows, patient identity management, clinical documentation, privacy, patient safety, and regulatory requirements.
  • Excellent leadership, consultation, analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, project management, and stakeholder communication skills.
  • Ability to lead complex technical initiatives, manage competing priorities, and provide support in a high-availability healthcare environment.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE:

  • Minimum of five (5) years of progressive experience in imaging informatics, PACS/RIS administration, clinical systems, healthcare information technology, or a related field.
  • Minimum of two (2) years in a senior imaging systems, lead consultant, solution architect, PACS administrator, or equivalent role within a complex healthcare environment.
  • Demonstrated experience implementing, integrating, upgrading, migrating, and supporting enterprise PACS, RIS, VNA, diagnostic viewing, and imaging workflow solutions.
  • Experience supporting radiology and at least one additional imaging specialty such as cardiology, breast imaging, nuclear medicine, oncology, dental imaging, endoscopy, or digital pathology is preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience with DICOM and HL7 integration, modality onboarding, image migration, workflow optimization, incident resolution, vendor management, and business continuity planning.
  • Experience integrating imaging artificial intelligence or advanced clinical decision-support solutions is highly desirable.
  • Experience within a tertiary, multi-site, or JCI-accredited hospital and familiarity with DHA and NABIDH requirements are preferred.
  • Experience leading multidisciplinary projects and working directly with physicians, radiologists, technologists, executives, technical teams, and external vendors is required.

As a Spa Therapist, you will be responsible for providing high-quality, therapeutic treatments that exceed guest expectations and reflect the luxury standards of Red Sea Global Hospitality. We are committed to providing reasonable adjustments throughout our recruitment process and we’ll always endeavor to be as accommodating as possible. If you would like to discuss any specific requirements, please get in touch with us.

About the job

About Taib

Taib is one of the leading home healthcare companies in Saudi Arabia, established in 2018. We provide a comprehensive range of home healthcare services, including medical consultations, nursing care, chronic disease management, post-hospitalization care, rehabilitation support, and patient education. Taib is among the first home healthcare companies in the Kingdom to be accredited by CBAHI and is a subsidiary of BLOMINVEST.

Job Title: Assistant Consultant – Internal Medicine (Home Healthcare)

Department: Medical Operations – Home Healthcare

Job Summary

The Assistant Consultant – Internal Medicine provides advanced medical assessment, diagnosis, and management for patients receiving healthcare services at home. The role focuses on managing complex acute and chronic medical conditions, developing individualized treatment plans, coordinating multidisciplinary care, and ensuring high-quality, patient-centered healthcare delivery.

The position plays a key role in improving patient outcomes, reducing avoidable hospital admissions, and enhancing continuity of care through evidence-based clinical practices, proactive disease management, and effective collaboration with healthcare teams. The Assistant Consultant ensures safe, compassionate, and comprehensive medical care aligned with healthcare regulations, CBAHI standards, and Ministry of Health requirements.

Key Responsibilities

1. Patient Consultation and Clinical Case Management

  • Conduct comprehensive medical assessments during home visits and virtual consultations.
  • Evaluate, diagnose, and manage a wide range of internal medicine conditions, including acute and chronic diseases.
  • Identify high-risk patients and implement early interventions to prevent complications and unnecessary hospital admissions.
  • Develop and implement individualized treatment plans including medication management, lifestyle modifications, referrals, and follow-up plans.
  • Monitor disease progression and adjust treatment plans according to patient needs and clinical findings.
  • Lead advanced care planning discussions and support clinical decision-making for complex cases.
  • Provide medical consultations through telemedicine platforms when required.
  • Ensure accurate documentation of assessments, diagnoses, treatment plans, and clinical outcomes according to evidence-based practices.
  • Educate patients and families regarding disease management, medication adherence, and preventive healthcare.
  • Coordinate care with specialists and multidisciplinary healthcare providers.

2. Clinical Quality and Compliance

  • Ensure compliance with clinical guidelines, healthcare regulations, CBAHI standards, and Ministry of Health requirements.
  • Participate in quality improvement initiatives, clinical audits, and patient safety programs.
  • Promote a culture of excellence, safety, and professional clinical practice.
  • Review and contribute to clinical policies, procedures, and care pathways.
  • Support inspection processes and prepare required clinical reports.
  • Ensure adherence to infection prevention and control standards and medical governance requirements.

3. Professional Development and Clinical Leadership

  • Lead educational sessions, case discussions, and clinical training activities for healthcare teams.
  • Share medical knowledge and best practices with multidisciplinary teams.
  • Contribute to the development of clinical guidelines, protocols, and treatment pathways.
  • Participate in medical conferences, workshops, and continuing medical education activities.
  • Maintain professional development and stay updated with advances in internal medicine.

4. Health Information Systems (HIS) and Medical Documentation

  • Utilize electronic medical records and healthcare information systems effectively.
  • Ensure complete, accurate, and timely documentation of patient information.
  • Support compliance with Ministry of Health documentation requirements.
  • Participate in training and improvement initiatives related to digital healthcare systems.
  • Collaborate with relevant departments to resolve healthcare technology issues when required.

5. Patient Safety and Satisfaction

  • Apply patient safety standards and clinical risk management practices.
  • Identify and report clinical risks, incidents, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Participate in quality improvement projects aimed at enhancing healthcare outcomes.
  • Provide clear medical explanations and ensure patients and families understand diagnoses and treatment plans.
  • Address patient and family concerns to improve satisfaction and overall care experience.
  • Deliver compassionate care while maintaining professional medical standards.

6. Collaboration with Healthcare Teams

  • Promote multidisciplinary teamwork and patient-centered care delivery.
  • Coordinate effectively with physicians, nurses, allied healthcare professionals, and external healthcare providers.
  • Facilitate timely referrals, escalation, and continuity of care according to clinical requirements.
  • Support and mentor junior medical staff through clinical guidance and knowledge sharing.
  • Ensure effective communication between all members of the healthcare team.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Quality and safety of medical care provided to home healthcare patients.
  • Accuracy and completeness of medical assessments and documentation.
  • Effective clinical decision-making and timely management of complex cases.
  • Reduction of avoidable hospital admissions and emergency escalations.
  • Compliance with clinical guidelines, CBAHI standards, and operational procedures.
  • Patient and family satisfaction scores.
  • Effective communication and coordination with multidisciplinary teams.
  • Timely completion of medical consultations, follow-ups, and care plans.

Qualifications and Skills Required

Education and Professional Requirements

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Medicine and Surgery (MBBS/MD) or equivalent.
  • Completion of Internal Medicine Residency Program.
  • Valid registration and classification from the Saudi Commission for Health Specialties (SCFHS).
  • Classification as Senior Registrar – Internal Medicine or equivalent.
  • Previous experience in internal medicine clinical practice.
  • Experience in home healthcare or outpatient care settings is preferred.

Skills and Competencies

  • Strong clinical assessment and diagnostic decision-making skills.
  • Ability to manage complex medical cases independently.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills in Arabic and English.
  • Proficiency in electronic medical records and telemedicine platforms.
  • Ability to work effectively in home-based and multidisciplinary environments.
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to prioritize workload.
  • Commitment to continuous professional development.
  • Professional, compassionate, and patient-focused approach.

What Taib Offers

Opportunity to contribute to improving patient outcomes through advanced home-based medical care.

Competitive salary and benefits package.

Professional and supportive healthcare environment.

Opportunities for career growth and clinical development.

Exposure to innovative home healthcare models in Saudi Arabia.

Responsibilities

  • Be responsible for providing and coordinating patient care, educating patients and the public about various health conditions, and providing advice and emotional support to patients and their family members.
  • Assess and identify patients’ needs and implement and monitor the patient’s medical plan and treatment. They will work with a team of physicians and other health care specialists or allied health in various settings.

  • Determine actual and potential nursing diagnoses, problems, and issues.

  • Maintain and update technical and clinical skills related to nursing practice.
  • Employ strategies to promote patients’ health and a safe environment.
  • Understand different diagnostic tests and laboratory examinations.
  • Perform essential life support as per regulatory requirements and scope such as but not limited to Basic Life Support, Pediatric Advanced Life Support, Advanced Cardiac Life Support, Neonatal Resuscitation etc.
  • Prepare patients for medical examination and treatment.
  • Administer medications and monitor patients for any side effects and reactions.
  • Administer treatments such as IV fluids or blood products and monitor patients for any reactions.
  • Provide wound care management.
  • Assist in medical procedures invasive or non-invasive as needed.
  • Facilitate the process of safe patient`s admission, transfer and discharge.
  • Provide comprehensive nursing care to pregnant women during all stages of their pregnancy, including prenatal, labor, delivery, and postpartum care.
  • Monitor and assess the health status of both the mother and baby, including vital signs, fetal heart rate, contractions, and postpartum recovery.
  • Assist with the management of labor, including monitoring progress, administering medication, providing pain relief, and assisting with the delivery process.
  • Educate and support expectant mothers and their families on various topics related to prenatal care, childbirth, breastfeeding, and newborn care.
  • Collaborate with a multidisciplinary healthcare team, including physicians, midwives, and other healthcare professionals, to ensure coordinated and comprehensive care for patients.
  • Administer medications, intravenous fluids, and other treatments as prescribed by healthcare providers.
  • Assist with the preparation and maintenance of sterile delivery rooms and equipment. Provide emotional support and counselling to expectant mothers and their families, addressing their concerns and answering any questions they may have.

  • Monitor the progress of labouring mothers, performs CTG monitoring and interprets findings of foetal heart rates and recognises when to escalate to the obstetrician, reflective of scope of practice, competence, and clinical privileging.

Provides parents with bereavement support, advice and compassion during end-of-life care in relation to congenital birth defects, loss of pregnancy, miscarriage, stillbirth and neonatal death

  • Hold a valid American Heart Association Basic Life Support Provider card.

  • Be able to communicate clearly and effectively in English (spoken and written) 

DESIRABLE: The post holder should have:

  • Evidenced ability to work as part of an inter-professional team.
  • Organizational and administrative skills with which to use the electronic medical record platform for clinical documentation.

Be able to communicate effectively in Arabic

Key Responsibilities

  • Deliver safe, high-quality nursing care to critically ill cardiac patients in accordance with hospital policies and international best practices.
  • Perform comprehensive patient assessments and continuously monitor clinical status, identifying and responding promptly to any deterioration.
  • Monitor and interpret cardiac rhythms, hemodynamic parameters, and invasive monitoring devices.
  • Care for patients with conditions including:
    • Acute Coronary Syndrome (ACS)
    • Myocardial Infarction (MI)
    • Heart Failure
    • Cardiogenic Shock
    • Life-threatening Arrhythmias
    • Cardiac Arrest
    • Post Cardiac Catheterization complications
  • Manage patients receiving advanced cardiovascular therapies such as:
    • Mechanical Ventilation
    • Arterial Lines
    • Central Venous Catheters
    • Temporary Pacemakers
    • Intra-Aortic Balloon Pump (IABP)
    • ECMO (where applicable)
    • Impella devices (where applicable)
    • Continuous Renal Replacement Therapy (CRRT) when required
  • Administer medications, vasoactive infusions, anticoagulants, thrombolytics, and blood products safely and accurately.
  • Recognize and respond effectively during medical emergencies, including Code Blue situations, utilizing ACLS protocols.
  • Collaborate with cardiologists, intensivists, cardiac surgeons, respiratory therapists, pharmacists, and other healthcare professionals to develop and implement individualized care plans.
  • Educate patients and their families regarding treatment plans, disease management, medications, discharge planning, and lifestyle modifications.
  • Maintain accurate, timely, and complete patient documentation within the electronic medical record.
  • Ensure compliance with infection prevention, patient safety, and quality improvement initiatives.
  • Participate in unit-based education, competency assessments, audits, and continuous professional development activities.
  • Mentor junior nurses and support students or newly hired staff during orientation when required.

Qualifications

  • Current Registered Nurse license.
  • Valid DOH, DHA, or MOH license/eligibility (for UAE positions) is preferred.
  • Minimum of 2 years of recent experience in a Cardiac ICU (CICU), Coronary Care Unit (CCU), Cardiovascular ICU (CVICU), or Critical Care setting.
  • Current BLS and ACLS certifications are mandatory.
  • CCRN or Cardiac Nursing certification is an advantage.

We are looking for an Operation Theatre Nurse – Trauma Care to provide expert perioperative support for trauma and emergency surgeries, ensuring safe, high-quality patient care within a multidisciplinary team.

Responsibilities

  • Provide comprehensive perioperative nursing care for trauma and emergency surgical patients, including pre-operative preparation, intra-operative support, and post-operative recovery.
  • Assist surgeons and the multidisciplinary team during trauma and emergency procedures, ensuring patient safety and adherence to aseptic and infection control standards.
  • Prepare, check, and manage surgical instruments, equipment, implants, and consumables to ensure readiness and functionality.
  • Monitor and document patients’ clinical status and vital signs throughout the perioperative journey, escalating concerns as appropriate.
  • Maintain accurate and timely clinical documentation in accordance with organizational and regulatory requirements.
  • Collaborate effectively with surgeons, anesthesiologists, recovery staff, and allied healthcare professionals to ensure seamless patient care and theatre workflow.
  • Participate in quality improvement, infection prevention, and patient safety initiatives to support clinical excellence.
  • Provide patient and family education regarding surgical procedures, post-operative care, and recovery expectations.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Nursing or equivalent.
  • Valid DOH, DHA, or MOH license, or DOH Eligibility.
  • Minimum 2 years of recent Operating Theatre experience, preferably supporting trauma, emergency, or acute surgical procedures.
  • Current BLS and ACLS certification.
  • Experience in managing trauma cases, emergency surgeries, and multidisciplinary surgical teams is an advantage.

About the Role

We are looking for a passionate and dedicated Pediatric Physiotherapist to join our team in Dubai. Key Responsibilities

Assess, evaluate, and treat pediatric patients with developmental, neurological, and musculoskeletal conditions.

About Prayatna Clinic

Prayatna Clinic is a multidisciplinary healthcare center committed to providing high-quality, patient-centered mental health services. We are seeking a qualified and compassionate M.Phil Clinical Psychologist to join our growing team and contribute to delivering evidence-based psychological care.

Job Summary:
The Wound Care Nurse is responsible for providing specialized assessment, treatment, and management of patients with acute, chronic, surgical, traumatic, and complex wounds. Working collaboratively with physicians and the multidisciplinary healthcare team, the Wound Care Nurse promotes evidence-based wound care practices, supports infection prevention, and educates patients, families, and staff to optimize healing outcomes and improve quality of care.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Assess, evaluate, and document wound conditions using evidence-based assessment tools.
  • Develop, implement, and evaluate individualized wound care treatment plans.

  • Monitor wound healing progress and revise care plans as clinically indicated.
  • Collaborate with physicians, surgeons, podiatrists, dietitians, physiotherapists, infection prevention teams, and other healthcare professionals to ensure comprehensive patient care.
  • Identify patients at risk for pressure injuries and implement preventive strategies.
  • Conduct regular skin and pressure injury assessments and recommend appropriate support surfaces and preventive measures.
  • Educate patients and their families on wound care, pressure injury prevention, nutrition, and self-care following discharge.
  • Provide education and clinical guidance to nursing staff on wound care best practices, products, and protocols.
  • Maintain accurate and timely clinical documentation in the electronic medical record (EMR).
  • Participate in wound care audits, quality improvement initiatives, and data collection to enhance patient outcomes.
  • Ensure compliance with hospital policies, infection prevention and control standards, and international best practices.
  • Participate in multidisciplinary rounds and contribute to discharge planning for patients requiring ongoing wound management.
  • Maintain competency in current wound care technologies, products, and evidence-based practices through continuing professional development.

Qualifications:

  • Current Registered Nurse (RN) license/eligibility as required by UAE regulatory authorities.
  • Certification in Wound Care (MANDATORY).
  • Minimum of 5 years of recent clinical nursing experience, with experience in wound care preferred.

Purpose of Job:

The Procurement Specialist is responsible for evaluating, selecting, and managing vendors (e.g., medical equipment suppliers, IT Vendors, Marketing agencies, pharmaceutical distributors, laboratory service providers, and facility maintenance contractors), ensuring cost-efficient procurement of high-quality products and services. This includes negotiating contracts, vetting vendors for compliance with regulations, and maintaining long-term partnerships to guarantee reliable access to critical supplies. The role ensures alignment with OneHealth objectives, risk mitigation strategies, and ethical sourcing practices.

Duties and Responsibilities:

Planning:

  • Estimate and establish cost parameters and budgets for purchases
  • Develop plans for purchasing equipment, services, and supplies

Functional:

  • Take a decision according to comprehensive cost analysis.
  • Create and maintain good and long-term relationships with vendors/suppliers
  • Register new vendors according to AXA registration process and documents needed.
  • Make professional decisions in a fast-paced environment
  • Maintain records of purchases, pricing, and other important data
  • Review and analyze all vendors/suppliers, supply, and price options
  • Negotiate the best deal for pricing and supply contracts
  • Ensure that the products and supplies are high quality
  • Maintain and update a list of suppliers and their qualifications, delivery times, and potential future development
  • Work with team members and procurement manager to complete duties as needed
  • Work with team members to provide technical and financial comparisons.
  • Sustainable Procurement: Include eco-friendly practices, such as sourcing from suppliers with environmental certifications or reducing waste in packaging.
  • Add responsibilities for developing risk mitigation strategies (e.g., emergency supplier networks for critical medical items).

JOB SUMMARY

The Psychologist – Developmental Pediatrics (PhD is responsible for providing specialist psychological intakes, behavioral assessments, and interventions for children and adolescents with neurodevelopmental disorders in the Outpatient Clinic. The incumbent is responsible for providing comprehensive psychological assessment and psychological/ psychoeducational/ neuropsychological testing, and for formulating/ implementing a formal psychological treatment plan for the patients. The incumbent is also responsible for providing specialist psychological advice, guidance, and consultation to other professionals contributing directly to the patient’s diagnosis and treatment plan.

KEY ROLE ACCOUNTABILITIES:

  • Composes comprehensive written reports of psychological and behavioral assessments.
  • Review’s relevant school and/or other medical records to understand cases better.
  • Communicates directly with schools and school staff, when applicable and with parental written consent for school input.
  • Familiarizes with various different educational systems that are available in Qatar, the public and private school and healthcare system, and the local community resources, so as to be in a position to counsel parents on appropriate educational placement, accessing therapy interventions and ability-friendly programs based on the outcome of the child’s diagnostic assessments that were completed by MDT or doctoral-level clinical psychologist.
  • Provides specialized clinical psychological input to the families, including parent counseling on parenting strategies and behavioral management of children with neurodevelopmental disorders that is evidence-based.
  • Offers evidence-based psychological treatments to children or adolescents with neurodevelopmental disorders such as Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) or Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD) and co-morbid psychological problems such as Anxiety (e.g., Cognitive Behavioral Therapy).
  • Provides group therapy interventions for children and families, such as social skills training for children with Autism Spectrum Disorder, and group parent education programs for parents of children with Autism Spectrum Disorder.
  • Is certified or willing to seek certification in the implementation of social-interaction focused/play-based therapy interventions for children/adolescents with neurodevelopmental disorders, such as those focused on the development of functional emotional developmental capacities (e.g., DIRFloortime®).
  • Provides specialist psychological advice, guidance and consultation to other professionals contributing directly to patient’s diagnosis and treatment plan. Works as a collaborative member of a multi-disciplinary team that comprises physicians, psychologists, speech language pathologists, occupational therapists, and nurses. Engages in peer consultation and multidisciplinary meetings in order to improve clinical care and to maintain ongoing professional standards.
  • Keeps abreast with current literature, talks with colleagues, and participates in professional organizations or conferences to keep abreast of developments in clinical psychology, counselling, developmental psychology, and neuropsychology.
  • Provides clinical supervision, based on scope and experience, to improve clinical skills and professional development of students, trainees, and early career colleagues.
  • Provides psychological services (e.g., assessment, intervention, consultation) with cultural competence appropriate to a wide variety of ethnic, linguistic, and religious populations.

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

Education

Doctoral degree (Ph.D., or PsyD, or DClinPsych) in Clinical Psychology.

Clinical Training:

Three years of supervised clinical work experience and/or a total of 4000 hours of supervised clinical experience (whichever applies) are required as part of pre-doctoral and post-doctoral training.

Experience

  • 5+ years’ experience as a practicing Licensed Clinical Psychologist, inclusive of 3+ years in a job position fully or partly dedicated to working with children with neurodevelopmental disorders such as Autism Spectrum Disorder.
  • Experienced and certified in the use of clinical diagnostic tools such as ADOS-2, ADI-R, CARS-2.

About the job

Diaverum is a Swedish-born, multinational healthcare organisation providing life-enhancing renal care to patients with chronic kidney disease. With more than 15,000 employees across 25 countries, and over 1,400 colleagues in 33 cities and towns across the Kingdom, we combine global experience with strong local presence. Our vision is to transform renal care by broadening access to high-quality kidney care. This is enabled by our standardised care delivery model, continuously evolving digital and AI capabilities, and people who care with competence, passion and inspiration.

At Diaverum Saudi Arabia, biomedical maintenance is more than technical work. It is the foundation that keeps our clinics running and our patients safe. Every machine that works as it should and every maintenance check completed on time is what allows our clinical teams to focus on delivering care.

Our clinics across the Kingdom run on standardised care delivery and reliable equipment. Dialysis machines and water treatment systems must perform to specification every session, for every patient. As we expand our clinic network, we need technicians who maintain that standard with precision and without shortcuts.

We are now looking for a Biomedical Technician who installs, maintains and repairs medical equipment across our dialysis clinics, keeping every machine running safely and every patient on schedule.

The Role

Biomedical Technician is responsible for the installation, preventive maintenance and corrective maintenance of medical equipment across our dialysis clinics. You respond to service requests, carry out scheduled maintenance and keep equipment performing to manufacturer specifications under the direction of the Regional Biomedical Supervisor.

You will report to the Regional Biomedical Supervisor and work closely with clinic administration, medical teams and other biomedical technicians across your assigned clinics.

What You Will Do

You will keep medical equipment across your assigned clinics installed, maintained and running without interruption.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Execute installation of new medical equipment including all pre-installation activities, in line with manufacturer requirements and approved layouts.
  • Perform scheduled preventive maintenance for all medical equipment within assigned clinics, following manufacturer recommendations and Diaverum PPM plans.
  • Respond promptly to service requests and carry out corrective maintenance and repairs to minimise equipment downtime.
  • Document all activities accurately and on time, including installations, maintenance, spare parts used and equipment condition.
  • Carry out emergency repairs, equipment transfers and dismantling as directed by the Regional Biomedical Supervisor.
  • Provide technical support and coverage to other clusters when required.
  • Maintain service tools and specialised equipment in clean, safe and operational condition.

Who You Are

You are hands-on, well-organised and take ownership of your assigned equipment and schedule. You work independently across multiple sites and know when to escalate.

You will be well-suited to this role if you:

  • Bring solid mechanical and electrical knowledge with field troubleshooting experience.
  • Read and interpret technical schematics and wiring diagrams.
  • Document your work accurately and report to your supervisor without needing to be followed up.
  • Communicate clearly with clinic staff and colleagues across different sites.
  • Are comfortable with frequent travel within and across cluster cities.

Experience and Qualifications

We are looking for someone with real, hands-on experience in biomedical or medical equipment maintenance.

What we need:

  • Diploma in Biomedical Engineering.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in biomedical engineering; dialysis field experience is preferred.
  • Speaks and writes in Arabic and English fluently
  • Ability to travel extensively, up to 80% of working time

What you need to be able to do:

  • Preventive and corrective maintenance in a clinical or hospital environment.
  • Installation and commissioning of medical equipment.
  • Service documentation using helpdesk systems or approved reporting formats.
  • Coordinating with clinic teams on equipment-related operational needs.

What gives you an edge:

  • Experience with dialysis machines or RO water treatment systems.
  • Factory technical training from a recognised medical equipment manufacturer.
  • Knowledge of safety regulations, industry standards and OSHA guidelines.
  • Proficiency in MS Word, Excel and Outlook.
  • Experience working across multiple clinic sites or clusters.

What Makes This Role Meaningful

When a dialysis machine is down, a patient misses their treatment. Your work as a Biomedical Technician is what keeps that from happening. Every installation you complete, every preventive check you run and every fault you resolve on time is a direct contribution to patient safety.

Ready to Make a Difference?

If you have the technical skills, the discipline to stay on schedule and the commitment to work across multiple sites in a clinical environment, apply. We review every application.

metas.experience: Minimum of 3 years of experience in biomedical engineering; dialysis field experience is preferred.

Diaverum is a Swedish-born, multinational healthcare organisation providing life-enhancing renal care to patients with chronic kidney disease. With more than 15,000 employees across 25 countries, and over 1,400 colleagues in 33 cities and towns across the Kingdom, we combine global experience with strong local presence. Our vision is to transform renal care by broadening access to high-quality kidney care. This is enabled by our standardised care delivery model, continuously evolving digital and AI capabilities, and people who care with competence, passion and inspiration.

At Diaverum Saudi Arabia, Human Capital Operations is more than administration. It is the backbone that allows our people, clinics and leaders to focus on what matters most: delivering safe, reliable and high-quality care to our patients.

We are looking for a Human Capital Operations Specialist who brings structure, accuracy, service mindset and a genuine interest in improving how people experience Human Capital in their daily work.

This role is for someone who understands that employee services, documentation, processes and systems may seem operational, but when done well, they create trust, speed, compliance and clarity across the organization.

The Role

Our Human Capital function supports a large and diverse healthcare organization with clinics across the Kingdom. Every contract, onboarding step, employee letter, personnel update, policy process and system transaction has an impact on someone’s working day.

You will contribute to a reliable, responsive and forward-looking Human Capital Operations department. That means delivering the basics brilliantly, while also improving the way we work through clearer processes, better data, digital tools and a stronger employee experience.

What you will help us build

As Human Capital Operations Specialist, you will support the daily operations of the Human Capital function and ensure that employee-related processes are handled accurately, efficiently and in line with company policies and applicable regulations.

You will work closely with Human Capital colleagues, clinic teams, employees, leaders and other support functions to ensure that requests are handled professionally and that our people processes are clear, consistent and well documented.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Supporting employee lifecycle processes, including onboarding, contract administration, employee letters, transfers, changes and exits.
  • Maintaining accurate employee records and ensuring data quality in Human Capital systems.
  • Supporting attendance, leave, documentation and employee service requests.
  • Coordinating with relevant internal teams on payroll input, benefits, government platforms and employee-related requirements.
  • Supporting policy implementation and ensuring that processes are followed consistently.
  • Helping employees and managers navigate Human Capital processes with clarity and professionalism.
  • Identifying recurring issues and suggesting process improvements.
  • Supporting reporting, dashboards and basic people analytics when required.
  • Contributing to a service-minded Human Capital culture built on reliability, confidentiality and care.

Who You Are

You are structured, detail-oriented and service-minded. You take pride in getting things right, following through and creating clarity for others. You understand the importance of confidentiality and you know that trust is built through consistency.

We believe you will succeed in this role if you have:

  • Experience in HR operations, employee services, government relations support, shared services or a similar administrative HR role.
  • Good understanding of employee lifecycle processes.
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy in documentation and data handling.
  • Ability to manage several tasks and requests while maintaining quality.
  • Professional communication skills in Arabic and English.
  • Good knowledge of Microsoft Office; experience with HR systems is an advantage.
  • A calm, helpful and solution-oriented approach.
  • High integrity and respect for confidentiality.

Most importantly, you see Human Capital Operations as a service that enables people to do their best work, not just as a set of transactions.

Experience and Qualifications

You bring real, hands-on experience in HR operations and a track record of handling employee processes accurately and professionally.

What we need:

  • At least 2 years Diploma degree, Bachelor is desirable
  • Minimum of 2 years experience in personnel and administration
  • Speaks and writes in Arabic and English fluently
  • Professional HR certifications such as CIPD or SHRM.

What you need to be able to do:

  • Manage employee lifecycle processes from onboarding to exit.
  • Work with HR systems for records, transactions and reporting.
  • Handle government platforms including among others GOSI and HRDF.
  • Manage multiple requests simultaneously without losing accuracy.
  • Communicate clearly with employees and managers on Human Capital matters.

What gives you an edge:

  • Experience in a healthcare or multi-site organization.
  • Familiarity with HR systems and digital tools.
  • Knowledge of Saudi labor law and government relations processes.

What Makes This Role Meaningful

In most organizations, Human Capital operations roles focus on transactions. At Diaverum, your work connects directly to patient care. When Human Capital processes run well, clinic teams spend less time on admin and more time with patients.

This is not a back-office role. You will have real scope, work on processes that affect every employee in the organization and see the direct impact of what you deliver. You will be part of a Human Capital function that is developing and becoming more connected to the business. 

Ready to Make a Difference?

If you value structure, take service seriously and want your work to create clarity for the people around you, apply. We review every application.

The Social Worker is responsible for planning, coordinating, delivering and evaluating social care services for patients across one or more assigned clinics. The role includes psychosocial support, patient well-being programmes, health promotion and educational activities, community engagement, social research and preventive care services, in line with Diaverum clinical governance and applicable local and international standards.

You will report directly to the Clinic Medical Director for clinic objectives and functionally to the Head of Social Care for standards of care and quality management. You will work closely with the multidisciplinary team, clinic nurses, physicians and operations management.

What You Will Do

You will provide direct patient support and contribute to quality, documentation, education and continuous improvement across your assigned clinic or clinics.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Provide psychosocial support, health promotion and lifestyle management tailored to hemodialysis patients with different demographic backgrounds, medical histories and psychosocial needs. Work with patients and the multidisciplinary team to support treatment adherence, including attendance, treatment duration, medication and required lifestyle changes.
  • Implement a continuous, accurate and effective Social Care Process for all patients, including screening, assessment, diagnosis, intervention and counselling, documentation, monitoring and evaluation.
  • Coordinate patient support programmes that improve access to social services, financial aid, transportation assistance and psychosocial interventions, and participate in relevant community engagement activities in alignment with the Head of Social Care.
  • Contribute to patient experience and quality-of-life initiatives by collecting and reviewing patient feedback, identifying areas for improvement and supporting actions that improve the overall care experience.
  • Maintain accurate and complete documentation, including Monthly Care Plans, social care follow-up records and in-clinic referrals. Monitor relevant psychosocial indicators and contribute to evaluating social care outcomes.
  • Comply with policies and procedures relating to scope of care, patient confidentiality and rights, infection control, facility management and safety, as well as JCI, CBAHI and applicable local regulatory requirements. Monitor compliance with social care policies and procedures.
  • Work closely with the Head of Social Care, Clinic Medical Director, clinic team and operations management to support quality goals and social care parameters. Participate in social care department meetings, clinic management meetings, quarterly management reviews, monthly business reviews and clinic development initiatives.
  • Participate in social care research, quality improvement initiatives, training and continuous professional development. Support the orientation and induction of new social work team members, as applicable.

Who You Are

You are empathetic, structured and effective in a clinical team environment. You understand that the social and emotional dimensions of chronic illness are as important as the clinical ones.

You will be well-suited to this role if you:

  • Connect with patients from diverse backgrounds with genuine care, respect and professionalism.
  • Work collaboratively with patients and members of the multidisciplinary team.
  • Document and manage cases with accuracy and consistency.
  • Communicate clearly with physicians, nurses, clinic management and the Head of Social Care.
  • Follow social care policies, quality standards and regulatory requirements, and participate in learning and quality improvement activities.

Experience and Qualifications

We are looking for someone with a social work background and a genuine interest in clinical and patient-centred care.

What we need:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Social Work. A master’s degree in Social Work is favourable.
  • Certified Clinical Social Worker Specialist by the Saudi Commission for Health Specialties (SCFHS).
  • Fluent in Arabic and English, spoken and written.
  • Proficient in MS Office and basic computer systems.

Experience and capabilities:

  • Fresh graduates are welcome. One to two years of social work experience in a clinical setting or hospital is favourable.
  • Ability to work within a multidisciplinary healthcare team.
  • Ability to document and manage patient care plans, psychosocial assessments, follow-up records and referrals.
  • Understanding of JCI, CBAHI and applicable local quality and compliance requirements.

What gives you an edge:

  • Experience in renal care, diabetes, hypertension or chronic disease management.
  • Familiarity with psychosocial indicators and social care measurement and evaluation.
  • Experience in patient experience and quality-of-life initiatives, including patient feedback and service improvement.
  • Experience with patient support programs covering financial aid or transportation services.
  • Prior involvement in social care research or quality improvement projects.
