About Diaverum:

We are a purpose-driven organization – delivering life-enhancing renal care because everyone deserves a fulfilling life. Our standardized, world-class care delivery sets us apart. Diaverum provides life enhancing renal care to patients with Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD), enabling them to live fulfilling lives. We are one of the world’s leading providers of renal care and the largest service provider in the Middle East. Our core service is hemodialysis, but our expertise stretches far beyond this. We offer support and treatments ranging from preventive care, peritoneal dialysis and home care to the coordinated management of patients’ comorbidities and transplant services. At the heart of what we do is our highly standardized proprietary care delivery model, supported by a continuously evolving digital infrastructure.

For more details, please visit our website – Diaverum Saudi Arabia

Medical Underwriter

Position Summary

The Medical Underwriter is responsible for evaluating and assessing medical risks associated with

individual and group health insurance applications. This role analyzes medical histories, clinical data, laboratory results, and underwriting information to determine eligibility, coverage terms, and appropriate premium rates. The ideal candidate combines strong analytical skills, medical knowledge, and regulatory

expertise to support sound underwriting decisions while balancing customer needs and organizational risk objectives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review and assess medical applications, health questionnaires, laboratory results, physician statements, and other supporting documentation to determine insurability.
  • Evaluate medical, occupational, and lifestyle risk factors and apply appropriate underwriting actions, exclusions, or premium adjustments.
  • Apply established underwriting guidelines, rating methodologies, and regulatory requirements to new business, renewals, policy amendments, and reinstatements.
  • Identify trends, inconsistencies, and potential risks within medical and underwriting data; document decisions with clear rationale and supporting evidence.
  • Collaborate with Sales, Actuarial, Claims, Product, and Medical teams to ensure accurate risk evaluation, pricing, and policy issuance.
  • Review and approve policy changes, riders, endorsements, and renewals based on updated risk assessments.
  • Maintain current knowledge of insurance products, underwriting practices, medical advancements, and applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Support the development, enhancement, and maintenance of underwriting guidelines, procedures, and best practices.
  • Provide technical guidance, training, and mentorship to junior underwriters and underwriting support staff.
  • Prepare and maintain audit-ready documentation and respond to inquiries from regulators, reinsurers, auditors, and internal stakeholders.
  • Contribute to process improvement initiatives that enhance underwriting quality, efficiency, and consistency.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Insurance, Healthcare
  • Administration, Life Sciences, Business Administration, or a related field; equivalent professional experience may be considered.
  • 3–7 years of experience in medical underwriting, health insurance underwriting, or a related risk assessment role.
  • Strong understanding of medical terminology, disease processes, diagnostic testing, and health insurance products.
  • Proficiency in underwriting systems, risk assessment methodologies, and health data analysis.
  • Demonstrated ability to interpret medical records, laboratory results, and clinical documentation.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain underwriting decisions effectively.
  • High level of accuracy, attention to detail, and organizational capability.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience underwriting complex individual and/or group health insurance products.
  • Knowledge of behavioral health, chronic disease management, disability underwriting, or specialty risk assessment.
  • Professional certifications such as CPCU, FALU, CPC, RMA, FLMI, or equivalent.
  • Familiarity with applicable healthcare and insurance regulations, including ACA requirements and related compliance standards.
  • Experience working with reinsurers and large-case underwriting.

Core Competencies

  • Risk Assessment & Underwriting Judgment
  • Analytical Thinking & Data Interpretation
  • Regulatory Compliance & Governance
  • Medical Knowledge & Clinical Evaluation
  • Decision-Making & Problem Solving
  • Collaboration & Stakeholder Management
  • Effective Written & Verbal Communication
  • Time Management & Organizational Excellence
  • Attention to Detail & Quality Assurance
  • Proficiency in Underwriting Platforms and Microsoft Office Applications

Education

& Certifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant discipline or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Professional underwriting, insurance, actuarial, or healthcare-related certifications are highly desirable.

A Clinical Support Assistant (CSA) plays a crucial role in healthcare settings by providing administrative and clinical support to healthcare professionals. They assist with patient care under the direction and supervision of a licensed healthcare professional, manage medical records, and ensure that clinical areas are prepared for patient treatments. CSAs work alongside nurses, doctors, and other staff to maintain the smooth and safe patient journey

Responsibilities

  • Prepare and organize clinical areas (including waiting areas) for patient presence,  consultations and procedures.
  • Provide non-interventional assistance to licensed healthcare professionals during medical examinations and treatments (eg. chaperoning, consumable/room preparation and turn around)
  • When trained and competent, perform basic patient care tasks, such as helping with mobility, bed making and personal hygiene, all at the instruction and supervision  of the licensed healthcare professional.
  • When trained and competent, ensure medical equipment is sterilized and cleaned and ready for use according to NMC Policy.
  • Manage patient records, updating information and ensuring confidentiality and data protection.
  • Schedule patient appointments and handle admissions/discharges, inclusive of follow up discharge phone calls
  • Monitor inventory of medical supplies and restock as needed.
  • Provide emotional support and clear communication to patients and families when required and following the instruction of the healthcare professional.
  • Adhere to all safety, health, and infection control procedures.
  • Speak up, if something isn’t right.
  • Maintain awareness of and comply with, the NMC Policies and Procedures
  • Participate in all activities related to DOH/DHA/MOH/MOHAP and NMC Quality Improvement when required
  • Uphold the regulatory and accreditation standards and which of them apply to their daily working practice
  • Support in the escort of patients within and between departments
  • Transport patient specimens in accordance to NMC Policy.

Strictly adhere to the regulator Scope of Practice.

Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent (some employers may require additional certification or training)

Job Purpose

The Quality Control Officer is responsible for inspecting inbound and outbound shipments to ensure compliance with quality standards and regulatory requirements. The role focuses on monitoring temperature-controlled shipments, maintaining accurate quality records, supporting warehouse quality operations, and ensuring compliance with Good Distribution Practices (GDP).

Key Responsibilities

  • Inspect incoming shipments according to the approved receiving checklist to ensure compliance with quality standards.
  • Collect, download, and manage temperature data loggers for inbound shipments, and communicate results with suppliers.
  • Monitor and report temperature excursions, shipment damage, and quality deviations to the Quality Assurance team.
  • Ensure rejected or hold shipments are properly reserved in the system and quarantined when required by SFDA or vendors.
  • Update shipment status in tracking systems to support product release activities.
  • Maintain accurate temperature and quality records for inbound and outbound shipments.
  • Conduct temperature validation for warehouses and vehicles according to the annual validation plan.
  • Monitor warehouse temperature conditions, review monthly readings, and initiate corrective actions when deviations occur.
  • Support compliance with quality standards, GDP requirements, and internal quality procedures.

Qualifications & Experience

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Minimum of 1 year of experience in a Quality Control or warehouse operations role.
  • Basic knowledge of warehouse operations, quality standards, and Good Distribution Practices (GDP).
  • Experience handling temperature-controlled products is an advantage.
  • Ability to maintain accurate records and follow quality procedures.

Registrar – Internal Medicine (Home Healthcare)
About the job

About Taib

Taib is one of the leading home healthcare companies in Saudi Arabia, established in 2018. We provide a comprehensive range of home healthcare services, including medical consultations, nursing care, chronic disease management, post-hospitalization care, rehabilitation support, and patient education. Taib is among the first home healthcare companies in the Kingdom to be accredited by CBAHI and is a subsidiary of BLOMINVEST.

Job Title

Registrar – Internal Medicine (Home Healthcare)

Department: Medical Operations – Home Healthcare

Location: Jeddah & Al Khobar, Saudi Arabia

Job Summary

The Registrar – Internal Medicine provides comprehensive medical assessment, diagnosis, and management for adult patients receiving healthcare services at home. The role focuses on managing acute and chronic medical conditions, implementing individualized treatment plans, coordinating multidisciplinary care, and ensuring high-quality, patient-centered healthcare delivery.

The Registrar plays an essential role in improving patient outcomes, reducing avoidable hospital admissions, and promoting continuity of care through evidence-based medical practice, proactive disease management, and close collaboration with healthcare teams. The position ensures safe, compassionate, and comprehensive medical care in compliance with Ministry of Health regulations, CBAHI standards, and organizational policies.

Key Responsibilities

1. Patient Consultation and Clinical Case Management

  • Conduct comprehensive medical assessments during home visits and virtual consultations.
  • Evaluate, diagnose, and manage a broad range of acute and chronic internal medicine conditions.
  • Develop individualized treatment plans, including medication management, investigations, referrals, and follow-up plans.
  • Monitor patient progress and modify treatment plans according to clinical findings.
  • Identify patients requiring escalation of care or hospital admission and coordinate timely referrals.
  • Provide medical consultations through telemedicine platforms when required.
  • Ensure accurate, complete, and timely medical documentation in accordance with evidence-based practice.
  • Educate patients and caregivers regarding disease management, medication adherence, preventive care, and healthy lifestyle modifications.
  • Coordinate care with consultants, specialists, nurses, and allied healthcare professionals to ensure continuity of care.
  • Participate in clinical discussions and seek senior medical consultation for complex or high-risk cases when appropriate.

2. Clinical Quality and Compliance

  • Practice according to approved clinical guidelines, Ministry of Health regulations, and CBAHI standards.
  • Participate in quality improvement initiatives, clinical audits, and patient safety activities.
  • Ensure compliance with infection prevention and control standards.
  • Contribute to maintaining high standards of clinical governance and documentation.
  • Support implementation of clinical policies, procedures, and care pathways.

3. Professional Development

  • Participate in continuing medical education (CME), workshops, and clinical training programs.
  • Attend multidisciplinary case discussions and contribute to knowledge sharing.
  • Maintain professional competence by keeping updated with current evidence-based internal medicine practices.
  • Support orientation and clinical guidance for junior physicians and healthcare staff when required.

4. Health Information Systems (HIS) and Medical Documentation

  • Utilize electronic medical records (EMR) and healthcare information systems effectively.
  • Ensure complete, accurate, and timely documentation of patient assessments, diagnoses, treatment plans, and follow-up notes.
  • Comply with Ministry of Health documentation requirements and organizational policies.
  • Participate in initiatives related to digital healthcare systems and telemedicine services.

5. Patient Safety and Satisfaction

  • Apply patient safety principles and clinical risk management practices.
  • Identify and report clinical incidents, risks, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Deliver compassionate, ethical, and patient-centered medical care.
  • Provide clear explanations to patients and families regarding diagnoses, treatment plans, and expected outcomes.
  • Address patient concerns professionally to improve satisfaction and quality of care.

6. Collaboration with Healthcare Teams

  • Work collaboratively with physicians, nurses, pharmacists, therapists, case managers, and other healthcare professionals.
  • Ensure effective communication among multidisciplinary teams.
  • Coordinate referrals, follow-up care, and continuity of treatment.
  • Participate in multidisciplinary meetings to optimize patient outcomes.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Quality and safety of medical care provided to home healthcare patients.
  • Accuracy and completeness of medical assessments and documentation.
  • Effective management of acute and chronic internal medicine cases.
  • Reduction in avoidable hospital admissions and emergency referrals.
  • Compliance with clinical guidelines, CBAHI standards, Ministry of Health regulations, and operational procedures.
  • Patient and family satisfaction scores.
  • Effective communication and coordination with multidisciplinary teams.
  • Timely completion of medical consultations, follow-ups, and care plans.

Qualifications and Skills Required

Education and Professional Requirements

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Medicine and Surgery (MBBS/MD) or equivalent.
  • Completion of an Internal Medicine Residency Program.
  • Valid registration and professional classification from the Saudi Commission for Health Specialties (SCFHS).
  • Classification as Registrar – Internal Medicine or equivalent.
  • Previous experience in Internal Medicine clinical practice.
  • Experience in home healthcare, outpatient care, or primary healthcare settings is preferred.

Skills and Competencies

  • Strong clinical assessment and diagnostic decision-making skills.
  • Ability to independently manage acute and chronic internal medicine cases.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills in Arabic and English.
  • Proficiency in electronic medical records (EMR) and telemedicine platforms.
  • Ability to work effectively in home-based and multidisciplinary environments.
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to prioritize workload.
  • Commitment to continuous professional development.
  • Professional, compassionate, and patient-focused approach.

What Taib Offers

Opportunity to contribute to improving patient outcomes through advanced home-based medical care. 

Competitive salary and benefits package.

Professional and supportive healthcare environment.

Opportunities for career growth and clinical development.

Exposure to innovative home healthcare models in Saudi Arabia.

About the job

Sales & Service Biomedical Engineer

Location: Egypt

Employment Type: Full-Time

About IRG

IRG is a leading provider of innovative healthcare, physiotherapy, and rehabilitation solutions across Egypt and the GCC. We partner with globally recognized manufacturers to deliver advanced medical technologies, ensuring exceptional quality, technical expertise, and customer satisfaction.

We are looking for a motivated and dynamic Sales & Service Biomedical Engineer to join our growing team. The ideal candidate will combine strong technical expertise with excellent communication and sales skills to promote, install, maintain, and support our medical equipment while building long-term relationships with healthcare providers.

Key Responsibilities

Sales Responsibilities

* Promote and sell IRG’s portfolio of medical, physiotherapy, and rehabilitation equipment.

* Identify new business opportunities and develop strong relationships with hospitals, clinics, universities, and healthcare professionals.

* Conduct product presentations, demonstrations, and technical discussions with customers.

* Prepare quotations, follow up on proposals, and negotiate to close sales opportunities.

* Achieve assigned sales targets and contribute to business growth.

* Maintain accurate sales records and provide regular market feedback.

Service Responsibilities

* Install, commission, and configure medical equipment at customer sites.

* Perform preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, repairs, and calibration.

* Provide technical support and respond promptly to customer service requests.

* Deliver product training to end users and clinical staff.

* Prepare detailed service reports after each visit.

* Coordinate with suppliers and the technical team to ensure timely resolution of technical issues.

* Ensure compliance with company procedures and manufacturer standards.

Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in Biomedical Engineering.

* 1–3 years of experience in medical equipment sales, service, or both.

* Strong technical knowledge of biomedical equipment.

* Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.

* Strong problem-solving and analytical abilities.

* Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks.

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office.

* Good command of English (written and spoken).

Preferred Requirements

* Previous experience in physiotherapy, rehabilitation, or medical devices is highly preferred.

* Valid driving license.

* Willingness to travel frequently across Egypt when required.

What We Offer

* Competitive salary package.

* Attractive sales commission.

* Professional development and continuous training.

* Career growth opportunities.

* Dynamic and supportive work environment.

If you are passionate about healthcare technology and enjoy combining technical expertise with customer engagement, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply now and become part of the IRG team.

Job Description

Registered Midwife

Department

Maternity Services / Labor & Delivery

Reports To

Nurse Manager – Maternity Services

Job Purpose

To provide safe, evidence-based, compassionate, and family-centered midwifery care to women throughout pregnancy, labor, childbirth, and the postnatal period. The Registered Midwife is responsible for promoting normal childbirth, recognizing complications, providing emergency interventions when required, and ensuring the safety and wellbeing of both mother and newborn in accordance with DHA regulations, UAE standards, and hospital policies.

Key Responsibilities

Clinical Care

  • Provide comprehensive antenatal, intrapartum, and postnatal care.
  • Assess, monitor, and document maternal and fetal wellbeing.
  • Support and promote normal physiological childbirth.
  • Conduct vaginal examinations and monitor labor progress.
  • Perform and interpret fetal heart monitoring (CTG).
  • Assist with normal vaginal deliveries within the approved scope of practice.
  • Identify high-risk pregnancies and promptly escalate concerns to the Obstetrician.
  • Prepare mothers for operative deliveries when required.
  • Monitor mothers and newborns during the immediate post-delivery period.
  • Recognize and respond appropriately to obstetric emergencies.

Newborn Care

  • Perform immediate newborn assessments.
  • Support neonatal adaptation following birth.
  • Promote skin-to-skin contact and early breastfeeding.
  • Monitor newborn health and identify abnormalities requiring medical intervention.

Patient Education

  • Educate mothers and families on:
    • Pregnancy health
    • Labor and delivery
    • Breastfeeding
    • Newborn care
    • Family planning
    • Postnatal recovery
  • Provide emotional support to patients and families throughout the childbirth journey.

Quality & Patient Safety

  • Maintain accurate and timely clinical documentation.
  • Comply with infection prevention and control standards.
  • Participate in quality improvement initiatives.
  • Report incidents, near misses, and patient safety concerns.
  • Maintain patient confidentiality at all times.

Collaboration

  • Work collaboratively with Obstetricians, Neonatologists, Anesthetists, Nurses, and allied health professionals.
  • Participate in multidisciplinary rounds.
  • Support junior staff and students where applicable.

Professional Responsibilities

  • Maintain professional registration and licensure.
  • Complete mandatory education and competency assessments.
  • Participate in continuing professional development (CPD).
  • Practice in accordance with UAE regulations, professional ethics, and hospital policies.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Midwifery OR
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Nursing with a recognized Midwifery qualification.
  • Valid DHA License or DHA Eligibility as a Registered Midwife.
  • Current BLS certification.
  • NRP certification is preferred.
  • ACLS certification is an advantage.

Experience

  • Minimum 4 years’ post-qualification experience as a Registered Midwife in a maternity hospital or similar clinical setting.
  • Experience in Labor & Delivery is essential.

Knowledge & Skills

  • Comprehensive knowledge of antenatal, intrapartum, and postnatal care.
  • Obstetric emergency management.
  • Neonatal assessment and care.
  • CTG interpretation.
  • Infection prevention and control.
  • Medication administration.
  • Electronic Medical Record (EMR) documentation.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work effectively under pressure.
  • Strong clinical judgment and decision-making skills.
  • Cultural sensitivity and patient-centered approach.

Core Competencies

  • Patient Focus
  • Clinical Excellence
  • Communication
  • Teamwork
  • Accountability
  • Professionalism
  • Compassion
  • Safety Awareness
  • Time Management
  • Ethical Practice

Working Conditions

  • Rotating shifts including nights, weekends, and public holidays.
  • Exposure to emergency and high-acuity maternity situations.
  • Compliance with hospital infection control and occupational health policies.

License Requirement

Must hold a valid Dubai Health Authority (DHA) Registered Midwife License or DHA Eligibility Letter and meet the UAE Professional Qualification Requirements for Registered Midwives.

  • 10 competency-based interview questions
  • KPIs for the role
  • Physical demands and working conditions section
  • Essential vs. desirable criteria for easier candidate screening.

Job Description – Patient Counselor

Job Title: Patient Counselor

Department: Patient Services / Customer Experience

Reports To: Patient Services Manager / Operations Manager / Medical Director

Location: Dubai, United Arab Emirates

Job Summary

The Patient Counselor is responsible for guiding and supporting patients throughout their healthcare journey by providing information about medical services, treatment plans, financial estimates, insurance coverage, and appointment coordination. The role serves as a liaison between patients, physicians, and other departments to ensure a seamless patient experience while maintaining high standards of customer service, confidentiality, and compliance with Dubai Health Authority (DHA) regulations and organizational policies.

Key Responsibilities

Patient Coordination

  • Welcome and assist patients throughout their treatment journey.
  • Explain treatment plans, procedures, and service options as outlined by the treating physician.
  • Coordinate appointments, diagnostic tests, procedures, and follow-up visits.
  • Facilitate communication between patients, physicians, nursing staff, and other departments.
  • Ensure smooth patient flow and timely coordination of services.

Patient Counseling

  • Provide patients with clear information regarding treatment plans, expected outcomes, timelines, and available healthcare services.
  • Educate patients on pre-procedure and post-procedure instructions as directed by the healthcare team.
  • Address patient inquiries, concerns, and complaints professionally and promptly.
  • Offer emotional support while maintaining professional boundaries.
  • Maintain confidentiality and protect patient privacy at all times.

Financial Counseling & Insurance

  • Coordinate with the insurance department regarding eligibility, approvals, and coverage.
  • Explain insurance benefits, exclusions, co-payments, and patient financial responsibilities.
  • Assist patients with payment arrangements in accordance with organizational policies.
  • Coordinate with the finance department regarding invoicing and payment collection where applicable.

Administrative Responsibilities

  • Maintain accurate patient records and documentation in the Electronic Medical Record (EMR) system.
  • Ensure all consent forms and required documentation are completed before treatment.
  • Schedule and confirm patient appointments.
  • Prepare reports and maintain departmental records as required.
  • Follow up with patients regarding appointments, treatment progress, and outstanding documentation.

Customer Service

  • Deliver exceptional customer service and ensure a positive patient experience.
  • Respond promptly to patient feedback and escalate concerns when necessary.
  • Support patient satisfaction initiatives and service excellence programs.
  • Assist with patient retention and follow-up activities.

Collaboration

  • Work closely with Physicians, Nurses, Reception, Insurance Coordinators, Finance, and Customer Service teams.
  • Coordinate multidisciplinary care to ensure efficient patient management.
  • Participate in departmental meetings and process improvement initiatives.

Quality & Compliance

  • Comply with Dubai Health Authority (DHA) regulations, hospital policies, and patient confidentiality requirements.
  • Ensure adherence to ethical standards and customer service protocols.
  • Participate in quality improvement initiatives and patient satisfaction programs.
  • Report incidents, complaints, or service issues according to organizational procedures.

Professional Development

  • Participate in Continuing Professional Development (CPD) and mandatory training.
  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of healthcare services, insurance processes, and customer service best practices.
  • Attend workshops on communication, patient experience, and healthcare administration.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Healthcare Administration, Nursing, Business Administration, Psychology, Social Work, or a related field.
  • Additional certification in Customer Service, Patient Experience, or Healthcare Administration is an advantage.
  • Basic Life Support (BLS) certification is preferred.

Experience

  • Minimum 2–3 years of experience in patient counseling, patient relations, customer service, healthcare administration, or a similar role.
  • Experience in a hospital, medical center, or outpatient clinic is preferred.
  • Familiarity with insurance approvals and medical billing processes is an advantage.
  • Previous experience in a DHA-licensed healthcare facility is preferred.

Knowledge & Skills

  • Strong understanding of healthcare services and patient care processes.
  • Knowledge of medical terminology and healthcare insurance procedures.
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and counseling skills.
  • Strong customer service and conflict resolution abilities.
  • Ability to explain medical and financial information clearly and professionally.
  • Competency in Electronic Medical Records (EMR), Hospital Information Systems (HIS), and Microsoft Office applications.
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary healthcare environment.
  • Knowledge of DHA regulations related to patient services and confidentiality.

Key Competencies

  • Customer Service Excellence
  • Communication and Interpersonal Skills
  • Counseling and Relationship Building
  • Problem-Solving and Conflict Resolution
  • Organizational Skills
  • Attention to Detail

Overview

M42 delivers comprehensive healthcare services across the full continuum of care; from primary care to advanced specialty treatments. Leveraging cutting-edge health technologies and precision medicine, we ensure the highest standards of effectiveness, efficiency, and patient-centered outcomes. With a global presence spanning more than 480 facilities in 27 countries and a dedicated workforce of over 20,000 professionals, M42 is uniquely positioned to redefine the future of healthcare on a global scale.

Since its inception in 2010, National Reference Laboratory (NRL) has expanded from a single standalone reference laboratory to a network of 12 state-of-the-art facilities across the United Arab Emirates. NRL provides world-class diagnostic services to the M42 network and partners with more than 250 clients from a wide range of market segments, including private and government hospitals, medical centers and clinics, corporate organizations, and other reference laboratories.

The Medical Laboratory Technologist – Microbiology is responsible for performing microbiological testing, analyzing specimens, and reporting accurate laboratory results to support clinical diagnosis and patient care. The role ensures adherence to established laboratory procedures, quality standards, and regulatory requirements while contributing to safe, efficient, and high-quality laboratory operations.

Responsibilities

  • Perform routine microbiology testing and report accurate results within established turnaround times (TAT).
  • Process, analyze, and validate patient specimens following approved laboratory procedures and protocols.
  • Operate, maintain, and troubleshoot laboratory equipment while ensuring proper documentation.
  • Perform quality control activities, validation studies, and support proficiency testing to maintain laboratory quality standards.
  • Prepare laboratory reagents, media, stains, and other materials required for microbiology testing.
  • Ensure compliance with CAP, ISO 15189, DOH, JCI, infection control, and laboratory safety requirements.
  • Monitor inventory levels and coordinate with senior staff to maintain laboratory supplies and consumables.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives, mentor new staff when required, and collaborate with multidisciplinary teams.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Medical Laboratory Science, Medical Laboratory Technology.
  • Valid DOH License (or eligibility) as a Medical Laboratory Technologist.
  • Minimum 2 years of experience in a clinical microbiology laboratory.
  • Strong knowledge of microbiology techniques, quality control, and laboratory accreditation standards (CAP, ISO 15189, JCI).
  • Experience operating microbiology laboratory equipment and performing validation and quality assurance activities.
  • ASCP, AMT, or equivalent professional certification is preferred.

metas.experience: Minimum 2 years of experience in a clinical microbiology laboratory.

About the job

Consultant Interventional Cardiologist

Job Purpose

Responsible for delivering comprehensive and advanced cardiology care, including the assessment, diagnosis, investigation, and treatment of patients with cardiovascular conditions. The role requires maintaining the highest standards of clinical excellence, patient safety, and evidence-based practice while actively contributing to quality improvement initiatives, medical education, and multidisciplinary collaboration.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct outpatient clinics according to the approved schedule and provide specialized cardiology consultations.
  • Assess, diagnose, and manage patients presenting with cardiovascular diseases and related conditions.
  • Determine the need for hospital admission and oversee inpatient care within granted clinical privileges.
  • Develop and implement individualized treatment plans, including medications, interventions, and preventive strategies.
  • Perform and supervise diagnostic and interventional cardiology procedures as per credentialing and professional privileges.
  • Monitor patient progress, evaluate treatment outcomes, and modify management plans when necessary.
  • Explain diagnoses, treatment options, procedures, and prognoses to patients and their families, ensuring informed decision-making.
  • Collaborate with physicians from other specialties and coordinate referrals when required.
  • Conduct regular inpatient rounds and provide ongoing clinical management for admitted patients.
  • Ensure accurate, timely, and complete documentation of patient records in compliance with established healthcare standards.
  • Review and validate clinical documentation prepared by junior medical staff involved in patient care.
  • Prepare and approve discharge summaries, medical reports, and follow-up plans.
  • Provide leadership, guidance, and supervision to physicians, residents, nurses, and allied healthcare professionals.
  • Participate in quality assurance, patient safety, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Contribute to the development and review of clinical policies, protocols, and practice guidelines.
  • Participate in departmental meetings, committees, and organizational projects as assigned.
  • Ensure adherence to ethical principles, professional standards, and applicable healthcare regulations.
  • Participate in on-call coverage and respond to emergency situations when required.
  • Identify and report medico-legal cases according to organizational and regulatory requirements.
  • Contribute to academic, research, and educational activities within the department.
  • Provide patient and community education on cardiovascular health, disease prevention, and healthy lifestyle practices.
  • Support the training and supervision of interns, residents, fellows, and other healthcare trainees.
  • Maintain ongoing professional development through continuing medical education and training activities.
  • Promote a patient-centered approach that emphasizes compassion, respect, dignity, and high-quality care.
  • Perform additional duties related to the specialty as assigned.

Qualifications

Education

  • Medical degree from an accredited institution recognized by the relevant medical authority.
  • Completion of internship and residency training in Cardiology.
  • Advanced postgraduate qualification in Cardiology or a related specialty.

Experience

  • Minimum of three years of independent clinical practice as an Interventional Cardiologist following completion of specialty training.
  • Experience in a tertiary care or highly specialized healthcare environment is preferred.
  • Additional fellowship or subspecialty training in Interventional Cardiology is highly desirable.

Licensure & Certifications

  • Board Certification, Fellowship, or equivalent specialist qualification in Cardiology.
  • Valid professional license and registration from the country of practice.
  • Eligibility for registration and clinical privileging according to the requirements of the relevant healthcare regulatory authority.

About the job

Company Description Sabaa Pharmaceuticals, founded in 2003, is a fast-growing, research-based pharmaceutical company dedicated to providing affordable generic medicines to the Egyptian community. Located in the industrial area of Balţīm, the company’s manufacturing facility produces branded generics, OTC medications, food supplements, cosmetics, veterinary products, and products for selected toll partners. Sabaa’s vision focuses on supporting a competent and comprehensive healthcare system in Egypt through high-quality, accessible medicines that meet local market needs. The company views access to affordable, quality healthcare as a fundamental human right and aligns its mission with this principle. With a workforce of over 150 employees, Sabaa continues to expand and welcomes skilled, passionate professionals who can contribute to product and research development.
Role Description The Pharmaceutical Quality Assurance Specialist is a full-time, on-site role based at Sabaa Pharmaceuticals’ facility in Balţīm. This role is responsible for overseeing quality systems, ensuring compliance with internal standards and external regulatory requirements, and supporting continuous improvement initiatives across manufacturing and packaging operations. Daily tasks include reviewing and approving batch records and documentation, conducting in-process and final product quality checks, coordinating and participating in internal and external audits, and monitoring adherence to Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP). The specialist will investigate quality issues and deviations, support root cause analysis, implement corrective and preventive actions, and collaborate closely with production, QC, and regulatory teams. The role also involves maintaining quality metrics, training staff on quality procedures, and contributing to the development and update of quality policies and SOPs.
Qualifications

  • Strong proficiency in Quality Assurance and Quality Management, with experience implementing and maintaining pharmaceutical quality systems.
  • Hands-on experience in Quality Control activities, including review of test results, batch documentation, and in-process controls.
  • Solid knowledge of Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) standards and regulatory requirements relevant to pharmaceutical manufacturing.
  • Experience with Quality Auditing, including planning, executing, and following up on internal and external audits.
  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Pharmacy, Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or a related scientific discipline.
  • Experience in a pharmaceutical manufacturing environment, preferably in generics or similar regulated industries.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to conduct root cause analysis and implement effective CAPAs.
  • Detail-oriented with excellent documentation skills and familiarity with SOPs, validation, and change control processes.
  • Effective communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally with production, QC, and regulatory teams.
  • Ability to work on-site in Balţīm, manage multiple priorities, and adapt to a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment.

Requirements added by the job poster

• 3+ years of Pharmaceutical Manufacturing experience

Job Summary

The Consultant Pediatrician & Neonatologist is responsible for providing comprehensive, evidence-based medical care to newborns, infants, children, and adolescents, including critically ill and premature neonates requiring specialized neonatal intensive care. The Consultant diagnoses, treats, and manages a wide range of pediatric and neonatal conditions while collaborating with multidisciplinary teams to ensure exceptional patient outcomes. The role supports quality improvement initiatives, patient safety, medical education, and clinical governance in accordance with DHA regulations and hospital policies.

Key Responsibilities

Clinical Responsibilities

  • Provide consultant-level assessment, diagnosis, treatment, and follow-up care for pediatric patients from birth through adolescence.
  • Deliver specialized neonatal care, including management of premature and critically ill newborns.
  • Provide clinical coverage for the Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU), delivery rooms, nursery, pediatric wards, outpatient clinics, and emergency consultations.
  • Attend high-risk deliveries and perform neonatal resuscitation when required.
  • Develop individualized treatment plans using evidence-based clinical guidelines.
  • Perform and interpret appropriate diagnostic investigations.
  • Prescribe medications and therapeutic interventions safely and appropriately.
  • Manage pediatric emergencies and stabilize critically ill patients.
  • Coordinate referrals to other specialties when indicated.
  • Maintain continuity of care through appropriate follow-up and discharge planning.

Neonatal Care

  • Assess and manage premature, low birth weight, and medically complex neonates.
  • Provide advanced neonatal life support.
  • Manage neonatal respiratory disorders, infections, congenital abnormalities, jaundice, feeding difficulties, and other neonatal conditions.
  • Oversee ventilator management where applicable.
  • Perform neonatal procedures within the scope of practice.
  • Participate in family counseling regarding neonatal prognosis and treatment plans.

Patient Safety and Quality

  • Adhere to DHA regulations, hospital policies, and international clinical standards.
  • Participate in clinical audits and quality improvement initiatives.
  • Report adverse events, near misses, and patient safety concerns.
  • Support infection prevention and control practices.
  • Ensure accurate clinical documentation in the electronic medical record.
  • Participate in mortality and morbidity reviews when required.

Multidisciplinary Collaboration

  • Work closely with obstetricians, anesthetists, pediatric surgeons, nurses, respiratory therapists, pharmacists, and allied health professionals.
  • Participate in multidisciplinary case discussions.
  • Support coordinated patient-centered care.

Education and Professional Development

  • Educate patients and families regarding disease prevention, treatment options, nutrition, vaccination, and child development.
  • Mentor junior physicians, residents, interns, and medical students.
  • Participate in Continuing Medical Education (CME) activities.
  • Maintain clinical competencies through ongoing professional development.

Administrative Responsibilities

  • Maintain complete and timely medical records.
  • Participate in departmental meetings.
  • Support hospital accreditation activities.
  • Assist in developing clinical protocols and guidelines.
  • Participate in on-call schedules as assigned.

Qualifications

  • Medical Degree (MBBS or equivalent) from a recognized institution.
  • Completion of an accredited residency in Pediatrics.
  • Fellowship or equivalent specialist qualification in Neonatology.
  • Board Certification in Pediatrics and Neonatology (or equivalent internationally recognized qualification).
  • DHA Consultant License or eligibility for Consultant licensure in Dubai.

Experience

  • Minimum 8–10 years of post-specialization clinical experience in Pediatrics.
  • Minimum 3–5 years of consultant-level experience in Neonatology.
  • Extensive experience managing NICU patients.
  • Experience in tertiary care or accredited hospitals is preferred.

Knowledge

  • Neonatal ventilation and respiratory support.
  • Neonatal nutrition.

Skills

PURPOSE OF POSITION

The Infection Control Practitioner (ICP) is responsible for implementing and overseeing infection control activities across all Diaverum clinics under the direction of the Infection Control Specialist. This role ensures continuous surveillance of clinic and laboratory data to identify and monitor healthcare-associated infections (HAIs) and potential outbreaks.

Key responsibilities include investigating disease outbreaks, maintaining accurate infection control records, and ensuring compliance with infection prevention policies. The ICP plays a vital role in staff education by developing and delivering infection control training programs, including orientation for new employees. Additionally, the role contributes to quality improvement initiatives, risk assessments, and policy development to strengthen infection prevention and control practices across all Diaverum clinics.

KEY RESULT AREAS

  • Assume responsibility for the coordination of activities related to Infection Control as directed by Infection Control Specialist
  • Assume responsibility in conjunction with the Infection Control Specialist, for the planning and implementation of Infection Control programs for the clinics in keeping with established standards of the clinics and Joint Commission on Accreditation of Healthcare organizations.
  • Participate in the planning, development, and implementation of in-service education programs directly related to Infection Control for current Center staff and activities related to the new employee orientation program.
  • Ensure the establishment and maintenance of standards for Infection Control on a clinic-wide basis that ensures compliance with JCI, CBAHI, OSHA, CDC, and local MOH regulations.
  • Review and evaluate all procedures and policies related to Infection Control and provide interpretation for Head Nurses, other Departmental Managers, and Professional Staff in conjunction with Infection Control Specialist.
  • Establish, maintain and evaluate a comprehensive record system for all isolated patients and determine the prevalence of nosocomial infection every month.
  • Collaborate with the Infection Control specialist and assist in the development and revision of the Infection Control Policies and Procedures.
  • Collaborate with appropriate Administrative and Medical Staff in the maintenance of patient care standards that relate to Infection Control.
  • Initiate and participate in programs and projects which enhance the mission of Infection Control within the Diaverum Clinics.
  • Plan and prepare infection control reports on a monthly, half annual and annual basis which are submitted to the Medical Director, Infection Control Specialist and the Infection Control Committee, administration, and all required departments of Diaverum.
  • Review the Quality of environmental cleanliness regularly and report concerns to the Infection Control Coordinator and appropriate Department Head for resolution.
  • Investigate significant outbreaks of infection to identify the source of the problem and the resolution in consultation with the Infection Control Specialist and the Medical Director.
  • Ensure that the staff Comply with the standards laid down by the Approved International Accreditation Standards.
  • Identifies any occurrence not consistent with the operation of the clinic or standard of service for patients, employees, or visitors and situations that put patients, staff, or visitors at risk for injury or other harm through the chain of command.

The Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU) is a specialized department dedicated to providing advanced, compassionate care to premature, critically ill, and medically fragile newborn infants. The multidisciplinary NICU team, including neonatologists, nurses, respiratory therapists, and allied health professionals, works collaboratively to deliver comprehensive care, continuous monitoring, and specialized treatments to support the growth, development, and recovery of neonates. The unit is committed to maintaining the highest standards of patient safety while promoting family-centered care and supporting parents throughout their newborn’s hospitalization journey.

Dietitian 1-Clinical Dietetics

Job Description


Provide individualized medical nutrition therapy (MNT) through a multi-disciplinary approach for inpatients and or outpatients in Health Care Facilities / Homecare/ Kidney Care and or Ambulatory Healthcare Services.
MNT is implemented according to the American Dietetic Association (ADA) Nutrition Care Process (NCP) which provides a framework for the Clinical Dietitians to individualize care, taking into account the patient’s needs and values and using the best scientific evidence available to make decisions.  
 

Responsibilities


ADMINISTRATIVE
   Encourages teamwork by creating an environment of empowerment and accountability

May supervise and liaise with Food Service related to therapeutic diets, therapeutic projects and education on therapeutic diets

Implements Departmental standards of practice

Able to utilize marketing techniques and participation in revenue generation, where appropriate

May be responsible in maintaining sufficient inventory of nutrition consumable items, general material management and equipment required for patient care and performance of duties
CLINICAL DUTIES/ MEDICAL NUTRITION THERAPY
   Responsible for Medical Nutrition Therapy and thus assess patients using the Nutrition Care Process (NCP) which is a systematic approach to providing high-quality nutrition care. The NCP consists of four distinct, interrelated steps: Nutrition Assessment, Nutrition Diagnosis, Nutrition Intervention, and Nutrition Monitoring and Evaluation.

Responsible to individualize and evaluate care and service processes within organization systems specific to the discipline of nutrition and dietetics.

Documenting a comprehensive assessment for all consulted and referred patients as per facility policies and procedures.

Discuss and/or refer complex cases to Senior Dietitians/Supervisor for guidance to ensure high-quality evidence based nutrition care.

Responsible to update nutritional standards of care and procedures for the facility and to promote evidence based guidelines.

Being an active member of a nutrition practice group / association for the areas of work concentration.

Job Description

Laboratory Technologist is responsible to perform chemical and biological tests on patient specimens for medical diagnosis with excellent clinical laboratory skills based on international quality standards, such as ISO 15189, CAP, AABB, defined by Pure Lab.
The Technologists also performs routine preventive maintenance, cleans, and calibrates laboratory instruments and equipment. Resolves technical problems using proper troubleshooting techniques
Additional Skills such as:
•    ELISA
•    Flow cytometry
•    Automated laboratory platforms
 

Responsibilities

  • Establishing, maintaining and recording the functional integrity of all medical laboratory equipment including, but not limited to routine daily, weekly and monthly checks as well as routine inspection by biomedical engineer and maintenance for these items such as medical laboratory machines, Infusion pumps and Airway equipment.
  • Maintaining sufficient inventory of material supplies and equipment for performance of duties
  • Reporting shortage of materials to supervisor at earliest convenience, ordering and approving replenishments when necessary
  • Assessing and ordering appropriate materials/equipment following discussion with senior staff 
  • Supervising junior staff and ensuring their abidance to going rules and policies as applied and implemented in the Section/Department/Facility (as per requirement)
  •  Maintaining sufficient inventory of material supplies and equipment for performance of duties
  •  Reporting shortage of materials to supervisor at earliest convenience, ordering and approving replenishments when necessary
  • Conducting analysis of specimens to determine presence of normal and abnormal components
  •  Ensuring data capture of lab results onto computer systems 
  •  Operating, calibrates and maintains lab equipment 
  •  Providing results to physicians as per defined SOP
  • Evaluating collected laboratory data and prepare reports as per protocol
  • Ensuring that equipment is used in the correct manner to obtain optimum results and informs Supervisor of equipment malfunction.
  • Promoting and maintaining quality in all services and ensure continuous quality improvement measures are in place. Conduct method evaluation/development as per standard policies and procedures
  •  Complying with all safety, health and quality control programs and procedures as applicable
  •  Complying with applicable precautions for environmental safety, infection control, using a series of interventions that minimize or prevent cross infection
  •  Maintaining the strictest confidence in relation to patient information whether formally or informally recorded 
  •  Practicing within the expressed limits of established policies and procedures
  •  Ensuring that SOP (standard operation procedures) and Quality Assurance tests are maintained within all sections 
  •  Being responsible for documenting all intervention in appropriate format
  •  Comply and support clinical audit processes within the service and report on these as agreed
  •  Communicating in a professional and courteous manner with patients, family and other medical personnel as necessary to obtain information for laboratory records, explain procedures, clarify orders and communicate status
  •  Interacting courteously with doctors, nurses and other healthcare providers when answering questions or providing other information
  • Participating in training and education sessions for department staff, doctors and nurses in the safe and secure handling of drugs and equipment, prescribing (whenever applicable), administration and treatment and management i.e. teaching, induction, peer review, case studies, and clinical presentations
  •  Participating in department programs/committees, various hospital committees, and staff meetings 
  •  Participating in the orientation and training of new employees
  •  Ensuring appropriate internal and external sharing of information based on governing policies and procedures
  •  Maintaining professional knowledge by attending lectures, seminars or on-line education units
  •  Completing and maintaining all regulatory requirements including licensure and certification and other mandatory training within established time frames 

Qualifications

Required

  1. BSc in Medical Technology or clinical laboratory science or equivalent qualification requiring NLT 3 years training course.
  2. Graduate of an accredited (MLT) program leading to registration with ASCP/CSMLS or equivalent  
  3. Currently holding DOH License as Medical Laboratory Technologist.
  4. Master’s in biomedical science or relevant clinical Msc in related field. (will reduce 1 year from the required years of experience)
  5. Not Less Than 4 yrs experience in a clinical laboratory environment.
  6. With Msc Not Less Than 1 year experience in a clinical laboratory environment.
  7. UAE National: upon completion of Internship. 

Desirable for candidates to have experience with several of the following techniques:

  1. ELISA
  2. Flow cytometry
  3. Automated laboratory platforms

Private healthcare environments

The Charge nurse coordinates daily administrative duties, including schedules, assignments and patient care. The Charge nurse shall have the knowledge of health care systems, demonstrate the ability to interact, relate to/ work with, and support the activities of a diverse multidisciplinary workforce. content.rendered:
Job Description

JOB SUMMARY

Reporting to the Chair – Pathology, the Division Chief / Division Head – Clinical Biochemistry provides clinical, education, research and executive management leadership In Clinical Biochemistry.  The Division Chief / Division Head -is a clinical and managerial leader working with the Sidra executive team to develop and deliver strategy and business plans and is accountable for resources and performance in Clinical Biochemistry division and integrates research and education priorities into a program of excellent clinical service delivery. Specialized investigation and diagnosis of pediatric and/or maternal disease in the fields of clinical chemistry, diagnostic and therapeutic procedures for routine, complex and complicated biochemical tests for pediatric patients, consultations and case management (where appropriate), and other associated clinical and academic activities are managed in this Division.

Responsibilities

KEY ROLE ACCOUNTABILITIES

  • Identifies and articulates the vision, strategic direction, and growth of the Division of Clinical Biochemistry and collaborates on the implementation of strategies to achieve them.
  • Leads diagnostic service planning, service development and capacity planning for the clinical activities of Clinical Biochemistry services.
  • Recommends clinical privileges, appointment, reappointment and corrective action for each member of the Division of Clinical Biochemistry as well as promoting mentorship and academic career development for these staff members.
  • Implements the clinical service strategies and business plan for the Clinical Biochemistry Division.
  • Strategic/directional decisions with significant business impact. 

General

  • Promotes leadership and direction for the development of strategies to promote the recruitment, retention, and direct mission of excellence for the medical staff, and collaborates with the other Division Chiefs to execute the strategies.
  • Ensures that the staff of the Clinical Biochemistry Division provide services that are in compliance with all applicable standards and requirements of the Joint Commission International, Qatar Supreme Council of Health, and all other applicable regulatory bodies.
  • Works with the Chair – Pathology to establish and update the work week standards for all physicians on staff and assures that there is appropriate clinical coverage for all patients requiring medical care from the Clinical Biochemistry Division (including on call services).
  • Works collaboratively with other service chiefs, chief officers, and executive directors to achieve broad Sidra objectives.
  • Conducts other duties as may be directed by the Chief Medical Officer and/or Chief Executive Officer through the Chair of Pathology.
  • Supports the development of Sidra as a world class regional center.

Clinical and Technical

  • Sets and achieves targets to drive continuous assessment and improvement of the quality of care and services provided and initiates actions for necessary improvements according to Sidra Board initiatives.
  • Sets and achieves targets for programs and procedures for confidentiality of all patient information in accordance with hospital policy and the privacy laws of the State of Qatar.
  • In conjunction with the Chair of Pathology, ensures the implementation of robust clinical governance structures and processes to ensure patient safety.
  • Ensures effective communication with and involvement of all staff within the Clinical Biochemistry Division in regards to key decisions and initiatives.
  • Initiates, implements and oversees programs designed to foster positive relations between staff of Clinical Biochemistry, physicians and the hospital operations and administration.
  • Promotes and evaluates pathology community outreach programs as appropriate.
  • Develops, manages and supports pathology and community relationships, coordinating and disseminating information to all stakeholders to solicit ongoing support from the State of Qatar for Clinical Biochemistry.
  • Promotes outreach and communications with non-Sidra providers of Clinical Biochemistry services to help Sidra function as the premier regional Clinical Biochemistry research center of the Gulf Region.

Educational

  • Continues surveillance of the professional performance of all individuals in the Clinical Biochemistry Division who have delineated clinical privileges, including performance, and ongoing and focused professional practice evaluations (OPPE and FPPE).
  • Continues surveillance of diagnostic patient care and the professional performance of all individuals in the Clinical Biochemistry Division who have defined clinical privileges.
  • In conjunction with the Dean of Weill Cornell Medical College – Qatar ensures there is an active and continuous program of undergraduate teaching within the Clinical Biochemistry Division to ensure an effective learning environment for students, residents, and medical staff.
  • Initiation and implementation of continuing education programs for laboratory technologists within the Division of Clinical Biochemistry (e.g. invited seminars, symposia, teleconferences).

Research and Diagnostic Test Development

  • Makes recommendations for the purchase of capital and other equipment and participates in the evaluation of products for use by different members of the Clinical Biochemistry Division to ensure their safety and efficacy.
  • In conjunction with the Chief Research officer and division heads of research, ensures a program of basic, clinical or translational research is developed and promoted and delivered within the Clinical Biochemistry Division.
  • Is actively involved in research, graduate teaching, and publication in established and recognized refereed journals, and in advising of students and in participation in academic activities.

Administrative and Financial

  • Responsible for all administrative related activities of the Clinical Biochemistry Division unless otherwise provided for by the hospital, and serves on all requested committees including medical executive committee, and appointing such committees as necessary to conduct the function of the department.
  • Develops and implements policies and procedures that guide and support provision of services to the Clinical Biochemistry (and subspecialty) services to support Sidra’s vision as a Center of Excellence.
  • Accountable to the Chair for the financial performance and management of all budgets within the Clinical Biochemistry Division.
  • Ensures all members of the Clinical Biochemistry Division optimize the use of electronic medical records.
  • Assists with marketing strategies to inform physicians and their staff of Sidra’s clinical diagnostic procedures, services and resources.
  • Identifies and coordinates resolution of problems to improve physician utilization and patient satisfaction.
  • Develops and maintains appropriate systems of communication between Sidra and other providers of primary and advanced Clinical Biochemistry in Qatar for the purpose of individual patient care and systemic safety and quality improvement.
  • Scope of clinical responsibilities for Division Chief – Clinical Biochemistry:
    • Manages and monitors, specialized investigation and diagnosis of pediatric and/or maternal disease in the fields of Clinical Biochemistry.
    • Identification of specialized testing appropriate for specific scenarios, and triaging and/or coordination of these cases where more than one pathology division is involved.
    • Consultation and advice regarding the appropriate management of patients and samples requiring Clinical Biochemistry expertise, including the involvement of other pathology divisions and other hospital departments.
    • Manages appropriate referrals and transfers under standard and emergency situations.
    • Participates in mandatory training and actively practices continual professional development in alignment with Sidra’s professional development programs to ensure maintenance of professional licensure/accreditation.
    • Develops and/or delivers training programs to new employees on equipment and procedures in the area of operations in alignment with the department’s and Sidra’s training objectives and plans.
    • Is an educational resource for the Division and contributes to the education of patients, staff and physicians and other stakeholders as required.
    • Provides support and relief for other Clinical Chemists as required.

Qualifications

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

Education

  • For Division Chief
    • MD, MBBS or equivalent
    • Board certification
    • Fellowship/training in Clinical Biochemistry 
  • For Division Head
    • PhD + FRCPath (or equivalent)
    • Post-doctoral training in Specialty area (or equivalent training)
    • Certification in Clinical Biochemistry (ABCC or CACB/CSCC, FRCPath or equivalent)

Experience

10+ years Clinical Biochemistry / pathology experience including 5+ years in clinical and/or academic leadership in Clinical Biochemistry

Job Description

Provides direct and indirect care for assigned patients (neonates to adolescents) in the Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU). Delivers nursing assessment, diagnosis, planning, intervention, evaluation, and coordination of care for patients across the healthcare continuum while involving families. Delivers, but is not limited to paediatric hemodynamics, cardiac monitoring, and management of paediatric patients with complex medical and surgical conditions.

Responsibilities

General:

  • Provides age-specific patient-centered care utilizing the nursing process:
    • Performs patient assessment using appropriate, problem-focused, and age-specific assessment techniques.
    • Performs continual critical care assessment of patient and family’s physical and psychological needs.
    • Involves the patient, significant others, and health care providers in the plan of care when appropriate.
    • Collaborates with a multi-disciplinary team to provide patient care.
    • Coordinates and plans critical care/clinical pathway, and prioritizes care, based on individual needs. Revises the care plan as necessary.
    • Initiates appropriate transfer plan.
    • Recognizes subtle cues to anticipate potential problems.
    • Documents all relevant data in the medical record according to hospital/departmental standards.
    • Ensures availability and maintenance of supplies and equipment needed for the unit and patient care.
    • Performs clerical duties when needed.
    • Assumes responsibility for meeting Joint Commission International Accreditation (JCIA) required mandatory education (e.g. fire, safety, infection control and others).
    • Participates in staff meetings and unit committees/projects.
  • Participates in developing and achieving unit goals.
  • Maintains a safe environment for patients and staff.
  • Performs safe handling and administrating of Narcotic/Controlled and Semi-Controlled Drugs and documentation as directed by policies and procedures.
  • Ensures completion of unit competencies i.e. pain management, and utilization of Emergency department devices.
  • Maintains clinical and professional competency based on the latest research and established standards of practice.
  • Completes yearly, the critical care nursing competencies (basic).
  • Participates in unit-based Continuous Quality Improvement (CQI) activities (data collection, CQI teams, incident reporting, customer complaint reporting, medication error reporting etc.).
  • Participates in ongoing educational activities.
  • Maintains mandatory educational requirements.
  • Performs additional duties when required.

Unit Specific:

  • Performs nursing interventions/procedures per established standards of care (Competency List “Green Book”) policy and procedures including but not limited to:
    • Administering Hepatitis B vaccine to neonates.
    • Managing incubators (Giraffe and Isolette) for neonates.
    • Assisting with intubation with direct visualization in neonates.
    • Assisting with lumbar puncture procedures in neonates.
    • Performing dressing changes for Peripherally Inserted Central Line Catheter (PICC) in neonates.

Preceptor’s Responsibilities (when applicable):

  • Completes the Preceptor workshop and meets the criteria indicators for the preceptor role on the unit. 
  • Plans, implements and evaluates the individualized competency-based orientation in collaboration with the orientee, nurse manager, and clinical resource nurse.
  • Provides appropriate feedback on time to orientee and Nurse Manager. 
  • Provides objective documentation to the nurse manager utilizing the American Hospital Dubai’s established standards of care (Competency List “Green Book and Blue Book”).

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in nursing (minimum of three (3) years full-time course duration) or
  • Degree in Nursing (minimum two (2) years course duration) and Registration as a Registered Nurse from Canada, USA, UK, Ireland, South Africa, New Zealand, and Australia

  • Must hold a valid License/Registration to practice in their home country and/or country of last employment (where applicable)
  • Must hold a minimum of a valid Basic Life Support (BLS) Certification or others according to the scope of practice

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE:

  • Knowledge of and ability to render care and services based on age, appropriateness, and developmental needs of patients.
  • Skills in the assessment of patient and family’s physical and psychological needs.
  • Skills in coordination and planning of care and prioritizing care based on individual needs.

ZenDXB | Jumeirah Lake Towers, Dubai | Full-Time

Medicine is evolving. At ZenDXB, we’re already there.

We’re a premium wellness clinic in the heart of JLT, Dubai, looking for a GP with a genuine interest in functional, longevity and aesthetic medicine to join our growing team. This isn’t a GP role managing chronic disease backlogs. It’s clinical work at the frontier — advanced lab diagnostics, physician-led wellness protocols, sexual and reproductive health, and aesthetic treatments delivered to a standard that matches the rest of the experience.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Conducting in-depth patient consultations focused on optimisation, not just symptom management
  • Delivering aesthetic consultations and injectable treatments — facial assessment, botulinum toxin, dermal fillers, skin boosters, mesotherapy and PRP — within your licensed scope of practice
  • Overseeing and clinically supervising laser and energy-device treatments delivered by our therapy team, including patient assessment, Fitzpatrick typing, parameter sign-off and adverse-event management
  • Designing and overseeing physician-led therapeutic protocols in line with UAE regulatory requirements
  • Prescribing and supervising infusion therapy tailored to patient goals
  • Interpreting comprehensive lab panels and translating results into actionable wellness plans
  • Managing STD and reproductive health cases with discretion and clinical excellence
  • Building an integrated offering where aesthetic outcomes are supported by underlying metabolic and nutritional health

  • Demonstrable interest or training in functional medicine, anti-ageing, or wellness medicine

We’re small enough that your clinical voice matters and large enough to be growing fast. You’ll work with a team that takes quality seriously, in a clinic designed to reflect the premium experience our patients expect — and where you’re encouraged to keep learning.

This is a role for a doctor who wants to practise medicine that transforms how people look and how they function.

Sports Medicine PhysicianLongevity, Performance & Healthy Ageing

Location: Dubai, United Arab Emirates

Employer: Emirates European Medical Centre LLCJoin the Future of Sports Medicine and Longevity

Emirates European Medical Centre (EEMC) is an established healthcare organisation in Dubai with a strong reputation for patient-centred care.

As part of our continued growth, we are launching a new dedicated Longevity Medicine Centre focused on preventive medicine, health optimisation, physical performance and enhancing health-span.

We are seeking an experienced and forward-thinking Sports Medicine Physician to join this exciting new venture.

This is an exceptional opportunity for a physician who believes that maintaining strength, mobility, fitness and physical capacity is fundamental to healthy ageing.

The role will extend beyond the traditional treatment of sports injuries. You will work with active individuals and athletes to prevent injury, optimise physical performance, maintain musculoskeletal health and support lifelong participation in exercise and sport.About the Role

The Sports Medicine Physician will play an important role within our Longevity Centre, providing specialist assessment and management of patients ranging from recreationally active adults to high-performing athletes.

You will assess musculoskeletal health, physical performance, injury risk and exercise capacity, and develop personalised strategies to help patients remain active, strong and physically capable throughout their lives.

The role will also involve close collaboration with the Centre’s physicians and allied health professionals, together with appropriate cross-referral to EEMC’s established multidisciplinary clinic, which provides chiropractic, physiotherapy, Traditional Chinese Medicine and rehabilitation services.Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct comprehensive sports medicine and musculoskeletal assessments.
  • Diagnose and manage acute and chronic sports and exercise-related injuries.
  • Assess injury risk, movement patterns, strength, mobility and physical function.
  • Develop personalised treatment, rehabilitation and injury-prevention programmes.
  • Provide evidence-based exercise and physical activity prescriptions.
  • Support patients returning safely to sport and exercise following injury or surgery.
  • Work with athletes and active individuals to optimise performance while reducing injury risk.
  • Assess and manage common musculoskeletal conditions affecting active adults, including tendinopathies, joint pain, muscle injuries and overuse injuries.
  • Support healthy ageing through the preservation of strength, mobility, balance, cardiovascular fitness and physical capacity.
  • Provide guidance around training load, recovery and appropriate progression of exercise.
  • Collaborate with physiotherapists, chiropractors, exercise professionals, nutrition specialists and other healthcare practitioners as appropriate.
  • Identify patients who may benefit from additional medical investigation, laboratory testing or specialist referral.
  • Monitor patient progress using objective functional and performance measures.
  • Contribute to the development of sports medicine, exercise medicine and performance services within the new Longevity Centre.
  • Maintain accurate clinical records in accordance with Dubai Health Authority (DHA) requirements.

Sports Medicine Within Longevity

We believe that physical capacity is a key component of health-span.

Our aim is not simply to help patients recover from injury, but to help them remain active and physically capable for as long as possible.

The successful candidate will therefore work with patients across a broad age range, including those who want to:

  • Continue playing sport as they get older.
  • Improve strength, fitness and physical performance.
  • Prevent injuries and reduce recurrent injuries.
  • Return to running, cycling, golf, tennis, padel and other sports.
  • Maintain muscle mass and physical function with age.
  • Improve mobility and movement quality.
  • Build resilience and physical capacity.
  • Remain independent and active later in life.

Essential Requirements

  • DHA Licence or Eligibility Letter appropriate to the position.
  • Recognised postgraduate qualification in Sports Medicine, Sports & Exercise Medicine or another relevant specialty, as appropriate to DHA licensing requirements.
  • Minimum five years’ post-qualification clinical experience.
  • Strong clinical knowledge of sports medicine and musculoskeletal conditions.
  • Excellent diagnostic, communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Commitment to evidence-based and patient-centred care.
  • Ability to work collaboratively within a multidisciplinary environment.

Desirable Experience

We would particularly welcome candidates with experience in:

  • Sports and Exercise Medicine
  • Musculoskeletal Medicine
  • Exercise Prescription
  • Injury Prevention
  • Sports Performance
  • Return-to-Sport Rehabilitation
  • Running Medicine
  • Strength and Conditioning
  • Exercise Physiology
  • Healthy Ageing and Health-span
  • Metabolic Health
  • Sports Nutrition
  • Musculoskeletal ultrasound
  • Ultrasound-guided procedures
  • Regenerative medicine and orthobiologics, where appropriately trained and licensed

Experience working with athletes, professional sports organisations, sports clubs or high-performance environments would be advantageous.The Ideal Candidate

We are looking for a physician who:

  • Is passionate about sport, exercise and human performance.
  • Understands the importance of physical activity in preventing disease and maintaining health-span.
  • Enjoys working with both athletes and everyday active individuals.
  • Takes a proactive approach to injury prevention rather than simply treating injuries when they occur.
  • Is interested in the science of healthy ageing and maintaining physical capacity throughout life.
  • Has excellent consultation and patient communication skills.
  • Builds strong, long-term relationships with patients.
  • Is innovative, curious and committed to continuous professional development.
  • Enjoys working within a multidisciplinary team.
  • Is excited by the opportunity to help develop a new model of Sports Medicine within a Longevity Centre.

Why Join Emirates European Medical Centre?

  • Be part of the launch of a new Longevity Medicine Centre in Dubai.
  • Help shape an innovative approach to Sports Medicine that integrates performance with long-term health.
  • Work with motivated patients who are committed to maintaining their health and physical capabilities.
  • Opportunity to develop new sports medicine and exercise medicine programmes.
  • Collaborate with an established multidisciplinary healthcare organisation.
  • Opportunities for appropriate cross-referral with EEMC’s existing chiropractic, physiotherapy and TCM practitioners.
  • Competitive remuneration package.
  • Professional development opportunities.
  • Opportunity to play a significant role in the growth and development of the new Centre.

About Emirates European Medical Centre

Emirates European Medical Centre is an established healthcare organisation in Dubai, committed to delivering high-quality, personalised and patient-centred care.

Building on our years of experience in multidisciplinary healthcare, EEMC is now expanding into Longevity, Functional Medicine and Preventive Healthcare through a new dedicated Centre.

Our vision is to help people not only live longer, but to remain stronger, fitter, more mobile and physically capable for longer.

If you are a Sports Medicine Physician who shares our vision and is excited by the opportunity to help redefine the role of Sports Medicine within modern longevity care, we would love to hear from you.
