The Pediatric Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation Consultant provides specialist assessment, diagnosis, and non-surgical management of infants, children, and adolescents with physical disabilities and functional impairments. The role involves evaluating and treating congenital, developmental, neuromuscular, musculoskeletal, traumatic, and acquired conditions. 

Education/Qualification:

  1. Basic medical degree from recognized institution
  2. Post-qualification certification
    • Qualification Source from: North America, Western Europe, Australia or New Zealand.  
      • USA: American Board of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation (ABPMR), 
      • Canada: Royal College of Physicians and Surgeons of Canada (FRCPC) in Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation.
      • UK and Ireland: CCT/CCST with entry on the GMC Specialist Register (Rehabilitation Medicine).
      • Australia and New Zealand: Fellowship of the Royal Australasian College of Physicians (FRACP) in Rehabilitation Medicine.
      • Western Europe: Equivalent specialist certification in Physical and Rehabilitation Medicine (PRM) recognized by the relevant national authority.

Experience:

  • Minimum of two (2) years of experience post-board/equivalent certification in Austria, Australia, Canada, Finland, France, Germany, Iceland, Ireland (CCST), United Kingdom (CCT) Luxembourg, Netherlands, New Zealand, Norway, Sweden OR  Switzerland,
  • Sub-Specialties: Minimum of two (2) years of experience post-sub-specialty certification in Austria, Australia, Canada, Finland, France, Germany, Iceland, Ireland, Luxembourg, Netherlands, New Zealand, Norway, Sweden, Switzerland, or the UK.
  • Minimum of five (5) years of experience after obtaining the main specialty qualification in United Kingdom (CESR) Portugal, Spain, or Italy.
  • Sub-Specialties: Minimum of four (4) years of experience after obtaining the sub-specialty qualification in Portugal, Spain, or Italy.

License:

  • Current and in a Good Standing Medical License to practice in country of residence.

Job Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Provide consultant-level assessment, diagnosis, and evidence-based management of infants, children, and adolescents with congenital, developmental, neurological, neuromuscular, musculoskeletal, and acquired disabilities.
  • Develop individualized rehabilitation plans to improve functional independence, mobility, participation, and quality of life.
  • Lead multidisciplinary rehabilitation programs in collaboration with physiotherapists, occupational therapists, speech and language therapists, psychologists, nurses, orthotists, prosthetists, and other healthcare professionals.
  • Evaluate and manage pediatric conditions including cerebral palsy, spina bifida, muscular dystrophy, traumatic brain injury, spinal cord injury, developmental delay, genetic disorders, and other complex rehabilitation needs.
  • Perform and supervise rehabilitation procedures, including spasticity assessment and management, botulinum toxin injections where appropriate, orthotic and assistive device recommendations, and functional mobility assessments.
  • Monitor patient progress through regular follow-up and modify treatment plans based on clinical outcomes and functional goals.
  • Conduct inpatient consultations, outpatient clinics, and multidisciplinary ward rounds while maintaining continuity of care.
  • Accept referrals from emergency medicine, primary care, pediatric subspecialties, and external healthcare facilities, providing timely specialist consultation.
  • Supervise, mentor, and support specialists, residents, fellows, and junior medical staff, maintaining responsibility for the quality of care delivered.
  • Participate in multidisciplinary case conferences, clinical governance activities, peer review, quality improvement initiatives, and clinical audits.
  • Maintain accurate, timely, and comprehensive medical documentation in accordance with Department of Health Abu Dhabi (DOH) regulations and hospital policies.
  • Obtain informed consent and communicate diagnoses, treatment plans, rehabilitation goals, and long-term care plans with patients and their families.
  • Participate in the consultant on-call rota and provide emergency consultation as required.
  • Support departmental education, research, continuing medical education (CME), and professional development activities.
  • Comply with all SEHA, DOH Abu Dhabi, and hospital policies related to patient safety, infection prevention, quality standards, and ethical clinical practice.

The Consultant in Fetal Medicine provides assessment, diagnosis, and management of fetal conditions and high-risk pregnancies.

Education/Qualification:

Qualification Source from: North America, Western Europe, Australia or New Zealand.

  • Basic medical degree from recognized institution
  • Post-qualification certification 
    • USA: American Board of Obstetrics and Gynecology (ABOG)
    • Canada: Royal College of Physicians and Surgeons Certificate in Obstetrics and Gynecology (FRCSC)
    • UK and Ireland: GMC/CCST Specialist Register in Obstetrics and Gynecology
    • Australia and New Zealand: Fellowship from the Royal College in in Obstetrics and Gynecology (FRACP)

Experience:

      • Minimum of two (2) years of experience post-board/equivalent certification in Austria, Australia, Canada, Finland, France, Germany, Iceland, Ireland (CCST), United Kingdom (CCT) Luxembourg, Netherlands, New Zealand, Norway, Sweden OR  Switzerland,
        • Sub-Specialties: Minimum of two (2) years of experience post-sub-specialty certification in Austria, Australia, Canada, Finland, France, Germany, Iceland, Ireland, Luxembourg, Netherlands, New Zealand, Norway, Sweden, Switzerland, or the UK.

License:

  • Current and in a Good Standing Medical License to practice in country of residence.

Job Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Provide expert assessment, diagnosis, and management of pregnancies complicated by fetal abnormalities, genetic conditions, multiple pregnancies, fetal growth disorders, and maternal medical conditions affecting pregnancy.
  • Perform and interpret advanced fetal ultrasound examinations, including detailed anatomical scans, fetal echocardiography (where appropriately trained), Doppler studies, and assessment of fetal growth and well-being.
  • Conduct prenatal diagnostic procedures as appropriate, including amniocentesis, chorionic villus sampling (CVS), and other fetal investigations.
  • Develop individualized care plans and provide ongoing surveillance for high-risk pregnancies throughout the antenatal period.
  • Provide preconception and prenatal counseling regarding fetal abnormalities, genetic risks, pregnancy complications, treatment options, prognosis, and expected outcomes.
  • Work closely with obstetricians, neonatologists, pediatric subspecialists, genetic counselors, radiologists, anesthesiologists, and other healthcare professionals to deliver coordinated multidisciplinary care.
  • Lead specialized fetal medicine clinics, review referrals, and provide expert consultation for complex maternal and fetal cases.
  • Participate in multidisciplinary fetal meetings to discuss diagnosis, management strategies, delivery planning, and neonatal care requirements.
  • Perform or support fetal therapeutic interventions and procedures where indicated and within the consultant’s scope of practice.
  • Monitor maternal and fetal outcomes and modify management plans according to clinical progress and evolving diagnostic findings.
  • Communicate sensitively with patients and families regarding diagnoses, risks, treatment options, and potential outcomes.
  • Supervise and provide clinical guidance to junior doctors, residents, fellows, sonographers, and medical students.
  • Participate in clinical teaching, case discussions, training activities, and mentorship programs.
  • Contribute to the development of fetal medicine protocols, clinical pathways, quality improvement initiatives, and service development programs.
  • Maintain accurate, timely, and comprehensive clinical documentation in accordance with hospital policies and regulatory standards.
  • Comply with patient safety requirements, informed consent policies, infection prevention measures, and accreditation standards.
  • Participate in clinical audits, research activities, morbidity and mortality reviews, and continuous professional development to advance fetal medicine services.

The Pediatric ENT Consultant provides specialist diagnosis, medical and surgical management of disorders affecting the ear, nose, throat, head, and neck in infants, children, and adolescents. The role involves managing congenital, developmental, infectious, inflammatory, traumatic, and neoplastic conditions while addressing the unique anatomical and physiological needs of pediatric patients.

Education/Qualification:

  1. Basic medical degree from recognized institution
  2. Post-qualification certification
    • Qualification Source from: North America, Western Europe, Australia or New Zealand.  
      • USA: The American Board of Otolaryngology – Head and Neck Surgery (ABOHNS)
      • Canada: Royal College of Physicians and Surgeons Certificate (FRCPC -in  Otolaryngology – Head and Neck Surgery)
      • UK and Ireland: CCT/CCST Specialist Register – (Otolaryngology – Head and Neck Surgery)
      • Australia and New Zealand: Fellowship of the Royal Australasian College of Surgeons (FRACS) in Otolaryngology – Head and Neck Surgery
      • Western Europe: Equivalent certification to the above

Experience:

  • Minimum of two (2) years of experience post-board/equivalent certification in Austria, Australia, Canada, Finland, France, Germany, Iceland, Ireland (CCST), United Kingdom (CCT) Luxembourg, Netherlands, New Zealand, Norway, Sweden OR  Switzerland,
  • Sub-Specialties: Minimum of two (2) years of experience post-sub-specialty certification in Austria, Australia, Canada, Finland, France, Germany, Iceland, Ireland, Luxembourg, Netherlands, New Zealand, Norway, Sweden, Switzerland, or the UK.

License:

  • Current and in a Good Standing Medical License to practice in country of residence.

Job Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Assess, diagnose, and manage congenital, developmental, infectious, inflammatory, and acquired disorders of the ear, nose, throat, and head and neck in infants, children, and adolescents
  • Perform comprehensive ENT examinations and interpret diagnostic investigations, including audiological tests, endoscopy, imaging studies, and sleep studies when indicated
  • Perform pediatric ENT surgical procedures including tonsillectomy, adenoidectomy, tympanostomy tube insertion, airway procedures, and management of congenital head and neck abnormalities
  • Manage pediatric hearing loss, recurrent ear infections, chronic sinus disease, nasal obstruction, voice disorders, swallowing difficulties, and airway disorders
  • Evaluate and manage complex pediatric airway conditions, including laryngomalacia, subglottic stenosis, and tracheal abnormalities
  • Diagnose and treat head and neck masses, congenital cysts, salivary gland disorders, and pediatric tumors in collaboration with oncology and surgical teams
  • Provide emergency ENT care for conditions such as airway obstruction, severe infections, trauma, and foreign body removal
  • Develop individualized treatment plans including medical management, surgical intervention, hearing rehabilitation, and long-term follow-up
  • Provide preoperative assessment, perioperative management, and postoperative care
  • Collaborate with pediatricians, pulmonologists, anesthesiologists, speech and language therapists, audiologists, radiologists, and other specialists in multidisciplinary care
  • Maintain accurate clinical documentation, operative reports, and patient records
  • Participate in clinical audits, quality improvement initiatives, research, and development of pediatric ENT protocols
  • Supervise and train residents, fellows, and junior medical staff
  • Ensure compliance with hospital policies, patient safety standards, and infection prevention protocols

Company Description SEHA Fertility Care is a specialized fertility center operating within the SEHA health system in Abu Dhabi, delivering advanced assisted reproductive services to diverse patient populations. The center focuses on evidence-based clinical practices, high-quality laboratory standards, and patient-centered care to support individuals and families seeking fertility treatment. Multidisciplinary teams of reproductive medicine specialists, embryologists, and nursing professionals collaborate to provide comprehensive diagnostic and treatment pathways. SEHA Fertility Care emphasizes continuous improvement, adherence to international guidelines, and the use of modern reproductive technologies to achieve safe, effective outcomes.

Role Description The Senior Clinical Embryologist is a full-time, on-site role based in Abu Dhabi, responsible for overseeing and performing advanced clinical and laboratory procedures within the fertility laboratory. Day-to-day tasks include handling and preparing gametes, performing IVF and ICSI procedures, monitoring embryo development, coordinating cryopreservation, and ensuring accurate documentation of all laboratory activities. The role involves maintaining and optimizing laboratory equipment, enforcing quality control and assurance protocols, and supporting compliance with regulatory and accreditation standards. The Senior Clinical Embryologist will collaborate closely with reproductive medicine physicians and nursing staff, participate in case discussions, contribute to treatment planning, and provide guidance to junior embryology and laboratory team members. The position also includes participation in continuous professional development, implementation of new techniques, and support for patient education initiatives related to embryology and fertility treatment.

Qualifications

  • Candidates should possess strong Laboratory Skills, including handling biological specimens, operating specialized equipment, and adhering to strict quality and safety standards.
  • Candidates should possess expertise in In Vitro Fertilization (IVF) and Assisted Reproduction techniques, including ICSI, embryo culture, cryopreservation, and related clinical embryology procedures.
  • Candidates should possess a solid foundation in Medicine and reproductive physiology sufficient to collaborate effectively with clinical teams and understand treatment protocols.
  • Candidates should possess proficiency in Andrology, including semen analysis, preparation, and processing for assisted reproductive procedures.
  • Relevant academic qualifications such as a master’s degree or higher in Clinical Embryology, Biomedical Sciences, or a related discipline; certification or registration in embryology where applicable is preferred.
  • Several years of proven experience in a fertility or IVF laboratory, with responsibility for complex cases and advanced procedures at a senior or supervisory level.
  • Strong attention to detail, data management skills, and familiarity with laboratory information systems, along with the ability to follow international and local regulatory standards.
  • Effective communication and teamwork skills, the ability to train and mentor junior staff, and a commitment to ethical, patient-focused care.

The Pharmaceutical Purchasing Officer manages the end-to-end procurement process for pharmaceuticals, medications, and clinical supplies within the hospital. This role ensures timely sourcing from approved vendors, strict adherence to quality and SFDA regulatory standards, cost negotiation, and uninterrupted availability of critical medications for patient care.

  • SFDA & Regulatory Compliance: Verify that all sourced medications, active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), and suppliers comply with Saudi Food and Drug Authority (SFDA) regulations, registration status, and hospital formulary guidelines.
  • Emergency & Critical Sourcing: Handle urgent procurement requests for non-formulary, life-saving, or out-of-stock (OOS) medications through alternative licensed channels or local emergency transfers.
  • Discrepancy Resolution: Coordinate with receiving, warehouse, and finance teams to resolve price variances, quantity discrepancies, batch failures, or damaged shipments.
  • Market Monitoring: Track drug shortages, price changes, regulatory updates, and market availability trends to mitigate supply chain disruptions proactively.
  • Record Keeping & Reporting: Maintain complete purchasing documentation, contract files, and supplier performance metrics for internal audit and accreditation checks.

o    Performance improvement and patient safety (PIPS) program
o    Alignment with industry best practices and recommendation for process improvements
o    Clinical care guidelines
o    Research collaboration
o    Local, regional, and national involvement of trauma system development
•    Supports Research Coordinator to enable the program research.

Essential Responsibilities
•    Performance Improvement – Participates in Quality Management and Performance Improvement activities: Identifies patient care, system, and/or process issues and trends; Assists with chart reviews, data collection and preparation for case presentations.
o    Works with the Trauma Medical Director, Trauma Program Manager and all other departments in the investigation and resolution of issues, and performance improvement activities related to Trauma care delivery.
•    Monitors, reviews, and reports extracted from the trauma registry and all other relevant reports
•    Assists in the development/revision of administrative policies and clinical nursing guidelines/standards of care for program patients in collaboration with appropriate disciplines.
•    Participates in Departmental meetings, and attends conventions, conferences, workshops, and other professional meetings to extend learning and to represent SSMC Center.
•    Update the Trauma performance improvement plan (PIPS) annually

Program Leadership
• Develops and maintains an adult trauma Performance Improvement and Patient Safety program. 
• Serve as Technical expert in the program development. 
• Provide guidance to all employees involved in program. 
• Provide performance feedback on program employees to applicable managers. 
• Evaluate and report to departmental/organizational senior management on status and changes in program.

Service Delivery 
• Participate in case review, track PIPS reviews and action plans, design and implement practice guidelines. 
• Role models service excellence in interactions with internal and external constituents. 
• Establishes a strong cooperative relationship with applicable leaders by providing the information, tools and services necessary to improve the outcomes associated with the program.

Communication
•    Designs and orchestrates the delivery of applicable communication to internal and external constituents. 
•    Demonstrates excellent oral and written communication using a variety of methodologies. 
•    Coordinates presentations and ensures consistent communication related to the program. 
•    Participates in the review of program processes. 
•    Recommends and participates in implementation of process improvements. Monitors and measures process changes.
•    Facilitates cross-functional performance improvement teams.

Administrative Role
•    Participate in various hospital processes
o    Quality
o    Research
o    Leadership
o    Focus on program goals and patient satisfaction
o    Facilitate development and execution of PIPS program

Resource Management 
•    Work with other relevant program operations managers to design the trauma registry to facilitate performance improvement activities, trend reports, and research while protecting confidentiality.  

Strategic Planning 
•    Works collaboratively with appropriate stakeholders to develop the strategic plan for the trauma program both internally and externally.  

Research 
•    Collaborates with other appropriate departments & entities (internal & external) for all research opportunities relating to the trauma program,

Miscellaneous 
•    Responsible for other miscellaneous duties as assigned. 

ALL DUTIES AND REQUIREMENTS MUST BE PERFORMED CONSISTENT WITH THE SSMC HEALTH PERFORMANCE STANDARDS.

Accountabilities
•    Performance Improvement  – identification, action plans, resolution and documentation of the process
 

Qualifications

Required:
•    Clinical Bachelor’s Degree (preferably BSN or medical/para-medical degree)
•    Current national professional license or equivalent
•    Certified proof of yearly CME

Desired:
•    Trauma Outcomes Performance Improvement Course completion (if not, within 6 months of starting the role)
•    Trauma Program Manager Course Completion (optional)
•    Recognized Registrar Certification CAIS or CSTR (optional)
•    Injury Scaling Certification (current edition AIS15) (optional)
•    ICD Coding Certification (optional)
•    Quality Management Certification (optional)
•    TNCC or ATCN Certification (optional)
•    BLS, ACLS & PALS/ENPC Certification
 

Experience:
Required:
•    Two (2) years of pediatric trauma care experience or general pediatric nursing
Desired:

The clinic provides comprehensive, evidence-based assessment and intervention services tailored to each client’s unique needs.   • Ability to collaborate effectively within a multidisciplinary team and communicate professionally with clients, families, and colleagues.

Role Purpose: 

The Manager of Performance Medicine will spearhead the development and delivery of world-class, integrated medical and performance therapy services, encompassing disciplines across track and field. This pivotal role is tasked with enabling athletes to achieve peak performance through a holistic, evidence-based approach focused on athlete health, injury prevention, rehabilitation, and performance optimization.

Serving as a key leader, this position will foster innovation, collaboration, and excellence within interdisciplinary teams — including sports physicians, physiotherapists, strength & conditioning coaches, sports scientists, and coaches — to build a sustainable, high-performance environment.

The role requires strategic oversight of medical care tailored to elite athletes’ unique needs, leadership in clinical governance, and the implementation of cutting-edge methodologies to maximize physical and competitive outcomes.

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES & ACTIVITIES:

Strategic Leadership & Vision:

  • Develop and implement a strategic roadmap for performance medicine emphasizing sustainable athlete health and peak performance.
  • Serve as the authoritative medical and performance lead for the athletics team, shaping medical policies and protocols that reflect best practices and innovation.
  • Lead initiatives to integrate emerging research and technologies into performance medicine to maintain Qatar’s competitive edge in athletics.
  • Drive long-term capacity building of the sports medicine program, including talent development, team expansion, and resource allocation.

Clinical and Performance Oversight:

  • Manage comprehensive athlete health programs, including injury surveillance, prevention, diagnostics, rehabilitation, and return-to-play processes tailored to athletics disciplines.
  • Oversee pre-participation medical screening, continuous health monitoring, and customized care planning.
  • Lead clinical management of complex medical cases, coordinating with specialists and external providers to optimize athlete recovery and longevity.
  • Utilize data-driven approaches to monitor training load, recovery, and injury risk in partnership with coaches and sports scientists.
  • Implement and advance evidence-based protocols for performance testing, biomechanical analysis, and movement screenings.
  • Provide pitch-side and training-ground medical coverage as required.
  • Oversee and coordinate return-to-play protocols in close collaboration with coaches, physiotherapists and strength & conditioning specialists.
  • Ensure early detection and management of conditions that may affect performance, including overtraining, fatigue, and nutritional deficiencies.
  • Apply physiological, metabolic, and recovery principles to support peak performance.
  • Lead initiatives on athlete health optimization, such as sleep hygiene, hydration, and immune support programs.
  • Participate in inter multidisciplinary case reviews to align medical, physical, and psychological strategies for each athlete.
  • Adhere to and actively promote the World Anti-Doping Agency (WADA) principles and regulations with regard to the use of drugs in sport. Abide by the spirit and letter of the WADA Code, and the ASPETAR/NSMP Anti-Doping Position Statement.

Performance Optimization:

  • Drive the use of integrated medical and performance data to enhance athlete development and peak performance and practices to support success at major competitions.
  • Collaborate closely with coaches and sport scientists on training load monitoring, recovery strategies, assessments, and injury prevention initiatives.
  • Lead the implementation of evidence-based performance testing and movement screening protocols.

Team and Program Management:

  • Establish and assist in recruiting a multidisciplinary team of appropriately experienced and well qualified practitioners that will support to drive ‘World Best’ technical standards and performance direction.
  • Provide leadership and expertise supporting sports medical practitioners in their development. Actively driving the department to be better every day.
  • Ensure appropriate engagement with and maintenance of medical records, documentation and the secure athlete management system across the entire team.
  • Establish medical policies that encompass best practice operational processes.
  • Lead patient safety initiatives, ensuring annual completion of organizational competencies and compliance with Aspetar Orthopaedic and Sports Medicine Hospital protocols.
  • Assume or accept any other responsibilities as assigned by the direct supervisor within the position role and responsibility.
  • Patient Safety: -Attend and successfully complete competencies which focus on patient safety initiatives implemented within Aspetar Orthopaedic and Sports Medicine Hospital. Patient Safety Training is an annual requirement, to include all organizational leaders, staff, service, and contracted providers.

Governance and Collaboration:

  • Develop and implement medical governance frameworks to ensure a safe environment for athletes during training and competition, in partnership with relevant stakeholders, in partnership with the Lead Doctor.
  • Lead education, support, and adherence to anti-doping policies and regulations.
  • Manage staff, external contractors, and quality assurance processes related to service provision.
  • Work alongside the Head Coach and Head of Performance Support to foster an interdisciplinary high-performance environment focused on sustainable athlete success.

Necessary knowledge and Experience to be able to do the job:

  • Minimum of 12 to 15 years of professional related experience, including 4 to 7 years in a similar role or responsibility, preferably within the same industry.
  • Desirable:
  • Additional certifications in Strength & Conditioning, Sports Science, or Performance Analysis.
  • Experience working with national teams, Olympic programs, or professional sports organizations.
  • Familiarity with electronic medical records (EMR) and performance management systems 
  • Experience with national or international sporting federations or major games (e.g., Olympics, Asian Games).
  • Must meet and fulfil the eligibility criteria for medical licensing in Qatar.

Knowledge Requirements:

  • Create an engaging and supportive learning environment by encouraging ongoing professional growth through training and mentorship. Support and contribute to research in sports medicine and performance science relevant to Athletics. Provide educational sessions and resources for athletes and coaches to enhance knowledge on health, recovery, and injury prevention
  • Extensive experience in elite sport medical roles aligned with high-performance environments.
  • Demonstrated leadership in managing large multidisciplinary medical teams and relevant staff.
  • Skilled in managing and communicating with diverse stakeholder groups within complex organizational systems.
  • Proficient in understanding individual personal styles and employing influence strategies to motivate team members towards shared goals.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of Track and Field Athletics’ structure, sports medicine, and anti-doping systems.
  • Insight into athlete development pathways and performance drivers across various Athletics disciplines.
  • In-depth knowledge of sports medicine, injury prevention, treatment protocols, and performance optimization.
  • Proven track record in knowledge transfer and development of people and systems to enhance organizational capacity.
  • Experienced in developing strategic visions and communicating them to inspire engagement and drive higher performance levels.
  • Committed to building a high-performance culture that prioritizes athlete wellbeing as a foundation for sustained success in high-performance sport.

Education and Certification requirements:

  • Preferrable Licensed Medical Doctor (MD) specialized in Sports Medicine.
  • Professional with a degree in a related medical field and demonstrated experience in sports and athletic performance “Track and field”
  • Strong knowledge of exercise science, sports nutrition, and athletic performance optimization, with proven experience working specifically in Athletics to enhance performance, prevent injuries, and support rehabilitation and recovery.
  • Deep expertise in performance medicine, specific to Athletics (track & field).
  • Proven experience managing multidisciplinary medical teams.

Company Description Mai Nasr Pharmacy is a distinctive pharmacy in Egypt, created from the founder’s journey from struggling with ineffective beauty products to working as a Pharmacist for leading global medical cosmetics companies. The pharmacy offers a complete care experience by combining trusted medicines with carefully selected, exclusive beauty products. Supported by Matrix, its own import company, Mai Nasr Pharmacy ensures continuous availability of luxury cosmetics and essential medications. The environment is designed for both everyday health needs and beauty discovery, appealing to customers seeking quality, reliability, and innovation.

  • Commitment to ethical practice, confidentiality, and compliance with Egyptian pharmacy laws and professional standards.

An Anesthesia Technician supports anesthesiologists and the perioperative team in delivering safe and effective anesthesia care. They are responsible for preparing, maintaining, and troubleshooting anesthesia equipment, monitoring devices, and supplies required for surgical and diagnostic procedures. Working in operating rooms, procedure suites, and critical care settings, Anesthesia Technicians help ensure patient safety by maintaining equipment readiness, adhering to infection control standards, and assisting with anesthesia-related procedures before, during, and after patient care.

Responsibilities

  • Prepare and check anesthesia machines, monitors, and related equipment before procedures.
  • Ensure all anesthesia supplies, medications, airway devices, and emergency equipment are available and functional.
  • Assist anesthesiologists during the induction, maintenance, and emergence phases of anesthesia.
  • Set up and maintain patient monitoring equipment, including ECG, pulse oximetry, blood pressure, and capnography monitors.
  • Assist with airway management procedures, including preparation of intubation equipment.
  • Prepare intravenous lines, infusion pumps, and specialized anesthesia equipment as required.
  • Perform routine maintenance, troubleshooting, and calibration of anesthesia equipment.
  • Ensure compliance with infection prevention and control standards for all anesthesia-related equipment and supplies.
  • Clean, disinfect, and restock anesthesia workstations and procedure rooms after each case.
  • Assist in responding to emergency situations, including code blue and difficult airway scenarios.
  • Monitor inventory levels and coordinate the procurement of anesthesia supplies and consumables.
  • Maintain accurate records of equipment checks, maintenance activities, and inventory.
  • Support patient transportation when required, ensuring appropriate monitoring and equipment availability.
  • Collaborate with anesthesiologists, surgeons, nurses, and other healthcare professionals to ensure safe patient care.
  • Assist with invasive monitoring procedures and specialized anesthesia techniques as directed by the anesthesiologist.
  • Ensure adherence to hospital policies, safety regulations, and quality standards.
  • Participate in quality improvement initiatives, staff education, and continuing professional development activities.
  • Maintain patient confidentiality and uphold professional and ethical standards at all times.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Anesthesia Technology.
  • Valid professional license- DOH, DHA, or MOH

About the job

Company Description LLSC (Language & Listening Stimulation Center) is a specialized medical center providing rehabilitation, guidance, and consulting services for children and adults facing challenges in communication, language, and behavior. Founded in 2011 in Saudi Arabia by auditory-verbal specialist Rana Mirza and partner Ratiba Sernivan, the center works in strategic partnership with international experts. LLSC is the first center in the Kingdom to implement a “Journey Sharing” program with families, emphasizing close collaboration and family involvement in care. The center offers a wide range of services, including speech improvement, fluency (stuttering) therapy, voice disorder treatment, language delay intervention, auditory-verbal rehabilitation, learning difficulty support, behavior modification, psychological services, attention and intelligence assessments, and early skills preparation programs.
Role Description The Occupational Therapist will work full time on-site at LLSC in Jeddah, providing assessment and treatment for children and adults with challenges in communication, language, behavior, and related developmental areas. Daily responsibilities include conducting occupational therapy evaluations, developing individualized treatment plans, and delivering evidence-based interventions focused on sensory integration, fine and gross motor skills, daily living skills, and school readiness. The role involves collaborating closely with speech therapists, psychologists, educators, and families to support integrated care and to align therapy goals with the center’s programs. The Occupational Therapist will document progress, prepare reports, participate in case conferences, and contribute to parent education and training sessions. The position requires maintaining ethical, culturally sensitive practice and staying current with best practices in pediatric and adult rehabilitation.
Qualifications

  • Demonstrated proficiency in Occupational Therapy, including assessment, treatment planning, and intervention across pediatric and adult populations.
  • Solid foundation in Rehabilitation principles and an understanding of related Medicine concepts relevant to multidisciplinary care.
  • Strong Communication skills for working with clients, families, and a diverse clinical team, including providing clear education and counseling.
  • Experience or strong interest in Pediatrics, especially in developmental delays, learning difficulties, behavioral challenges, and sensory processing issues.
  • Recognized degree in Occupational Therapy (or equivalent), with current professional licensure or eligibility to practice in Saudi Arabia.
  • Experience in clinical or educational settings, preferably in speech, language, developmental, or behavioral services.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a multidisciplinary team and to adapt interventions to cultural and family contexts.
  • Strong organizational and documentation skills, with basic proficiency in digital health records and reporting.
  • Commitment to continuous learning, evidence-based practice, and participation in professional development activities.

Role Purpose

Within the limits of his/her delineated clinical privileges, to manage patients for whom he/she is responsible for providing the highest level of clinical care and expertise in pre-operative assessment including pre-Anesthesia consultations and visits, Anesthesia management of intra-operative and post-operative care, under supervision of consultant in full compliance to Dallah Hospital Medical Staff Bylaws, Rules and Regulations.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  1. Takes full responsibility for monitoring and care of patients (that is compassionate, appropriate & effective) attending his/her allocated Anesthesia Clinics for preoperative assessment.
  2. General Anesthesia for major, moderate and minor surgeries for adults and children.
  3. Provides consultation and administer anesthesia with the full range of Anesthesia methods and techniques.
  4. Maintains high-level professional performance according to Hospital standards.
  5. Provides technical advice and guidance to Anesthesia technicians and nursing staff and as required provides orientation / training in new techniques and procedures.
  6. He should supervise the work, performance and efficiency of the work & duties of Anesthesia technicians during his duty hours or on-call.
  7. Interview patients scheduled for surgery to assess and develop an Anesthesia care plan and to establish rapport and allay fear and apprehension.
  8. Sees patients post operatively to evaluate and document recovery from Anesthesia, to assess complications and make recommendations as indicated.
  9. Keeps current with new procedures and techniques in the field of Anesthesia.
  10. Stands on-call duty as assigned by Chief Anesthesia for emergency surgery, obstetrics and/or medical procedures.
  11. To evaluate patients in the Accident and Emergency Room at the request of A/E Room Physicians.
  12. Provides on-call coverage on a rotation basis. When on-call, the specialist must be physically present at all times to respond to the requests of the physicians / nurses to evaluate patients.
  13. Writing clinical notes related to anesthesia in patients’ medical records as per the hospital policy.
  14. Demonstrates interpersonal & communication skills that establish & maintain professional relationships with patients, families, co-workers & other members of healthcare team.
  15. Able to demonstrate both understanding of contexts and systems in which health care is provided and ability to apply this knowledge to improve and optimize health care.
  16. Able to use scientific evidence and methods to investigate, evaluate and improve patient care practices
  17. Demonstrates cost-conscious care including avoiding the overuse and misuse of diagnostic tests and treatment.
  18. Demonstrates commitment to continuous professional development, ethical practice, understanding & sensitivity to diversity & responsible attitude towards other staff and patients
  19. Develops and co-ordinates the Quality Improvement. Program within his/her area of responsibilities.
  20. Participate in patient and family education to help patients and families to better understand and participate in their care and make well informed care decisions.
  21. Performs any other duties within the range of his/her professional knowledge and skills as directed by the Head of Anesthesia or the Chief of Medical Staff.

This is a Medical Oncology physician position and is responsible for applying medical knowledge and skills to the diagnosis, prevention, and treatment of illnesses for patients within the Cancer Institute – Breast Medical Oncology specialty at CCAD. This position is a physician that primarily treats breast cancer patients and helps develop, and coordinate associated programs.

Primary Duties and Responsibilities

  • Monitor and deliver comprehensive care to patients at CCAD within the Cancer Institute, with a focus on Oncology and Hematology.
  • Prescribe and administer specialized medical care, including chemotherapy, immunotherapy, and targeted therapy, to effectively treat and prevent breast cancer and other malignancies.
  • Analyze patient records, reports, and test results with precision to diagnose and tailor individualized treatment plans.
  • Engage with patients to gather additional history and information, ensuring a holistic understanding of their medical condition.
  • Clearly communicate procedures, discuss test results, and explain prescribed treatments with empathy and expertise.
  • Develop and participate in the clinical trials in breast cancer.
  • Provide specific treatments and conduct operations as needed to address patient medical conditions.
  • Evaluate patient progress and meticulously record relevant notes for comprehensive treatment records and potential referrals to fellow healthcare team members.
  • Liaise with other medical and non-medical staff at CCAD to ensure the highest quality of patient treatment.
  • Deliver care in a culturally appropriate and sensitive manner, recognizing the diverse needs of our patient community.
  • Uphold the highest ethical and regulatory standards in medical practice.
  • Adhere rigorously to individual approved clinical privileges and uphold all policies and procedures of the Medical Staff at CCAD

Experience Requirements

  • For Physicians from Tier 1 countries, not less than two (2) years additional experience post qualification
  • For Physicians from Tier 2 countries, not less than five (5) years additional experience post qualification
  • Must hold a valid License/ Registration to practice in their home country and/or country of last employment (where applicable)
  • Should meet the Maintenance of Certification requirements (where applicable)
  • Demonstrated ability to effectively manage a team of health care professionals
  • Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with patients and staff
  • Ability to speak and write in English is required
  • Ability to speak and write in both English and Arabic is preferred

Education Requirements

  • MD, MBBS, MBChB or DO (only if the specialization is obtained from one of the following: American Board of Medical Specialties or Certificates of Specializations of the Royal College of Physicians and Surgeons of Canada) or equivalent qualification from an accredited Institution and completion of specialty qualification as per the Recognized Specialty Certificate table listed in Healthcare Professionals Qualification Requirements 2024.

About Us

Cleveland Clinic Abu Dhabi is a multispecialty hospital on Al Maryah Island in Abu Dhabi, UAE.

Cleveland Clinic Abu Dhabi combines its patient-centered model of care with state-of-the-art amenities and world-class clinical practices to deliver exceptional medical care that has redefined the healthcare landscape in the region.

Cleveland Clinic Abu Dhabi’s commitment to excellence has earned global recognition. For the second consecutive term, the hospital achieved the Magnet® designation for nursing and patient care, reaffirming its dedication to compassionate care. The Ministry of Health and Prevention (MoHAP) named Cleveland Clinic Abu Dhabi the UAE’s top research hospital for the second consecutive year in 2024. The hospital was also ranked top UAE hospital on Newsweek’s World’s Best Hospitals from 2022 to 2025, and World’s Best Smart Hospitals from 2022 to 2026, demonstrating its ongoing commitment to bringing world-class care to the region and redefining healthcare delivery.

The purpose of the Senior Patient Safety & Quality Officer position is to support the Patient Safety & Quality team in the day-to-day management and execution of safety and quality initiatives within the organization. This role involves monitoring and evaluating patient safety events, conducting data analysis, and assisting in the implementation of quality improvement projects. The Senior Executive works closely with PSQ Manager/Assistant Manager and healthcare teams to identify areas for improvement, track progress, and ensure adherence to safety protocols and regulatory requirements. By providing operational support and ensuring the effective execution of safety programs, the Patient Safety & Quality Senior Executive plays a key role in promoting a culture of safety, enhancing the quality of care, and ensuring positive patient outcomes

Responsibilities

  • Performs highly responsible office functions; assists in arranging and coordinating department activities.
  • Establishes and maintains records, filing systems, and logs;
  • Reserve meeting sites; contacts and confirms appointments and meetings; attends meetings and takes minutes in the absence of the Patient Safety & Quality Executives.
  • Operates a computer, duplicating machine, fax machine, calculator, and other peripheral office equipment in the course of assigned functions
  • Utilizes a variety of word-processing, graphic/presentation, and data base software applications programs
  • Types, edits, and distributes a variety of correspondence, forms, and policies and procedures
  • Participating effectively in implementing & follow up of PSQ improvement activities.
  • Communicates appropriate information from studies and data sources to the Heads of the Department
  • Assist the HOD in maintaining all necessary records pertinent to the JCI process or any other relevant accreditation and regulatory requirement process.
  • Assist in facilitating relevant accreditation meetings.
  • Assist the HOD in maintaining records of policies, procedures, guidelines, forms and other documents and ensures the circulation of current documents and the de- circulation of expired documents.
  • Performs miscellaneous related duties as requested by the HOD.
  • Be familiar with emergency and evacuation procedures
  • Attend applicable OSH/Infection control training programs, mock drills and awareness programs
  • To develop, monitor and support implementation of the hospital/ cluster OSHMS in line with DHA/MOH/MOHAP/DOH Health Sector OSHMS policies and standards (and other policies and standards as applicable) and entity requirements.
  • Notifying and optimizing the reporting of OSH Hazards, other incidents, Near misses and issues and assistance with the preparation of risk assessments
  • Coordinate Risk management program of the facility in coordination with all stakeholders
  • Support to develop objectives and monitor achievement of objectives and compliance with DHA/MOH/MOHAP/DOH Health Sector OSHMS requirements across all departments.
  • To report and provide guidance to the entity OSH Committee, the Prevention and Control of Infection and the CQPS Committee in developing programs and policies for implementing and monitoring applicable OSHMS and Infection Control and Patient Safety standards.
  • To conduct or participate in incident and outbreak investigations as applicable.
  • Help and assist in relevant regulatory body KPIs including but not limited to JAWDA KPIs, DHA KPIs, audits, accreditations, certifications and preparing reports.
  • Help to support data collection throughout the hospital/cluster by assisting with data collection issues such as creating forms to collect data, identifying which data to collect, how to validate data, and creating reports.
  • Ensures data reported is validated and analyzed for implementing improvements and evaluating if the improvements were sustained.

Qualifications

  • Graduate of a Secretarial Course or its equivalent
  • Six months or more in healthcare set up
  • Excellent command of oral and written English. Arabic language is desirable but not essential.
  • Responsibility for own continued professional growth beyond minimum preparation.
  • Strong data analysis and reporting skills with proficiency in advanced Excel tools or statistical software

Job Summary

The Consultant Physician – Forensic Medicine holds a senior leadership position responsible for delivering comprehensive medico-legal and forensic medical services within SEHA Mortuary Services. The post holder provides expert forensic consultations, conducts medico-legal investigations and post-mortem examinations, determines causes and manners of death, and supports legal and judicial authorities through evidence-based medical opinions and expert testimony.

The consultant is responsible for maintaining the highest standards of clinical excellence, forensic practice, patient and public safety, clinical governance, and regulatory compliance. The role includes leadership of multidisciplinary teams, supervision of junior medical staff, participation in quality improvement initiatives, and contribution to education, research, and service development in accordance with Department of Health (DOH) regulations, UAE laws, and SEHA policies.

Key Responsibilities

Clinical and Forensic Services

  • Lead and perform medico-legal death investigations, forensic examinations, and post-mortem assessments.
  • Determine the cause, mechanism, and manner of death using internationally accepted forensic methodologies.
  • Examine cases involving sudden, unexplained, suspicious, accidental, violent, and custodial deaths.
  • Conduct external and internal forensic examinations and autopsies when legally authorized.
  • Collect, preserve, document, and interpret forensic evidence while maintaining strict chain-of-custody requirements.
  • Review clinical records, laboratory data, toxicology reports, radiological findings, and investigative information relevant to forensic cases.
  • Participate in disaster victim identification (DVI), mass casualty incidents, and public health emergency investigations as required.

Clinical Excellence and Patient Care

  • Provide expert forensic medical opinions and consultations to healthcare facilities, law enforcement agencies, and judicial authorities.
  • Ensure all medico-legal assessments are evidence-based, objective, accurate, and completed in a timely manner.
  • Lead forensic case reviews and ensure adherence to ethical and professional standards.
  • Participate in on-call services and provide emergency forensic support when required.

Medico-Legal Reporting

  • Prepare comprehensive medico-legal reports, autopsy reports, expert opinions, and court documentation.
  • Present forensic findings to law enforcement authorities, prosecution services, courts, and regulatory bodies.
  • Serve as an expert witness in legal proceedings and tribunals when required.
  • Maintain accurate, complete, and confidential documentation in compliance with legal and regulatory standards.

Leadership, Supervision, and Training

  • Provide leadership and clinical supervision to specialists, medical practitioners, residents, fellows, forensic technologists, and mortuary personnel.
  • Participate in recruitment, orientation, mentoring, and performance evaluation of staff.
  • Support the education and professional development of junior medical staff through teaching, coaching, and supervision.
  • Promote a culture of continuous learning, excellence, and professional accountability.

Multidisciplinary Collaboration

  • Collaborate closely with law enforcement agencies, public prosecution authorities, emergency services, healthcare providers, and government entities.
  • Participate in multidisciplinary case discussions, mortality reviews, and clinical governance meetings.
  • Foster effective communication and cooperation among stakeholders involved in medico-legal investigations.

Quality Improvement and Governance

  • Ensure compliance with SEHA policies, DOH regulations, UAE laws, and international forensic medicine standards.
  • Participate in clinical audits, peer reviews, accreditation activities, and quality improvement initiatives.
  • Contribute to the development and implementation of departmental policies, procedures, and standard operating protocols.
  • Support risk management activities and promote patient, staff, and public safety.

Research and Academic Activities

  • Participate in forensic medicine research, publications, presentations, and educational programs.
  • Contribute to medical education and continuing professional development activities.
  • Remain up to date with emerging developments in forensic pathology, forensic science, toxicology, and medico-legal practice.

Qualifications and Requirements

Education

  • Medical Degree (MBBS or equivalent) from a recognized institution.
  • Completion of a recognized Residency Training Program in Forensic Medicine or Forensic Pathology.
  • Board Certification, Arab Board, European Board, UK CCT, American Board, Canadian Board, Australian Fellowship, or equivalent qualification recognized for Consultant registration in Forensic Medicine.
  • Eligibility for Department of Health (DOH) Consultant licensing in Abu Dhabi.

Experience

  • Minimum of 5 years post-board experience as a Consultant in Forensic Medicine or Forensic Pathology.
  • Experience in medico-legal death investigations, forensic examinations, and court reporting within a recognized tertiary healthcare, governmental, or forensic institution.
  • Experience in disaster victim identification and mass casualty management is desirable.
  • Experience gaps exceeding two years may require specific DOH approval or completion of a return-to-practice program.

About the job

Microbiology Lead

Company: Pharco Corporation

Job Title: Microbiology Lead

Department: Quality Control

Location: Alexandria, Egypt

Reporting To: QC Manager

Job Purpose

The Microbiology Lead is responsible for leading and overseeing the microbiology laboratory activities within the Quality Control function, ensuring that all microbiological testing, environmental monitoring, personnel practices, documentation, and laboratory operations are performed accurately and in full compliance with GMP, GLP, pharmacopeial requirements, and applicable regulatory standards.

The role provides technical leadership to the microbiology team, ensures timely and reliable testing results, supports investigations and continuous improvement, and maintains the microbiology laboratory in a state of inspection readiness.

Key Responsibilities

1. Microbiology Laboratory Operations

• Lead and supervise daily activities of the QC Microbiology laboratory.

• Ensure timely execution and review of microbiological testing for raw materials, finished products, water, in-process samples, and other required samples.

• Oversee environmental monitoring activities, including viable and non-viable monitoring where applicable.

• Ensure proper execution of microbial limit tests, sterility testing, bacterial endotoxin testing, growth promotion tests, and other applicable microbiological analyses.

• Ensure appropriate handling, identification, storage, and disposal of microbiological samples and cultures.

• Monitor laboratory workload and allocate tasks effectively among microbiology team members.

2. GMP & Compliance

• Ensure microbiology activities comply with GMP, GLP, SOPs, pharmacopeial standards, and approved specifications.

• Ensure laboratory documentation is complete, accurate, traceable, and compliant with data integrity requirements.

• Maintain microbiology laboratory readiness for internal, customer, and regulatory inspections.

• Participate in the preparation and implementation of SOPs, work instructions, protocols, and microbiological procedures.

• Ensure proper management of laboratory deviations, OOS/OOT results, incidents, CAPAs, and change controls.

3. Environmental Monitoring & Utilities

• Supervise environmental monitoring programs for classified and controlled areas.

• Review environmental monitoring trends and identify potential adverse trends or contamination risks.

• Oversee microbiological testing of pharmaceutical water systems and other relevant utilities.

• Participate in contamination control activities and investigations related to microbiological excursions.

• Support the implementation and continuous improvement of the site’s Contamination Control Strategy (CCS).

4. Method Validation & Qualification

• Lead or support microbiological method validation, verification, suitability, and transfer activities.

• Review and approve microbiological protocols, reports, and associated technical documentation.

• Ensure microbiological test methods remain scientifically sound and compliant with current pharmacopeial requirements.

• Support qualification and validation activities related to microbiology laboratory equipment and processes.

5. Investigations & Problem Solving

• Lead microbiological investigations related to OOS, OOT, environmental monitoring excursions, contamination events, and other laboratory deviations.

• Perform root cause analysis using appropriate investigation tools.

• Define and follow up on effective CAPA plans.

• Provide technical microbiology support to QA, Production, Engineering, and other relevant departments.

6. Team Leadership & Development

• Lead, supervise, and develop microbiology analysts and laboratory personnel.

• Assign responsibilities and monitor individual and team performance.

• Provide technical guidance, coaching, and on-the-job training.

• Identify training needs and support the development of the microbiology team’s technical competencies.

• Evaluate team performance and provide constructive feedback.

7. Documentation & Reporting

• Review laboratory records, worksheets, analytical results, logbooks, and microbiological reports.

• Ensure accurate and timely reporting of microbiology laboratory results.

• Prepare periodic reports and trend analyses for microbiological monitoring activities.

• Maintain appropriate laboratory records in accordance with GMP and data integrity requirements.

8. Continuous Improvement

• Identify opportunities to improve microbiology laboratory efficiency, reliability, and compliance.

• Participate in quality improvement and risk management initiatives.

• Keep updated with changes in pharmacopeial requirements, GMP expectations, and microbiological testing practices.

• Support implementation of new technologies, methods, and laboratory practices where applicable.

Job Requirements

• Bachelor’s degree in pharmacy, Science – Microbiology.

• Minimum 10 years of relevant experience in pharmaceutical microbiology, preferably within a QC laboratory environment.

• Previous experience in a lead/senior microbiology position is highly preferred.

• Strong practical knowledge of pharmaceutical microbiological testing and environmental monitoring.

• Good knowledge of GMP, GLP, data integrity, pharmacopeial requirements, and microbiological laboratory practices.

• Hands-on experience with relevant microbiological techniques and laboratory equipment.

• Strong knowledge of OOS/OOT investigations, deviations, CAPA, change control, and risk assessment.

• Good analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.

• Strong leadership, communication, and team-management abilities.

• Good command of English language, particularly technical and pharmaceutical terminology.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.

title.rendered: Consultant Clinical Scientist or Physician – Hematopathology

content.rendered:
JOB SUMMARY

The Consultant Clinical Scientist or a Physician – Hematopathology reports directly to the Division Chief of Hematopathology, and through the Division Chief to the Chair of Pathology. The Consultant Clinical Scientist or a Physician – Hematopathology represents his or her Division within the Department of Pathology, within Sidra and externally to provide, advance, and promote excellence in the investigation and diagnosis of pediatric and/or maternal hematologic diseases; and to plan and direct the educational activities, research and diagnostic test development in the Division. The primary responsibilities of the Consultant Clinical Scientist or a Physician – Hematopathology are the provision of laboratory service; diagnostic testing, test interpretation, communication with medical staff, quality control and assurance; participation in the management of the Division; teaching at various levels; basic and applied research; sharing responsibility for all aspects of laboratory functions including diagnostic testing, maintaining quality assurance programs, and training of laboratory staff, residents and fellows within the Division.

Responsibilities

KEY ROLE ACCOUNTABILITIES

  • Supports and directs clinical service, research and educational activities of the Division.
  • Develops and validates test and orderable menu for hematopathology and transfusion, working with colleagues in hematopathology, immunopathology, medical microbiology, medical biochemistry, and other clinical and laboratory specialties.
  • Provides direction and assists in the validation and testing of the laboratory information system as it relates to hematopathology.
  • Leads and assists in quality assurance of the Division and the Department.
  • Assists in the hiring of colleagues and technologists. 

General

  • Assists and supports the Division Chief and Department Chair in the development and implementation of the vision, strategic direction, and growth of the Division of Hematopathology and Department of Pathology.

Clinical and Technical

  • Medical oversight of clinical hematopathology diagnostics and, if consistent with training and experience, transfusion medicine.
  • Medical oversight of quality assurance and management of the clinical hematopathology laboratory in association with the laboratory manager, supervisors and bench technologists.
  • Consultation and advice regarding the appropriate investigation of pediatric and maternal patients suspected of diseases of the hematolic system, including both inherited and acquired conditions.
  • Interpretation of results from laboratory tests for diagnosis and management of hematologic conditions in pediatric and maternal patients.
  • Consultation and advice regarding the appropriate utilization of hematopathological and transfusion-related tests by Sidra clinicians and monitoring of areas of over- and under-utilization.
  • Assists clinicians in development of test algorithms for diagnosis of complex hematological disorders.

Educational

  • Education of medical students and postgraduate trainees in the Department of Pathology and graduate/postgraduate programs at Sidra.
  • Informal and formal education in the clinical laboratory setting, seminars, and rounds.
  • Updates physicians of new developments and trends in diagnostic hematopathology.
  • Initiation and implementation of continuing education programs for laboratory technologists within the Division of Hematopathology (e.g. rounds, invited seminars, symposia, teleconferences).
  • Trains research students and fellows in both the basic and R&D laboratories.

Research and Diagnostic Test Development

  • Basic and applied clinically relevant research in the area of hematopathology in collaboration with internal and external scientists and clinicians.
  • Seeks external funding to support basic and applied research activities.
  • Continuing efforts to improve existing diagnostic methods, replace outdated technology, evaluate new technology, and implement new research findings in diagnostic hematopathology.
  • In collaboration with Sidra clinicians, performs clinical research projects that address specific and important questions in the diagnosis and management of pediatric and maternal patients.

Administrative

  • Participation in committees relevant to the Department of Pathology and the Division of Hematopathology within Sidra as directed by the Department Chair and/or Division Chief. 
  • Assists in establishment of standards for delivery of diagnostic and consultative services in hematopathology and transfusion.
  • Assists in the management of the Division technologists.
  • Assists in coordination of fellow/resident/medical student education within the Division.
  • Determination of the range and scope of hematopathological and transfusion-related testing in consultation with Sidra clinicians.
  • Assists in establishment and monitoring of quality improvement and utilization review.
  • Continuous review of the hematopathology testing menu offered by the core laboratory in order to identify obsolete tests and areas where introduction of new or improved testing is warranted.
  • Continuous review of instrumentation in the core laboratory with a view to update and upgrade the testing technology utilized in the Division to achieve improved workflow as well as cost effectiveness.
  • Adheres to Sidra’s standards as they appear in the Code of Conduct and Conflict of Interest policies

Qualifications

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

Education

  • PhD or MD, MBBS (or equivalent)
  • Relevant Board Certification, or Fellowship of relevant College (FACMG; FCCMG; FRCPath; FFSc(FRCPA) in Hematopathology

Experience

  • 8+ years’ relevant experience in a clinical diagnostic laboratory OR
  • 2+ years of post-certification/residency experience focusing on the laboratory diagnosis and monitoring of hematologic disorders.

Staff Nurse-Tower A6 – Pediatrics Wing

Job Description

 Job Purpose 
The Staff Nurse is accountable for the coordination of nursing care, including direct patient care, patient/family education and transitions of care. The Staff Nurse supports professional nursing practice across the continuum of care to meet the needs of the patient and family. The Staff Nurse will understand, support and promote the mission, vision and values of SSMC; provides age-appropriate patient care according to the Nursing Scope of Practice as defined by the regulatory body. The Staff Nurse will adhere to and promote the Professional Nurses Code of Conduct for Abu Dhabi and UAE.

Responsibilities



•   Assessment and Diagnosis: Collects and analyzes assessment data to determine diagnosis/issues: 
   Assesses comprehensive data including but not limited to physical, psychosocial, emotional, cognitive, and spiritual needs and interprets assessment information to derive the diagnosis or issues as defined by the patient’s condition. 
   Uses evidence-based assessment techniques and instruments in collecting data and validates the diagnosis or issue with the patient, family and healthcare team members as appropriate. 
   Prioritizes the data and information collected based on patient’s immediate condition or anticipated needs and identifies potential risks or barriers to the patient’s health or safety. 
   Documents the data and information collected in compliance with established guidelines and reflective of the needs of the patient. 
•   Planning and Outcomes Identification: Identifies expected outcomes and develops a plan that address health promotion, health restoration and health maintenance to attain expected outcomes. 
   Involves patient, family and healthcare team members in formulating a culturally appropriate individualized plan of care. 
   Applies evidence-based nursing practices in developing the individualized plan of care to attain expected outcomes and continuity of care. 
   Modifies the individualized plan of care according to the ongoing assessment and reevaluation of the patient’s response, status, and outcome indicators. 
   Documents the expected outcomes as measurable goals in a manner that uses standardized language or recognized terminology.

•   Implementation and Coordination of Care Delivery: 
   Implements the plan of care in partnership with the patient, family and healthcare team members in a timely manner utilizing evidence-based interventions and treatments specific to the needs of the patient. 
   Performs treatments and procedures according to established procedural guidelines and protocols. 
   Administers medications according to organization policies and procedures. 
   Ensures  that  all  components  of  the  individualized  plan  of  care,  including  modifications,  are documented in the patient’s health record. 
   Communicates relevant information across all levels of care and organizations. 
   Demonstrates a working knowledge of resource consumption and practices within a costeffective framework. 
•   Health teaching and health promotion: 
   Utilizes teaching strategies appropriate to the individual patient’s condition and learning needs. 
   Uses health promotion to support patients and families in developing skills that promote, maintain, or restore healthy lifestyles and self-management support. 
   Seeks opportunities for feedback and evaluation of the effectiveness of the strategies used, including teach back. 
   Ensures that all components of the health education, relevant to the clinical condition, is documented in the patient health record. 
•   Evaluation: Evaluates progress toward attainment of outcomes. 
   Evaluates the patient/family’s understanding of and response to the plan of care. 
   Utilizes systematic and ongoing assessment data to revise nursing diagnoses, outcomes, and the plan of care. 
   Involves the patient, family and healthcare team members in the evaluation process.

  • Prepares CDs and links for diagnostic images as requested.

  • Validates requests and authorizations for the release of medical information according to established procedures.
  • Performs quality checks on all work to ensure accuracy of the release, and confidentiality.

Paper Documents:

Off-site Storage:

Senior Nuclear PET / CT Technologist

Performs licensed independent practitioners in diagnostic and therapeutic Nuclear Medicine and Positron Emission Tomography/Computed Tomography (NM and PET/CT) procedures, including the preparation, administration, and documentation of medications in adherence to state and federal regulations. Participates in quality improvement processes and continually assess their professional performance. Oversees the daily operations of NM SPECT/CT and PET/CT scanners, prepares patient schedules, equipment maintenance, and quality assessment. Analyses and synthesizes NM SPECT/CT and PET/CT information, Communicates findings to physicians, coordinates work schedules, ensures patient safety and comfort, addresses patient care problems, and provides education on NM and PET/CT procedures. Performs venepuncture, intravenous access, administers radiopharmaceuticals and medications, evaluates images for technical quality, responds to emergencies, and engages in customer service training.

Responsibilities:

  • Performs the licensed independent practitioner in the completion of diagnostic and therapeutic NM and PET/CT procedures.
  • Prepares, administers, and documents activities related to medications per state and federal regulations or lawful institutional policy.
  • Participates in quality improvement processes and continually assesses their professional performance.
  • Oversees daily operations of the NM SPECT/CT and PET/CT scanners, patient schedules, equipment maintenance, the report of equipment failures, and Quality Assessment (QA).
  • Maintains a high standard of medical ethics and is self-motivated to increase the level of understanding and knowledge of the field, disease, and new procedures as they evolve.
  • Uses cognitive NM SPECT/CT and PET/CT skills to identify, record, and adapt procedures as appropriate to anatomical, pathological, and diagnostic information and images.
  • Operates PET/CT and SPECT/CT scanners.
  • Uses independent judgment during the NM SPECT/CT and PET/CT exams to accurately differentiate between normal and pathologic findings.
  • Analyses and synthesizes NM SPECT/CT and PET/CT information and medical history, and communicates findings to the appropriate physician.
  • Coordinates work schedule with the Technical Director and/or scheduling desk to ensure workload coverage.
  • Assumes responsibility for the safety, and mental and physical comfort of patients while they are in the NM and PET/CT environment care.
  • Establishes and maintains ethical working relationships and good rapport with all interrelating hospitals and referrals.
  • Performs all requested NM and PET/CT examinations as ordered by the attending physician.
  • Coordinates with other staff to ensure appropriate patient care is provided.
  • Addresses problems of patient care as they arise and makes decisions to appropriately resolve the problems.
  • Organizes daily work schedule and performs related clerical duties as required.
  • Reports equipment failures to the appropriate supervisor or staff member.
  • Provides in-service education team on requirements of NM and PET/CT procedures as requested by other members of the health care team.
  • Responds promptly and positively to patients, families, co-workers, and all others in a respectful, courteous and confidential manner.
  • Selects appropriate imaging acquisition with consideration given to established protocols and other factors influencing data acquisition parameters.
  • Posts processing digital data for display or hard copy records, ensuring proper identification is evident.
  • Verifies informed consent for applicable procedures.
  • Assumes responsibility for patient needs during procedures.
  • Prepares patients for procedures.
  • Applies principles of As-Low-As-Reasonably-Achievable (ALARA) to minimize exposure to patient, self, and others.
  • Performs venepuncture as prescribed by a licensed independent practitioner.
  • Performs intravenous access as prescribed by a licensed independent practitioner.
  • Identifies, prepares and/or administers radiopharmaceuticals and medications as prescribed by a licensed independent practitioner.
  • Monitors and maintains quality control standards.
  • Evaluates images for technical quality and ensures proper identification is recorded.
  • Identifies and responds to emergencies.
  • Educates and monitors students and other health care providers.
  • Maintains archival storage of digital data as appropriate.
  • Participates in customer service training and continuing education.
  • Performs other work-related duties as assigned.

Position Qualification:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or Diploma in Nuclear Medicine Imaging
  • Active home country registration
