Responsibilities

Quality and Accuracy:

  • Performs safe and quality respiratory care services and basic cardiopulmonary diagnostic tests following the clinical policy and procedures established by the American Hospital Dubai and the Cardiopulmonary Department.  He or she is not allowed to perform advanced cardiology and neurology diagnostic test procedures and advanced polysomnography studies.
  • Responds to the patient’s emergency and assists/performs Basic Life Support (BLS), Advanced Cardiac Life Support (ACLS) and/or Pediatric Advance Life Support (PALS) and Neonatal Resuscitation Program (NRP) whenever clinically indicated and/or required as prescribed by the physician.
  • Performs comprehensive patient assessment and re-assessment before, during or after each clinical test procedure and following the clinical standards established by the World Health Organization assessment and the Joint Commission International Accreditation (JCIA) – International Patient Safety Goals (IPSG) requirement.
  • Communicates directly with the attending or the ordering physician and/or the Medical Consultant and immediately reports any of the following that includes vague or contraindicated diagnostic procedures, unstable patient’s baseline vital signs, preliminary but critical diagnostic findings or test results, test complications, medications adverse reactions, patient’s refusal to diagnostic testing and any serious clinical events or a patient emergency.
  • Documents all test procedures and clinical test events into the patient’s electronic medical records (EMR) following the hospital and the established clinical policy and procedures of the department.
  • Utilizes appropriate medical equipment during the test procedures that may include any of the following Respiratory equipment, Pulmonary Function Testing (PFT) machine, Bedside Spirometer, Pulse Oximeter, Polysomnography (PSG)-Sleep Screening monitoring system, Blood Gas Analyzers and Cardiac Monitoring Device.
  • Reviews the quality of the preliminary test reports after each patient’s test procedure on diagnostic tests that include Pulmonary Function Testing (PFT) and Polysomnography (PSG) studies.
  • Prepares preliminary diagnostic test reports and/or machine-generated preliminary reports after each test procedure and submits a preliminary report copy to the Medical Consultants for immediate review, evaluation and final results.
  • Refrains from utilizing any medical equipment that failed functional calibration or bio-calibration and verbally reports the equipment problems to the Biomedical Engineers and/or through the Service Requisition Software electronic reporting system for immediate inspection and repair.
  • Disinfects all medical equipment after each patient’s utilization following the Infection Prevention and Control clinical standards and as per hospital and department clinical policy and procedures.
  • Disposes all soiled or used “single patient use” medical supplies after each patient’s test procedure using the medical biohazard bin at bedside and following the Infection Prevention and Control standards and the established clinical policy and procedures of the department.
  • Performs the monthly inventory of all medical supplies, reviews the medical equipment preventive maintenance requirement and respiratory medications, and replenishes all the requirements as applicable.
  • Performs the daily patient room safety checks, respiratory supply checks and the patient room temperature and humidity checks following the established clinical policy and procedures of the hospital and the department.
  • Participates in the Key Performance Improvement projects and Clinical Measures requirement for a respiratory section of the department.
  • Participates in the weekly critical patient care rounds along with another multidisciplinary team in the Intensive Care Unit.
  • Participates in the daily end-of-the-shift patient care plan review and clinical events reporting.

Quantity/Organizational Skills:

  • Reviews the daily patient’s diagnostic test schedules, patient daily acuity and the patient’s medical records before the test procedure.
  • Prepares all the medical equipment required for daily diagnostic testing and performs daily functional checks and calibration before diagnostic test procedures including checking all accessories and supplies required during the test procedures.
  • Identifies the correct patient, and assists the patient and/or the patient’s relative with the registration and billing process requirements.
  • Admits the patient to the department and/or visits the patient in a specified clinical area and independently performs the prescribed diagnostic test procedure.
  • Provides the patient and/or the patient’s relative with clinical education for specific and prescribed diagnostic test procedures that include the test indications, contraindications, goals and expectations, potential complications and/or specific instructions during the procedure.
  • Assesses the patient before the procedure and performs the prescribed respiratory care services, monitors, and observes the patient during the procedure and re-assesses the patient after the test procedure.
  • Operates and troubleshoots all cardiopulmonary medical equipment including Cardiac Monitors, Pulse Oximeters, Invasive and Non-invasive Mechanical Ventilators, Suction Machines, Blood Gas Analysers, Medical Gases Equipment, Bedside Spirometer, Wright manometer and Oxygen Medical Devices.
  • Performs independently the following Respiratory Care Services that includes:
    • Oxygen Therapy (Low Flow Oxygen Delivery System)
    • Oxygen Therapy (High Flow Oxygen Delivery System)
    • Oxygen Therapy (Heated High Flow Nasal Cannula System).
    • Aerosol Therapy (Heated or Non Heated Oxygen Delivery System)
    • Aerosol Drug Administration using the Small Volume Nebulizer (SVN-with Bronchodilators and Corticosteroids).
    • Aerosol Drug Administration using the Small Volume Nebulizer (SVN with Antibiotics, Mucolytics, Hypertonic and Normal Saline Solution).
    • Aerosol Drug Administration uses the Metered Dose Inhaler (MDI with Bronchodilators and Corticosteroids.
    • Respiratory Medication Stock Monitoring and Inventory.
    • Bronchial Hygiene (Sputum Induction and Collection).
    • Bronchial Hygiene (Directive Cough Assist, Deep Breathing Exercises).
    • Bronchial Hygiene (Tracheal Suctioning – Oral – Nasopharyngeal).
    • Chest Physiotherapy and Postural Drainage (with portable percussor).
    • Chest Physiotherapy and Postural Drainage (with vest percussor).
    • Incentive Spirometry
    • Simple Bedside Spirometry
    • Simple Bedside Spirometry pre and post-with bronchodilator.
    • Peak Expiratory Flow Measurement.
    • Forced Vital Capacity Measurement.
    • Blood Gas Sampling and Analysis and interpretation (arterial–venous–capillary and fetal).
    • Blood Gas Sampling and Analysis and Interpretation (Electrolytes, Lactate and/or Bilirubin).
    • Arterial Line blood sampling, monitoring, and maintenance.
    • Artificial Airway Management (Oral Airway, Nasopharyngeal Airway, Laryngeal Mask Airway,
    • Endotracheal/Trach and Tracheostomy Tube).
    • Tracheal Intubation Assist (Elective, Emergency and/or Code Blue).
    • Tracheal Tube Removal and/or Assist (Post Weaning Procedure).
    • Non-Invasive Mechanical Ventilator Management (NCPAP and/or BIPAP initial Setup and subsequent monitoring).
    • Invasive Mechanical Ventilator Management (Initial Set-up, subsequent monitoring, and patient transport).
    • Exercise Pulse Oximetry Monitoring (Six-Minute Walking Exercise)
    • Continuous Nocturnal Pulse Oximetry Monitoring.
    • Emergency Response and/or Assistance (Code Blue, Code Green)
    • Patient critical transport assistance inside or outside the hospital.
  • Patient Respiratory Care Education and In-services (Patient planned for discharge for respiratory care procedures and treatments and respiratory medical equipment set-up and preventive maintenance.
  • Assesses the patient before the procedure and administers the prescribed respiratory treatment with the respiratory medications that are required during the Pulmonary Function Testing (PFT) test and re-assesses the patient including the therapeutic or adverse effects of the medications administered. 
  • Performs independently the following Pulmonary Diagnostic Test/respiratory treatment (small volume nebulizer – SVN) that includes:
    • Spirometry 
    • Spirometry Pre and Post
    • Pulmonary Function Testing (PFT) Complete 
    • Pulmonary Function Testing (PFT) Complete Pre and Post bronchodilator
    • Performs Fraction of Exhaled Nitric Oxide Measurement.

The Charge nurse shall have the knowledge of health care systems, demonstrate the ability to interact, relate to/ work with, and support the activities of a diverse multidisciplinary workforce. unit.

Key Responsibilities

    • Assist with diagnostic tests, procedures, and post-procedure care as needed.
  2. Family-Centered Care:
    • Educate and support families on the child’s condition, treatment plans, and home care requirements.
    • Encourage family participation in the care process to promote a supportive environment for the child’s recovery.
  3. Documentation & Reporting:
    • Maintain accurate and comprehensive medical records, including nursing assessments, care plans, and interventions.
    • Ensure timely and effective communication with the multidisciplinary team regarding patient progress and concerns.
  4. Health & Safety:
    • Follow infection control protocols and ensure a clean, safe, and child-friendly environment within the pediatric unit.
    • Monitor for potential risks, including falls, and implement preventative measures.
  5. Professional Development:
    • Participate in ongoing training, workshops, and certifications to stay updated on pediatric nursing best practices.
    • Collaborate with team members for quality improvement initiatives and evidence-based practices in pediatric care.
  6. Emergency Care:

Job Purpose:

Dispenses medications ordered by privileged physicians while observing at all times highest standards of safety and quality and ensuring prompt seamless process that is conducive to highest patient satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities And Duties

  • Reviews, interprets, clarifies doctor’s medications orders and verifies all orders doses, duration and checks for potential drug-to-drug interaction and clinical indication. Communicates with ordering doctor in case of any ambiguity or concern.
  • Oversees the preparation of the verified medications, performs double-checking and review of proper labeling for the prepared medications and then dispenses.
  • Calculates the amount of the drug product to dispense for a prescription based upon body weight and patient age.
  • Performs computer entry of outside prescriptions or orders into CPOE of Fakeeh Care HIS before dispensing.
  • Ensures prompt and timely calling of patients to dispensing windows and aims at reducing patients waiting time to the minimum possible.
  • Counsels the patients and caregivers on the proper & safe use of medication, storage, and interactions, etc.
  • Follows all medication safety procedures when dispensing medications.
  • Maintains inventory control & security of all drugs, record keeping and secured storage of narcotics and controlled medications.
  • Identifies and appropriately handles the nearly expired medications according to Fakeeh Care policies and NEVER dispenses a medication beyond its expiry date.
  • Properly completes charging of patients for dispensed medications.
  • Demonstrates knowledge of proper storage & handling of hazardous materials found in her/him workplace, as well as first aid measures necessary for accidental exposure.
  • Demonstrates knowledge & skills in utilizing formulary, identifications of generic substitution, indication and the role of deductible limits and application of prescription quantity limitations.
  • Practices and fully complies with current infection prevention and control standards when handling medications and preparing IV and TPN formulas.
  • Contributes to training and induction orientation for newly hired pharmacists and students and trainees.
  • Demonstrates knowledge of commonly used over the counter (OTC) drugs.
  • Reports to pharmacy supervisor/ manager and enters on OVR any encountered medication error or ADR.
  • Attends continuing education programs to maintain expertise in pharmacy and required licensure.
  • Ensures Enrollment in continuous education program regarding medication management practices, high risk medications, medication errors and others.
  • Educates patients and their families about health conditions, treatments and preventative measures if applicable.

All Fakeeh Care employees are responsible for continuous improvement, including:

  • Performing all duties and tasks in a manner that supports Fakeeh’s Person-Centered care values.
  • Actively contributing to continuous improvement initiatives, within the scope of the role.
  • Adherence to safety protocols and proactively seeking to address any job-related safety concerns.
  • Maintaining strict confidentiality of all sensitive information accessed or encountered during work.
  • Complying with cybersecurity policies and standards to protect Fakeeh’s systems and participating in awareness training and initiatives to prevent cyber threats.
  • Adhering to and upholding Fakeeh Care’s code of conduct, policies and ethical standards.
  • Completion of mandatory education as per the requirement, at least one month prior to expiration.

Requirements

Skills and Abilities:

  • Competent computer skills with software applications to include Microsoft Word, Excel.
  • Actively strive to upgrade professional skills through engaging in appropriate professional training and experience.

Experience

0 – 2 years of experience in hospital pharmacy setting.

Education

Bachelor’s Degree of Pharmacy.

Language

Good command of oral and written English.

Licenses / Certifications

License for practice as per the regional health regulatory authority e.g. (SCFHS / DHA).

Job Purpose: 

Responsible for the decontamination, preparation, sterilization, and distribution of surgical instruments and medical equipment by Fakeeh Care policy and procedures/standards. The role ensures that all equipment is properly sterilized and available in patient care and surgical procedures.

Key Responsibilities and Duties: 

1.    Decontamination:

  • Receives, sorts, and inspects used surgical instruments and medical equipment for decontamination.
  • Manually cleans instruments using appropriate detergents and disinfectants.
  • Operates and maintains decontamination equipment such as ultrasonic cleaners, washers, and disinfectors.

2.    Preparation and Packaging:

  • Assembles surgical instrument sets and medical equipment according to established protocols.
  • Packages instruments and supplies in preparation for sterilization, ensuring proper wrapping, labeling, and documentation.
  • Inspects instruments for damage or wear and report any issues to the line manager.

3.    Sterilization:

  • Operates sterilizers (e.g., autoclaves) according to manufacturer guidelines and Fakeeh Care policies.
  • Monitors and documents sterilization cycles, including time, temperature, and pressure parameters.
  • Performs routine biological, chemical, and mechanical monitoring tests to ensure effective sterilization.

4.    Storage and Distribution:

  • Stores sterilized instruments and supplies in designated storage areas, ensuring proper rotation and inventory control.
  • Distributes sterilized instruments and equipment to operating rooms, clinics, and other departments as required.
  • Maintains accurate records of sterilization processes and inventory levels.

5.    Quality Control and Safety:

  • Adheres to all infection control and safety protocols to prevent cross-contamination and ensure a safe working environment.
  • Participates in regular equipment maintenance, calibration and performance checks, and quality improvement initiatives.
  • Report any equipment malfunctions/ incidents or safety concerns to the supervisor.

6.    Compliance and Documentation:

  • Ensures compliance with all regulatory standards, including Joint Commission, OSHA, and facility-specific policies.
  • Maintains accurate records of sterilization processes, inventory management, and quality control measures.

Job Description

The Neurology Technician plays a vital role in supporting neurologists and other healthcare professionals in diagnosing and treating patients with neurological disorders. This position requires specialized knowledge of neurology, technical skills, and a compassionate approach to patient care

Patient Care

  • Conduct diagnostic tests, Perform and assist with various neurological diagnostic tests and procedures, such as electroencephalograms (EEG), nerve conduction studies, electromyograms (EMG), and autonomic testing, following established protocols.
  • Prepare patients for neurological tests, explain procedures, and provide instructions to ensure their comfort and cooperation during the tests.
  • Assist during procedures: Provide support to neurologists during diagnostic procedures, help with patient positioning, equipment setup, and troubleshooting to ensure the smooth flow of patient care.

Patient Education and Support

  • Assesses patient educational and needs and interacts with relevant staff and departments to facilitate requirement.
  • Educate patients and their families about neurological conditions, diagnostic tests, treatment options, and lifestyle modifications as prescribed by the neurologist.
  • Provide emotional support and guidance to patients and families during challenging times.
  • Ensure patients understand discharge instructions and follow-up care

Collaboration and Communication

  • Work collaboratively with physicians, Nurses, and other healthcare team members to coordinate patient care.
  • Communicate effectively with colleagues to ensure seamless transitions of care and optimal patient outcomes

Documentation and Record Keeping

  • Record and document results: Accurately record test results, patient information, and other relevant data in electronic medical records (EMR) systems for review by healthcare providers.
  • Ensure compliance with legal and regulatory requirements regarding patient documentation.
  • Maintains patient confidentiality at all time

Safety and Infection Control

  • Maintain equipment: Ensure that neurology equipment is properly maintained, calibrated, and ready for use, following manufacturer guidelines and safety protocols..
  • Adhere to strict infection control protocols to prevent the spread of healthcare-associated infections.
  • Implement safety measures to protect patients, staff, and visitors from accidents and injuries.
  • Identify and address potential safety hazards in the healthcare environment.
  • Identifies and reports defective or broken equipment, safety hazards and environmental hazards.

Professional Development

  • Professional development: Stay informed about advancements in neurology technology, diagnostic techniques, and treatment options through ongoing training and professional development activities.
  • Seek opportunities for professional growth and skill development through workshops, seminars, and certifications.
  • Demonstrates and maintains competence in all mandatory competencies.
  • Maintain current licensure and certifications required for the position

Quality Improvement and Compliance

  • Ensure compliance: Adhere to all relevant regulations, protocols, and safety standards to maintain a safe and efficient working environment.
  • Participate in quality improvement initiatives to enhance patient care and safety.
  • Demonstrates sensitivity to patient complaints and concerns. Initiates the nursing of administrative chain of command if unable to resolve patient issues
  • Assists the Head Nurse of the unit by willing acceptance of any other work-related responsibility.
  • Other duties as assigned within the scope of responsibility and requirements of the job

Skills

  • Knowledge of neuroanatomy, neurophysiology, common neurological disorders, and diagnostic procedures.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. and the ability to interact effectively with patients and healthcare professionals
  • Proficiency in using electronic health records (EHR) and other healthcare technology.
  • Ability to work independently and adapt to changing patient needs and environments.
  • Attention to detail, organizational skills, and the ability to work in a fast-paced environment
  • BLS certification

Job Description

The Ophthalmology Technician plays a critical role in supporting ophthalmologists and other eye care professionals in diagnosing, treating, and caring for patients with eye-related conditions. This position requires a combination of technical skills, knowledge of ophthalmic procedures, and a patient-centred approach to healthcare

Patient Care

  • Conduct preliminary tests: Perform various ophthalmic diagnostic tests and screenings, such as visual acuity testing, tonometry, visual field testing, and refraction, following established protocols and guidelines.
  • Prep patients: Prepare patients for eye examinations and procedures, explaining the process, obtaining relevant medical history, and ensuring their comfort throughout the visit.
  • Perform specialized tests: Conduct specialized ophthalmic tests such as optical coherence tomography (OCT), visual field testing, fluorescein angiography, and ultrasound imaging to assist ophthalmologists in diagnosing and monitoring eye conditions.
  • Contact lens fitting: Assist with contact lens fittings, measurements, and instructions for patients requiring contact lenses as part of their vision correction treatment.
  • Patient triage: Assist in triaging patients based on the urgency of their eye conditions, ensuring that patients with acute issues are seen promptly by the ophthalmologist.
  • Medication management: Administer eye drops, ointments, or medications as directed by the ophthalmologist, and educate patients on proper administration techniques.
  • Patient follow-up: Schedule follow-up appointments, coordinate referrals to other specialists if needed, and communicate test results and treatment plans to patients under the supervision of the ophthalmologist.
  • Assist with procedures: Support ophthalmologists during eye exams, procedures, and treatments by providing assistance with instruments, equipment setup, patient positioning, and other tasks as needed

Patient Education and Support

  • Assesses patient educational and needs and interacts with relevant staff and departments to facilitate requirement.
  • Educate patients: Provide patients with information on eye conditions, treatment options, medications, and post-care instructions to promote patient understanding and compliance with treatment plans.
  • Provide emotional support and guidance to patients and families during challenging times.
  • Ensure patients understand discharge instructions and follow-up care

Collaboration and Communication

  • Work collaboratively with physicians, Nurses, and other healthcare team members to coordinate patient care.
  • Communicate effectively with colleagues to ensure seamless transitions of care and optimal patient outcomes

Documentation and Record Keeping

  • Record and document: Record test results, patient information, treatment plans, and other relevant data accurately in electronic medical records (EMR) systems for review by ophthalmologists and other healthcare providers..
  • Ensure compliance with legal and regulatory requirements regarding patient documentation.
  • Maintains patient confidentiality at all time

Safety and Infection Control

  • Maintain equipment: Ensure that ophthalmic equipment is in proper working condition, clean, and calibrated regularly to produce accurate test results and maintain patient safety.
  • Adhere to strict infection control protocols to prevent the spread of healthcare-associated infections.
  • Implement safety measures to protect patients, staff, and visitors from accidents and injuries.
  • Identify and address potential safety hazards in the healthcare environment.
  • Identifies and reports defective or broken equipment, safety hazards and environmental hazards.

Professional Development

  • Professional development: Stay current with advancements in ophthalmology technology, procedures, and best practices through ongoing training, workshops, and professional development opportunities..
  • Seek opportunities for professional growth and skill development through workshops, seminars, and certifications.
  • Demonstrates and maintains competence in all mandatory competencies.
  • Maintain current licensure and certifications required for the position.

Quality Improvement and Compliance

  • Quality assurance: Participate in quality assurance activities, such as monitoring and maintaining the cleanliness of ophthalmic equipment, ensuring infection control measures are followed, and participating in audits and quality improvement initiatives.

Ensure compliance: Adhere to all relevant regulations, protocols, and safety standards to maintain a safe and efficient working environment.

Other duties as assigned within the scope of responsibility and requirements of the job

The Registered Nurse will work as Patient Care Coach to provide compassionate and empathetic guidance to help patients to manage the impact of their condition and to receive their treatment effectively. The Registered Nurse / Care Coach is a qualified healthcare professional who complements the education and care provided by the patient’s own healthcare team. The role involves regular patient contact, in person and by telephone, and is responsible for building rapport and helping to address their patients’ personal challenges and needs. Facilitate successful communication between patients, physicians and third party payers that leads to shared motivation to achieve treatment goals. Ensure continuous patient education, motivation, consultation and follow up.

Responsibilities

  • Introduce to physicians the role of the Patient Care Coach (PCC) and their purpose to assist them with their patients.
  • Have a consent form signed by the physician to allow the PCC to contact his/her patients for education, follow ups and collection of health information.
  • Have a consent form signed by the patient and acknowledged by the treating physician to allow the PCC to teach him/her self-injection, follow up on his general health status, treatment outcomes and adverse events (if spontaneously reported), collect relevant health information and update the treating physician periodically.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  1. Assist the dentist / surgeon in all aspects of the practice.
  2. Attend to the patient with such a warm reception, with a “SMILE”.

(From waiting room to the surgery: surgery to the reception)

  1. Cooperate with the receptionist: paper works like referrals, Insurance Cards, ICD, invoices, and approvals.
  2. Carry on telephone manner as per procedure and policy.
  3. Practice the universal precaution to maintain the good infection control in every aspect of the clinical practice.
  4. Maintain availability of stocks and other needed items in the surgery.
  5. Participate in patient and family education to help patients and families to better understand and participate in their care and make well informed care decisions.

Daily Procedures:

  1. Start Up:
  • Wear appropriate uniform, clean and ironed. Switch on surgery / unit and computer, X Ray. Check appointment and laboratory works.
  • Run through the 3:1 and motors to remove any stagnant water (this must be done for at least 2 minutes) flush water into spittoon. Ensure a clean environment and set for the first patient.
  1. During the day:
  • Assist the surgeon throughout day, observe cross infection control procedure by universal precaution
  • Be present in the surgery during all operating procedures, talk to patient as necessary when the dentist is out for some reasons
  • Follow Standard Operating Procedures (S.O.P) when using all equipment, ask when unsure.
  • Maintain stocks, note any item that are less, needs refill.
  • Keep patient record updated: invoices and charges / maintain lab work diary.

3. End of day:

  • Accomplish daily statistics report, check patient’s notes records / files as necessary.
  • Run headpieces and 3:1 into spittoon, clean and disinfect aspirator, its tubing and the spittoon with disinfectant. Flush the aspirator / suction tubing’s with water several times.
  • Remove and clean “amalgam” traps and other residues.
  • Collect “amalgam waste” in a sealed container with water.
  • Clean / Wipe and disinfect the dental chair with alcohol-free disinfectant, unit and accessories with alcohol base disinfectant.
  • Clean sink with soap and water thoroughly. Clean and disinfect all work surfaces thoroughly with alcohol base disinfectant
  • Dispose all clinical waste (yellow bag), Reline bins, brush and mop the floor (with the aid of the janitor).
  • Check next day’s appointment.
  • Switch off computer and all equipment.

Weekly Procedures

  1. Clean all displays in practice

Check stocks in the surgery, note requisitions

  1. Clean operating chair / stools – top and bottom

Clean all suction tubes and other bottles outside and in, X-ray machine – arms and head, and other dental equipments in the surgery.

  1. Clean cupboard fronts, skirting boards, pictures and mirrors, window sills, ceiling lights, any ledges and shelves
  2. Clean and reline all cupboards and drawers.
  3. Hygiene surgery as on Rota: Clean – chair, stools, light, skirting etc

Prepare weekly stat for the weekly meeting

Job Description

The Officer – Clinical Trials Office provides support to the Principal Investigator (PI) during the startup, conduct and close out phases of Investigators Initiated and Sponsored Clinical Trials within Sidra Medicine. 

Under the supervision and support of the Clinical Trials Office (CTO), as the Officer – Clinical Trials Office, the post holder is specifically responsible for the coordination and day to day management of a portfolio of clinical studies.

The post holder works collaboratively with PIs and nurses, providing expert coordination support in a clinical and academic research environment, driving study set up and delivery of projects. 

The post holder is primarily responsible for the coordination between the Investigators, and various stakeholders of the Research Projects and core facilities within Sidra, and with collaborating centers in Qatar and abroad. Specifically(s)he is responsible for setting up Regulatory Binders for Clinical Trials, liaising with the Pharmacy Department during the setup of interventional Clinical Trials facilitating research subjects’ recruitment, supporting with English/Arabic translation where needed, handling research sampling and completing related administrative tasks, collecting research data, recording information on research databases, uploading research forms and documents on IRBNet and monitoring the progress of the assigned Clinical Trials with the support of the CTO. 

The post holder is expected to collate and manage regulatory documentation to ensure the team is conducting research in accordance with ICH-GCP guidelines, Ministry of Public Health (MoPH) regulations and local Policies and Procedures. This varied and challenging post will involve among other tasks being committed to following up patients for the studies as required and is a key link for supporting patients and their families through ensuring that they receive appropriate and timely information regarding their inclusion and participation in the study. The post holder is instrumental in the patients’ retention in a study.

Responsibilities

  • Provides research coordination to Sponsored and Investigator’s initiated Clinical Trials which involve liaising with multiple stakeholders and core facilities and with external organizations.
  • Practices in compliance with the IRB-approved Protocol, ICH-GCP and MoPH guidelines and Local Policies and Procedures.
  • Organizes and maintains research databases/Regulatory Binders and files including patient information’s such as secured data and unidentified data, as relevant.
  • Designs and manages the Case Report Forms (CRF), according to the different Clinical Trials.
  • Coordinates and attends Site Initiation Visits (SIVs).
  • Coordinates recruitment of patients and works closely with Investigators when they collect informed consents.
  • Coordinates samples collection and transportation.
  • Monitors recruitment and other metrics on a regular basis and liaises with the Project Management Office (PMO).
  • Provides updates and reports of study data as needed to the CTO, for meetings and presentations.
  • Supports PIs regarding submissions of protocol amendments for IRB approval.
  • Adapts local study documentation in response to protocol amendments.
  • Prepares for, and facilitates, audits and/or inspections.
  • Works closely with the Pharmacy Department to ensure timely delivery of investigational Products (IP) to patients, monitors and records drug compliance in research patients and delivers patients’ drug returns to the Clinical Trials Pharmacy team.
  • Reports promptly to the PI and the CTO, events which could result or have resulted in protocol violation.
  • Organizes and supports monitoring visits.
  • Coordinates patients’ follow up visits.
  • Provides training, guidance and supervision to junior staff within the team where required.
  • Contributes to research induction and training of new staff as required.
  • Adheres to Sidra’s standards as they appear in the Code of Conduct and Conflict of Interest policies
  • Adheres to and promotes Sidra’s Values.

In view of the evolving needs and opportunities within Sidra, this position may be required to perform other duties as assigned and reporting relationships may vary.

Qualifications

Sidra Medicine a healthy population is essential to a strong, prosperous society, and throughout 2020, Sidra continued to provide uninterrupted comprehensive specialist healthcare services for children and young people; and exceptional maternity, gynecology, and reproductive medical services for women, previously unavailable in Qatar and the region.” – H.H Sheikha Moza bint Nasser, Chairperson of Qatar Foundation

About SEIF Pharmacies and Pharmacist Overview

For over 45 years, SEIF Pharmacies has been a trusted name in Egyptian communities, and pharmacists have been at the heart of that trust. From day one, our focus has been simple: meet people where they are, and serve them with care and professionalism. That mission led us to introduce 24-hour pharmacy services, integrate wellness and beauty into the pharmacy space, and pioneer online pharmacy solutions in Egypt. But at the center of every innovation, every expansion, and every interaction, is the pharmacist.

Pharmacists are the most essential part of the team. You’re a guide, an educator, and often the first point of contact for someone making an important health decision. Your ability to listen, explain, reassure, and act with precision shapes how people experience care. That responsibility is something we take seriously and support fully.

Were here to give you the tools, training, and professional respect you need to deliver excellent care, one person at a time. As pharmacy continues to evolve, so do we. New services, new technologies, and new patient expectations require pharmacists who are thoughtful, adaptable, and informed. That’s the kind of environment we offer: stable, modern, and built on real patient needs, not just business goals.

Position Description:

The Assistant Pharmacist supports the safe, accurate, and efficient preparation, dispensing, distribution, and management of medications under the supervision of a licensed Pharmacist.

The role assists with prescription processing, medication preparation, stock and inventory control, controlled medication documentation, ward stock management, billing, and pharmacy operations while maintaining patient safety, confidentiality, and compliance with American Hospital Dubai policies and applicable regulatory requirements.

Position Responsibility:

  • Assists the Pharmacist in preparing, dispensing, labeling, and distributing medications accurately according to approved prescriptions, medication orders, departmental procedures, and authorized scope of practice.
  • Reviews medication orders for completeness and refers clinical concerns, allergies, interactions, dosing issues, or prescription discrepancies to the Pharmacist for assessment and resolution before dispensing.
  • Supports patient service by providing approved medication-use instructions and referring requests for clinical counseling, therapeutic advice, adverse effects, or medication-related concerns to the Pharmacist.
  • Maintains medication stock levels within the Pharmacy and assigned ward areas, including ordering, receiving, issuing, replenishment, stock rotation, expiry monitoring, and appropriate storage of medications.
  • Participates in inventory and cycle-count activities, investigates stock discrepancies with the responsible Pharmacist, and assists in managing excess, expired, obsolete, recalled, returned, or defective pharmaceutical products.
  • Assists with controlled, semi-controlled, and narcotic medication documentation, stock reconciliation, registers, and reporting in accordance with applicable regulatory requirements and departmental controls.
  • Conducts routine checks of medication storage areas to ensure appropriate temperature, security, stock rotation, labeling, segregation, and compliance with established medication-management standards.
  • Supports inter-hospital and ward-specific medication transfers and ensures all medication movements are appropriately authorized, recorded, and traceable.
  • Ensures accurate processing of patient medication charges, credits, cash/card transactions where assigned, and other pharmacy billing activities in accordance with hospital Finance and Pharmacy procedures.
  • Maintains cleanliness, organization, security, and operational readiness of pharmacy work areas, refrigerators, medication storage areas, equipment, and supplies.
  • Reports medication incidents, near misses, adverse drug reactions, stock discrepancies, damaged products, and other safety concerns promptly to the Pharmacist and assists with required documentation and corrective actions.
  • Participates in departmental quality improvement, medication safety, inventory management, audits, accreditation readiness, and other Pharmacy initiatives as assigned.
  • Maintains patient confidentiality, professional conduct, and ethical practice and works collaboratively with Pharmacists, Pharmacy Technicians, physicians, nurses, and other healthcare professionals.
  • Performs other pharmacy-related responsibilities within approved professional scope and competency as assigned by the Pharmacist or Pharmacy leadership.

Position Qualification:

  • Diploma in Pharmacy or Bachelor’s Degree in Pharmacy from a recognized institution, subject to applicable UAE professional licensing requirements.
  • Current home-country professional registration where applicable.
  • Valid Dubai Health Authority (DHA) License/Eligibility appropriate to the professional title and assigned scope of practice.
  • Knowledge of medication dispensing processes, pharmaceutical terminology, medication storage requirements, inventory control, and pharmacy operations.
  • Good understanding of patient confidentiality, medication safety, infection prevention, and quality standards.
  • Good computer skills with the ability to accurately use pharmacy information systems, Electronic Medical Records, ERP systems, and Microsoft Office applications.
  • Strong attention to detail, organization, communication, customer service, and time-management skills.
  • Ability to prioritize workload and work effectively within a multidisciplinary healthcare team.
  • Minimum of two (2) years of relevant experience in pharmacy operations, preferably within a hospital, clinic, or other healthcare setting.
  • Experience in medication dispensing support, inventory management, ward stock management, and pharmacy billing is preferred.
  • Experience with controlled medication records, cycle counts, medication storage audits, and stock reconciliation is advantageous.
  • Experience working within a tertiary or JCI-accredited healthcare organization is preferred.
  • Ability to communicate effectively in English; Arabic language skills are advantageous.

Job Description

The Psychologist – Developmental Pediatrics (PhD  is responsible for providing specialist psychological intakes, behavioral assessments, and interventions for children and adolescents with neurodevelopmental disorders in the Outpatient Clinic. The incumbent is responsible for providing comprehensive psychological assessment and psychological/ psychoeducational/ neuropsychological testing, and for formulating/ implementing a formal psychological treatment plan for the patients. The incumbent is also responsible for providing specialist psychological advice, guidance, and consultation to other professionals contributing directly to the patient’s diagnosis and treatment plan.

Responsibilities

  • Composes comprehensive written reports of psychological and behavioral assessments. 
  • Review’s relevant school and/or other medical records to understand cases better. 
  • Communicates directly with schools and school staff, when applicable and with parental written consent for school input. 
  • Familiarizes with various different educational systems that are available in Qatar, the public and private school and healthcare system, and the local community resources, so as to be in a position to counsel parents on appropriate educational placement, accessing therapy interventions and ability-friendly programs based on the outcome of the child’s diagnostic assessments that were completed by MDT or doctoral-level clinical psychologist.  
  • Provides specialized clinical psychological input to the families, including parent counseling on parenting strategies and behavioral management of children with neurodevelopmental disorders that is evidence-based. 
  • Offers evidence-based psychological treatments to children or adolescents with neurodevelopmental disorders such as Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) or Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD) and co-morbid psychological problems such as Anxiety (e.g., Cognitive Behavioral Therapy). 
  • Provides group therapy interventions for children and families, such as social skills training for children with Autism Spectrum Disorder, and group parent education programs for parents of children with Autism Spectrum Disorder.

HealthHub Clinics, part of Al-Futtaim Health, is seeking an experienced Head Nurse to lead our nursing operations at our modern multidisciplinary clinic in Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC), Dubai.

This is a senior nursing leadership role and is ideally suited to a nurse who is already working as a Head Nurse, Charge Nurse, Nurse Supervisor, Team Leader, Clinic Lead, or Nurse Manager.

You will work closely with physicians, allied health professionals, operational teams, and senior management to ensure efficient clinic operations, outstanding patient experiences, and strong nursing team performance.

The Group has now introduced a whole new way of holistic healthcare through HealthHub Clinics by Al-Futtaim, its multi-speciality chain of more than 20 clinics in Dubai with over 25 specialties offering the right combination of advanced diagnostics, proven medical expertise and specialised services.

About Diaverum:

We are a purpose-driven organization – delivering life-enhancing renal care because everyone deserves a fulfilling life. Our standardized, world-class care delivery sets us apart. Diaverum provides life enhancing renal care to patients with Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD), enabling them to live fulfilling lives. We are one of the world’s leading providers of renal care and the largest service provider in the Middle East. Our core service is hemodialysis, but our expertise stretches far beyond this. We offer support and treatments ranging from preventive care, peritoneal dialysis and home care to the coordinated management of patients’ comorbidities and transplant services. At the heart of what we do is our highly standardized proprietary care delivery model, supported by a continuously evolving digital infrastructure.

For more details, please visit our website – Diaverum Saudi Arabia


About the Role:

To be responsible for the pharmaceutical care management for assigned clinic(s) by ensuring excellence in service delivery according to Diaverum clinical governance five core practices (clinical standards, medical standards, performance measurement, education, and scientific research). To plan, coordinate, deliver, and evaluate the pharmaceutical care service , be responsible provision of drug therapy for purpose of achieving definite therapeutic outcome that improve the patient quality of life ), wellbeing and health promotion (educational activities), Pharmaceutical supply management, scientific research and preventive care services to provide Life Enhancing Renal Care

DEFINITION OF REPORTING LINES

  • Pharmacist is accountable towards the Direct Manager with regards to meeting clinic objectives including administrative, business, medical and operational outcomes.
  • Pharmacist is accountable towards the Function Head with regards to ensuring standards of care and quality management, further specified below.
  • Annual performance evaluation, including training and development needs, is a shared responsibility between the Direct Manager and Function Head towards the Pharmacist.

ROLE WITHIN THE MULTIDISCIPLINARY TEAM (MDT)

  • Aim to cultivate pharmaceutical care that is patient-centric, evidence-based and integrated within Diaverum care delivery system.

We are looking for a Supply Chain Specialist who takes full ownership of clinic supply activities, from stock validation and requirement calculation to purchase order issuance, delivery monitoring, invoice processing and audit documentation.

The Role

The Supply Chain Specialist is responsible for managing assigned clinic supply chain activities end-to-end. You validate stock counts, calculate supply requirements, prepare and issue purchase orders, monitor deliveries, coordinate contingency actions and maintain complete documentation for traceability and audit purposes.

You will report to the Supply Chain Team Leader and work closely with clinic teams, logistics, and finance.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

You will own the supply chain cycle for your assigned clinics across twelve areas of responsibility.

This may include:

  • Receive, review and validate clinic stock-count reports for completeness, accuracy and reasonableness.
  • Investigate abnormal stock movements and follow up with clinics to resolve discrepancies.
  • Calculate supply requirements based on stock on hand, open orders, consumption and approved coverage targets.
  • Prepare and issue purchase orders through the approved process, verifying all item details before issuance.
  • Support sourcing assessments, market research and supplier pre-qualification activities.
  • Monitor deliveries against PO dates and formally follow up orders.
  • Retain all approvals, supplier communications and supporting documents for traceability and audit readiness.
  • Prepare weekly operational updates for the Supply Chain Team Leader covering open orders, shortages, delays and pending approvals.
  • Ensure all procurement activities comply with Supply Chain policies, approval requirements and company controls.

Who You Are

You take ownership of your scope. You do not wait for clinics to report shortages before following up on deliveries. You validate data before acting on it and you document everything.

You will be well-suited to this role if you:

  • Work with precision and follow through on every open item until it is resolved.
  • Communicate clearly and professionally with clinics, suppliers and internal stakeholders.
  • Identify risks early and escalate with the right level of detail.
  • Stay organised across multiple clinics, suppliers and open tasks simultaneously.
  • Take compliance and documentation seriously, not as a formality but as a professional standard.

Experience and Qualifications

We are looking for someone with real, hands-on experience in supply chain, procurement or inventory management.

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, Industrial Engineering, Healthcare Administration or a related field.
  • 2 to 5 years of experience in supply chain, procurement, inventory planning, sourcing or supplier management.
  • Fluent in Arabic and English, spoken and written.
  • Experience with ERP systems, preferably Epicor Kinetic or similar.
  • Strong Microsoft Excel skills.

Experience in the following areas will help you succeed:

  • Stock-count validation and inventory analysis in a multi-site environment.
  • Purchase order preparation, issuance and open-order management.
  • Supplier follow-up and late-delivery management.
  • Sourcing assessment and supplier pre-qualification.
  • Operational reporting and performance tracking.

What gives you an edge:

  • Healthcare, medical supply, dialysis or clinic-support experience.
  • Power Query or Power BI exposure.
  • Experience with audit-trail documentation and compliance controls.
  • Knowledge of material transfer processes and coverage planning in a regulated environment.

What Makes This Role Meaningful

Dialysis is a life-sustaining treatment. When supplies run short, patients and clinical teams pay the price. Your work as a Supply Chain Specialist directly determines whether clinics are stocked, compliant and ready to deliver care without interruption.

This is a role with real operational ownership and visibility across the organisation. You will work closely with clinic teams, suppliers and leadership and see the direct impact of what you deliver.

Ready to Make a Difference?

If you are detail-oriented, operationally strong and take pride in keeping supply chains running to a high standard, we want to hear from you.

The Medical Pre-Authorization Officer is responsible for evaluating and processing pre-authorization requests for medical services, ensuring compliance with company policies, insurance guidelines, and medical necessity criteria to facilitate efficient service delivery for policyholders. The officer will also handle case management for in-patient admissions to ensure efficient use of resources while maintaining high-quality patient care.

Key Responsibilities:

Medical Pre-Authorization:

  • Verify eligibility and coverage of the insured members.
  • Evaluate requests for medical services, diagnostics, treatments, procedures, and hospital admissions to determine coverage eligibility and compliance with policy terms.
  • Approve or deny requests based on medical necessity, policy limits, and established guidelines.
  • Assess pre-existing conditions and undeclared medical history in alignment with CCHI Unified Policy and CHI Implementing Regulations, and apply appropriate coverage exclusions where applicable.
  • Promptly and professionally communicate authorization decisions to healthcare providers and policyholders.
  • Ensure adherence to turnaround time (TAT) requirements for all pre-authorization requests.
  • Monitor utilization rates and identify early signs of fraud, waste, abuse (FWA), or suspicious patterns, including anti-selection behaviors, with the ability to report findings.

Case Management

  • Monitor inpatient admissions to ensure appropriate utilization of medical services and compliance with insurance policy terms.
  • Liaise with healthcare providers, patients, and internal teams to coordinate care plans.

Thoracic Surgeon (Cardiac + Thoracic experience is required)

Basic Function

A thoracic surgeon is a surgeon sub-specialist providing attending and consulting surgical services to patients of all age group and maintains efficient and effective care of this patient group as part of an integrated program of curative and preventive medical services.
 

Scope

Incumbents are responsible for attending ambulatory and hospitalized patients of any age group, including cases of all degrees of complexity, which are within their competence and expertise. Surgeons work at JHAH Dhahran hospital facility to meet established medical ethical and legal rules in the field of thoracic surgery and by observing practices and procedures as required by Johns Hopkins Aramco Healthcare. 

Reports to, and is under the supervision of the Chair of Heart and Vascular Department. The applicable sub-specialty provides day-to-day work including management and evaluation of the quality of patient care within their clinical privileges approved by the Credential & Privileges Committee, the Chair of Heart and Vascular Department be informed of unusual problems or action taken regarding unusual cases, within their clinical privileges approved by the credentials & Privileges committee. 

Principal Contacts

Daily contact with patients and their families, also to interact routinely with other medical and para-medical staff in performance of duties. 
 

Principal Duties

  1. Performs professional duties of a Thoracic Surgeon sub-specialist and provides expert medical- surgical care for ambulatory and hospitalized patients. 
  2. Makes daily rounds related to assigned patients in the hospital, performs general and special examinations in the field of surgical sub-specialties.

Company Description Ghonaim International CO (GIPCCO) is a growing pharmaceutical company founded in 2016 by Mr. Al Saeed Al Ghoniam, with a manufacturing facility in New Borg Al Arab City, Alexandria, Egypt. The company specializes in producing sterile products, including IV solutions, vials, ampoules, and purified water. GIPCCO’s strategy focuses on IV solutions and other sterile products that meet the needs of the Egyptian, Middle Eastern, and African markets. The manufacturing site is located in Block 15, Extension of the 4th Industrial Zone, providing a dedicated environment for high-quality pharmaceutical production. The organization is committed to expanding its presence through safe, effective, and compliant sterile manufacturing operations.

Role Description The Microbiology Section Head is a full-time, on-site role based at GIPCCO’s manufacturing facility in Alexandria, Egypt. This role oversees all microbiological testing and environmental monitoring related to sterile pharmaceutical and cosmetic manufacturing, ensuring compliance with GMP, regulatory standards, and internal quality requirements. Day-to-day responsibilities include planning and supervising microbiological analyses of raw materials, in-process samples, finished products, purified water, and cleanroom environments, as well as reviewing and approving test results and reports. The Microbiology Section Head leads a team of microbiology staff, sets work schedules and priorities, implements and updates laboratory methods and SOPs, and supports validation activities for sterilization, cleaning, and water systems. The role also involves investigating microbiological deviations, supporting root cause analyses, participating in audits, and collaborating with Quality Assurance, Production, and Engineering to maintain robust contamination control across the facility.

* Hands-on experience in environmental monitoring, water testing, sterility testing, microbial limit testing, and endotoxin testing.

* Good knowledge of aseptic processing and sterile manufacturing practices.

* Experience in handling deviations, OOS/OOT investigations, CAPA, change control, and risk assessment.

* Strong knowledge of Egyptian pharmaceutical regulatory requirements and relevant pharmacopoeias (USP, EP, BP).

* Strong leadership, communication, problem-solving, and team-management skills.

* Good command of English and strong documentation/report-writing skills.

About the job

Medical Science Liaison – Rare Disease Neurology

About Astrazeneca

AstraZeneca is a global, science-led, patient-focused biopharmaceutical company that focuses on the discovery, development, and commercialisation of prescription medicines for some of the world’s most serious diseases. But we’re more than one of the world’s leading pharmaceutical companies.

Site Description

AstraZeneca is experiencing a significant transformation in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, driven by a commitment to advancing healthcare, innovation, and sustainable growth. Building on our global legacy, AZ KSA is rapidly evolving its operations to better serve patients, collaborate with healthcare stakeholders, and contribute to the ambitious goals outlined in the Saudi Vision 2030. We are investing in talent, digital solutions, and new ways of working; all designed to enhance our impact on patient outcomes and reinforce our leadership in therapeutic areas. This dynamic environment calls for visionary, agile professionals who thrive in change and are motivated to help shape the future of healthcare in KSA. 

Role Summary

AstraZeneca is accelerating the expansion of our geographical footprint in rare diseases following the acquisition of Alexion in 2021. Rare disease is a high-growth therapy area with rapid innovation and significant unmet medical need. Over 7,000 rare diseases are known today – yet less than 1% of them have an approved treatment.

As we build our position as a Rare Disease leader, we seek a Rare Disease Medical Science Liaison to join our Medical Affairs team in Jeddah, Western Region, KSA.

As a Medical Science Liaison – Rare Disease you’ll play a pivotal role in channelling our scientific capabilities to bring an important new therapy in a rare disease setting into clinical practice, making a positive impact on patients’ lives.

The Medical Science Liaison – Rare Disease is a professional with scientific, clinical and therapeutic area expertise responsible for providing medical and scientific support to healthcare professionals aligned to the use of medicines in our combined rare disease portfolio. You will report into the Medical Manager Rare Disease.

In this role you will be expected to identify and cultivate relationships with HCPs working in the field including physicians, nurse practitioners, registered nurses and pharmacists as well as other key strategic partners, such as patient advocacy groups. You will conduct educational programs on disease state and the appropriate use of our medicines, consistent with Medical Affairs plans and objectives. You will also respond to customer inquiries to ensure focused clinical and scientific information that supports the appropriate use of these medicines.

Additionally you will deliver clinical and scientific information to support appropriate use of the medicine in the relevant therapy area in a patient focused manner; maintain expertise in disease state management, keep abreast of emerging therapies and the therapeutic landscape; gather customer insights regarding the use of the medicine in the wider therapeutic landscape to help inform medical and commercial strategies while adhering to internal standards, processes and complying with regulatory and compliance requirements.

What You’ll Do

Build, enhance, maintain the engagement with scientific leaders (KEEs)

  • Provide AZ with an understanding of the local medical community, clinical practice trends, HCP insight and real or perceived gaps in current scientific knowledge and medical treatment
  • Share emerging data with HCPs, discussing all aspects of the data in a scientific, objective, and balanced way.
  • Responsible for identifying and developing scientifically based relationships with KEEs in Saudi Arabia market.
  • Work with HCPs as partners in scientific activities that help advance disease understanding and are consistent with Medical Affairs strategy & objectives, such as:
    • Interact in the field with the medical community in the context of various medical projects such as clinical trials, Non-Interventional Studies, Investigator Sponsored Studies (ISSs), scientific exchange.
    • Identify potential speakers and train speakers as appropriate for local events
    • Provide recommendations for advisory board/Round Table discussion participants and serve as faculty/facilitators for advisory board meetings.
    • Present scientific data to HCPs in both group (Medically led meetings) and one on one setting.
    • Facilitate continuing medical education events for HCPs.

Develop or initiate scientific programs to explore unmet medical needs in priority disease area(s) through obtaining and sharing valuable insights

  • Provide actionable insights that enhance the value and appropriate use of AZ products and disease management to internal stakeholders
  • Engage in strategic planning meetings with payer customers or hospital decision makers where the discussion of scientific topics is clearly separated from discussion of promotional and/or other business topics.
  • Demonstrate expertise and knowledge of AZ products, emerging therapies, competitors, patient and treatment trends, clinical trials, and scientific activities within the Disease Area and continuously updates this expertise and knowledge based on training direction and approved resources provided.
  • Support the Medical Manager and Marketing Team in development of non-promotional and promotional materials/programs.

Act as scientific expert in priority disease area for internal stakeholders

  • Continuously acquire and update necessary scientific knowledge on therapeutic area and relevant compounds.
  • Provide the AZ internal stakeholders with an understanding of the local medical community, clinical practice, trends and real or perceived gaps in current scientific knowledge and medical treatment, competitor information
  • Provide scientific support at AZ sponsored educational events
  • Gather, monitor, and share competitor knowledge that may affect company strategies
  • Planning and executing regional medical activities during the product launch processes.

Medical Background Training

  • Serve as a medical resource for the sales representatives and accurately answer any medical question they may have to help them utilize their approved materials and to help them understand therapeutic area.
  • Participate/develop/conduct therapeutic area and product trainings and periodic scientific updates to the internal customers

Medical Information

  • Respond to unsolicited requests for information about unapproved AZ products or unapproved uses of approved products, presenting such information in an objective, well balanced, substantiated manner that is scientific in tone and content, free of promotional messages, truthful, and is not misleading

Demonstrate appropriate response and documents the provision of accurate, scientific data in response to unsolicited scientific questions posed by Healthcare providers with Company Policies, and applicable laws, regulations, and ethical standards.

Only Applications in KSA will be considered.

Essential For The Role

  • Bachelor’s degree in medicine, Pharmacy, Pharmacology.
  • Experience in rare disease therapeutic area
  • 3 or more years of experience in the Pharmaceutical industry or equivalent
  • Demonstrated expertise in synthesizing scientific information and communicating it effectively at peer level with HCPs.
  • Excellent ability to learn and capacity for scientific concepts and knowledge.
  • Experience in Neurology’s rare diseases and/or critical care specialties are highly regarded.
  • Direct patient care experience or equivalent experience in the pharmaceutical industry
  • Strong presentation skills – effectively communicating medical data/concepts
  • Excellent computer skills (Excel, Word, Power Point, etc.)
  • Excellent project management ability
  • Excellent oral and written communication and interpersonal skills
  • Strong leadership capabilities with the ability to work independently

Why AstraZeneca?

At AstraZeneca we’re dedicated to being a Great Place to Work. Where you are empowered to push the boundaries of science and unleash your entrepreneurial spirit. There’s no better place to make a difference to medicine, patients, and society. An inclusive culture that champions diversity and collaboration, and always committed to lifelong learning, growth, and development. We’re on an exciting journey to pioneer the future of healthcare.

So, what’s next?

  • Are you already imagining yourself joining our team? Good, because we can’t wait to hear from you.
  • Are you ready to bring new ideas and fresh thinking to the table? Brilliant! We have one seat available, and we hope it’s yours.

Key Responsibilities And Duties

  • Ensures patients are adequately prepared for surgery by verifying consent forms, confirming pre-anesthetic assessments, and educating them about the surgical process via direct communication and SMS.
  • Provides information about the surgical process and pre-operative preparation to patients and families.
  • Conducts comprehensive assessments of patients scheduled for surgery, including medical history, current medications, allergies, and psychosocial factors, and ensure that relevant steps are in place.
  • Discusses management plans with the treating physician and ensure that proper booking and diagnostic tests are completed promptly.
  • Collaborates with surgical teams, anesthesiologists, and nursing staff to develop and implement individualized perioperative care plans. Ensures that additional referrals, extra payments, and device availability are managed to avoid cancellations.
  • Maintains detailed records of patient interactions, care plans, and outcomes to ensure compliance with Fakeeh Care policies and regulatory requirements.
  • If delays occur in the operating room, actively resolve the issues by communicating with the concerned parties.
  • Evaluates patients thoroughly upon admission, using referrals and unit rounds to identify their needs and determine care requirements for effective care coordination.

  • Creates and adjusts individualized care plans based on ongoing assessments and patient feedback, ensuring all aspects of patient care are addressed.
  • Starts discharge planning at the time of admission by evaluating potential post-place needs and facilitating a smooth transition to suitable care settings.

Provides specialised sports medicine care within the ICC physical clinic on a part-time, in-person basis, addressing a broad range of musculoskeletal and exercise-related conditions. Evaluates, diagnoses, and manages acute and chronic sports-related injuries, including patients with muscle, tendon, and ligament injuries, joint pain, overuse injuries, and those requiring concussion assessment or return-to-play evaluation. Delivers evidence-based, patient-centered care during scheduled part-time in-clinic sessions, ensuring continuity of care, appropriate diagnostic work-up, and injury management for patients seen. Professional Development

About the job

Purpose of Job:

  • The Medical Validator is responsible for reviewing and validating all medical records, clinical documentation, and claim-related information to ensure accuracy, completeness, consistency, and medical appropriateness prior to claim submission. The role serves as a critical quality gate between clinical operations and Revenue Cycle Management (RCM), ensuring that all medical reports and claims are medically justified, quantitatively accurate, qualitatively complete, and compliant with requirements before being handed over to the RCM team for submission and collection.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Review and validate inpatient, outpatient, emergency, and day-case medical records to ensure completeness and accuracy of clinical documentation.
  • Verify that diagnoses, procedures, investigations, medications, and treatment plans are adequately documented in the medical record and justified by the medical necessity.
  • Assess and validate the medical necessity and appropriateness of services rendered in accordance with accepted clinical practice and requirements.
  • Review claims and medical documentation prior to submission to ensure medical accuracy, consistency, and readiness for reimbursement.
  • Validate the qualitative aspects of medical records, including documentation completeness, clinical justification, physician notes, operative reports, discharge summaries, and supporting reports.
  • Validate the quantitative aspects of claims, including diagnoses, procedures, length of stay, utilization of services, consumables, investigations, and billed items against the documented medical record.
  • Intervene in cases of suspected Fraud, Waste, and Abuse (FWA), collaborating closely with physicians, medical teams, and healthcare practitioners to execute corrective actions that minimize financial loss while prioritizing patient safety and quality of care.
  • Ensure alignment between clinical documentation and claim data prior to submission.
  • Identify missing, incomplete, or unsupported clinical information that may affect claim approval or reimbursement and coordinate timely resolution with the relevant clinical teams.
  • Support denial prevention by identifying documentation and medical necessity gaps before claiming submission.
  • Collaborate closely with physicians, nursing teams, medical records staff, coding teams, billing and the Revenue Cycle Management department to improve claim quality and submission accuracy.
  • Provide medical clarification and validation support for claim-related inquiries and documentation requirements.

Job Requirements:

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in medicine (MBBS) or equivalent healthcare qualification. Preferably a Physician, could be Dentist or Pharmacist.

Certifications:

  • Certifications in healthcare quality, medical coding, health insurance, or revenue cycle management are advantageous.

Experience:

  • Minimum 2–3 years of experience in clinical practice, medical claims management, medical review, health insurance, or revenue cycle operations.
  • Experience in both medical documentation review and claims handling is highly preferred.

Technical Skills and Knowledge:

  • Proficiency in data reporting and analytics using Excel, PPT, and Power BI.
  • Proficiency in Electronic Medical Records (EMR) and healthcare information systems.
  • Desirable experience with ICD coding principles, and healthcare insurance practices.
  • Soft Skills: Excellent command of English, strong communication and stakeholder management skills, problem solving, and the ability to take initiative while working effectively within a team.

Job Role

We are seeking an experienced Homecare & Doctor On-Call Manager to lead and manage our Home Healthcare and Doctor On-Call services in Dubai.

The successful candidate must be a physician holding a valid DHA professional licence / eligibility to practice in Dubai and will provide both operational and clinical leadership across the services.

The role is responsible for ensuring the safe, efficient and high-quality delivery of patient care while overseeing multidisciplinary clinical teams, workforce planning, service performance, patient experience and regulatory compliance. The Manager will work closely with physicians, nurses, caregivers, therapists, administrative teams and senior management to ensure consistently high standards of care and service delivery.

Key Responsibilities

Operations & Service Delivery

  • Lead the day-to-day operations of the Home Healthcare and Doctor On-Call services.
  • Manage patient demand, staff deployment, physician schedules, on-call rosters, shifts, leave coverage and emergency replacements.
  • Ensure appropriate staffing levels and clinical coverage based on patient requirements and service demand.
  • Coordinate the delivery of home healthcare services to ensure timely, safe and efficient patient care.
  • Work closely with medical, nursing, operations and administrative teams to ensure effective continuity of care.
  • Monitor service utilisation, operational performance, staffing requirements and associated costs.
  • Support the continued development and growth of Home Healthcare and Doctor On-Call services.

Clinical Leadership & Patient Care

  • Provide clinical oversight and leadership across Home Healthcare and Doctor On-Call services.
  • Supervise and support physicians, nurses, caregivers, therapists and other clinical personnel.
  • Review and oversee patient care plans and ensure appropriate coordination between physicians, nurses, patients, families and other healthcare professionals.
  • Ensure clinical services are delivered in accordance with approved policies, procedures, clinical guidelines and professional standards.
  • Provide clinical guidance and support for complex cases, escalations and patient safety concerns.
  • Ensure appropriate clinical handover, referral and escalation processes are maintained.

Quality, Governance & DHA Compliance

  • Ensure full compliance with Dubai Health Authority (DHA) requirements and all other applicable UAE healthcare regulations and standards.
  • Maintain appropriate clinical governance, patient safety and quality-management processes.
  • Ensure accurate, complete and timely clinical and operational documentation.
  • Lead and support quality improvement, infection prevention and control, health and safety, and risk-management initiatives.
  • Ensure incidents and clinical concerns are appropriately reported, investigated and followed through with corrective and preventive actions.
  • Support regulatory inspections, audits, licensing requirements and accreditation activities where applicable.

Patient Experience

  • Maintain a strong focus on patient experience, quality of care and service responsiveness.
  • Monitor patient satisfaction and identify opportunities for service improvement.
  • Manage patient and family concerns, complaints and clinical escalations professionally and ensure timely resolution.
  • Ensure service standards consistently meet or exceed patient expectations.

Team Leadership & Development

  • Lead, supervise and support multidisciplinary clinical and operational teams.
  • Participate in recruitment, onboarding, orientation, training and competency assessment of clinical staff.
  • Conduct performance reviews and support ongoing professional development.
  • Monitor staff attendance, performance, competency and compliance with organisational policies and regulatory requirements.
  • Promote a professional, accountable and patient-focused working environment.

Performance & Business Support

  • Monitor and report on relevant KPIs including patient volumes, response times, service utilisation, patient satisfaction, clinical quality and workforce performance.
  • Support budgeting, resource planning and cost management across the services.
  • Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency while maintaining clinical quality and patient safety.
  • Support business development activities, referral relationships and service expansion initiatives where appropriate.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Medical degree (MBBS, MBChB, MD or equivalent) from a recognised institution.
  • Valid DHA physician licence or eligibility to practise as a physician in Dubai is mandatory.
  • Minimum 7 years of relevant healthcare experience, including healthcare management, home healthcare, primary care, medical operations or clinical leadership (mandatory).
  • Previous experience within Home Healthcare and/or Doctor On-Call services in the UAE is strongly preferred.
  • Strong understanding of DHA regulations, clinical governance and UAE healthcare requirements.
  • Demonstrated experience managing multidisciplinary healthcare teams.
  • Strong knowledge of patient care coordination, clinical quality, patient safety and healthcare operations.
  • Good financial and commercial awareness, including budgeting, resource utilisation and cost management.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, organisational and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple operational and clinical priorities within a fast-paced healthcare environment.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to engage effectively with patients, families, healthcare professionals, regulators and internal and external stakeholders.
