Technologist II – Pathology Sciences (Qatari Nationals)

Qatar

Be the First to Apply

Job Description

The Technologist II – Pathology Sciences assists in the commissioning of the relevant sections. This involves the commissioning of equipment, IT systems, recruitment, on-boarding and training of staff, preparing policies and procedures in accordance with CAP and JCI. The incumbent performs pre-batching, pooling, and processing of human donor samples for PCR testing in accordance with established Standard Operating Procedures. The incumbent is part of a team of Biomedical Scientists/Technologists delivering high quality services in their specialty and has operational oversight of a team within the department.   

Responsibilities

  • Organizes, supervises and participates in the work of the section. Works unsupervised, but under the direction of the Supervisor – Pathology Sciences. 
  • Answers enquiries and communicates patient results to clinicians, surgeons and nursing staff both internally and external to Sidra. 
  • Provides specialist technical advice on specimen handling to clinicians, surgeons and nursing staff. 
  • Actively supervises other staffs within their section to ensure an efficient throughput of work as directed by the Supervisor. 
  • Assists the Supervisor – Pathology Sciences in the implementation of management decisions affecting the sections, as documented above. 
  • Maintains co-operation between the section and between disciplines by regular liaison with other section leads and senior staff.  This includes attendance at staff meetings.  
  • Leads by good example in order to motivate staff to create high quality work, interest and contribution. 
  • Actively participates in the technical work of the section.  
  • In liaison with the Supervisor – Pathology Sciences ensures adequate stocks of reagents and consumables are available for the efficient running of the service. 
  • Uses LIS to generate workload statistics and run queries. 
  • In liaison with Supervisor – Pathology Sciences, provides technical advice on, and assists in the selection of new equipment. 
  • Performs all aspects of PCR pre-batching, pooling, processing, test result entry, equipment maintenance and sample management functions to ensure accuracy and appropriate product pooling is performed, completed, and reported in a timely manner.  
  • Performs routine and non-routine analyses of DNA according to established testing methods and protocols in a high throughput environment.  
  • Monitors and advises on the use of reagents and consumables in the section. 
  • Takes responsibility for the maintenance and safe use of equipment within the section. 
  • Reviews batching and pooling documents, quality control, and other reports for accuracy, completeness and compliance to requirements to ensure that quality standards are met.  
  • Participates in operational excellence initiatives and projects to drive a culture of continuous improvement to achieve operational excellence.  
  • Facilitates improvements to processes and methodologies where appropriate. 
  • Assists in organization and scheduling of analytical activities to ensure service requests are accurately run within the allotted time and testing priorities are met. 
  • Communicates with Lab Coordinator and stakeholders regarding identified laboratory processes or quality issues. 
  • Utilizes laboratory data handling systems to document, communicate and archive results. 
  • Monitors quality of critical testing equipment, performing calibrations, verifications and maintenance of systems as necessary. 
  • Documents out-of-tolerance occurrences and takes corrective actions as per the laboratories quality management systems. 
  • Networks with other technical experts to leverage problem solving and prevention expertise and where appropriate share technology. 
  • Contributes to value creation by continuous improvement of procedures in the analytical work processes and related tools and performance metrics. 
  • Ensures the integrity of analytical data and timely/accurate interpretation of results, updating the company databases.  
  • Ensures work is performed to the highest standards of safety and quality and the working environment is clean and tidy.  
  • Proactively develops and expand knowledge and experience of other analytical techniques. 
  • Adheres to Sidra’s standards as they appear in the Code of Conduct and Conflict of Interest policies 
  • Adheres to and promotes Sidra’s Values 

In view of the evolving needs and opportunities within Sidra, this position may be required to perform other duties as assigned and reporting relationships may vary. 

Qualifications

metas.experience: 5+ years of experience working with advanced analytical lab equipment (liquid handlers, automatic pipettes, plate readers)  Experience in LIS operations
metas.qualification: Bachelor’s degree in lab based Molecular Biology, Biochemistry, Biology or other biological science field.

Performs activities for the diagnosis and treatment of patients receiving care in Fakeeh Care facilities.

USRC’s greatest strength in being a leader in the dialysis industry is our ability to recognize and celebrate the differences in our diverse workforce. We strongly believe in recruiting top talent and creating a diverse and inclusive work climate and culture at all levels of our organization.

SUMMARY

  • Responsible for preventing and reducing Healthcare-Associated Infections (HAIs) among patients, visitors, and staff, and for coordinating the facility Infection Prevention and Control (IPC) Program in accordance with GDIPC/MOH requirements, accreditation standards, scientific references, internal policies, and approved governance structures.
  • The role leads and coordinates IPC risk assessment, annual planning, surveillance, data analysis, reporting, consultation, education, audits, outbreak response, communicable disease reporting, and corrective action follow-up to maintain a safe dialysis care environment.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Develop, implement, and periodically review the Infection Prevention and Control (IPC) Program, annual plan, priorities, and policies based on Infection Control Risk Assessment (ICRA).
  • Ensure compliance with Ministry of Health (MOH), General Department of Infection Prevention and Control (GDIPC), Weqaya, CBAHI, applicable international standards, and approved USRC policies.
  • Conduct infection surveillance using approved methodologies and monitor dialysis-related infection indicators and transmission risks.
  • Analyze surveillance and audit data, identify trends, and recommend performance improvement initiatives.
  • Maintain IPC evidence files, surveillance records, audit schedules, committee reports, corrective action plans (CAPA), and closure evidence.
  • Report IPC performance indicators, surveillance findings, and significant risks to the IPC Committee, QAPI, leadership, and regulatory authorities, including escalation when required.
  • Report communicable diseases and notifiable events through approved MOH reporting channels.
  • Conduct IPC audits, environmental rounds, and infection control risk assessments.
  • Oversee infection prevention practices, including hand hygiene, PPE use, isolation precautions, sharps safety, waste management, environmental cleaning, disinfection, sterilization, safe injection practices, and dialysis station turnover practices.
  • Oversee environmental hygiene activities and identify infection risks within clinical and support service areas, including kitchen environments.
  • Investigate outbreaks, exposure incidents, and significant IPC risks, and coordinate corrective and preventive actions.
  • Oversee staff screening, immunization, occupational exposure management, and post-exposure activities in collaboration with relevant stakeholders.
  • Provide IPC orientation, education, consultation, and technical guidance to staff, patients, families, and multidisciplinary teams.
  • Collaborate with medical, nursing, laboratory, housekeeping, biomedical, dietary, HR, and operational teams to support IPC activities and regulatory compliance.
  • Ensure IPC responsibilities, protected time, and resources are appropriately documented and allocated in accordance with applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Full-Time IPC Assignment: An IPC Nurse designated as a Full-Time IPC Practitioner shall be assigned exclusively to Infection Prevention and Control activities and shall not be considered part of the routine nursing staffing allocation or assigned routine patientcare, dialysis, staffing-coverage, or other non-IPC duties.
  • Solid Line – Head Nurse: Responsible for administrative matters, including attendance, leave, scheduling, timesheets, and daily administrative coordination.
  • Dotted Line – Clinical Services Director: Responsible for functional oversight of the IPC program, including surveillance, audits, MOH reporting, training, technical guidance, and IPC performance evaluation.
  • Medical Director: Provides clinical governance and escalation support as required.
  • Perform other duties related to the Infection Prevention and Control Program as assigned.
  • The position shall not be assigned routine patientcare, dialysis shift, staffing-coverage, or other non-IPC responsibilities where the position is designated as a full-time IPC Practitioner

QUALIFICATIONS REQUIREMENTS:

Education Requirements:

  • Registered Nurse (RN) with Bachelor or High Diploma Degree in Nursing (for Non-Saudi candidates).
  • Bachelor’s degree in nursing or two (2) years Associate Degree/Diploma in Nursing (for Saudi candidates).
  • Infection prevention and control education, training, or certification is required/preferred according to the approved role assignment and regulatory requirements.

Experience Requirements:

  • Minimum two (2) years of training and experience in dialysis.
  • Minimum one (1) year of relevant IPC experience, or completion of an applicable IPC certification/training pathway accepted by MOH/GDIPC.

Other Requirements:

  • Current Registered Nurse Licensure from a country of origin.
  • Certified and registered with the Saudi Commission for Health Specialties is required.
  • Certified in BLS from Saudi or American Heart Association and preferably in ACLS
  • Successfully passed the hemodialysis training program is an advantage.
  • Passed color vision or color blindness test.

JOB SUMMARY

The physician qualifying for this position will be held responsible for applying medical knowledge and skills to implement anesthetic care plans for CCAD patients within the purview of the Anesthesiology Institute at Cleveland Clinic Abu Dhabi-(CCAD).

PRIMARY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Preoperative Evaluation:

  • Evaluate patients’ medical histories, physical examinations, and surgical risks to determine anesthetic risk stratification, formulate appropriate anesthetic plans and adequately counsel patients about benefits and alternate plans before they sign informed consents.

Develop Anesthesia Care Plans:

  • The anesthesiologist will be expected to develop anesthesia care plans tailored to patients’ individual needs and the complexity of the surgical/non-surgical procedures involved Care plans should include strategies to manage potential risks and complications.
  • The anesthesiologist is expected to be proficient in the use of a variety of anesthesia modalities (such as TCI and regional anesthetic techniques), as well as the use of the wide range of invasive and non-invasive monitoring techniques.

Responding to Emergencies:

  • The anesthesiologist must be prepared to respond to an array of emergencies in the clinical care areas where anesthetics are provided.
  • Furthermore, he/she might be called on to assist with the care of critically ill patients in clinical areas across CCAD.

Caring with empathy:

  • The anesthesiologist must be capable of providing care in a culturally appropriate and sensitive manner.

Postoperative Care:

  • The anesthesiologist will be responsible for ensuring that patients recover safely from anesthesia in a level of care that’s appropriate for the patient’s clinical condition.
  • The anesthesiologist must be adept in the hand-off of patient care (especially critically ill patients).

Team Collaboration:

  • The anesthesiologist will be expected to work collaboratively with CCAD medical and non-medical staff to ensure the best possible outcomes for the patient. That includes participations in multi-disciplinary collaborations and consultations.

Provide Consultation Services:

  • This includes providing advice and recommendations related to anesthesia/sedation administration or assisting in the development of anesthesia plans for high-risk patients. Moreover, it includes consulting on pain management care plans for surgical and non-surgical patients and assisting with life-threatening emergencies when needed.

Continuing Education:

  • The anesthesiologist will be expected to keep up to date with the latest advances in anesthesia techniques, medications, and equipment to provide the best possible care to CCAD patients.
  • He/she will also be expected to meet the CME requirements to maintain DOH licensing in the emirate of Abu Dhabi and in their home countries as well as those needed to maintain CCAD privileges.

Administrative functions:

  • The anesthesiologist will be expected to adhere to CCAD policies related to documentation, billing, and key performance indicators (KPIs) that ensure the optimal operations of the clinical environment.
  • He/she may be asked to serve on committees, task forces and performance improvement projects that adhere to the Mubadala ethics and regulatory guidelines.

Work hour compliance:

  • The anesthesiologist will be expected to work flexible shifts, including nights, weekends, and holidays according to departmental policies and procedures.

Clinical privileges:

The anesthesiologist will adhere to the extent of his/her individual approved clinical privileges, as well as to all policies and procedures of the staff physicians’ bylaws.

EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS

  • CCAD is a tertiary center of surgical excellence therefore anesthesiologist must meet the following requirements to qualify for employment:

Consultant anesthesiologists must have a minimum of:

  • 3 years of independent work experience post-graduation if they completed training in a Tier-1 classified country.
  • 5 years of independent work experience post-graduation if they completed training in a Tier-2 classified country.

EDUCATION REQUIREMENTS

For a job description, I would write it as:

Basic Purpose of the role

Responsible for rendering professional nursing care to patients within an assigned unit of the hospital, ensuring that nursing care is an integral part of the total patient care plan, working in conjunction with the medical staff and according to policies and procedures of the hospital. This will be in keeping with the accepted principles of professional nursing practice.

Key responsibilities of the role

Managerial/Administration    Manages clinical and operational activities at ward level and ensure the provision of optimum clinical care, customer satisfaction and patient safety.Demonstrate ability to adapt to varied age-specific patient populations.

Maintains an effective rapport with patients, visitors, physicians, and other member of the hospital team.

Promotes confidentiality and uses complete discretion when discussing information.

Works collaboratively with other staff members to provide continuous service to the organisation.

Ability to express self in the areas of communication verbal, written and non-verbal.

Demonstrates knowledge of current computer system used in the organisation.

Demonstrates adherence to safety and risk management policies as evidenced by in-service attendance records and employee practices.

Ensures the reporting of all adverse events, incidents and near misses.

Contributes to investigations of complaints and incidents and draft responses as required in a timely manner.

Contributes to the monitoring of key performance indicators and developing action plans as required

Technical    Responsible for the implementation and delivery of age appropriate patient care congruent with the mission, vision and values of the organisation. 

Undertake comprehensive and holistic assessment of the patients nursing care needs.

Develops a plan of care, which is evidence based and planned in partnership with the patient wherever possible.

Collaborates with nursing staff and multidisciplinary teams on effective patient management ensure appropriate and timely interventions for patients and for discharge planning. 

Documents patient assessment findings, physical/psychosocial responses to nursing intervention.

Provides a comprehensive clinical handover / report as required to ensure patient safety using SBAR principles.

Establish priorities of care, nursing actions and desired outcomes in a timely manner.

Performs required clinical procedures competently and ensures competencies are current as outlined in the Clinical Competency Framework

Attends meetings pertinent to department.

Acts as shift coordinator as required.

Reports unsafe practice to the nurse in charge. 

Performs appropriate treatments as ordered by physician in an accurate and timely manner.

Provides care in a non-judgmental, non-discriminatory manner that is sensitive to the patient’s and family diversity, preserving their autonomy, dignity and rights.

Reports patient’s condition to appropriate medical personnel during each shift.

Educates patients on health risk factors.

Uses the nursing process in the promotion of patient holistic health and wellbeing.

Uses ward resources such as dressings and clinical items in a cost effective and responsible manner

Other responsibilities

Quality & Safety    Participates as assigned on committees, working groups and other organization activities.

Communicates with patient care team ongoing changes in patient’s plan of care and unit activity.
Education    Contributes to product evaluation at unit levels and participates in trials related to new product lines as appropriate.

Acts as a preceptor to less experienced staff as required.

Patient and family teaching as required.

Actively participates in organisational change in a constructive manner.

Actively participates in the Clinical Competency Programme.

Actively participates in the process for ensuring the organisation achieves and maintains JCIA status.

Engages in health promotion activities in the organization and community.

Responsible for educating less experienced staff in adverse drug reaction and the process to be followed for medication errors.

Compliance guidelines

Complying with Policies, Procedures and Practices of Al Reem Integrated Healthcare Center Facilities and other Regulatory Requirements    Participates in the development of policies and procedures in the units.

Understands actions of medication and contraindications, evaluates patient’s response, identifies side effects and initiates appropriate action. 

Responsible to ensure that on a shift basis at unit level, the monitoring, replacement, storage and administration of Narcotic and Controlled Drugs is in accordance with Ministry of Health and Department of Health Narcotic Policies and Procedures.
Maintaining Confidentiality    Maintains confidentiality regarding patient/staff information.

Ensures all nursing and allied health staff maintains confidentiality regarding patient/staff information.
Promoting Customer Service Standards    Promotes positive public relations with patients, peers, medical staff and members of the general public.

Collaborates with personnel from non-clinical department/disciplines regarding issues that may negatively impact patient care;  facilitate solutions as needed.
Adhering to the Occupational Health and Safety, Materials Management and Maintenance Standards    Adheres to requirements of the Occupational Health and Safety Guidelines and Infection Control Guidelines.

Understands and adheres to emergency preparedness plans/policies.

Maintains compliance in relation to the Occupational Health and Safety standards.

The position does have exposure to malodorous, infectious body fluids from patients and some minimal exposure to noxious smells from cleansing agents.

The position requires exposure to infectious wastes such as blood and body fluids that mandate the wearing of gloves, masks and goggles for every actual or potential exposure.
Ensuring Personal Effectiveness    
Facilitates effective communication between the patient, family and the interdisciplinary health care team as required.

Demonstrates improvement in clinical practice as a result of application of new theoretical knowledge and technology.

Initiates or participates in Nursing and or other disciplines research that contributes to continual improvement in standards of care.

Obtains accredited and non-accredited Continuing Nursing Education (CNE) Units in compliance with Department of Health and the organization’s requirements.

Actively participates in the annual system of performance review.

Qualifications, Certifications and Experience

Qualifications    Bachelor of Science degree in Nursing 
Maintains valid, current RN licensure from own country. 
BLS, certified.
Certified proof of yearly CME.

Specialist Certifications    Specialist Nursing certifications such as Critical Care Nursing or Paediatric Nursing is advantageous.

Experience Required in addition to the Qualifications mentioned above  (Relevant to the Job)    Minimum of 2 years clinical experience.
International accreditation experience is an advantage.
Additional Requirements / Remarks    The ability to influence and implement change.
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
Able to work independently and collaboratively with others.
Organized and able to work methodically.
Excellent leadership skills.
Able to relate to people from different cultural backgrounds.
Fluent in both written and spoken English.

Physical requirements

The position requires a considerable amount of physical work. The individual must be able to quickly manoeuvre throughout halls, stairways and patient rooms in response to hospital emergencies. The following denote the key physical requirements for the job, which may require: Standing, Simple Grasping, Fine Manipulation, Operation Machinery / Equipment, Lifting / overhead reaching, Twisting, Climbing / Balancing, Crouching / Squatting, Reaching and Manual handling of people of approximately 100kg.  Lifting equipment must be used whenever practicable.

In addition the position requires office work involving extensive use of the computer and interdepartmental coordination. Typical physical demands include: a high degree of manual dexterity to sufficiently perform computer functions on a keyboard, produce materials on a PC and operate basic office equipment, normal or corrected vision and hearing, extensive sitting and walking, mobility sufficient to visit with departments or employees throughout the facility and lift up to 13 kgs.

  • Clinical Excellence: Lead and supervise the delivery of high-quality, evidence-based care, effectively diagnosing, managing, and treating all patients within the post holder’s specialty.
  • Patient Care: Conduct patient examinations, take detailed medical histories, order and interpret diagnostic tests, prescribe medications and therapies, and develop comprehensive treatment plans. This includes leading ward rounds and managing both inpatient and outpatient cases.
  • Supervision and Training: Oversee the clinical activities of junior medical staff (specialists, GP’s and Residents), and actively participate in their instruction, guidance, and supervision.
  • Multidisciplinary Collaboration: Liaise with other medical specialties and support services and participate in multi-disciplinary meetings to ensure holistic patient care.
  • On-Call Coverage: Participate in and ensure the provision of out-of-hours (on-call) coverage on a rotational basis, including evenings, nights, weekends, and public holidays.
  • Documentation and Compliance: Accurately and clearly document all relevant clinical information in a timely fashion. Comply with all hospital, departmental, and DOH policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements, including infection control and patient safety standards.
  • Quality Improvement: Participate in clinical audits, performance management systems (including peer review), and proactive risk management to foster continuous improvement in patient outcomes.
  • Communication: Communicate clinical information to patients and their families in a timely and compassionate manner, ensuring informed consent is obtained for procedures.

Qualifications

Qualifications and Requirements

  • Education: An MBBS or equivalent degree from a recognized medical school, followed by the successful completion of a structured specialty training program (e.g., North American/European Board Certification, Fellowship of a Royal College, or equivalent qualification from a DOH-approved ‘Tier 1’ or ‘Tier 2’ country). A postgraduate qualification such as MD, MS, or DNB is generally required.
  • Experience: A minimum of 3-7 years of post-specialty clinical experience, depending on the qualification and tier level, in a recognized multidisciplinary setting. Experience gaps of more than two years require specific DOH approval or a return-to-practice program.
  • Licensing: Eligibility of or a valid DOH (Department of Health Abu Dhabi) license to practice in Abu Dhabi is a mandatory legal requirement. The process involves:
    • Primary Source Verification (PSV): Mandatory verification of all educational and professional documents through the Data Flow Group.
    • DOH Exam: Successful completion of the DOH license exam unless exempted based on Tier 1 qualifications/experience.
    • Good Standing Certificate: A valid certificate from the current/previous licensing authority.
  • Skills: Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, strong leadership abilities, problem-solving skills, and a commitment to continuous medical education (CME/CPD).
  • Language: Fluency in English and Arabic is required, and competence in other languages is often a distinct asset.

Job Description
Key Accountabilities

These must be upheld in accordance with the UAE Code of Conduct, Scope of Practice and licensure as per the regulator.

The post holder will:

Always speak up if safety is a concern

Treat all patients with kindness, respect and compassion

Recognize and work within the limits of their own competence

Take responsibility for their own actions

Communicate effectively with colleagues to ensure patients receives the safest, most effective care possible

Perform additional duties when required

Education and Training:

Ensure relevant training and competency is undertaken to deliver care safely.

Maintain up-to-date mandatory training requirements.

Follow and comply with the NMC Nurse Competency Matrix / Framework, relevant to their role profile.

Be willing to learn new clinical skills and actively contribute to the learning culture through attendance of journal clubs and professional development programs.

Support and supervise pre-registration and new nurses and other health care workers when required.

Participate in teaching, mentorship and preceptorship when required.

Participate in clinical supervision of student nurses, newly graduated nurses, newly hired experienced nurses, return to practice nurses and nurses undergoing cross-training or upskilling.

Participate in Performance Improvement Plans when required.

Share knowledge and skill with others, to improve patient care and services.

Ensure they are skilled, trained and competent before using any medical device.

Involve patients in their own healthcare and recovery through education, awareness and positive reinforcement.

Quality Assurance and Governance:

Speak up, if something isn’t right.

Maintain awareness of and comply with, the NMC Policies and Procedures

Participate in all activities related to DOH/DHA/MOH/MOHAP and NMC Quality Improvement when required.

Uphold the regulatory and accreditation standards.

Continually seek to improve the service of and care delivery for patients and their families.

Report and notify all untoward/serious and near miss incidents to your direct line manager and then through the incident reporting system in a timely manner.

Cooperate with all investigations and audits when requested to do so in the interest of developing a learning culture and seeking to improve care and services.

Promote customer service based on NMC patient satisfaction results.

Share best practices and quality patient outcomes through audit.

Be aware of the impact of nursing care on patient outcomes measured through Nursing Sensitive Key Performance Indicators and external benchmarks.

Contribute to a positive practice environment, upholding the six standards of ANCC Pathway to Excellence®.

Professional:

Always uphold the reputation of the nursing profession.

Act as a positive role model for all nursing and support staff.

Must have insight of own behaviour and in others.

Be responsible for the assessment, planning, implementation and evaluation of programmes of care under the indirect supervision of senior nursing staff.

Comply will all aspects of the UAE Code of Conduct, Scope of Practice and licensure as per the regulator.

Refuse to undertake any task for which he/she has not been trained and is not competent to undertake.

Always seek expert help when the demand of care, service or skill, falls outside their capabilities.

Only delegate tasks to those team members who are trained, skilled and competent to undertake such tasks.

Assist in updating clinical policies and guidelines in line with skill and experience.

Assist, engage with and contribute to the professional development of colleagues.

Ensure re-licensure is managed in a timely manner.

Always maintain patient confidentiality.

Ensure timely expert advice or senior nursing support is sought when a patient’s condition fails to respond to prescribed treatment.

Manage a deteriorating patient without delay, using the Early Warning System escalation process and American Heart Association emergency algorithms.

Equality and Diversity:

The post holder is required to promote diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging in service delivery and employment practices. All employees must comply with NMC equality and diversity policies, procedures and initiatives.

Infection Prevention and Control (IPC):

IPC is everyone’s responsibility. All staff are required to read and implement the NMC IPC Policy and Strategy to maintain the highest possible standards of cleanliness at all times, thus reducing the risk of infection in patients, staff and visitors.

The strictest hand hygiene complianceencompassing, 5 moments of hand hygiene, bare below the elbows and environmental care, will be expected of all staff, including the post holder, at all times.

Safeguarding Children:

NMC is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of all children and vulnerable adults and expects all employees to share this commitment.

Please refer to Federal Law No. 3 of 2016 (Wadeema’s Law)

Occupational Safety and Health Management Systems (OSHMS)

Comply with OSHMS instructions, policies and safe working procedures.

Use of appropriate personal protective equipment and safety systems.

Be familiar with emergency and evacuation procedures.

Not wilfully or recklessly endanger anyone’s health and safety.

Assist with the preparation of risk assessments.

Report OSH Hazards, incidents, near misses and issues.

Reduce, Reuse, Recycling of waste as much as possible.

Attend all OSH Trainings, awareness programs and mock drills.

Participates in the OSHMS audits, inspections, ensuring standards are maintained.

Specific Responsibilities for this Role

National Nursing Practice Standards RN MOHAP.pdf

Scope of Practice RN MOHAP.pdf

Registered Nurse will:

Be responsible for providing and coordinating patient care, educating patients and the public about various health conditions, and providing advice and emotional support to patients and their family members.

Assess and identify patients’ needs and implement and monitor the patient’s medical plan and treatment. They will work with a team of physicians and other health care specialists or allied health in various settings.

Perform systematic patient assessment, re-assessment and collect pertinent data about the patient’s health or situation.

Understand and analyse the assessment information and data.

Determine actual and potential nursing diagnoses, problems, and issues.

Define the predicted and expected outcomes of the patient’s planned care.

Create and evaluate patient care plans with the interprofessional team, in collaboration with the patient and patient’s bystanders.

Record vital signs, recognize, address and escalate all abnormalities.

Maintain and update technical and clinical skills related to nursing practice.

Employ strategies to promote patients’ health and a safe environment.

Understand different diagnostic tests and laboratory examinations.

Perform essential life support as per regulatory requirements and scope such as but not limited to Basic Life Support, Pediatric Advanced Life Support, Advanced Cardiac Life Support, Neonatal Resuscitation etc.

Prepare patients for medical examination and treatment.

Administer medications and monitor patients for any side effects and reactions.

Administer treatments such as IV fluids or blood products and monitor patients for any reactions.

Provide wound care management.

Assist in medical procedures invasive or non-invasive as needed.

Facilitate the process of safe patient`s admission, transfer and discharge.

The ​Technologist I – Immunochemistry​ performs a broad range of technical and analytical work with a high level of individual skill and judgment, under minimal supervision. The incumbent is required to observe and maintain a high standard of laboratory health, safety and risk procedures; and works to departmental Standard Operating Procedures, and current professional standards. The Technologist I – Immunochemistry is actively involved in the laboratories continuing professional development program, preparing and delivering presentations to a range of staff, attending internal and external lectures, and undertaking additional training courses as required. The ​Technologist I – Immunochemistry​ is part of a team of Biomedical Scientists/Technologists delivering high quality services in their specialty. 

Responsibilities

  • Actively participates in the technical and analytical work of the section. 
  • Takes responsibility for the maintenance and safe use of equipment within the section. 
  • Determines acceptability of specimens and/or blood or blood components, performs laboratory tests and communicates critical results in accordance with laboratory policy for assigned section and/or obtains and records results for laboratory tests according to established procedures. 
  • Liaises with Technologist II and Supervisor – Clinical Biochemistry on appropriateness of tests, results and additional testing as required. 
  • Monitors, records and reports back results, participates in discussions to rectify areas of concern if necessary.

  • In liaison with the Technologist II and the Supervisor – Clinical Biochemistry, provides technical advice on, and assists in the selection / validation of new equipment. 
  • Takes responsibility for the maintenance and safe use of equipment within the section.

Job Description

Category Management: Build and execute category strategies tailored to customer demographics and store profile. Review category performance weekly and recommend actions to improve sales and profitability; introduce new ranges based on trends; Phase out slow-moving and underperforming products. Analyse customer buying behaviour, market trends and competitor activity to identify opportunities and optimise product assortments. 

Merchandise Planning: Create annual/seasonal plans, forecast demand and inventory needs, allocate stock across stores, and maintain optimal product mix while minimizing excess inventory and Ensure the right product mix is maintained in every store.

Inventory Management: Monitor inventory health across all categories, improve turn and sell through, reduce aged/obsolete stock, Develop action plans for slow-moving stock. Manage full product life cycles, and partner with vendors on replenishment. Optimise inventory investment and working capital while maximising stock productivity and return on inventory. 

Sales & Performance Analysis: Track sales, units, ASP, gross profit/margin, sell-through, stock turn, weeks of cover and category contribution; identify growth opportunities and produce regular performance reports. Visual Merchandising: Set merchandising guidelines and planograms, ensure consistent in-store presentation, optimise display space by performance, and conduct store visits/audits. Conduct regular store visits and merchandising audits. 

Product & Range Management: Build balanced assortments across price points and brands, manage launches and seasonal collections, recommend exits, and secure exclusive ranges with suppliers.

 Pricing & Promotions: Recommend pricing and markdown strategies, evaluate promotional effectiveness, and support marketing with the right product selection while protecting margin. 

Vendor & Supplier Management: Build supplier relationships, participate in buying meetings, negotiate promotional/marketing support, and review supplier performance. 

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Operations, Marketing, Supply Chain, Finance, Store Managers, Vendor Partners, and IT/BI teams to deliver commercial goals. 

Skills & Competencies: Strong commercial/analytical mindset; merchandising and category management expertise; advanced Excel and Power BI skills; forecasting and inventory planning ability; strong communication, negotiation and supplier management; high attention to detail; project management and cross-functional influence. 

Experience: Required 5 years in retail merchandising, planning or category management, with strong commercial, analytical mindset; ideally within Optical, Fashion, Beauty, or Specialty Retail; proven multi-store, multi-category management; ERP (e.g. Microsoft Dynamics 365) and BI tool proficiency (e.g. Power BI).

Job Description

Job Purpose:

To provide expert medical care and clinical management of patients with non-malignant (benign) hematological disorders, such as anemia, bleeding and clotting disorders, hemoglobinopathies, and platelet disorders. The Benign Hematology Specialist supports the diagnostic, therapeutic, and monitoring processes in collaboration with a multidisciplinary team, in accordance with SEHA’s quality standards and patient safety guidelines.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities:

Diagnose, treat, and manage patients with benign hematological conditions including iron-deficiency anemia, thalassemia, sickle cell disease, ITP, hemophilia, von Willebrand disease, and other coagulation disorders.

Interpret laboratory and diagnostic tests, including complete blood counts, coagulation profiles, iron studies, and bone marrow biopsies.

Manage anticoagulation therapy and monitor related complications.

Collaborate with laboratory hematology teams for accurate diagnosis and monitoring.

Participate in multidisciplinary team meetings for complex case discussions.

Support care of both inpatient and outpatient hematology cases, including emergency consultation for hematologic complications.

Document clinical assessments, investigations, and treatment plans using SEHA’s electronic medical record system.

Educate patients and families regarding disease management, treatment options, and prognosis.

Participate in continuing medical education, audits, research, and quality improvement activities.

Adhere to infection control protocols, clinical safety standards, and DOH medical ethics guidelines.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications:

Medical Degree (MBBS or equivalent) from a recognized institution.

Completion of residency in Internal Medicine followed by subspecialty training in Hematology.

Board Certification in Hematology or Hematology & Oncology (e.g., American Board, Arab Board, MRCP with specialization in Hematology, or equivalent).

Valid DOH Specialist License in Hematology or eligibility to obtain it.

Experience:

Minimum 3–5 years of post-residency experience in Hematology, with a focus on benign conditions.

Experience in managing thalassemia, hemophilia, and anticoagulation in tertiary healthcare settings is preferred.

Job Description

Job Purpose:

To deliver specialized, evidence-based care in the management of acute, chronic, and cancer-related pain using interventional and non-interventional techniques. The Consultant will lead multidisciplinary approaches to pain relief and functional restoration, ensuring high standards of patient-centered care in line with SEHA protocols and international guidelines.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities:

Evaluate and manage patients with complex pain conditions, including neuropathic, musculoskeletal, postoperative, and cancer-related pain.

Perform interventional pain procedures such as nerve blocks, epidural injections, facet joint injections, radiofrequency ablation, spinal cord stimulation, and intrathecal therapies.

Develop individualized treatment plans integrating pharmacologic, physical, psychological, and procedural interventions.

Work closely with departments such as orthopedics, neurology, oncology, palliative care, and rehabilitation in a multidisciplinary setting.

Ensure the safe administration of anesthetics and sedation when required for pain procedures.

Lead and participate in inpatient and outpatient pain clinics, case reviews, and pain boards.

Monitor treatment outcomes, document procedures, and ensure accurate, timely entries in SEHA’s electronic health records system.

Supervise and educate junior doctors, residents, and allied health professionals in pain management principles.

Contribute to research, quality improvement initiatives, and the development of clinical guidelines for pain management within SEHA.

Adhere to infection control, patient safety, radiation safety, and regulatory compliance as per DOH and SEHA standards.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications:

Basic Medical Degree (MBBS or equivalent) from an accredited institution.

Completion of residency in Anaesthesiology and fellowship in Anesthesiology

CCT UK, Arab Board, American Board, any Western Board Certification in Anaesthesiology with subspecialty training in IVF (e.g., ABA, FIPP, FRCA with Pain Medicine subspecialty, or equivalent).

Valid DOH Consultant License in Anaesthesiology with Pain Management, or eligibility to obtain it.

Experience:

Minimum 5 years post-specialty certification experience as a Consultant in Anaesthesiology with focused practice in Pain Medicine.

Demonstrated clinical competence in interventional pain procedures and multidisciplinary pain care models.

About Us

Abu Dhabi Healthcare Company (SEHA) is the largest and most comprehensive healthcare network in the UAE that was established in 2007 with the objective of operating all public hospitals and clinics across the Emirate of Abu Dhabi.

SEHA is committed to delivering world-class healthcare services using the most advanced diagnostics and systems across its network of public healthcare centers and hospitals in addition to partnering with global leaders in healthcare, including world renowned organizations such as the Mayo Clinic.

About the Team

Sheikh Khalifa Medical City (SKMC) is a flagship tertiary hospital in the UAE and the largest teaching medical center in Abu Dhabi. The hospital has pioneered multiple innovative medical technologies locally and regionally, establishing itself as a market leader and setting new benchmarks for the sector. Major achievements include; the first Transplant Center in the UAE and the sole provider of paediatric transplant services in the Emirate of Abu Dhabi, the largest Cardiac Science program for paediatrics and adults and the only Paediatric Cardiac Surgery Program in Abu Dhabi, the first accredited Chest Pain Center in the region and outside the United States. SKMC is committed to providing exceptional and comprehensive adult surgical and medical services in its inpatient and outpatient facilities. SKMC also manages a Biosafety Level 3 Laboratory (BSL3) and a 125-bed Behavioural Sciences Pavilion, the largest mental care facility that provides adults and paediatrics services.

Job Description

Job Purpose:

To provide specialized cardiac care for infants, children, and adolescents with congenital or acquired heart diseases. The Consultant Pediatric Cardiologist plays a key role in the diagnosis, treatment, and long-term management of pediatric cardiac conditions using advanced diagnostic tools, non-invasive and invasive procedures, and multidisciplinary care models in accordance with SEHA’s clinical standards.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities:

Evaluate and manage a wide spectrum of pediatric cardiac conditions including congenital heart defects, arrhythmias, cardiomyopathies, and acquired heart diseases (e.g., Kawasaki disease, myocarditis).

Perform and interpret pediatric cardiac diagnostics such as echocardiography (transthoracic, transesophageal, fetal), ECG, Holter monitoring, and exercise stress testing.

Coordinate care and collaborate with pediatric cardiac surgeons, intensivists, neonatologists, and other specialists for surgical planning, preoperative and postoperative care.

Participate in cardiac catheterizations and interventional procedures if credentialed.

Provide expert consultation in pediatric intensive care, neonatal ICU, and emergency settings.

Counsel and support families regarding diagnoses, treatment options, prognosis, and follow-up care.

Document all assessments, procedures, and management plans in the electronic medical record system in accordance with SEHA guidelines.

Engage in academic activities including teaching, training, and mentoring residents and junior staff.

Participate in clinical governance activities including morbidity and mortality reviews, case conferences, audits, and quality improvement initiatives.

Ensure compliance with all SEHA and DOH standards for patient safety, clinical documentation, ethics, and infection control.

Qualifications

Basic Medical Degree (MBBS or equivalent) from an accredited medical institution.

Residency in Pediatrics followed by fellowship/subspecialty training in Pediatric Cardiology.

Board Certification in Pediatric Cardiology (e.g., American Board, Arab Board, CCT UK, MRCPCH with Pediatric Cardiology subspecialty, or equivalent).

Valid DOH Consultant License in Pediatric Cardiology or eligibility to obtain it.

Experience:

Minimum 5 years of post-certification experience as a Consultant Pediatric Cardiologist.

Hands-on expertise in pediatric cardiac imaging, diagnostics, and outpatient/inpatient care.

The Billing Coordinator is responsible for coordinating and supporting the end-to-end billing process within the Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) department. The role ensures that patient accounts and claims are accurately prepared, billed, submitted, monitored, and followed up in a timely manner, in accordance with payer requirements, hospital policies, and applicable regulatory standards.

The Billing Coordinator works closely with clinical, front-office, coding, insurance, finance, and other relevant departments to ensure accurate documentation, appropriate billing, timely claim submission, and effective resolution of billing-related issues.

Key Responsibilities

1. Billing & Claim Preparation

  • Review patient accounts and supporting documentation to ensure completeness and billing readiness.
  • Prepare and process patient and insurance claims accurately and within established timelines.
  • Ensure charges, services, procedures, medications, supplies, and other billable items are accurately captured and billed.
  • Verify that required clinical and administrative documentation is available before claim submission.
  • Ensure billing is aligned with approved payer contracts, agreed tariffs, and hospital billing policies.
  • Identify billing discrepancies, missing charges, duplicate charges, and other issues that may impact claim submission or reimbursement.
  • Coordinate with relevant departments to obtain missing information or documentation required for billing.

2. Claims Submission & Follow-Up

  • Submit insurance claims through the appropriate payer channels within defined turnaround times.
  • Monitor submitted claims and maintain appropriate follow-up until adjudication and payment.
  • Review claim status and identify claims requiring correction, resubmission, or additional documentation.
  • Coordinate with the Claims, Coding, Insurance, and Finance teams to resolve claim-related issues.
  • Ensure rejected or returned claims are investigated and addressed promptly.
  • Maintain accurate records of claim submissions, corrections, resubmissions, and outstanding actions.

3. Denial & Rejection Management

  • Review billing-related denials and rejections and determine the underlying cause.
  • Correct billing errors and coordinate with relevant departments where additional action or documentation is required.
  • Support timely resubmission of corrected claims.

4. Patient Account & Billing Review

  • Review patient accounts for accuracy, completeness, and appropriate billing.
  • Verify that services provided are reflected correctly on the patient account.
  • Investigate billing discrepancies and coordinate with the relevant departments for resolution.
  • Support the accurate processing of patient refunds, adjustments, credit balances, and other account-related transactions in accordance with approved procedures.

5. Coordination & Cross-Functional Support

  • Work closely with Front Office, Outpatient and Inpatient departments, Medical Records, Coding, Insurance, Finance, and Clinical teams.
  • Communicate billing requirements and outstanding documentation requirements to relevant stakeholders.
  • Follow up on incomplete or delayed documentation that may affect claim submission or reimbursement.
  • Participate in regular coordination meetings and provide updates on billing issues, pending accounts, and outstanding claims.
  • Maintain effective communication with internal stakeholders to facilitate timely resolution of revenue cycle issues.

6. Compliance & Quality

  • Ensure billing activities comply with hospital policies, payer requirements, contractual agreements, and applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Maintain confidentiality and security of patient and financial information at all times.
  • Follow established billing workflows, approval processes, and internal controls.
  • Identify potential compliance or billing risks and escalate them appropriately.
  • Participate in internal audits and provide required billing documentation when requested.

7. Reporting & Performance Monitoring

  • Prepare routine reports related to billing status, pending claims, rejections, denials, and other assigned RCM activities.
  • Monitor assigned accounts and ensure follow-up is completed within agreed timelines.
  • Support the Revenue Cycle team in analyzing billing performance and identifying opportunities for improvement.
  • Provide accurate and timely updates to the Revenue Cycle Team Lead/Manager.

  • Participate in RCM process improvement initiatives.
  • Support the development and implementation of standardized billing procedures and controls.
  • Share recurring issues and payer-related observations with the Revenue Cycle leadership team.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Billing accuracy and completeness.
  • Timely claim submission.
  • Claim submission turnaround time.
  • First-pass claim acceptance rate.
  • Billing-related rejection and denial rate.
  • Timely resolution and resubmission of rejected/denied claims.
  • Outstanding billing/claim follow-up.
  • Value of avoidable billing errors.
  • Productivity and volume of accounts/claims processed.

Education & Qualifications

Job Description

Provides patient care, assists patient care requirements and performs cardiology diagnostic test procedures for adult patients, paediatric and neonatal per the clinical objectives established by the ordering or attending physicians, the Cardiology Consultants, Critical Care Consultants, other Specialty Medical Consultants, Director of Interventional Cardiology, Manager of Heart Center and Senior Cardiac Technician following the American Hospital Dubai/AHVI Clinical Policy and Procedures, the Joint Commission International Accreditation (JCIA), the Dubai Health Authority (DHA), the American Heart Association (AHA), the American Society for Echocardiography, the Inter-societal Accreditation Commission and the American College of Cardiology clinical procedures and guidelines.

Responsibilities

Quality and Accuracy:

  • Performs safe and quality basic and comprehensive cardiology diagnostic test procedures following the clinical policy and procedures established by the American Hospital Dubai and the American Heart and Vascular Institute (AHVI).  
  • Responds to patient emergencies and assists or performs Basic Life Support (BLS), Advanced Cardiac Life Support (ACLS) or Pediatric Advance Life Support (PALS) whenever clinically indicated or required.  
  • Performs comprehensive patient assessment and re-assessment before, during or after each clinical test procedure and following the clinical standards established by the World Health Organization assessment and the Joint Commission International Accreditation (JCIA) – International Patient Safety Goals (IPSG) requirement.  
  • Communicates directly with the attending or the ordering physician or the Medical Consultant and immediately reports any of the following that includes vague or contraindicated diagnostic procedures, unstable patient’s baseline vital signs, preliminary but critical diagnostic findings or test results, test complications, medications adverse reactions, patient’s refusal to diagnostic testing and any serious clinical events or a patient emergency. 
  • Documents all test procedures and clinical test events into the patient’s electronic medical records (EMR) following the hospital and the established clinical policy and procedures of the department.  
  • Utilizes appropriate medical equipment during the test procedures that may include any of the following:
    • Cardiac Monitoring Device
    • Pulse Oximeter
    • ECG machine
    • Treadmill machine
    • Echocardiography machines
    • Holter machines
    • Ambulatory Blood Pressure machines
    • External mobile monitoring system.
  • Reviews the quality of the cardiology diagnostic preliminary test reports after each patient’s test procedure on all cardiology diagnostic tests. 
  • Prepares all preliminary cardiology diagnostic test reports or machine-generated preliminary reports after each test procedure and submits a preliminary report copy to the Cardiology Consultants for immediate review, evaluation and final results. 
  • Refrains from utilizing any medical equipment that failed functional calibration or bio-calibration and verbally reports the equipment problems to the Biomedical Engineers and through the iService electronic reporting system for immediate inspection and repair.  
  • Disinfects all medical equipment after each patient’s utilization following the Infection Prevention and Control clinical standards and as per hospital and department clinical policy and procedures.
  • Disposes all soiled or used “single-patient-use” medical supplies after each patient’s test procedure using the medical biohazard bin at bedside and following the Prevention and Control of Infection standards and the established clinical policy and procedures of the department.    
  • Performs the monthly inventory of all medical supplies, reviews the medical equipment preventive maintenance requirement and replenishes all the requirements as applicable. 
  • Performs the daily patient room safety checks, respiratory emergency box checks and the patient room temperature and humidity checks following the established clinical policy and procedures of the hospital and the department.
  • Participates in the Key Performance Improvement projects and Clinical Measures requirement for specific sections of the department.  
  • Performs a follow-up audit for the turnaround time final test resulting in specific Cardiology Consultants for all diagnostic test procedures performed as per hospital and department policy.
  • Prepares a monthly statistical report of all physicians who review and finally results of all the cardiology diagnostic test procedures performed in the department.

Organizational Skills:

  • Reviews the patient’s cardiology diagnostic test schedules, patient daily acuity and the patient’s medical records before the test procedure.
  • Prepares all the medical equipment required for daily cardiology diagnostic testing and performs daily functional checks and calibration before diagnostic test procedures including checking all accessories and supplies required during the test procedures.
  • Identifies the correct patient, and assists the patient or the patient’s relative with the registration and billing process requirement. 
  • Admits the patient to the department or visits the patient in a specified clinical area and independently performs the prescribed diagnostic test procedure.
  • Provides the patient or the patient’s relative with clinical education for specific and prescribed cardiology diagnostic test procedures that include the test indications, expectations, potential complications or specific instructions during the procedure.
  • Assesses the patient before the procedure and performs the prescribed cardiology diagnostic test procedures, monitors and observes the patient during the procedure and re-assesses the patient after the test procedure.
  • Demonstrates competence to independently perform the cardiology diagnostic test procedure following the CPD clinical policy and guidelines that include:
    • Electrocardiography (ECG – Short Rhythm)
    • Electrocardiography (ECG – Long Rhythm)
    • Echocardiography (2D – 4D)
    • Ambulatory Holter Monitoring (24/48 hours)
    • Ambulatory Blood Pressure Monitor (24/48 hours)
    • External mobile Arrhythmia Monitoring 
  • Assists the Cardiology Consultant perform the following advanced Cardiology Test Procedures that include:
    • Echocardiography (Exercise Stress) 
    • Echocardiography (with Dobutamine)
    • Echocardiography (Transesophageal)
    • Treadmill Stress Testing (TMT)
    • Passive and/or Augmented Tilt Table Testing
  • Reviews and evaluates the quality of the cardiology preliminary report and submits all preliminary reports to the Cardiology Consultant for evaluation and final results. 
  • Communicates directly with the attending or ordering physician and the Cardiology Consultant and immediately reports the sudden clinical deterioration of the patients who may require transfer admission at the American Hospital Dubai’s Emergency Department.  
  • Discharges the patient directly from the department after the cardiology diagnostic test procedure following the hospital discharge policy and performs patient re-assessment ensuring that vital signs are checked and noted within the normal range before discharge.
  • Completes the patient’s diagnostic test Order Entry in the Power Chart after each diagnostic test procedure.
  • Performs a follow-up audit of specific Cardiology Consultant’s turnaround time for final test resulting in all cardiology diagnostic test procedures performed as per hospital and department policy.
  • Prepares a monthly statistical report of all Cardiology Consultants who reviews and completes the final results of all diagnostic test procedures performed in the department.

Specialized Skills:

  • Qualified and licensed clinical staff to provide safe patient care.
  • Organized, resourceful and with strong abilities to implement and maintain the clinical and operational requirements of the department.
  • Strong patient advocate and an excellent customer service-oriented individual.
  • Driven and focused on maintaining the safety and quality of clinical practice following the established clinical guidelines.
  • Experienced and competent to perform all aspects of cardiology diagnostic test procedures.
  • Performs clinical duties and responsibilities with accuracy, as clinically indicated and as ordered by the physician.
  • Strong ability and competence to operate and manage cardiology medical equipment and to maintain preventive maintenance requirements.
  • Highly trained and certified to perform cardiology diagnostic procedures.
  • Qualified to assist the Cardiology Consultant performing specialized or advanced clinical procedures at the bedside that include Echocardiography 2D with contrast, Stress Echocardiography, Dobutamine Echocardiography, Transesophageal Echocardiography, Treadmill Stress Testing, Tilt Table Testing and Elective Cardioversion.
  • Restricted to lift or move medical supplies or medical equipment over 20 kilograms.

Qualifications

  • Cardiovascular program (minimum two (2) years course duration) or
  • Certificate or Diploma in Nursing, Cardiovascular Technology, Allied Health or any of the following additional diagnostic test experience that includes:
    • Electrocardiography (ECG)
    • Holter and Blood Pressure Monitoring
    • Treadmill Exercise Testing and Echocardiography
  • Clinical and practical competency record of all cardiology diagnostic testing
  • Current/Valid Dubai Health Authority (DHA) License
  • Certified Basic Life Support (BLS) and Advance Cardiac Life Support (ACLS)

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE:

  • Minimum of two (2) years of clinical experience in Cardiovascular Diagnostic Services.
  • Minimum of two (2) years of clinical experience to perform and assist basic and comprehensive electrocardiography (ECG), Echocardiography and Exercise Stress Testing, Ambulatory Holter and Blood Pressure monitoring.

  • Ability and competence to operate and troubleshoot all cardiology diagnostic test machines including:
    • ECG
    • Echocardiography
    • Treadmill
    • Holter and Blood Pressure monitors
    • Trans-telephonic monitoring system during the diagnostic test procedures

Assistant Consultant, Pediatric Hematology / Oncology/Stem Cell Transplantation &Cellular Therapy

Assists in providing medical care in the field of PEDIATRIC Hematology/Step Cell Transplantation & Cellular Therapy, and supervises interns and residents, in accordance with current medical staff bylaws, rules and regulations and the Organizations policies and procedures.

Essential Responsibilities and Duties:

Clinical Responsibilities

  • Assists the Consultants in providing required patient care and management in the field of Pediatric Hematology/Step Cell Transplantation & Cellular Therapy, in accordance with standards of medical care laid down by the Healthcare Delivery.
  • Studies and performs assessment, examination and the compilation of a case history and assists in the diagnosis and management of the patient in accordance with criteria listed in diagnostic manuals such as the Diagnostic and Statistical Manual.
  • Registers detailed medical history, conducts a thorough physical examination and creates a plan for patient management and follows-up for discussion with the Consultant. Subsequently, records the consultant’s orders, progress notes and other required documents for outpatients.
  • Provides on-call coverage for their specialty on a rotational basis during evenings, nights, weekends and public holidays.
  • Prepares for and participates in consultant and specialist ward rounds as per policy. Documents findings in medical records.
  • Follows up on investigation results for outpatients and modifies treatment accordingly.
  • Attends specialty clinics, outpatient clinics, and shares on on-call schedule as per requirements.
  • Performs other clinical responsibilities, as assigned.

Academic Responsibilities:

· Provides orientation, bedside training and supervision of interns, residents and fellows as assigned.

· Keeps abreast of all the latest techniques and developments, especially in area of specialization. Implements them on a selective basis to improve technical standards.

· Participates in the educational activities and training programs of the department.

· Participates in national and international medical conferences.

Research Responsibilities:

  • Participates in clinical, basic and translational research projects and published papers in accordance with Research Advisory Council Policy in order to advance knowledge, improve the quality of post graduate education and contribute to the national and international recognition of the Healthcare Delivery.

Administrative Responsibilities:

  • Undertakes the administrative duties assigned by the Section Head or Chairman of the department.
  • Participates in all mandatory departmental activities and serves on departmental and Healthcare Delivery committees, as required.
  • Assists the department in the development and implementation of techniques and practices that help maximize the utilization of all resources within the department and across the Healthcare Delivery.
  • Abides by the current Healthcare Delivery and medical stall bylaws, all relevant rules, regulations and policies and keeps updated of any changes that might occur.
  • Participates in self-and others’ education, training and development as applicable.
  • Follows all Organizations -related policies and procedures.
  • Performs other related duties as assigned.

Job Requirements

Education:

Graduation from a medical school in good standing, completion of required period of postgraduate training in a specialty and/or subspecialty, with Saudi/American Board or Canadian/UK certification, or equivalent as outlined by the Medical Staff Credentialing Committee.

Experience Required:

2–4 years of experience in Pediatric Hematology-Oncology and Stem Cell Transplantation.

Other Requirements/ Certifications:

Bilingual proficiency in Arabic and English.

Job Description

Carries out obstetrician and gynecologic health care, both on an in-patient and out-patient basis, for those patients designated as being entitled to such care by.

Responsibilities

  • Basic knowledge of medical Arabic desirable.
  • Must have a thorough knowledge of medical ethics

The role involves delivering professional, ethical, and high-quality clinical care, managing clinical risks, ensuring compliance with governance standards, and maintaining accurate medical records. It also emphasizes continuous professional development and maintaining integrity in providing ethical, responsible clinical services

Responsibilities

  • Provide a comprehensive professional and ethical quality clinical services to patients in an effective and efficient manner.
  • Monitor and manage clinical risks associated with direct patient care.
  • Ensure compliance with clinical governance and quality management standards.
  • Maintain accurate medical records.
  • Ensure excellence in medical practice is maintained by focusing on continuous professional development of self and others.
  • Maintain integrity in professional services by executing clinical services in an ethical and responsible manner.
  • Performs administrative functions at the Department level as established by the Medical Management.
  • Supports Continuous Quality Improvement. Develops and promotes appropriate standards of care.
  • Develops and implements work assignments, on-call assignments, and vacation schedules for Department staff.
  • Supervises and monitors the delivery of health care by department staff. Provides guidance regarding patient care when indicated. Takes remedial action when appropriate.
  • Develops and implements effective Peer Review. Provides annual and on-going feedback as appropriate.
  • Works closely with other concerned committees in developing policies and procedures to promote quality health care for psychiatric patients.
  • Exercises effective interpersonal skills in dealings with department staff, with associates and with Management.
  • Evidences leadership skills in developing in others the willingness and desire to work toward common objectives.
  • Maintains confidentiality regarding patient information and regarding administrative matters of confidential nature.
  • Produces written communications, assessments, proposals and administrative documents that are timely and of high quality. Work product is of the quantity required to effectively accomplish duties as head of the department.
  • Evidences dependability in carrying out the commitments and obligations of the position.
  • Demonstrates the ability to listen to others in promoting effective communication.
  • Develops thorough understanding of policies and procedures of the hospital and demonstrates respect for them.
  • Performs other duties as assigned by the Medical Director. 

Occupational Safety and Health Management Systems 

  • Comply with reasonable OSH instructions, policies and safe working procedures
  • Use of appropriate personal protective equipment and safety systems.
  • Be familiar with emergency and evacuation procedures
  • Not willfully or recklessly endanger anyone’s health and safety
  • Assist with the preparation of risk assessments
  • Report OSH Hazards, incidents, Near misses and issues
  • Reduce, Reuse, Recycling of waste as much as possible
  • Attend all OSH Trainings, awareness programs and mock drills.
  • Participates in the OSHMS audits, inspections, ensuring standards are maintained

Prevention and Control of Infection (PCI): 

  • PCI is everyone’s responsibility. All staff are required to read and implement the NMC PCI Policy and Strategy in an effort to maintain the highest possible standards of cleanliness at all times, thus reducing the risk of infection in patients, staff and visitors.

The strictest hand hygiene, 5 moments of hand hygiene, bare below the elbows and environmental care, will be expected of all staff, including the post holder, at all times

Qualifications

At least 3 – 5 years’ post qualification experience at Specialist level (independent of country)

At least 1 year Specialist level experience from a Tier 1 country as specified by the UAE healthcare regulator.

Basic medical degree and completion of a specialty qualification/education programme (fellowship/diploma) recognised by the relevant UAE healthcare authority.

Certification and registration in a speciality recognised by relevant UAE healthcare authority. Active and valid life support certification (e.g. BLS, ACLS, PALS, ATLS, NRP)

Eligibility for relevant healthcare authority registration e.g. Membership from Royal College / Arab Board Certification / MS / DM / MPhil or an equivalent recognised by relevant healthcare authority in UAE

Job Overview:

The Nurse provides dedicated clinical and operational support to the Psychiatrist and supports the safe and efficient delivery of the Psychiatry service. The role includes supporting patient preparation and follow-up, clinical documentation and coordination, and other nursing duties within the employee’s professional scope of practice. Where the Psychiatrist is completing psychological or neurodevelopmental assessments, the Nurse may also provide assessment-related support similar to an Assistant Psychology role, under clinician direction and within the limits of their competence and regulatory scope. The Nurse will also provide additional administrative and operational support to the clinic when required.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Providing day-to-day clinical support to the Psychiatrist and Psychiatry service
  • Supporting patient preparation, clinical coordination, follow-up and documentation
  • Taking and recording vital signs when clinically required
  • Supporting and educating patients regarding medications prescribed by the Psychiatrist, when required and within the Nurse’s professional scope of practice
  • Assisting with assessment administration, materials, data collection and workflow when the Psychiatrist is completing assessments, under clinician guidance
  • Maintaining accurate, organised and up-to-date patient records and ensuring confidentiality
  • Coordinating with clinicians, Front of House and Back Office to support a smooth patient journey
  • Providing additional administrative and operational support across the clinic when required
  • Working within DHA requirements, professional nursing scope of practice and organisational policies

Qualifications/Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Nursing or equivalent recognised nursing qualification
  • Valid DHA Registered Nurse licence or eligible for DHA licensing
  • Current Basic Life Support (BLS) certification or ability to maintain required certification
  • Strong clinical, organisational and documentation skills
  • Strong IT skills, including proficiency in Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Word, Excel, Teams)
  • Excellent written and spoken English
  • Empathetic, professional and patient-centred communication style
  • Ability to work effectively within a multidisciplinary team and adapt to a fast-paced clinic environment
  • Strong attention to detail and discretion in handling sensitive patient information
  • Interest or experience in mental health, psychiatry or psychological assessment is desirable

Experience:

  • 1–2 years of nursing experience in a clinical or healthcare setting is preferred
  • Experience in mental health, psychiatry, psychology, neurodevelopmental or outpatient services is desirable
  • Experience supporting assessments, clinical administration or multidisciplinary services is an advantage
  • Previous work experience in the UAE is preferred but not essential

Job Description

The Front Office Training Manager leads the design, delivery, standardization, and evaluation of training and competency programs for Patient Access and front office teams across American Hospital Dubai and assigned clinics. The role ensures staff are consistently prepared to deliver accurate registration, appointment, insurance, financial, customer service, and patient-navigation processes in accordance with hospital policies, patient safety requirements, service standards, and applicable DHA and JCI expectations

Responsibilities

  • Leads the selection, onboarding, and induction of Front Office and Patient Relations employees.
  • Develops and delivers structured training programs covering hospital operations, patient experience, and customer service.
  • Trains teams on the complete outpatient clinic workflow, from appointment and registration through to physician consultation, checkout, and bill closure.
  • Ensures staff are competent in patient registration, appointment management, insurance processes, check-in/check-out, and billing and payment collection.
  • Trains teams on accurate bill closure, payment processes, credit notes, refunds, and escalation of billing discrepancies.
  • Delivers customer-service training focused on communication, empathy, service recovery, complaint handling, and patient engagement.
  • Establishes and monitors competency standards for front office roles through knowledge assessments, observation, simulations, quality audits, and post-training evaluation; maintains complete and auditable training records.
  • Monitors training effectiveness and identify performance gaps through patient feedback, operational audits, complaints, and KPIs.
  • Conducts regular quality audits of front office and operations ensuring compliance with established standards, identify gaps, drive corrective actions and retrain as needed
  • Generate reports as required.
  • Develops and maintains SOPs, training manuals, competency checklists, and training matrices.
  • Provides refresher training and continuous development based on operational and patient-experience needs.
  • Partners with Clinic Managers, Patient Experience, Finance/RCM, HR, Nursing, and Operations to ensure consistent Front Office standards.
  • Leads Front Office training readiness for new clinics, services, systems, and operational workflows.
  • Ensures consistent patient journey standards across all hospital outpatient locations.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Healthcare Administration, Business Administration, Hospitality Management, Education/Training, or a related discipline.
  • Professional certification in Training and Development, Adult Learning, Customer Experience, or a related field is preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of adult-learning principles, competency assessment, training-needs analysis, instructional design, coaching, and training effectiveness measurement.
  • Proficiency in hospital information systems, learning management systems, Microsoft Office applications, reporting tools, and preparation of training materials and dashboards.
  • Experience in hospital Front Office, Patient Relations, Patient Experience, or healthcare operations.
  • Strong knowledge of outpatient workflows, registration, billing, and patient journey processes.
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE:

  • Preferably 5 years of experience out of which 2 years are in supervising staff with 1 year as an Educator
  • Experience in competency assessment, quality auditing, workflow standardization, service improvement, and implementation of new systems or operational processes is required.
  • Strong customer-service mindset with a passion for patient-centered care.
  • Ability to identify operational gaps and translate them into practical training solutions.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to work across multiple departments and locations.
