Job Description

To act as Infection Prevention & Control Expert and to implement, promote and maintain an active infection control program through surveillance and investigative activities, consultation, education, policy development, risk assessment, product evaluation and research. To work collaboratively with clinical staff, departments and administration to reduce the risk of healthcare associated infections among patients. To assure that facilities and services are in compliance with infection control practice as well as local, state and regulatory infection control standards.

Responsibilities

  • Providing consultation and expert advice in infection control practice for professional staff, administrative, medical, clinical, patient care and support services.
  • Collaborating with all departments on departmental policies related to infection control.
  • Providing advice to occupational health, laboratory staff and the risk manager in the event of a blood borne pathogen and body fluid exposure incident or any other Infection Prevention and Control issue.
  • Establishing needs assessment for all departments around infection prevention and control issues.
  • Collaborating with all departments on departmental policies related to infection control.
  • Assisting line manager in related policy development and/or review or revision.
  • Playing a key role in infection prevention and control committee.
  • Representing the infection prevention and control team in external meetings.
  • Conducting product evaluation activities related to the field of Infection Prevention & Control.
  • Leading implementation of evidence based infection prevention and control strategies in conjunction with a multidisciplinary team that is effective and improves patient outcome.
  • Making self-accessible for infection prevention and control consultation in all phases of the change process.
  • Leading integration of prevention activities within and across departments.
  • Leading financial/value analysis of programs and related projects.
  • Building relationships with staff, peers and colleagues to support interdisciplinary and interdepartmental planning, aimed at improving patient outcomes.
  • Providing bedside clinical consultations to nurses, physicians and allied health professionals related to infection prevention and control.
  • Demonstrating knowledge of microbiological and epidemiological principles and isolation precautions when addressing the purchase of resources (e.g., personal protective equipment).
  • Communicating with HAAD on reportable infectious diseases, endemic and epidemic situation in the community.
  • Monitoring antibiotic therapy.
  • Surveillance and epidemiologic investigation:
  • Design and implement surveillance systems according to latest NHSN definitions
  • Collecting and reviewing surveillance data related to health care associated infection.
  • Analyzing and interpreting the surveillance data.
  • Recommending appropriate actions to clinicians and administrators targeted to reduce or eliminate infectious risks in patients and staff.
  • Performing active surveillance on targeted device and procedure associated infections in the hospital and following up on epidemiological importance organisms/diseases.
  • Conducting outbreak investigations
  • Conducting contact tracing related to exposure of patients or/and healthcareworkers to communicable diseases
  • Preparing and maintaining confidentiality of all aspects of infection prevention and control surveillance data collection, storage and distribution.
  • Preventing/controlling the transmission of infectious agents:
  • Promoting and implementing infection prevention and control guidelines/standards that improve patient outcome and reduce healthcare-associated infections.
  • Collaborating with public health agencies in planning community responses to biologic agents
  • Investigating and studying trends in infection prevention and control practices, recommending changes or adjustments in existing practice for performance improvement.
  • Collaborating with relevant departments on establishing and maintaining an active employee/occupational health program.
  • Liaising effectively with other health care providers both internal and external to the organization.
  • Maintaining confidentiality and security of patient, family, and organization information in accordance with the confidentiality policy
  • Using information technology to access, transmit and produce information as necessary.
  • Providing infection prevention and control reports and surveillance monitoring in a timely manner (i.e., monthly).
  • Liaising closely with medical and nursing staff in ensuring that all notifiable diseases are reported to HAAD.
  • Developing an effective mechanism for communication of infection prevention and control information from patient care areas with feedback of analyzed information.
  • Collaborating with multidisciplinary team by providing effective communication and timely feedback in improving quality and patient safety.

Qualifications

Required: RN/RM with Bachelor’s degree in nursing or midwifery or equivalent

Licensing: HAAD licence in Nursing or Midwifery

Desired: Master’s Degree is preferred. Certified in Infection Control (CIC) (i.e. Board of Infection Control and Epidemiology or equivalent) and maintain certification status

Experience Required

  • NLT 5 years postgraduate experience in an acute care hospital
  • NLT 2 years’ experience in the infection prevention & control field

Overview

M42 delivers comprehensive healthcare services across the full continuum of care; from primary care to advanced specialty treatments. Leveraging cutting-edge health technologies and precision medicine, we ensure the highest standards of effectiveness, efficiency, and patient-centered outcomes. With a global presence spanning more than 480 facilities in 27 countries and a dedicated workforce of over 20,000 professionals, M42 is uniquely positioned to redefine the future of healthcare on a global scale.

Danat Al Emarat is a world-class specialty women’s and children’s hospital in the Emirate of Abu Dhabi. It offers advanced medical services across specialties including Neonatology, Pediatrics, Obstetrics & Gynecology, and Women’s Health. The hospital is one of the very few to encompass a dedicated Fetal Medicine Department along with a full-fledged Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU) in the UAE. This has established Danat Al Emarat as a regional referral center for women with high-risk pregnancies, supported by its Level III NICU providing care for the most fragile newborns.

The Healthcare Assistant in the Paediatric OPD supports physicians, nurses, and other healthcare professionals in delivering safe, efficient, and patient-centered care to women attending outpatient clinics. The role involves assisting with patient care activities, maintaining a clean and organized clinical environment, and ensuring patient comfort throughout their visit.

Responsibilities

  • Assist pediatricians and nurses in providing care to infants, children, and adolescents during outpatient visits.
  • Prepare examination and treatment rooms before patient appointments.
  • Measure and record vital signs such as temperature, pulse, respiratory rate, blood pressure, height, weight, and head circumference (for infants).
  • Support patient assessment by collecting basic medical history and relevant information from parents or caregivers.
  • Help maintain accurate patient records and ensure confidentiality of medical information.
  • Provide age-appropriate comfort and reassurance to children to reduce anxiety during consultations and procedures.
  • Assist with specimen collection and transportation as directed.
  • Prepare equipment and supplies required for examinations, immunizations, and minor procedures.
  • Assist healthcare professionals during vaccinations, dressings, wound care, and other outpatient procedures.
  • Educate parents and caregivers on basic health, hygiene, medication administration, and follow-up care as directed by clinicians.
  • Monitor patients in the waiting and treatment areas and promptly report any concerns to the nursing or medical team.
  • Maintain cleanliness, infection prevention, and safety standards within the clinic.
  • Ensure adequate stock of medical supplies and report shortages.
  • Support referral processes and coordination of follow-up appointments.
  • Respond appropriately to pediatric emergencies while seeking immediate assistance from the healthcare team.
  • Promote a child-friendly, safe, and supportive environment for patients and their families

Qualifications

  • Diploma in Healthcare Assistance
  • Valid BLS

Job Description

Provides comprehensive medical care to adult patients across both in-person clinic and telemedicine settings, with a primary focus on diabetology within the scope of family medicine. Leads the diagnosis, treatment, and long-term management of diabetes and related metabolic disorders, alongside a broad range of acute and chronic medical conditions, ensuring consistent, evidence-based, patient-centred care regardless of consultation channel. Coordinates seamlessly between face-to-face and virtual encounters through multidisciplinary collaboration, emphasizing prevention, early intervention, chronic disease optimization, and continuity of care. Applies population health and value-based care principles to improve clinical outcomes, enhance patient experience, and optimize healthcare resource utilization across both service modalities.

Patient Consultations and Management

  • Deliver comprehensive care for patients through both in-person clinic visits and virtual assessment, diagnosis, treatment, and follow-up of diabetes, related metabolic disorders, and other acute and chronic medical conditions.
  • Conduct comprehensive clinical evaluations, including medical history, physical or virtual assessment, medication review, diabetes risk assessment, and interpretation of relevant laboratory and diagnostic findings.
  • Determine, per clinical protocol, when a patient’s condition requires an in-person visit versus when it can be safely managed virtually, and facilitate smooth transitions between the two.
  • Develop and implement individualized, evidence-based management plans, including glycemic optimization, medication management, lifestyle modification, preventive care, and specialist referrals when indicated.
  • Manage patients with type 1 diabetes, type 2 diabetes, prediabetes, obesity, and other metabolic conditions, while preventing, identifying, and managing diabetes-related complications and associated comorbidities.
  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary healthcare teams, including endocrinologists, dietitians, diabetes educators, pharmacists, and primary care providers, to deliver coordinated, patient-centred care across both channels.
  • Utilize digital health technologies, including remote patient monitoring and telemedicine platforms, alongside standard in-clinic systems, to provide safe, high-quality care while maintaining accurate and timely clinical documentation.
  • Promote preventive care, chronic disease management, population health, and value-based care initiatives to improve glycemic control, reduce diabetes-related complications, and optimize healthcare resource utilization.

Quality Assurance and Compliance

  • Communicate effectively with patients and their families, providing clear and concise explanations of diagnoses, treatment options, and follow-up care in both settings.
  • Adhere to all relevant medical regulations, ethical guidelines, and quality assurance standards for both in-clinic and telehealth practice.
  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of clinical and telehealth regulations and best practices; participate in quality improvement initiatives and document patient encounters accurately regardless of channel.
  • Participate in quality improvement initiatives, research activities, and clinical audits to enhance patient care and outcomes.
  • Regularly review compliance protocols and participate in training sessions; collaborate with compliance officers to ensure both physical and virtual practices meet regulatory standards.
  • Prepare reports for audits and inspections, ensuring accuracy and completeness across both service lines; stay updated on changes in healthcare regulations and implement necessary adjustments. Regulations and implement necessary adjustments

Professional Development

  • Continuously enhance professional knowledge and skills in family medicine with a focus on diabetology, covering both in-person and telehealth best practices.
  • Attend relevant conferences, workshops, and online courses.
  • Stay up to date on the latest advancements in diabetology and telehealth technology.

Telehealth Platform Proficiency

  • Maintain accurate and complete patient records in accordance with HIPAA-equivalent regulations, across both physical and electronic health record (EHR) systems.
  • Maintain proficiency in the clinic’s EHR system as well as the designated telehealth platform, including video conferencing, secure messaging, and EHR integration.
  • Actively participate in training programs and stay updated on platform enhancements and best practices; collaborate with IT support to troubleshoot technical issues

Patient Safety and Satisfaction

  • Maintain compliance with all patient safety standards and ensure patient safety across both in-person and virtual clinical interactions.
  • Report any patient safety risks or issues to the appropriate staff in the quality department.
  • Practice safe medicine to ensure no patient harm in either setting; explain medications, possible side effects, and proper use.
  • Maintain satisfactory patient consultations through communication, taking complete history, providing empathy and understanding of the patient’s condition and circumstances, explanation of diagnosis and proposed management plan, and answering patient queries.
  • Monitor patient feedback and address concerns promptly; implement safety protocols to minimize risks during consultations in both channels.
  • Conduct regular training sessions on patient safety for healthcare staff; utilize patient satisfaction surveys to gather insights for continuous improvement.

Collaboration with Healthcare Teams

  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to optimize patient care across in-person and virtual pathways.
  • Share insights and recommendations to support patient-centered care approaches.
  • Facilitate communication between team members regarding patient status and needs, regardless of consultation channel.
  • Mentor junior staff and provide training on clinical protocols for both in-person and telehealth delivery

Skills

  • Medical degree (MBBS, MD or equivalent) from an accredited medical school.
  • Residency training in Family Medicine from an accredited program.
  • Board certification in Family Medicine
  • Fellowship certification in Diabetology.
  • Saudi Commission for Health Specialties SCFHS classification and registration as Family Medicine- Diabetology Consultant.
  • Proven experience as a Family Medicine Diabetology Consultant or similar role, preferably in a hospital or clinical setting.
  • Experience in practicing population health management and value-based care approaches.
  • Proficiency in using electronic medical records (EMR) and telemedicine platforms.
  • Strong clinical judgment and analytical skills.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build rapport and establish effective relationships with patients and colleagues.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple priorities.
  • Commitment to ongoing professional development and staying abreast of the latest advancements in family medicine with a focus on diabetology, population health management, and value-based care.

Education

Medicine and Surgery

Delivers evidence-based, patient-centred care during scheduled part-time in-clinic sessions, ensuring continuity of care, appropriate diagnostic work-up, and surgical case management for patients seen. Coordinates closely with the full-time clinical and administrative teams to maintain continuity of care between sessions, applying population health and value-based care principles to improve clinical outcomes, optimise healthcare resources, and deliver safe, efficient, and high-quality general surgery care, within the defined scope resources.

Patient Consultations and Management

• Participate in ongoing training and adopt system enhancements and best practices, collaborating with relevant support teams to optimise performance and user experience.

Metabolic is a pioneering healthcare provider that integrates advanced technology with patient-centric care to transform the prevention and management of diabetes, obesity, metabolic health, and chronic disease.

Our approach combines specialist medical expertise, multidisciplinary care, and digital health solutions to provide personalised, high-quality care and improve long-term patient outcomes.

Role Summary:

The Cardiologist will provide comprehensive cardiovascular care within Metabolic’s integrated, multidisciplinary care model, with a particular focus on cardiovascular risk and conditions associated with diabetes, obesity, metabolic syndrome, hypertension, dyslipidaemia, and other chronic diseases.

The role involves specialist cardiovascular assessment and management, preventive cardiology, patient education, and collaboration with the wider clinical team. The Cardiologist will also use digital health technology and remote monitoring to support proactive management, personalised treatment, and improved long-term cardiovascular and metabolic outcomes.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Clinical Care:
  • Provide specialist-level cardiac consultations for patients with diabetes, metabolic syndrome, obesity, hypertension, dyslipidaemia, and other chronic conditions.
  • Diagnose and manage a broad range of cardiovascular disorders using evidence-based and patient-centred approaches.
  • Assess cardiovascular risk and develop individualised prevention and management strategies.
  • Collaborate closely with endocrinologists, GPs, nurses, dietitians, and other members of the multidisciplinary care team to align cardiovascular management with overall metabolic health goals.
  • Perform and interpret relevant cardiac diagnostic investigations, including ECG, echocardiography, stress testing, and Holter monitoring.
  • Manage chronic cardiovascular conditions and optimise cardiovascular medications where appropriate.
  • Provide preventive cardiology interventions focused on reducing cardiovascular risk and improving long-term health outcomes.
  • Identify and appropriately manage acute cardiac presentations within the clinic setting and arrange timely referral or escalation to tertiary-level care when required.
  • Provide appropriate follow-up and ongoing monitoring of patients with cardiovascular conditions and risk factors.
  • Digital Health Integration:
  • Utilise Metabolic’s digital health and patient monitoring platforms to track relevant clinical metrics, including blood pressure, heart rate, activity, and other cardiovascular and metabolic data.
  • Review patient data and trends and incorporate relevant findings into individualised clinical management plans.
  • Use technology and remote monitoring to support proactive identification of changes in cardiovascular risk or clinical status.
  • Participate in teleconsultations and remote patient monitoring programmes where clinically appropriate.
  • Engage with new digital health technologies and clinical tools that support cardiovascular care and patient outcomes.
  • Multidisciplinary Collaboration & Quality Improvement
  • Work collaboratively with physicians, nurses, dietitians, health coaches, physiotherapists, and other members of the multidisciplinary team.
  • Participate in multidisciplinary clinical meetings, case discussions, and patient reviews.
  • Contribute specialist cardiology expertise to integrated care pathways and clinical protocols.
  • Support continuous quality improvement, clinical audits, service development, and professional education activities.
  • Maintain accurate and comprehensive clinical documentation and ensure appropriate communication with the wider care team.
  • Contribute to the development and improvement of Metabolic’s cardiovascular and integrated chronic disease services.
  • Patient Education & Advocacy
  • Educate patients on cardiovascular disease prevention, risk-factor management, lifestyle modification, and medication adherence.
  • Explain diagnoses, investigations, treatment options, and recommendations clearly and sensitively.
  • Support patients in understanding and actively managing their cardiovascular and metabolic health.
  • Promote patient engagement, shared decision-making, and adherence to agreed treatment plans.
  • Provide ongoing communication and follow-up to support long-term health outcomes.
  • Clinical Governance & Infection Control
  • Practice in accordance with applicable UAE healthcare regulations, DHA requirements, and Metabolic clinical policies and procedures.
  • Maintain high standards of clinical care, patient safety, confidentiality, and professional conduct.
  • Participate in clinical governance, audit, quality improvement, and continuing professional development activities.
  • Ensure appropriate escalation and referral of patients where clinical needs exceed the services available within the clinic.
  • Understand, follow, and support all infection prevention and control programmes and procedures.

  • MBBS or equivalent medical degree from a recognised institution.
  • Board Certification or equivalent specialist qualification in Cardiology.
  • Minimum 5 years of post-qualification clinical experience in cardiology.
  • Experience in cardiovascular risk assessment, prevention, and chronic disease management.
  • Experience managing patients with diabetes, obesity, metabolic syndrome, hypertension, or dyslipidaemia is preferred.
  • Experience working within a multidisciplinary clinical environment.
  • Experience performing and/or interpreting cardiovascular diagnostic investigations, including ECG, echocardiography, stress testing, and Holter
  • Arabic language – a bonus

  1. Primary Responsibilities:

Technical:

  1. Monitoring and maintaining optimal stock levels of medical and non-medical supplies, equipment, and consumables.
  2. Receive and distribute all incoming and outgoing deliveries on a timely manner according to Clinic standards, Policies and Procedures
  3. Revise the requisitions received for stock items from end-users whenever needed.
  4. Checks quantity, quality and condition of goods received for conformity to purchase order specifications and End-user requirements.
  5. Properly submit the invoices/ GRN documents to finance on timely manner, Scanning and copied in the SCM Share Folder.
  6. Participate effectively in the daily cycle count activities & periodical stock take run by finance.
  7. Checking Fridge/ room temperature and other daily Activates as assigned.
  8. Implementing and maintaining efficient inventory control procedures, including stock rotation, first-in-first-out (FIFO) principles, and proper storage practices.
  9. Conducting regular inventory audits to ensure accuracy and reconcile discrepancies.
  10. Implementing systems for proper categorization, storage, and retrieval of items.
  11. Accurately entering and updating information related to stock levels, item descriptions, and other relevant data into the ERP system.
  12. Ensuring that all data entered aligns with established coding and categorization standards.
  13. Ensuring that all received goods meet quality standards and specifications, collaborating with relevant departments to address any quality or safety concerns.
  14. Recording details of received goods, including quantities, condition, and any discrepancies, in the ERP system, collaborating with the quality assurance team to update the system with information about the inspection and acceptance of received items.
  15. Maintaining effective communication with various departments to understand their needs and address concerns, coordinating with receiving, storage, and distribution teams to streamline stock-related processes.
  16. Overseeing stock storage processes, including tagging, boxing, and labeling.
  17. Utilizing inventory management software to analyze usage patterns and forecast future needs.
  18. Generating reports on stock levels, consumption rates, and other relevant metrics for management review.
  19. Identifying and addressing issues such as overstocking, stockouts, and slow-moving items.
  20. Identifying and mitigating risks associated with stock management, such as expiration of medical supplies, developing and implementing contingency plans for emergencies or disruptions in the supply chain.
  21. Performing other professional duties as assigned.

M42 delivers comprehensive healthcare services across the full continuum of care; from primary care to advanced specialty treatments. It offers advanced medical services across specialties including Neonatology, Pediatrics, Obstetrics & Gynecology, and Women’s Health. The hospital is one of the very few to encompass a dedicated Fetal Medicine Department along with a full-fledged Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU) in the UAE. This has established Danat Al Emarat as a regional referral center for women with high-risk pregnancies, supported by its Level III NICU providing care for the most fragile newborns.

A Sonographer in Fetal Medicine is a highly skilled healthcare professional responsible for performing specialized obstetric ultrasound examinations to assess fetal growth, development, and well-being throughout pregnancy. Working closely with fetal medicine specialists, obstetricians, and multidisciplinary healthcare teams, the sonographer plays a critical role in the early detection of fetal anomalies, monitoring high-risk pregnancies, and supporting prenatal diagnosis. Through the use of advanced ultrasound technology and adherence to evidence-based practices, the Fetal Medicine Sonographer contributes to optimal maternal and fetal outcomes while providing compassionate care and support to expectant mothers and their families.
Responsibilities

  • Perform detailed obstetric and fetal ultrasound examinations, including first, second, and third trimester scans.
  • Assess fetal growth, anatomy, well-being, and development throughout pregnancy.
  • Conduct specialized fetal medicine scans such as anomaly scans, nuchal translucency scans, fetal echocardiography, and Doppler studies.
  • Identify and report fetal abnormalities, congenital anomalies, and pregnancy-related complications.
  • Monitor high-risk pregnancies and provide serial ultrasound assessments as requested by fetal medicine specialists.
  • Accurately obtain and document fetal biometric measurements and ultrasound findings.
  • Prepare comprehensive ultrasound reports and communicate significant findings to the referring physician or fetal medicine consultant.
  • Assist physicians during invasive prenatal diagnostic procedures such as amniocentesis and chorionic villus sampling (CVS) under ultrasound guidance.
  • Ensure proper operation, maintenance, and quality control of ultrasound equipment.
  • Maintain accurate patient records and imaging documentation in accordance with departmental and regulatory requirements.
  • Provide clear explanations of ultrasound procedures to patients and offer emotional support during examinations.
  • Adhere to radiation safety, infection prevention, patient privacy, and professional practice standards.
  • Participate in multidisciplinary team discussions regarding complex fetal cases.
  • Stay updated with advancements in fetal imaging techniques, guidelines, and best practices through ongoing professional development.
  • Support clinical audits, research activities, and quality improvement initiatives within the fetal medicine department.
  • Ensure patient care is delivered with compassion, respect, and cultural sensitivity at all times.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or Diploma in Diagnostic Medical Sonography, Radiography, Medical Imaging, or a related healthcare field

About the job

Job Summary:

We are seeking an experienced and motivated Product Specialist to join our team in Saudi Arabia. The successful candidate will be responsible for promoting and supporting the company’s pharmaceutical products, with a particular focus on injectable and hospital-based products.

The Product Specialist will develop strong relationships with healthcare professionals, hospital stakeholders, and key opinion leaders (KOLs), while supporting sales growth, product awareness, tender activities, and market development across the Kingdom.

The ideal candidate will have strong pharmaceutical or clinical knowledge, excellent communication and presentation skills, and a good understanding of the Saudi healthcare market, including government and private hospital procurement processes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Promote and provide scientific information on injectable pharmaceutical products to physicians, pharmacists, nurses, hospital procurement teams, and other relevant healthcare professionals.
  • Conduct effective scientific presentations, product detailing, and product demonstrations, communicating clinical efficacy, safety, indications, and product benefits.
  • Develop and maintain strong professional relationships with healthcare professionals, hospital accounts, and key opinion leaders (KOLs).
  • Identify and develop new business opportunities within government and private healthcare institutions.
  • Support hospital and government tender activities, including tender submissions, product registration requirements, pricing follow-up, and account coordination.
  • Work closely with distributors, procurement teams, and internal stakeholders to ensure effective product availability and commercial execution.
  • Achieve assigned sales targets and contribute to revenue and market-share growth within the assigned territory.
  • Monitor competitor activities, market trends, pricing, customer needs, and changes within the Saudi healthcare market.
  • Collaborate with Medical, Regulatory, Marketing, Supply Chain, and other relevant teams to support product positioning, launches, and ongoing product development.
  • Attend and participate in medical conferences, exhibitions, workshops, and scientific events to increase product awareness and strengthen professional networks.
  • Maintain accurate customer records, sales reports, forecasts, and CRM updates.
  • Provide regular feedback to management regarding market opportunities, customer requirements, competitor activity, and product performance.
  • Ensure all activities are conducted in accordance with company policies, ethical standards, and applicable Saudi healthcare and pharmaceutical regulations.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Pharmacy, Medicine, Nursing, Life Sciences, or a related healthcare field.
  • 2–5 years of experience in pharmaceutical sales, medical sales, or product specialist roles, preferably with injectable, hospital, or specialty pharmaceutical products.
  • Strong knowledge of injectable pharmaceutical products, including their clinical applications, safety profiles, and appropriate use.
  • Experience working with hospitals, healthcare institutions, physicians, and procurement teams.
  • Previous experience with NUPCO and/or hospital-based tenders and procurement processes is preferred.
  • Good understanding of SFDA regulations and the Saudi healthcare system.
  • Strong scientific detailing, presentation, negotiation, and communication skills.
  • Ability to build and maintain relationships with healthcare professionals and KOLs.
  • Strong commercial awareness with a results-oriented approach.
  • Fluency in English; Arabic language skills are highly preferred.
  • Valid Saudi driving license and willingness to travel within the assigned territory and across KSA as required.

Job Description

JOB SUMMARY

Reporting to the Chair of the Department of cardiovascular diseases, the Division Chief provides clinical, educational, research and executive management leadership for pediatric and congenital cardiac Surgery. S/he is a clinical and managerial leader working with the department of cardiovascular diseases executive team to develop and deliver strategy and business plans and be accountable for resources and performance in providing pediatric and congenital cardiac surgery.  In conjunction with cross-functional teams, the division chief integrates research and education priorities into a program of excellent clinical service delivery. 

The primary goal of the division chief is to coordinate the provision of care for patients requiring pediatric and congenital cardiac surgery across the spectrum of conditions encountered in the specialty, for both elective and emergent cases.  The division chief would have a proven track recorded academic pediatric and congenital cardiac surgeon, with a broad range of expertise. The Chief also cultivates the development of new innovative surgical programs within Sidra and works to expand the outreach of the division through coordination with the International Medical Office.

The individual occupying this position reports directly to the Chair of cardiovascular diseases and works cooperatively with the surgical team, department staff and other stakeholders, including allied health specialists, referring clinicians and patients.  

The division chief is responsible for ensuring a high standard of service is continually provided to all patients, their families and other hospital staff as prescribed in the patient care and facility standards set down by Sidra Medicine. This includes ensuring that the clinical services required are available, with appropriate call coverage, and that clinic and OR resources are managed efficiently. 

The division chief is broadly responsible for developing the skill sets and human capital of the surgical and allied health staff of the care teams supervised.  Specifically, s/he provides mentorship and career development support for the pediatric and congenital cardiac Surgeons within the division including the development of clinical, teaching, research and administrative expertise by this group. The postholder is responsible for ensuring that appropriate monitoring of the quality of the surgical care provided is done, including participation in department wide initiatives such as the National Surgical Quality Improvement Project (NSQIP). S/he is also responsible for identifying problems if they should ensue and developing effective strategies for improving and optimizing outcomes on a continual basis.  

The division chief will have a full-time appointment to Weill Cornell Medical College – Qatar. S/he is expected to work collaboratively with the Medical School, to provide teaching support for undergraduate medical students and surgical residents by the members of the division, as required for the ACGME curriculum. The postholder is expected to perform research or pursue approved academic initiatives during dedicated academic time, which will be provided every week.

Associate Program Coordinator-(Medical ICU Unit Manager)

Job Code

30000808

Basic Function

Provides clinical direction and leadership for the assigned Nursing and Clinical Services Division/Department. Coordinates and manages activities of assigned division/department and assumes overall 24- hour responsibility. Develops department goals and objectives, evidenced based patient care practice, policies, and procedures in a cost effective environment. Provides overall organization guidance and direction in collaboration with the managers, prepares and monitors budgeting and quality management.    

Scope

Incumbent has responsibility and authority for all activities within assigned division/department; including forecasting nursing & clinical services patient care needs and evaluation of patient care systems/programs. Accountable and responsible for administrative and fiscal management of the division/department and in meeting the Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), patient satisfaction & staff engagement.  Interprets and implements Johns Hopkins Aramco Healthcare, Nursing and Clinical Services policies. Plans and oversees the provision for staffing within the division/department, and ongoing education, training and development for staff. Systematically evaluates the quality and effectiveness of nursing & clinical services practice within assigned division/department.

Principal Contacts

INTERNAL: Daily contact with JHAH, Human Resources (HR), Nursing & Clinical Services Managers and other Johns Hopkins Aramco Healthcare (JHAH) health care personnel involved in care of the patient.

EXTERNAL: Frequent contact with departments responsible for concerns relating to employees, patients and families (i.e., JHAH HR and JHAH Government Affairs).

Principal Duties

Performs all duties of Project Coordinator plus the following:                                                              

  • Leadership and people management:  
  • Performs all managerial functions common to the division/department level as established by JHAH.  Manages and provides leadership that incorporates the JHAH mission and vision, Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and standards of the organization.                         
  • Manages direct reports effectively, delegating appropriately and holding them accountable for the delivery of specific objectives and targets, maximizing their performance through regular performance coaching and review, and reflective practice, ensuring they meet required standards in their current job whilst developing their skills       and knowledge. Provides leadership, supervision, functional guidance, and developmental activities for the nursing & clinical services managers.  
  • Ensure that where performance issues have been identified, personnel policies are adhered to and specialist advice sought where required.          
  • Provide guidance and support to all team members as well as to managers in dealing with Human resource issues and disciplinary matters. Promotes a positive work environment conducive to productive, collegial relations among all members of the health care team.
  • With the Chief Nursing Officer and managers builds a pool of talent that will sustain the performance of nursing & clinical services in the future by identifying manpower requirements and partaking in the recruitment and selection process.
  • Works closely with members of the senior management team to deliver the successful implementation of key initiatives as appropriate by managing the impact of change within the team.  
  • Promotes the involvement of Nursing & Clinical Services in Community Health Awareness Programs.
  • Take responsibility alongside the managers for the clinical education and professional development of the division/department.
  • Conducts meetings with managers to communicate information, address quality issues, and problem solve. Contribute as one of the senior management team.
  • Supports and monitors the KPIs, Quality Improvement / Risk Management interventions in the division/department
  • Remains current regarding nursing & clinical practice developments and trends.  
  • Develop and implement effective educational programs designed to assist the staff in the progression from novice to expert in the care of the patient and family.
  •  Assures staff involvement in decision-making process and creates a positive work environment that enhances individual’s abilities to grow professionally.
  • Performs annual appraisals on managers/assigned staff and reviews the appraisals of all staff.    
  • Educates and mentors staff on principles of leadership and creates an environment that is conducive to learning.
  • Functions as a staff advocate. 
  • Participates in multidisciplinary committees, as well as leading Nursing & Clinical Services Division/Department committees.  

Principal Duties (cont’d)

  • Functions as a member of the Nursing & Clinical Services Executive Committee and supports and communicates the decisions made by the committee.
  • Recognize the diverse skill levels of individual staff members and the unique needs of the patient population when developing staffing plans; ensures level of staffing for the level of acuity is appropriate 24hours/day. Maintains 24-hour accountability for problem solving. 
  • Monitor and evaluate appropriate utilization of staff in collaboration with hospital wide stakeholders. Works collaboratively to assure consistency in planning of patient care to achieve expected outcomes interdepartmentally and intra departmentally. 
  • Responsible for manpower budget and financial planning for area.  
  • Develops measures and monitors division/department operational performance metrics inclusive of LOS, overtime costs, vacancy and turnover rates.
  • Maintains current knowledge of and ensures compliance with all regulatory and professional standards of care which includes, Central Board for Accreditation of Health Care Institutions (CBAHI), Joint Commission International (JCI), Institute Health for Health Care Improvement, (IHI) etc.   
  • Corrective action plans to ensure that quality of care is embedded into clinical practice on an ongoing basis promoting and the Quality improvement (QI) program within the Department.  
  • Performs other miscellaneous related duties as requested by the Chief of Nursing Officer. 
  • Is able to identify, at least one potential successor to the Division/Director role.  
  • Assesses and forecasts department resource needs and allocates resources/budgets to ensure objectives are met
  • Understands the needs, drivers and constraints of various stakeholder groups and applies this understanding in communications and decisions across division/department
  • Makes significant expenditures within established parameters
  • Directs and implements revenue – enhancing and/or cost-reduction measure
  • Manages subordinate managers,  and/or professional/technical employees
  • Achieves work objectives primarily through impact/influence on others

Education

  •  Master’s degree is required.
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Nursing/Specialty

Experience

  • 9 years clinical nursing experience post-registration with three years of management experience in clinical specialty.
  • Expert in clinical knowledge of assigned specialty is required.

Certifications/Other requirements as applicable

  • Advanced training /certification in specialty.
  • Current licensure as a professional registered nurse.
  •  Fluent spoken and written English. Spoken Arabic is desirable.
  • Professional experience with demonstrated competency in clinical management and leadership skills.
  • The ability to establish positive working relationships with all health care members in a multinational setting.

metas.experience: 9 years clinical nursing experience post-registration with three years of management experience in clinical specialty.

Basic Purpose of the role
Responsible for rendering professional nursing care to patients ensuring that nursing care is an integral part of the total patient care, working in conjunction with the medical staff and according to policies and procedures of the hospital. This will be in keeping with the accepted principles or professional nursing practice.

Key responsibilities of the role
Responsible for the implementation and delivery of age appropriate patient care congruent with the mission, vision and values of the organisation.

Collaborates with nursing staff and multidisciplinary teams on effective patient management.

Liaise with other health care providers as necessary to ensure appropriate and timely interventions for patients and for discharge planning.

Provides a comprehensive clinical handover / report as required to ensure patient safety using SBAR principles.

Establish priorities of care, nursing actions and desired outcomes in a timely manner.

Good knowledge of contemporary nursing practices.

Manages clinical and operational activities and ensure the provision of optimum clinical care, customer satisfaction and patient safety.

Demonstrate ability to adapt to varied age-specific patient populations.

Demonstrate maturity and accountability for job performance.

Maintains an effective rapport with patients, visitors, physicians, subordinates and other directors.

Good judgment and analytical ability in preparing work for review.

Promotes confidentiality and uses complete discretion when discussing information.

Works collaboratively with other staff members to provide continuous service to the organisation.

Ability to express self in the areas of communication verbal, written and non-verbal.

Demonstrates knowledge of current computer system used in the organisation.

Demonstrates adherence to safety and risk management policies as evidenced by in-service attendance records and employee practices.

Demonstrate good communication skills, interacts effectively with patients, visitors and other staff.

Ensures annual competencies are current.

Attends meetings pertinent to department

Other responsibilities
Follows hospital policies and procedures.

Maintains a professional demeanor and is culturally sensitive.

Acts as shift coordinator as required.

Reports unsafe practice Nurse In-charge or Nursing Supervisor.

Monitors the hemodynamic status of the patients.

Performs appropriate treatments as ordered by physician in an accurate and timely manner.

Performs therapeutic nursing interventions.

Documents patient assessment findings, physical/psychosocial responses to nursing intervention.

Initiates and assists in emergency resuscitative measures.

Provides care in a non-judgmental, non-discriminatory manner that is sensitive to the patient’s and family’s diversity, preserving their autonomy, dignity and rights.

Reports patient’s condition to appropriate medical personnel during each shift.

Administers medications safely.

Administers blood and blood products safely.

Inserts IV cannulae.

Instigates Doctors’ orders accurately and timely.

Educates patients on health risk factors.

Uses the nursing process in the promotion of patient holistic health and wellbeing.

Provides care for patients with acute and chronic physical health conditions.

Provides care for patients with acute, chronic and persistent mental health disorders.

Implements general nursing care and comfort measures.

Assesses plans and manages nursing interventions to optimise outcomes care for patients.

Follow up results to the physician as needed.

Participates as assigned on committees, working groups and other organization activities.

Communicates with patient care team ongoing changes in patient’s plan of care and unit activity.
Contributes to product evaluation at unit levels and participates in trials related to new product lines as appropriate.

Acts as a preceptor to less experienced staff as required.

Patient and family teaching as required.

Actively participates in organisational change in a constructive manner.

Actively participates in the process for ensuring the organisation achieves JCIA status.

Engages in health promotion activities in the organization and community.

Responsible for educating less experienced staff in adverse drug reaction and the process to be followed for medication errors.

Compliance guidelines
Participates in the development of policies and procedures in the units, relating to equipment and materials.

Understands actions of medication and contraindications, evaluates patient’s response, identifies side effects and initiates appropriate action.

Responsible to ensure that on a shift basis at unit level, the monitoring, replacement, storage and administration of Narcotic and Controlled Drugs is in accordance with Ministry of Health’s and Department of Health Narcotic Policies and Procedures.
Maintains confidentiality regarding patient/staff information.

Ensures all nursing and allied health staff maintains confidentiality regarding patient/staff information.
Promotes positive public relations with patients, peers, medical staff and members of the general public.

Collaborates with personnel from non-clinical department/disciplines regarding issues that may negatively impact patient care; facilitate solutions as needed.
Adheres to requirements of the Occupational Health and Safety Guidelines and Infection Control Guidelines.

Understands and adheres to emergency preparedness plans/policies.

Maintains compliance in relation to the Occupational Health and Safety standards.

The position does have heavy exposure to malodorous, infectious body fluids from patients and some minimal exposure to noxious smells from cleansing agents.

The position requires high exposure to infectious wastes such as blood and body fluids that mandate the wearing of gloves, masks and goggles for every actual or potential exposure.

Facilitates effective communication between the patient, family and the interdisciplinary health care team as required.

Demonstrates improvement in clinical practice as a result of application of new theoretical knowledge and technology.

Initiates or participates in Nursing and or other disciplines research that contributes to continual improvement in standards of care.

Obtains accredited and non-accredited Continuing Nursing Education (CNE) Units in compliance with Department of Health and the organization’s requirements.

Qualifications, Certifications and Experience
Graduate from School of Nursing (not less than 3 years study duration from an accredited program).
Bachelor of Science degree in nursing and/or Master in Nursing / Health Services Management.
Maintains valid, current RN licensure from own country.
BLS, PALS, ACLS, NRP certified.
Certified proof of yearly CME.

Minimum of 2 years clinical experience
The ability to influence and implement change.
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
Able to work independently and collaboratively with others.
Organized and able to work methodically.
Excellent leadership skills.
Able to relate to people from different cultural backgrounds.
Fluent in both written and spoken English.

Physical requirements
The position requires a considerable amount of physical work. The individual must be able to quickly manoeuvre throughout halls, stairways and patient rooms in response to hospital emergencies. The following denote the key physical requirements for the job which may require: Standing, Simple Grasping, Fine Manipulation, Operation Machinery / Equipment, Lifting / overhead reaching, Twisting, Climbing / Balancing, Crouching / Squatting, Reaching and Manual handling of people of approximately 100kg. Lifting equipment must be used whenever practicable.

In addition the position requires office work involving extensive use of the computer and interdepartmental coordination. Typical physical demands include: a high degree of manual dexterity to sufficiently perform computer functions on a keyboard, produce materials on a PC and operate basic office equipment, normal or corrected vision and hearing, extensive sitting and walking, mobility sufficient to visit with departments or employees throughout the facility and lift up to 13 kgs.

Description

Job Purpose:

Responsible for delivering high-quality nursing care that transforms lives through excellent evidence-based practices to patients in a clinical setting. The role includes assessing patient health problems and needs, developing and implementing nursing care plans, and maintaining medical records. The Registered Nurse works closely with physicians, other nurses, and healthcare professionals to ensure optimal patient care and outcomes.

Key Responsibilities And Duties

  • Clinical Duties:
  • Conducts initial and ongoing assessments of patient’s health, including physical examinations, taking vital signs, and monitoring symptoms.
  • Develops, implements, and updates individualized care plans based on patient assessments and in collaboration with other healthcare professionals.
  • Administers medications and treatments as physicians prescribe and monitor for side effects or adverse reactions.
  • Provides care for wounds, including cleaning, dressing, and monitoring for signs of infection.
  • Assists physicians and other healthcare professionals during medical procedures and diagnostic tests.
  • Educates patients and their families about health conditions, treatments, and preventive measures.
  • Observe and record patients’ conditions, including changes in symptoms or behaviors, and report any significant changes to the medical team.
  • Respond to medical emergencies and provide immediate care as needed.
  • Conducts purposeful rounding for patients to ensure their needs are met, prevent complications, and improve overall care quality.
  • Adhere to strict infection control standards, including hand hygiene, personal protective equipment (PPE) use, and proper handling of hazardous materials.
  • Participate in infection control surveillance and reporting to help prevent facility-acquired infection.
  • Maintain the cleanliness of the patient items and equipment as per Fakeeh Care policies.
  • Follow established protocols for different emergencies (e.g., codes, and RRT), ensuring patient safety and effective response.
  • Innovate in patient care and implement evidence-based practices to enhance patient outcomes.
  • Administrative Duties:
  • Maintains accurate and detailed patient care records, including observations, interventions, and responses.
  • Communicates effectively with patients, families, and the healthcare team to ensure coordinated and comprehensive care.
  • Collaborates with other healthcare professionals to ensure that patient care is continuous and integrated.
  • Supportive Duties:
  • Provides emotional support to patients and their families, addressing concerns and offering reassurance during stressful times.
  • Advocates for patients’ needs and preferences, ensuring that their rights are respected, and their voices are heard.
  • Participates in ongoing education and training to stay current with medical practices and advancements.
  • Respect diverse cultural backgrounds and incorporate patient values and beliefs into care planning.
  • Oversees the work of junior staff and nursing students and provides guidance and support as needed
  • Collaborates with a multidisciplinary team, including physicians, therapists, and social workers, to provide comprehensive care
  • Identifies and addresses issues or challenges in patient care and contributes to solutions and improvements in practice
  • Other duties as assigned by the nursing manager within the scope of the job

All Fakeeh Care employees are responsible for continuous improvement, including:

  • Performing all duties and tasks in a manner that supports Fakeeh’s Person-Centered care values.
  • Actively contributing to continuous improvement initiatives, within the scope of the role.
  • Adherence to safety protocols and proactively seeking to address any job-related safety concerns.
  • Maintaining strict confidentiality of all sensitive information accessed or encountered during work.
  • Complying with cybersecurity policies and standards to protect Fakeeh’s systems and participating in awareness training and initiatives to prevent cyber threats.
  • Adhering to and upholding Fakeeh Care’s code of conduct, policies and ethical standards.
  • Completion of mandatory education as per the requirement, at least one month prior to expiration.

Requirements

Skills And Abilities

  • Excellent interpersonal skills and service-oriented
  • Manages work pressure and teamwork skills
  • Computer skills (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Typing and more)
  • Clerical skills (Preparing agenda and taking minutes of meetings, scanning documents, and more

Experience

  • Minimum of one year of clinical experience
  • RN resident: Staff with less than one year of experience will go through the RN residency program (Fakeeh Graduate)

Education

Bachelor’s degree in Nursing or equivalent

Language

Excellent command of the English language and Arabic is a plus.

Licenses / Certifications

License from the country of origin, License for practice as per the regional health regulatory authority e.g. (SCFHS / DHA), BLS, ACLS and other LSTC courses as applicable

  • Innovate in patient care and implement evidence-based practices to enhance patient outcomes.
  • Administrative Duties:

M42 delivers comprehensive healthcare services across the full continuum of care; from primary care to advanced specialty treatments. Leveraging cutting-edge health technologies and precision medicine, we ensure the highest standards of effectiveness, efficiency, and patient-centered outcomes. With a global presence spanning more than 480 facilities in 27 countries and a dedicated workforce of over 20,000 professionals, M42 is uniquely positioned to redefine the future of healthcare on a global scale.

Danat Al Emarat is a world-class specialty women’s and children’s hospital in the Emirate of Abu Dhabi. It offers advanced medical services across specialties including Neonatology, Pediatrics, Obstetrics & Gynecology, and Women’s Health. This has established Danat Al Emarat as a regional referral center for women with high-risk pregnancies, supported by its Level III NICU providing care for the most fragile newborns.

They work collaboratively with physicians, nurses, and other healthcare professionals to optimize drug therapy, improve patient outcomes, and support medication safety initiatives within the hospital.

  • Document clinical interventions and report medication incidents and adverse drug reactions.
  • Provide medication counseling to patients and families and education to healthcare professionals.
  • Contribute to medication-use evaluations, clinical guidelines, formulary reviews, and quality improvement initiatives.

  • Manage medication formulary and related PTC activities

  • Valid DOH licnese as a clinical pharmacist.

OP Medical Coder (Immediate Joiner)

Job Summary

The OP Medical Coder is responsible for accurately reviewing and coding outpatient medical records, diagnoses, procedures, and services according to established coding guidelines and payer requirements. The role ensures that medical documentation is translated into accurate ICD, CPT, HCPCS, and other applicable codes to support appropriate billing, reimbursement, reporting, and compliance.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review outpatient medical records, physician notes, diagnostic reports, and other clinical documentation.
  • Assign accurate diagnosis and procedure codes based on the documentation provided.
  • Apply appropriate ICD-10-CM, CPT, HCPCS, and applicable modifiers.
  • Ensure coding is supported by complete and appropriate clinical documentation.
  • Identify missing, unclear, or conflicting documentation and coordinate with the appropriate clinical or coding team for clarification.
  • Review outpatient encounters for coding accuracy, completeness, and compliance with applicable guidelines.
  • Ensure correct sequencing of diagnoses and procedures.
  • Identify potential coding errors, denials, and documentation issues and recommend corrective action.
  • Maintain confidentiality and comply with patient privacy and information-security requirements.
  • Stay current with changes to coding guidelines, payer policies, regulatory requirements, and coding updates.
  • Participate in internal audits, quality reviews, and coding education activities.
  • Meet established productivity and accuracy standards.
  • Collaborate with physicians, clinical staff, billing teams, and other departments to resolve coding-related issues.
  • Support denial management and provide coding-related information when required.

Required Qualifications

  • Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Medical Coding, Health Information Management, Medical Records, Healthcare Administration, or a related field.
  • Professional medical coding certification such as CPC, CCS, CCA, or an equivalent qualification is preferred.
  • Knowledge of ICD-10-CM, CPT, and HCPCS coding systems.
  • Understanding of outpatient coding guidelines and medical terminology.
  • Familiarity with anatomy, physiology, and common medical procedures.
  • Previous experience in outpatient medical coding is preferred.

Required Skills

  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Good knowledge of medical terminology and clinical documentation.
  • Ability to interpret physician documentation and assign appropriate codes.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and meet productivity targets.
  • Proficiency in electronic medical records (EMR/EHR) and coding software.
  • Ability to maintain patient confidentiality and professional standards.

Key Performance Indicators

  • Coding accuracy and quality.
  • Productivity and turnaround time.
  • Reduction in coding-related denials and errors.
  • Compliance with applicable coding guidelines.
  • Documentation query quality and resolution.
  • Adherence to organizational policies and confidentiality requirements.

Reporting

Reports to: Coding Supervisor / HIM Manager / Revenue Cycle Manager

Department: Health Information Management / Medical Coding / Revenue Cycle Management

Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary

The Staff Nurse – Cardiac ICU is responsible for providing specialized nursing care to critically ill cardiac patients requiring intensive monitoring and advanced life support. The role involves assessing, planning, implementing, and evaluating patient care while ensuring adherence to evidence-based clinical practices, patient safety standards, and organizational policies. The nurse will collaborate closely with multidisciplinary teams to deliver high-quality, patient-centered care in a fast-paced critical care environment.

Key Responsibilities

Clinical Care

  • Deliver comprehensive nursing care to critically ill cardiac patients in the CICU.
  • Perform thorough patient assessments and continuously monitor clinical status.
  • Administer medications, intravenous therapies, blood products, and treatments as prescribed.
  • Monitor and interpret ECGs, cardiac rhythms, hemodynamic parameters, and other critical care indicators.
  • Care for patients requiring mechanical ventilation, invasive monitoring devices, and advanced cardiac support.
  • Respond promptly to cardiac emergencies, code blue situations, and patient deterioration.
  • Assist physicians during bedside procedures and emergency interventions.
  • Provide pre- and post-procedural care for cardiac interventions and surgeries.

Patient Safety & Quality

  • Ensure compliance with infection prevention and control standards.
  • Maintain accurate and timely documentation in the electronic medical record (EMR).
  • Follow medication safety protocols and patient identification procedures.
  • Participate in quality improvement initiatives and patient safety programs.
  • Report incidents, adverse events, and clinical concerns according to organizational policies.

Communication & Collaboration

  • Collaborate effectively with physicians, respiratory therapists, pharmacists, and other healthcare professionals.
  • Educate patients and families regarding treatment plans, medications, and recovery processes.
  • Participate actively in multidisciplinary rounds and clinical handovers.
  • Support patient and family-centered care initiatives.

Professional Development

  • Maintain current nursing knowledge and competencies in critical care and cardiac nursing.
  • Attend mandatory training, continuing education programs, and competency assessments.
  • Mentor and assist newly hired nurses and students as required.
  • Participate in departmental audits, accreditation activities, and clinical improvement programs.

Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN) or equivalent recognized nursing qualification.

Experience

  • Minimum 2-5 years of recent experience in a Cardiac ICU, ICU, Coronary Care Unit (CCU), or Critical Care setting.
  • Experience in managing critically ill cardiac patients is highly preferred.
  • Experience with ventilators, invasive monitoring, and advanced cardiac life support is desirable.

Licensure

  • Valid DOH License as Registered Nurse OR DOH Eligibility Letter (mandatory).
  • Eligibility to practice nursing in Abu Dhabi in accordance with Department of Health (DOH) regulations.

Certifications

  • Basic Life Support (BLS) certification (mandatory).
  • Advanced Cardiovascular Life Support (ACLS) certification (mandatory).
  • Critical Care Nursing certification (preferred).

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong knowledge of cardiac critical care nursing practices.
  • Ability to recognize and respond to cardiac emergencies.
  • Proficiency in cardiac monitoring and ECG interpretation.
  • Excellent clinical assessment and decision-making skills.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary team.
  • Commitment to patient safety and quality care.
  • Ability to work flexible shifts, including nights, weekends, and public holidays.

As a Patient Care Navigator, you will be responsible for organizing and coordinating patient care activities to ensure optimal patient outcomes. This involves collaborating with healthcare providers, patients and families to facilitate communication, address concerns, and resolve issues. By acting as a liaison between patients, their families, and the healthcare team, you will contribute to a seamless and positive patient experience.

You will also be expected to understand, support, and promote SEHA’s mission, vision, and values. Provide age-appropriate patient care aligned with the Nursing Scope of Practice as defined by the Department of Health. This includes demonstrating professional leadership by supervising the patient care team and upholding clinical standards and quality of patient care within their specialty. We are seeking a skilled and motivated physiotherapy specialist to join our Home Health Care and Corporate Health Centers team. Job Summary

The EEG Technician/Technologist is responsible for performing electroencephalogram (EEG) procedures to record and monitor patients’ brain electrical activity. The role involves preparing patients, operating EEG equipment, ensuring accurate recordings, maintaining patient safety and comfort, and assisting physicians with neurodiagnostic investigations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform routine and specialized EEG examinations according to physician orders and established clinical protocols.
  • Explain the EEG procedure to patients and obtain the necessary cooperation and consent.
  • Prepare patients for the examination and correctly apply EEG electrodes and other monitoring equipment.
  • Operate, calibrate, and troubleshoot EEG equipment to ensure high-quality recordings.
  • Monitor patients throughout the procedure and recognize and appropriately respond to clinical events, including seizure activity.
  • Maintain accurate patient and examination records and document relevant observations during the study.
  • Ensure proper identification of patients and adherence to infection-control and patient-safety procedures.
  • Perform activation procedures such as hyperventilation and photic stimulation when clinically indicated and within scope of practice.
  • Assist physicians/neurologists during EEG interpretation by providing relevant clinical and technical information.
  • Perform routine equipment checks and report technical problems or equipment malfunctions.
  • Clean, disinfect, and maintain EEG equipment and accessories according to infection-control standards.
  • Maintain patient confidentiality and comply with applicable healthcare regulations and facility policies.
  • Participate in quality-assurance activities, audits, and continuing professional development.
  • Provide appropriate patient education and reassurance before, during, and after the procedure.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in EEG Technology, Neurophysiology, Electroneurodiagnostic Technology, or a related healthcare field.
  • CANDIDATE MUST have their own visa ( sponsor visa , residence visa , golden visa , spouse visa since this position is TEMPORARY for 3 months.
  • DHA Eligibility / License is A MUST!
  • Relevant professional certification/registration, where required by the applicable healthcare authority.
  • Previous experience performing EEG procedures in a hospital, or neurodiagnostic setting is preferred.
  • Knowledge of EEG equipment, electrode placement, patient monitoring, and basic neurophysiology.
  • Good communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work effectively with neurologists, physicians, nurses, and other healthcare professionals.

The Case Management team shall operate in an effort to deliver the most efficient, effective allocation of health care resources, while maintaining the maximal quality of services provided.

The evidenced-based clinical decision support criteria will be used for the evaluation of medical necessity with relation to admission and continued stay.

The Utilization Review (UR)case manager (CM) has well-developed knowledge and skills in areas of utilization management (UM), medical necessity, and patient status determination. This individual is responsible for performing a variety of concurrent and retrospective UM-related reviews and functions and for ensuring that appropriate data is tracked, evaluated, and reported. This individual monitors the effectiveness/outcomes of the UM program, identifying and applying appropriate metrics, evaluating the data, reporting results to various audiences, and designing and implementing process improvement projects as needed. This individual identifies, develops, and provides orientation, training, and competency development for appropriate staff and colleagues on an ongoing basis. This individual leads and/or actively participates in process improvement initiatives, working with a variety of departments and multi-disciplinary staff. The UR CM effectively and efficiently manages a diverse workload in a fast-paced, rapidly-changing regulatory environment. Medical Lab Technologist – Special Chemistry and Functional Med


Job Description

The Medical Laboratory Technologist – Special Chemistry & Functional Medicine is responsible for performing specialized, moderate to high-complexity laboratory testing within the approved test menu to support accurate diagnosis, treatment monitoring, disease prevention, and personalized healthcare. Perform pre-analytical, analytical, and post-analytical laboratory functions including specimen assessment, Analytical processes, quality control, instrument operation, result verification within authorized scope, and technical troubleshooting.

The role ensures compliance with American Hospital Dubai policies and procedures, Dubai Health Authority (DHA) regulations, College of American Pathologists (CAP) accreditation requirements, Joint Commission International (JCI) standards, and recognized laboratory quality, safety, and professional practice standards.

Responsibilities

Technical Operations

  • Performs specialized chemistry and functional medicine testing within the approved laboratory scope, including endocrine, metabolic, nutritional, immunoassay, therapeutic drug monitoring, trace element, toxicology, and other advanced chemistry investigations using validated methodologies.
  • Assesses specimen acceptability by reviewing patient preparation, collection requirements, transport conditions, storage parameters, and other pre-analytical factors. Reject or escalate unsuitable specimens in accordance with laboratory policies and quality standards.
  • Conducts analytical testing accurately and efficiently while adhering to standard operating procedures, quality requirements, and established turnaround times.
  • Reviews and verifies analytical results within authorized scope, evaluating accuracy, consistency, reference intervals, delta checks, instrument flags, and critical values. Escalates unusual, discrepant, or clinically significant findings to senior laboratory technologists, supervisors, or pathologists as appropriate.
  • Operates, calibrates, maintains, and troubleshoots specialized laboratory analyzers and equipment, ensuring optimal functionality, reliability, and regulatory compliance.
  • Maintains comprehensive records of maintenance activities, instrument performance, calibration status, reagent utilization, and corrective actions.
  • Participates in the validation and verification of new instruments, reagents, assays, reference intervals, and methodology changes, including studies related to precision, accuracy, linearity, analytical measurement range, carryover, and method correlation.
  • Maintains accurate, complete, and timely documentation within the Laboratory Information System (LIS) and associated records.
  • Adheres to established reporting protocols and escalation pathways for critical results and laboratory issues.
  • Manages reagents, calibrators, quality control materials, consumables, and specialized testing kits through appropriate receipt, storage, lot verification, inventory monitoring, stock rotation, and expiry management. Assists in maintaining adequate inventory levels to ensure uninterrupted laboratory operations while minimizing wastage.
  • Provide technical guidance, mentoring, and support to students and trainees. 

Quality Assurance and Compliance

  • Performs and evaluates quality control, calibration, calibration verification, proficiency testing, external quality assessment activities, and other quality indicators to ensure analytical reliability and accuracy.
  • Investigates quality control failures, instrument performance issues, and non-conforming events, implementing corrective actions and documenting outcomes in accordance with laboratory procedures.
  • Ensures compliance with patient identification, traceability, confidentiality, data integrity, and document control requirements.
  • Collaborates effectively with pathologists, physicians, nursing staff, phlebotomists, laboratory colleagues, referral laboratories, and other stakeholders to ensure high-quality laboratory services and optimal patient outcomes. Provides technical support and guidance to laboratory colleagues within area of expertise.
  • Participates in continuing education, professional development, competency programs, and departmental training initiatives to maintain current knowledge and technical proficiency. Promotes a culture of safety, quality, teamwork, innovation, and patient-centered care.
  • Participates in internal audits, quality improvement initiatives, competency assessments, accreditation activities, and regulatory inspections to maintain continuous compliance with CAP, DHA, JCI, and other applicable standards.
  • Supports the investigation, documentation, and resolution of incidents, non-conformities, corrective actions, preventive actions, and risk management activities.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Medical Laboratory Science, Medical Laboratory Technology, Biomedical Science, Clinical Laboratory Science, or a related recognized discipline.
  • Current professional registration in the home country where applicable and valid Dubai Health Authority (DHA) License/Eligibility as a Medical Laboratory Technologist.
  • Strong knowledge of clinical chemistry, immunoassay principles, analytical instrumentation, quality control, calibration, specimen management, laboratory safety, and result interpretation within professional scope.
  • Knowledge of CAP accreditation requirements, DHA Clinical Laboratory Standards, JCI requirements, and ISO 15189 quality principles is preferred.
  • Proficiency in Laboratory Information Systems, analyzer middleware, quality-control applications, and standard Microsoft Office tools.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, communication, and organizational skills with high attention to accuracy, patient identification, confidentiality, and laboratory quality.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE:

  • Minimum of three (3) years of recent experience as a Medical Laboratory Technologist, preferably in Clinical Chemistry, Special Chemistry, Endocrinology, Immunoassay, or a comparable high-complexity laboratory section.
  • Demonstrated experience with automated and specialized chemistry/immunoassay platforms, quality control, calibration, instrument troubleshooting, and verification of analytical performance.
  • Experience with functional or personalized medicine-related laboratory testing, specialized send-out testing, or advanced metabolic and nutritional investigations is preferred.
  • Experience in assay validation/verification, proficiency testing, quality improvement, audit preparation, and corrective action processes is preferred.
  • Experience within a tertiary, CAP-accredited, JCI-accredited, or similarly regulated laboratory environment is highly preferred.

Responsibilities

Quality and Accuracy:

Job Description

Provides direct and indirect age-specific care for assigned patients in the Emergency Room per scheduled shifts. Responsible for professional performance and safe patient care. The role encompasses nursing assessment, diagnosis, planning, intervention, evaluation, and care coordination for patients across the healthcare continuum involving families. Abides by the Joint Commission International (JCI) requirements, including but not limited to International Patient Safety Goals, national and international standards.

Responsibilities

General:

  • Provides age-specific patient-centered care utilizing the nursing process:
    • Performs patient assessment using appropriate, problem-focused, and age-specific assessment techniques.

    • Involves the patient, significant others, and health care providers in the plan of care when appropriate.
    • Collaborates with a multi-disciplinary team to provide patient care.

  • Performs safe handling and administrating of Narcotic/Controlled and Semi-Controlled Drugs and documentation as directed by policies and procedures.

Unit Specific:

  • Interprets arterial blood gas.
  • Interprets basic Electrocardiogram (ECG).
  • Monitors arterial pressure.
  • Monitors central venous pressure.
  • Performs chest, abdomen, and back burn care.
  • Prepares Central Venous Access Devices (CVAD) for adults and pediatrics:
