    • Changing central venous catheter dressing.
    • Changing central venous catheter needless connector and line tubing.
  • Prepares Implanted Venous Access Devices (IVAD) for adults and pediatrics:
    • Accessing implanted port.
    • Accessing implanted port (top entry).
    • Sampling blood from the implanted port.
    • Removing the non-coring needle from the implanted port.
  • Prepares chest tubes:
    • Monitoring and caring for the chest tube drainage system.
    • Setting up chest tube drainage system.
  • Conducts COVID-19 Polymerase Chain Reaction (PCR) testing.
  • Measures creatinine levels.
  • Administers emergency medications to paediatrics.
  • Performs intubation with direct visualization.
  • Inserts and assists with intraosseous infusion device.
  • Removes the intraosseous infusion device.
  • Administers Intravenous (IV) alteplase for acute ischemic stroke.
  • Measures ketone levels.
  • Administers moderate sedation.
  • Performs rapid strep test using point-of-care testing (POCT).
  • Applies splints and casts.
  • Cares for tracheotomy tubes:
    • Suctioning tracheostomy.
    • Managing tracheostomy tube cannula and stoma.
  • Prepares mechanical ventilation during patient transport.
  • Conducts triage using the Emergency Severity Index (ESI).
  • Operates urine analysis machine.
  • Uses defibrillator for pediatric patients:
    • Performing cardioversion.
    • Performing defibrillation.
    • Performing transcutaneous pacing.

For Pediatrics:

  • Conducts aspiration precautions:
    • For child or adolescent
    • For children receiving enteral tube feedings
    • For infant
  • Calculates pediatric fluid requirements.
  • Conducts Implantable Venous Access Device (IVAD) for pediatrics:
    • Accessing implanted port.
    • Sampling blood from the implanted port.
    • Removing the non-coring needle from the implanted port.
  • Monitors cardiopulmonary status in paediatrics.
  • Prepares chest tubes in paediatrics:
    • Monitoring and caring for the chest tube drainage system.
    • Setting up chest tube drainage system.
    • Assisting with chest tube removal.
  • Utilizes handheld resuscitation bags and masks in paediatrics.
  • Conducts health history interviews and physical assessments in paediatrics.
  • Manages infiltration and extravasation in paediatrics.
  • Administers oxygen via nasal prongs to neonates.
  • Administers nebulized drugs to paediatrics.
  • Manages obstructed airways in children and infants.
  • Samples blood from a peripherally inserted central catheter in paediatrics.
  • Changes in dressing on the peripherally inserted central catheter in paediatrics.
  • Manages seizures in paediatrics.
  • Cares for pediatric tracheostomies:
    • Suctioning tracheostomy.
    • Changing tracheostomy ties.
    • Changing tracheostomy tube.

Preceptor’s Responsibilities (when applicable):

  • Completes the Preceptor workshop and meets the criteria indicators for the preceptor role on the unit.
  • Plans, implements and evaluates the individualized competency-based orientation in collaboration with the orientee, nurse manager, and clinical resource nurse.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in nursing (minimum of three (3) years full-time course duration) or
  • Degree in Nursing (minimum two (2) years course duration) and Registration as a Registered Nurse from Canada, USA, UK, Ireland, South Africa, New Zealand, and Australia.
  • For UAE nationals graduates of UAE or non-UAE universities are exempted from the experience and clinical training requirements for the applied title. (UAE nationals must submit a copy of their birth certificate and the mother’s family book).

  • Canadian Triage and Acuity Scale (CTAS) certification preferred

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE:

  • Skills in the assessment of patient and family’s physical and psychological needs.

Job Description

Our Nursing Vision: At NMC Healthcare, we are committed to providing clinical excellence through safe, compassionate, and individualized care to every patient, every time.

Our Nursing Mission: To exemplify clinical excellence, every NMC nurse will seek to:

  • Do the right thing
  • Be the patient’s advocate
  • Be open and transparent
  • Deliver safe, compassionate care
  • Recognize the uniqueness of each patient
  • Contribute to an outstanding patient’s experience
  • Engage with and contribute to, a learning culture
  • Lead and influence changes in healthcare

Our Nursing Values: We will achieve this through our core values:

  • Safety
  • Excellence
  • Ethics
  • Trust
  • Collaboration

The post holder will work collaboratively with other team members, uphold and live the NMC Nursing Strategy in order to provide safe and outstanding care to their patient, to the patient’s bystanders all the time, every time

Responsibilities

  • Be responsible for providing and coordinating patient care, educating patients and the public about various health conditions, and providing advice and emotional support to patients and their family members.
  • Assess and identify patients’ needs and implement and monitor the patient’s medical plan and treatment. They will work with a team of physicians and other health care specialists or allied health in various settings.
  • Perform systematic patient assessment, re-assessment and collect pertinent data about the patient’s health or situation.
  • Understand and analyse the assessment information and data.
  • Determine actual and potential nursing diagnoses, problems, and issues.
  • Define the predicted and expected outcomes of the patient’s planned care.
  • Create and evaluate patient care plans with the interprofessional team, in collaboration with the patient and patient’s bystanders.
  • Record vital signs, recognize, address and escalate all abnormalities.
  • Maintain and update technical and clinical skills related to nursing practice.
  • Employ strategies to promote patients’ health and a safe environment.
  • Understand different diagnostic tests and laboratory examinations.
  • Perform essential life support as per regulatory requirements and scope such as but not limited to Basic Life Support, Pediatric Advanced Life Support, Advanced Cardiac Life Support, Neonatal Resuscitation etc.
  • Prepare patients for medical examination and treatment. 
  • Administer medications and monitor patients for any side effects and reactions.
  • Administer treatments such as IV fluids or blood products and monitor patients for any reactions. 
  • Provide wound care management.
  • Assist in medical procedures invasive or non-invasive as needed. 
  • Facilitate the process of safe patient`s admission, transfer and discharge.
  • Administer medications, injections, immunizations, and IV therapies per clinic protocols.
  • Prepare patients for physician or provider examinations and assist during procedures.
  • Monitor and respond to patient phone calls, messages, and triage concerns appropriately.
  • Ensure infection control standards and patient safety practices are followed.
  • Verifies treatment orders relevant to the dialysis treatment for each individual patient
  • Assists in preparation of access site and takes proper care of access site using aseptic technique. 
  • Preparation of delivery system, dialysate bath and dialyzer, lines, system: Preparation of dialysate, Assembles the extracorporeal circuit, Primes blood lines and dialyzer aseptically, Tests the function status of monitors and alarms and sets them appropriately to ensure safety of patient.
  • Monitors patients and adjusts specialized equipment used on patients and interprets and records information.
  • Obtains and documents pre, intra and post dialysis vital signs, weight, and temperature.

Re-dominant role in preparation, administration and documentation of medications

Qualifications

  • Have an appropriate license to work as a registered nurse in the relevant regulatory health authority with all the qualifications and experience these mandates.
  • Manage their own professional re-licensure
  • Hold a valid American Heart Association Basic Life Support Provider card. 
  • Be willing to work across departments when necessary. 
  • Be able to communicate clearly and effectively in English (spoken and written) 
  • DESIRABLE: The post holder should have:
  • Evidenced ability to work as part of an inter-professional team.
  • Organizational and administrative skills with which to use the electronic medical record platform for clinical documentation.

Be able to communicate effectively in Arabic

Job Description

The Patient Care Coordinator serves as the patient’s named clinical key worker throughout the care pathway, from receipt of referral through treatment, follow-up, survivorship, or transition to palliative and supportive care. The role provides specialist nursing assessment, care coordination, patient and family education, symptom and risk screening, clinical triage, proactive follow-up, and timely escalation in collaboration with the responsible consultant, multidisciplinary team, and relevant support services.

The Patient Care Coordinator coordinates the patient’s end-to-end clinical pathway and works across organizational and professional boundaries to promote continuity, safety, and timely access to care. The role maintains regular contact with the patient and family, coordinates investigations and appointments, reviews outstanding actions, supports shared decision-making, and ensures that changes in clinical status or pathway delays are communicated promptly to the accountable clinical team.

Acting as the primary liaison for patients and families, the Care Coordinator facilitates access to a wide range of support services, including Finance and Insurance, Socio – Psycho and Counselling, Social Work, Nutrition, Rehabilitation, Palliative Care, and other allied health services as appropriate. The role ensures that patients and caregivers are not required to navigate complex healthcare processes independently and receive timely guidance, reassurance, and support.

The Patient Care Coordinator is a registered nursing role with responsibility for specialist assessment, care planning, clinical triage, symptom and toxicity screening within competence, patient education, care coordination, and escalation. Diagnosis, prescribing, and medical treatment decisions remain with the responsible medical practitioner and authorized multidisciplinary team members. The postholder practices within professional scope, approved competencies, organizational policies, and applicable regulatory requirements, and escalates any deterioration, safeguarding concern, complex symptom, or uncertainty without delay.

The role contributes to delivering a personalized, coordinated, and compassionate care experience that improves patient satisfaction, enhances access to supportive services, minimizes delays in care, and supports the achievement of organizational quality and patient experience objectives.

The role directly supports the performance of the institute’s and flagship program and the achievement of institute-level and executive performance commitments, through the KPIs and pathway data it owns. 

Responsibilities

  • Adheres to the approved standards of specialist nursing practice, clinical pathway coordination, and professional performance within the department, assigned clinical service, and relevant multidisciplinary partnerships.
  • Collects comprehensive data pertinent to the issues, situation, or trends related to the assigned pathway (e.g., referral volumes, appointment access, time-to-treatment).
  • Analyzes assessment data to determine the issues, problems, or trends impacting pathway performance, in line with CMSA’s emphasis on comprehensive assessment as the basis for a coordinated plan of care.
  • Identifies expected outcomes for a plan individualized to the patient’s situation, reflecting person-centered, whole-person coordination principles.
  • Develops a plan that prescribes effective strategies and alternative(s) to attain expected outcomes, in partnership with the patient, family/caregiver, and the multidisciplinary team.
  • Implements the identified plan: coordinates the implementation and associated processes; employs strategies to foster pathway efficiency, staff development, and process improvement.
  • Provides consultation to influence the identified plan, enhance the abilities of others, and effect change.
  • Evaluates progress towards attainment of outcomes and adjusts the plan as needed in discussion with clinical and operational leadership.
  • Enhances the quality and effectiveness of clinical operations, access management, and support services delivery in a systematic manner: evaluates the operating environment and quality of service rendered.
  • Attains knowledge and competency that reflects current practice: uses current data and industry best practices (e.g., NHS Personalised Care, CMSA, patient navigation standards) to enhance role performance and increase knowledge of professional issues.
  • Evaluates own practice in relation to professional practice standards and guidelines, relevant statutes, rules, and regulations.
  • Interacts with and contributes to the professional development of peers and colleagues.
  • Collaborates with all levels of clinical, medical, and administrative staff, interdisciplinary teams, executive leaders, and other stakeholders.
  • Integrates ethical provisions, including diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging principles, in all areas of practice, consistent with CMSA’s Standard on equitable, culturally competent care.
  • Integrates data and performance insights into practice: creates a supportive environment with sufficient resources for continuous improvement and operational excellence.
  • Maintains and demonstrates current knowledge in the administration of healthcare coordination to advance service delivery and the provision of quality healthcare services.
  • Professional Development: seeks experience to advance skills and knowledge in operations management, changes in healthcare systems, application of emerging technologies (including data analytics and AI), and innovative practice.
  • Communication: utilizes behaviors and skills which promote positive and professional communication within the work group and with patients/families.
  • Leadership: demonstrates forward-thinking leadership skills such as being a role model and mentor, a visionary and a planner, and a big-picture thinker who can enlist the voluntary support of others in building a joint future.
  • Management: demonstrates responsibility for the oversight of work processes, including analytical, financial, and work-coordination skills, judgment in decision-making, and service orientation.
  • Operations: provides specialized services that contribute to the operational success of the pathway/unit, including commitment to task, time management, prioritization, and follow-through to closure.
  • Community Resources: maintains current knowledge of internal and external community, charitable, and support resources (e.g., transport assistance, accommodation, patient support groups) and refers patients and families accordingly
  • Patient Empowerment: coaches and equips patients and families to build their own capacity to navigate the health system, ask informed questions, and participate actively in decisions, 
  • Barriers to Care / Health Disparities: proactively identifies logistical, financial, cultural, linguistic, or health-literacy barriers to care for each patient and documents and addresses them or escalates for resolution, per the GW Cancer Institute Barriers to Care/Health Disparities domain.
  • Health literacy is assessed using a standardized, brief screening instrument (e.g., Single Item Literacy Screener or Newest Vital Sign) rather than informal judgment, so results are consistent and auditable across the caseload.
  • Cultural Competency: delivers culturally sensitive support tailored to the patient’s and family’s background, beliefs, and language needs, arranging interpreter/translation services where required.
  • Outreach: supports outreach and awareness activities that improve early identification and timely entry of patients into the pathway, consistent with the GW Cancer Institute Outreach domain.
  • Undertakes holistic needs and distress screening using approved tools, interprets findings within professional competence, initiates appropriate nursing interventions, and coordinates referral to psychology, social work, palliative care, safeguarding, or other specialist services. Urgent risks are escalated immediately in accordance with policy.

Clinical Governance: practices in accordance with the professional code, scope of practice, approved clinical competencies, medicines management requirements, safeguarding procedures, infection prevention standards, consent requirements, and organizational clinical governance policies. Maintains contemporaneous clinical records, participates in incident review, audit, supervision, and quality improvement, and acts promptly on identified patient-safety risks.

Qualifications

Educational Qualification:

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Nursing or an equivalent recognised nursing qualification, with current registration and licence to practise as a registered nurse in the relevant jurisdiction.

Desired:

  • Postgraduate qualification or accredited specialist education relevant to the assigned clinical pathway, such as cancer nursing, advanced assessment, clinical decision-making, symptom management, palliative and supportive care, or an equivalent field.
  • Relevant accredited training in care coordination, personalised care, patient navigation, or case management, supported by evidence of continuing professional development in the assigned clinical specialty.
  • Certified Case Manager (CCM) credential from the Commission for Case Manager Certification (CCMC), or equivalent case management/patient navigation certification.

Experience:

Required:

  • Minimum five years of post-registration nursing experience, including at least two years in the relevant specialty or an equivalent complex care pathway. Demonstrated experience in holistic assessment, clinical triage, patient education, multidisciplinary working, care coordination, escalation, and management of an active caseload is required.

Desired:

  • Experience in a specialty care pathway coordination role, or experience within a multidisciplinary/tumor board or similar case-conference coordination process.

Additional Requirements:

Required:

  • Specialist clinical knowledge of the assigned pathway, including common presentations, investigations, treatments, treatment-related risks, symptom assessment, deterioration, psychosocial needs, safeguarding, rehabilitation, survivorship, and palliative and supportive care. Applies this knowledge safely within professional scope and approved competencies.
  • Demonstrated ability to support patients through their end-to-end care journey, providing guidance, reassurance, and continuity from referral through follow-up.
  • Ability to deliver clear, empathetic patient and family education tailored to individual understanding and needs throughout the care pathway.
  • Strong understanding of patient pathway coordination and multidisciplinary care models, consistent with CMSA and NHS care coordination frameworks.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills for liaising with patients, families, and multidisciplinary teams.
  • Proficiency with hospital information systems (e.g., Cerner) for scheduling, tracking, and documentation.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple patient cases simultaneously.
  • Data tracking and reporting skills to support pathway performance monitoring.

metas.experience: Minimum five years of post-registration nursing experience, including at least two years in the relevant specialty or an equivalent complex care pathway. Demonstrated experience in holistic assessment, clinical triage, patient education, multidisciplinary working, care coordination, escalation, and management of an active caseload is required.

Job Description

We are looking for a compassionate physician to provide primary care for patients suffering from injuries and common illnesses. The physician’s responsibilities include diagnosing and treating injuries, illnesses, and disorders, prescribing medications, making recommendations on lifestyle changes, and answering patients’ questions. A physician may work in one or more areas of specialization, such as anesthesiology, family and general medicine, internal medicine, and pediatrics.

To be a successful physician, you should be kind and compassionate towards your patients, with excellent communication and interpersonal skills. You should be knowledgeable, detail oriented, and have good problem-solving skills.

Responsibilities

  • Examining patients, taking medical histories, addressing patients’ concerns, and answering patients’ questions.
  • Diagnosing and treating injuries, illnesses, and disorders.
  • Ordering, performing, and interpreting diagnostic tests and explaining the results to patients.
  • Counseling patients on diet, hygiene, preventative healthcare, and other lifestyle changes.
  • Updating patients’ charts and information to reflect current findings and treatments.
  • Recommending and designing treatment plans.
  • Prescribing medications or therapies.
  • Explaining medical procedures to patients.
  • Consulting with other physicians, referring patients to specialists when necessary, and working with other healthcare staff, such as nurses, assistants, and other physicians.
  • Complying with medical laws (for example, HIPAA).

Qualifications

  • A medical degree and the successful completion of a residency and internship.
  • A state license and certification to practice medicine.
  • Knowledge and experience in diagnosing and treating a wide variety of illnesses.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Good leadership, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Dexterity and detail oriented abilities.
  • Patience and compassion.
  • The ability and willingness to stay up to date on advancements, innovations, and developments in the field.

The Registrar / Senior Registrar is responsible for providing high-quality, patient-centered and evidence-based medical care in accordance with hospital policies, ethical standards, and regulatory requirements. This role ensures effective diagnosis and treatment, maintains patient safety, and supports clinical excellence through collaboration, continuous professional development, and participation in training and educational activities.

1. Clinical Care and Patient Safety

  • Provide comprehensive, professional, and ethical clinical services to patients.

Job Description

The Senior Medical Laboratory Technologist – Genomics provides technical oversight and performs high-complexity molecular and genomic testing within the laboratory’s approved scope of services. The role is responsible for ensuring the accuracy, quality, and timeliness of genomic diagnostic testing through oversight of pre-analytical, analytical, and post-analytical processes, including specimen assessment, nucleic acid extraction, assay preparation, sequencing workflows, quality control, technical review, troubleshooting, and workflow coordination.

The position serves as a technical resource for laboratory staff and supports competency assessment, staff development, method verification and validation, quality management activities, and continuous process improvement initiatives. The Senior Technologist ensures compliance with American Hospital Dubai policies and procedures, Dubai Health Authority (DHA) regulations, College of American Pathologists (CAP) accreditation requirements, Joint Commission International (JCI) standards, and applicable genomic data privacy, security, and governance regulations.

Responsibilities

Technical Operations

  • Performs and coordinates high-complexity molecular and genomic testing within the approved test menu, including nucleic acid extraction, PCR/qPCR, sequencing workflows, library preparation, and other validated molecular techniques as applicable.
  • Reviews specimen suitability, patient and sample identification, collection requirements, transport, storage, chain of custody, and pre-analytical variables, ensuring complete traceability and timely escalation of unsuitable or discrepant specimens.
  • Oversees daily technical workflow and prioritization within the Genomics Lab, monitors turnaround times and pending work, and provides technical guidance to technologists to maintain safe, accurate, and efficient service delivery.
  • Operates, maintains, and troubleshoots genomic laboratory equipment and software platforms, coordinating preventive maintenance, service support, reagent readiness, environmental controls, and downtime contingencies with relevant teams and vendors.
  • Supports verification and validation of new assays, instruments, reagents, software, and workflow changes, including accuracy, precision, analytical sensitivity/specificity, reportable range, reference materials, contamination controls, and required technical documentation.
  • Reviews analytical data and test results within authorized professional scope, identifies quality or technical concerns, and escalates significant, discordant, or clinically relevant findings to the responsible laboratory specialist, pathologist, or authorized reporting professional.
  • Leads staff orientation, technical training, competency assessment, procedure updates, and bench-level coaching; supports audits, CAP/DHA/JCI accreditation readiness, non-conformity investigations, CAPA, and continuous quality improvement initiatives.
  • Provide technical guidance, mentoring, and support to students.

Quality Assurance and Compliance

  • Performs and evaluates quality control, calibration, calibration verification, proficiency testing, external quality assessment activities, and other quality indicators to ensure analytical reliability and accuracy.
  • Investigates quality control failures, instrument performance issues, and non-conforming events, implementing corrective actions and documenting outcomes in accordance with laboratory procedures.
  • Ensures compliance with patient identification, traceability, confidentiality, data integrity, and document control requirements.
  • Maintains accurate genomic laboratory records and data within the LIS and approved systems, ensuring confidentiality, controlled access, secure handling, auditability, retention, and compliance with applicable human genetic and genomic data-governance requirements.
  • Collaborates effectively with pathologists, physicians, nursing staff, phlebotomists, laboratory colleagues, referral laboratories, and other stakeholders to ensure high-quality laboratory services and optimal patient outcomes. Provides technical support and guidance to laboratory colleagues within area of expertise.
  • Participates in continuing education, professional development, competency programs, and departmental training initiatives to maintain current knowledge and technical proficiency. Promotes a culture of safety, quality, teamwork, innovation, and patient-centered care.
  • Participates in internal audits, quality improvement initiatives, competency assessments, accreditation activities, and regulatory inspections to maintain continuous compliance with CAP, DHA, JCI, and other applicable standards.
  • Supports the investigation, documentation, and resolution of incidents, non-conformities, corrective actions, preventive actions, and risk management activities.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Medical Laboratory Science, Medical Laboratory Technology, Molecular Biology, Genetics, Biomedical Science, or a related recognized discipline.
  • Current professional registration in the home country where applicable and valid Dubai Health Authority (DHA) License/Eligibility appropriate to the professional title and approved scope of practice.
  • Advanced knowledge of molecular diagnostics and genomic laboratory workflows, including nucleic acid extraction, PCR-based methods, sequencing, quality control, contamination prevention, and analytical troubleshooting.
  • Knowledge of DHA Standards for Genomic Services, DHA Molecular and Genomics Testing Laboratory requirements, CAP laboratory accreditation requirements, JCI standards, and ISO 15189 quality principles is preferred.
  • Working knowledge of Laboratory Information Systems, genomic laboratory software, sequencing platforms, data transfer workflows, and applicable bioinformatics interfaces is preferred.
  • Strong leadership, analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, communication, and organizational skills with exceptional attention to patient identification, traceability, confidentiality, and data integrity.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE:

  • Minimum of five (5) years of recent experience in Medical Laboratory Science or Molecular Diagnostics, with at least three (3) years of hands-on experience in a molecular or genomics laboratory.
  • Demonstrated experience with next-generation sequencing and/or other high-complexity molecular platforms, including sample preparation, quality assessment, instrument operation, troubleshooting, and technical review.
  • Experience in assay validation/verification, proficiency testing, quality control review, non-conformity investigation, corrective action, and accreditation preparation is required.
  • Previous experience providing technical supervision, staff training, competency assessment, or workflow coordination in a molecular/genomics laboratory is highly preferred.
  • Experience within a tertiary, CAP-accredited, JCI-accredited, or similarly regulated laboratory environment is highly preferred.

The Division Chief – Endocrinology reporting to the Executive Chair – Medicine provides clinical, education, research and executive management leadership in Endocrinology.  The Division Chief is a clinical and managerial leader working with the Sidra executive team to develop and deliver strategy and business plans and is accountable for resources and performance in Endocrinology and integrates research and education priorities into a program of excellent clinical service delivery, specialized outpatient clinical services including diagnostic and therapeutic procedures for complex and complicated procedures, consultations and case management, and other associated clinical and academic activites. Danat Al Emarat is a world-class specialty women’s and children’s hospital in the Emirate of Abu Dhabi. A Healthcare Aide in the Labour and Delivery Department provides essential support to nurses, midwives, and physicians in delivering safe, compassionate, and patient-centered care to mothers during labor, delivery, and the immediate postpartum period. The Healthcare Aide assists with patient comfort, hygiene, mobility, and basic care needs while helping maintain a clean, safe, and supportive environment for patients and their families. Working collaboratively with the multidisciplinary team, they contribute to a positive childbirth experience and support the efficient operation of the department.

Responsibilities

  • Assist patients with activities of daily living, including personal hygiene, grooming, dressing, and toileting.
  • Provide comfort measures to laboring mothers, such as assisting with positioning, ambulation, and non-pharmacological pain relief techniques.
  • Support patient mobility and safe transfers within the unit.
  • Measure and record vital signs as directed and report any abnormalities to the nursing staff.
  • Assist nurses and midwives in preparing patients for examinations, procedures, and delivery.
  • Monitor and maintain cleanliness, safety, and organization of patient rooms, delivery suites, and equipment.
  • Restock medical supplies, linens, and essential equipment in patient care areas.
  • Transport patients, specimens, equipment, and medical records as required.
  • Assist with postpartum care by supporting mothers with basic comfort and hygiene needs after delivery.
  • Support newborn care activities under the supervision of nursing staff, including preparing supplies and maintaining a safe environment.
  • Observe and report changes in patients’ physical, emotional, or behavioral conditions to the healthcare team.
  • Provide emotional support and reassurance to patients and their families during labor and delivery.
  • Assist in maintaining infection prevention and control standards.
  • Ensure patient privacy, dignity, and confidentiality at all times.
  • Respond promptly to patient call bells and requests for assistance.
  • Participate in emergency situations by providing support to the healthcare team within the scope of practice.
  • Document care activities accurately according to hospital policies and procedures.
  • Collaborate effectively with nurses, midwives, physicians, and other members of the multidisciplinary team to ensure high-quality patient care.

Qualifications

  • Certified Nursing Assistant Course preferred.

PURPOSE OF THE ROLE:

The role of the case manager is to ensure a smooth and wholesome patient safety centric approach from the point of admission of the patient up until discharge whilst ensuring the appropriate level of care is implemented in line with the plan of care. The role would also perform the necessary advocacy on the services and plans formulated during the stay whilst adhering to the insurance approvals and advocating the patients’ requirements to the respective hospital stakeholders.

ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES:

Care Facilitation

  • Assess all patients
  • Clinical
  • Psycho-social
  • Economic-review financial coverage of all inpatients

Proactive Length of Stay Management

  • Calculate LOS (for patient who transfer to acute, HDU or ICU from LTC or PAR or LTAC areas)
  • Round daily with physicians, Charge Nurses, Social Workers, PAA, communicate LOS, discuss plan of care, clinical documentation, psychosocial issues/barriers, Utilization Review + Utilization Management issues, continuum of care facilitation, MDT coordination, plan for discharge, follow up community support, repatriation.

Utilization Management

  • Confirm benefit coverage to avoid delays, each month for: LTC; PAR & LTAC patients
  • Ensure appropriate treatment/intervention based on medical necessity and supported by physician documentation
  • Diagnostic testing directly related to the admitting diagnosis
  • Frequency of diagnostic testing
  • Cost effective yet clinically appropriate selection of diagnostic testing

Utilization Review

  • Medical Necessity – support physician decision making with evidence based admission, continued stay and discharge screening criteria
  • Clinical liaison/interface, review criteria for admission and give recommendations

Plan for Discharge

  • Have more than one plan underway to deal with a discharge
  • Engage patients and families early in the planning process
  • Facilitate and implement plan for transfer, repatriation, follow up

Clinical Documentation

  • Facilitate accurate physician documentation which supports medical necessity of admission and resource utilization and accurately reflects severity of illness, risk of mortality to support justification to Payer for Authorization each month
  • Outcome directly related to Case Mix Index
  • Work with MDT team and facilitate MDT summary note

Plan of Care

  • Facilitate and participate in Physician and MDT rounds and chart reviews, to identify any potential or real change in patient condition or treatment plan that would require modification to address the need for increased or reduced services at time of discharge.
  • Ensure appropriate consults are in place and performed in a timely manner.
  • Provide clinical information to payers as indicated for continued stay authorization.
  • Collaborate with the Social Worker to Identify appropriate resources to provide post discharge care for those patients who are able to transition back to home.
  • Communicate patient anticipated discharge plan and continuing care needs and services for those patients able to transition back to home.
  • Review final discharge plan with patient/family and MDT Monitoring and Evaluation

Advocacy

  • Promote the use of the most appropriate setting in meeting each patients needs to maximize quality of care, utilization of resources and insurance benefits.
  • Promote patient and family rights to self-determination and involvement in care planning and goal setting.
  • Collaborate with the Social Worker to Involve appropriate hospital and community resources, as needed, to address patients medical, ethical, financial, psychosocial and legal issues
  • Coordination of school placement for Pediatric patients with families
  • Entitlement assessments
  • Patient advocacy and environmental interventions

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Nursing
  • 2 years Clinical Nursing or Case Manager/Leadership Experience
  • DOH License
  • Commission for Case Manager Certification, or equivalent
  • Fluent in written and oral Arabic language

Location: Dubai, Dubai, AE

Company: FakeehCare

ABOUT US

Fakeeh Health is a pioneering healthcare group brought to the UAE by the esteemed founders of Fakeeh Care Group, KSA. With a strong legacy in clinical excellence, research & innovation, and academic integration, Fakeeh Health stands as a testament to our unwavering commitment to delivering holistic, high-quality, and accessible healthcare.

Fakeeh Health includes a network of patient-focused facilities led by our flagship, Fakeeh University Hospital, where Person-Centered Care (PCC) guides both patient and employee experiences. As a Planetree-aligned organization, we foster a supportive and empowering work culture. Our network also includes Fakeeh MediCenters across Dubai for accessible primary care, the tech-enabled Fakeeh Smart Clinic for hybrid physical and virtual care, and Fakeeh DaySurge, focused on minimally invasive, same-day procedures.

Aligned with our organizational values and PCC goals, we value professionals who bring experience in community engagement or corporate social responsibility (CSR), as such backgrounds reflect our shared commitment to meaningful social impact and community upliftment.

JOB PURPOSE:

To provide total patient care to an assigned group of patients within the framework of Fakeeh Care, accreditation standards and Ministry of Health requirements on a 24/7 basis, either day or night shift.
 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES & DUTIES:

  • Assess, plans, implements, evaluates and documents nursing care of patients in accordance with organizational policies and in accordance with standards of professional nursing practice utilizing the framework of professional nursing practice and development. 
  • Assures quality of care by adhering to therapeutic standards; measuring health outcomes against patient care goals and standards; making or recommending necessary adjustments; following hospital and nursing division’s philosophies and standards.
  • Maintains accurate, detailed reports and records.
  • Monitors, records and reports symptoms and changes in patients’ conditions.
  • Assesses and cares for the normal newborn immediately after birth.
  • Provides assistance with post-partum care including breastfeeding.
  • Sets up for deliveries and other procedures, including Emergency C-sections.
  • Cleans equipment, forwards same for re-sterilization and helps set up for next case. Coordinate with the maintenance of a clean, safe environment.
  • Assists with patient examination.
  • After successfully completing relevant competencies may:
    • Apply CTG Monitor.
    • Conduct Phlebotomy.
    • Conduct IV Cannulation.
  • Provides assistance in emergency procedures as well as elective and rescheduled cases.
  • Assists and supports patient during labor and delivery process.
  • Documents patients’ medical and clinical information and health assessments in HIS.
  • Prepares patients for, and assist with, examinations and treatments.
     

.

  • Provides comprehensive, safe and effective evidence-based nursing & midwifery care to achieve identified health outcomes. Promotes healing environment.
  • Recognizes and upholds the rights of all patients accessing health services and advocate on their behalf while maintaining cultural sensitivity.
  • Prepares rooms, sterile instruments, equipment and supplies, and ensure that stock of supplies is maintained. Assists in the maintenance of all supplies and equipment and clean-up/ re-set after deliveries and C-Sections.
  • Plans and evaluate nursing & midwifery care in consultation with the multidisciplinary health care team and patients and families using effective interpersonal communication.
  • Contributes to team effort by accomplishing related results as needed.
  • Refers and co-ordinates the patients’ discharge arrangements with the case manager 
  • Provides and facilitates appropriate training and ongoing support to students and less experienced health service staff within the delegated scope of practice, as and when required.
  • Directs and supervises less skilled nursing/health care personnel, students and interns and visit patients to ensure that proper care is provided.
  • Protects patients and employee by adhering to infection-control policies and protocols, medication administration and storage procedures, and controlled substance regulations.
  • Performs other QI responsibilities as delegated from time to time by the Nurse Manager.
  • Upholds quality initiatives that improve ‘customer care’ and enhance the interface between staff, patients and visitors.
  • Demonstrates awareness of personnel responsibilities in relation to the maintenance of a clean and safe environment and identification of potential risks for all personnel, patients and visitors, taking action as and when required.
  • Shows awareness of the role of the midwife in handling complaints in accordance with Fakeeh care policy.
  • Uses critical thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making within each step of the care process.
  • Employs strategies to promote health and a safe environment by providing the adequate education and engagement to the patient and family.
  • Practices within professional and ethical framework in accordance with the nursing/ midwifery profession’s codes of ethics and conduct.
     

.

  • Accepts individuals/groups regardless of race, culture, religion, age, gender, sexual preference, physical or mental state.
  • Ensures that personal values and attitudes are not imposed on others.
  • Seeks assistance and escalates operational and clinical issues to nursing supervisor to resolve situations when needed.
  • Identifies and attempts to overcome factors which may constrain ethical decisions, in consultation with the health care team.
  • Maintains professional and technical knowledge by attending educational workshops; reviewing professional publications; establishing personal networks; participating in professional societies.
  • Contributes to annual appraisal and is responsible for own personal Development Program.
  • Assists in the development and implementation of nursing/midwifery practice guidelines, standards and policies.
  • Assists in the training and development students, trainees, interns, and participates in the Transition to Practice Programs for fresh graduates.
  • Participates in shared-governance, decision-making structures and process that establish standards of practice and address opportunities for improvement.
  • Promotes continuous, consistent, efficient, and accountable delivery of nursing & midwifery care using Professional Practice Model and appropriate care delivery system.
  • Provides Exemplary professional practice evidenced by effective and efficient care services, inter-professional collaboration, and high-quality patient outcomes.
  • Participates in programs related to evidence-based practices and research programs and integrate evidence-based practice and research into clinical and operational process.
  • Creates partnerships with patients and families to establish goals and plans for delivery of patient-centered care.
  • Participates recruitment and retention assessment and planning activities.
  • Participates in the review, action planning, and evaluation of patient safety data at the unit level.
  • Disseminates the organization’s nursing research findings to internal and external audiences.
  • Evaluates and use evidence-based findings in their practice.
  • Participates in the design and implementation of technology to enhance the patient experience and nursing /midwifery practice.
     

Skills and Abilities:

Manages work pressure and can work in a team effectively.

Experience:

Minimum of 2 years of experience as Midwife 

Education:

Diploma in Midwifery

Licenses / Certifications:

License from the country of origin, License for practice as per the regional health regulatory authority e.g. (SCFHS / DHA), BLS, ACLS and other LSTC courses as applicable.
 

COMPETENCIES:

  • Adaptability & Resilience
  • Accountability & Role Understanding with Accreditation Knowledge
  • Teamwork and Relationship Building with Cultural Alignment
  • Talent Management and Development
  • Compassionate and Effective Communication

Job Summary

The Consultant Psychiatrist is responsible for providing comprehensive assessment, diagnosis, treatment, and ongoing management of patients with a wide range of mental health and psychiatric conditions. The role involves delivering evidence-based, patient-centered care and working collaboratively with multidisciplinary teams to support the psychological and overall well-being of patients.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct comprehensive psychiatric assessments, including clinical history, mental status examination, and risk assessment.
  • Diagnose and manage a wide range of psychiatric and mental health conditions.
  • Develop individualized treatment plans based on patients’ clinical needs.
  • Provide pharmacological and, where appropriately trained, psychological interventions.
  • Monitor patients’ response to treatment and adjust medications or treatment plans as required.
  • Assess and manage patients presenting with acute psychiatric conditions and clinical emergencies.
  • Evaluate and manage risks related to self-harm, suicide, aggression, abuse, and other safeguarding concerns.
  • Provide appropriate referrals to psychologists, therapists, social workers, or other medical specialists when required.
  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to ensure coordinated and comprehensive patient care.
  • Provide psychiatric consultations for patients with complex medical or psychological needs when required.
  • Maintain accurate, timely, and confidential medical records and clinical documentation.
  • Communicate effectively with patients and their families regarding diagnosis, treatment options, prognosis, and follow-up care.
  • Provide appropriate patient and family education regarding mental health conditions and treatment.
  • Participate in multidisciplinary meetings, case conferences, clinical audits, and quality improvement activities.
  • Comply with hospital policies, professional standards, infection control procedures, and patient safety requirements.
  • Maintain current knowledge of developments in psychiatry through continuing professional education and clinical training.
  • Support and mentor junior doctors and other healthcare professionals when required.

Qualifications

  • Medical degree (MBBS/MD or equivalent) from a recognized and accredited medical institution.
  • Recognized postgraduate qualification in Psychiatry, such as:
    • MD/MS in Psychiatry,
    • Fellowship/Membership of a recognized psychiatric college or professional body, or
    • Equivalent recognized specialist qualification.
  • Completion of recognized specialist training in Psychiatry.
  • Valid professional license or eligibility from the relevant health authority.
  • Current BLS certification; additional relevant certifications are an advantage.

Experience

  • Minimum 5 years of post-specialty experience in Psychiatry, preferably in a hospital or multidisciplinary healthcare setting.
  • Previous experience at Consultant or Specialist level is preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience in the assessment and management of a broad range of psychiatric disorders.
  • Experience in managing acute psychiatric presentations and complex mental health cases.
  • Experience in multidisciplinary team collaboration is highly desirable.

Skills & Competencies

  • Excellent psychiatric assessment, diagnostic, and clinical decision-making skills.
  • Strong knowledge of evidence-based psychiatric treatments and psychopharmacology.
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and counseling skills.
  • Strong risk assessment and crisis management abilities.
  • Compassionate, ethical, and patient-centered approach.
  • Ability to establish effective therapeutic relationships with patients and families.
  • Strong documentation and organizational skills.
  • Ability to work effectively as part of a multidisciplinary healthcare team.
  • Commitment to patient safety, confidentiality, and professional ethics.
  • Proficiency in English; knowledge of Arabic is an advantage.

Responsible for the effective management and quality of critical HIS master data supporting RCM operations, including pricing, packages, insurance plans and policy masters. The role also supports RCM system and process improvements, identifying operational gaps, system inefficiencies and opportunities for automation or digitalization.

The role acts as a key interface between RCM, IT/HIS, Finance, Contracts & Pricing and operational teams, translating business requirements into accurate system configurations, process enhancements and practical digital solutions that improve billing accuracy, operational efficiency and revenue capture.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

1. HIS Master Data Management

  • Manage and maintain critical HIS master data required for accurate RCM billing and revenue capture.
  • Maintain pricing masters, including tariffs, rate plans, effective dates, payer-specific pricing and related configurations.
  • Maintain package masters, including package components, pricing, validity and payer/plan applicability.
  • Manage Insurance Plan / Policy Masters, including insurer, plan, network and rate-plan mappings.
  • Ensure timely and accurate implementation of approved pricing, contractual, payer and regulatory changes within HIS.
  • Perform detailed validation and QC of master-data updates before and after implementation.
  • Ensure appropriate documentation, approvals and audit trails are maintained for master-data changes.
  • Identify and resolve incorrect mappings, duplicate masters, configuration inconsistencies and other data-quality issues.

2. HIS System & Process Improvements

  • Proactively identify system and process gaps within the RCM billing lifecycle and assess their operational and financial impact.
  • Review existing workflows, system configurations and business processes to identify opportunities to improve efficiency, controls and billing accuracy.
  • Work with RCM stakeholders and IT/HIS teams to define and implement system enhancements addressing identified gaps.
  • Translate operational requirements into business requirements, functional specifications and system/process improvement opportunities.
  • Evaluate opportunities to introduce system controls, validations, alerts, workflow changes and automated checks to prevent errors at source.
  • Participate in solution design, testing, UAT and implementation of system and process enhancements.
  • Monitor implemented changes to ensure the intended business outcome is achieved and identify any downstream impacts.
  • Maintain a structured log of system/process improvement opportunities, prioritizing initiatives based on business impact, risk, effort and revenue implications.

3. Digital Solutions & Automation

  • Identify manual, repetitive and error-prone RCM activities that can be improved through automation, digital tools or workflow solutions.
  • Work with IT and relevant stakeholders to test and operationalize solutions.
  • Assess the effectiveness of implemented solutions through measurable improvements in accuracy, turnaround time, manual effort and process control.
  • Continuously identify opportunities to simplify and digitize RCM processes.

4. Master Data Quality & System Controls

  • Establish and perform appropriate maker-checker and QC controls for critical HIS master-data updates.
  • Conduct periodic audits of pricing, package and insurance master data.
  • Validate effective dates, pricing logic, payer mappings and other critical parameters against approved source documents.
  • Analyse billing issues linked to incorrect system configuration and perform root-cause analysis.
  • Recommend system or process controls to prevent recurring errors.
  • Ensure master-data standards and system configurations are consistently applied across facilities and business units.

5. RCM Analytics & Operational Insights

  • Analyse RCM operational data to identify billing trends, anomalies, process gaps and potential revenue leakage.
  • Develop and maintain operational reports and dashboards supporting RCM performance monitoring.
  • Analyse the impact of pricing, system and process changes on billing outcomes.
  • Provide data-driven insights to support prioritization of system enhancements and process improvements.
  • Support RCM management with analysis of operational issues and improvement opportunities.

Physician – Interventional Radiology provides specialist clinical radiology services for the Department of Radiology with particular regard to service provision in women’s, pediatric and neonatal imaging for patients and medical research. The individual occupying this position reports directly to the Division Chief – Interventional Radiology and works cooperatively with radiologists, department staff and other stakeholders, including referring clinicians and patients.  S/he provides educational support in radiology to junior medical and other staff. The Physician – Interventional Radiology will have an academic appointment to Weill Cornell Medical College – Qatar.

Through the diagnostic interpretation of high-quality images, the Physician – Interventional Radiology is responsible for ensuring a high standard of service is continually provided to all patients, their families and other hospital staff as prescribed in the patient care and facility standards set down by Sidra Medical and Research Center.  It is expected that the Physician – Interventional Radiology will perform research or pursue approved academic initiatives during dedicated academic time, which will be provided throughout the year. Furthermore, participation in continuous quality improvement is mandatory and it is expected that all staff will contribute to this important and continually evolving process.

Responsibilities

KEY ROLE ACCOUNTABILITIES

  • Provides diagnostic consultation related to diagnostic imaging to other members of the medical staff and performs and provides interpretation of diagnostic radiologic imaging examinations.
  • Performs and provides interpretation of interventional radiology examinations, and provide consultation related to interventional radiology to other members of the medical staff. Examinations, procedures, and studies performed will include the full range of interventional radiology work that would be performed by an appropriately credentialed interventional radiologist, with a primary focus on pediatric interventional techniques.
  • Prepares all records and reports as may be required in support of services rendered and as required by  Qatar State Law
  • Provides clinical services as assigned. Responsible for clinical services provided in area during assigned time frame, which could include an evening shift rotation and participation in on call roster.  All scheduling in radiology is established at the direction of the Chief of Radiology.
  • Provides advice and opinions in support of diagnostic interpretations of radiological examinations and procedures as provided in conjunction with patient care.
  • Performs STAT and emergency interventional radiology procedures and provide verbal/written results of critical results to clinical staff as directed by the facility policy.
  • Develops assists and/or participates in medical research/academic projects as directed by the Chief of Radiology.
  • Is accessible and available to referring physicians, technologists & clerical staff. Maintains good working relationships with peers, as well as with technical and clerical staff. Provides quality services as demonstrated by procedural success and complication rates, and compliance with local legislation and ACR Documentation Standard. Works cooperatively with other members of department to ensure that a high standard of patient care services is maintained.
  • Sidra will be using a structured report format, and all radiologists will be required to issue reports in this format. Furthermore, all reports will be issued via voice recognition software. 
  • Sidra is a digital environment, and as such, it is expected that radiologists will become fluent in the use of appropriate digital systems; training will be provided. 
  • Facilitates patient access to medical care by recommending appropriate referrals to other health care providers in accordance with policies and regulations of the facility.
  • Ensures quality improvement programs and competency assessment initiatives for the Department of Radiology are followed by the radiology patient care team
  • Undertakes appraisals of staff as directed. Assists with the process of recruiting Radiologists as requested. Assists with orientation for new Radiologists, as requested. Participates in professional local, regional and/or national organizations and meetings. Participates in other service activities in support of the facility
  • Participates in mandatory training and actively practices continual professional development in alignment with Sidra’s professional development programs to ensure maintenance of professional licensure/accreditation
  • Develops and/or delivers training programs to new employees on equipment and procedures in the area of operations in alignment with the department’s and Sidra’s training objectives and plans
  • Is an educational resource for radiology and contributes to the education of patients, staff and physicians and other stakeholders as required
  • Provides support and relief for other Radiologists as required
  • Participates in community outreach programs and tele radiology initiatives undertaken by the organization
  • Observes and implements departmental and applicable organizational policies, procedures, regulations and information to the radiology patient care team
  • Adheres to and promotes compliance with the hospital’s radiation safety and protection policy and associated codes of practice, and takes appropriate action where non-compliance is evident
  • Demonstrates the ability to be flexible, organized and function under stressful situations
  • Represents the organization in a positive and professional manner. Communicates the mission, ethics and goals of the facility, and maintains patient confidentiality at all times

Qualifications

QUALIFICATION & EXPERIENCE

Education

  • Medical Degree 
  • Completion of residency program in Radiology (or equivalent)
  • Subspecialty training or Fellowship in pediatric interventional radiology

Experience

2+ years of training/fellowship experience in pediatric interventional radiology

About Us

Sidra Medicine a healthy population is essential to a strong, prosperous society, and throughout 2020, Sidra continued to provide uninterrupted comprehensive specialist healthcare services for children and young people; and exceptional maternity, gynecology, and reproductive medical services for women, previously unavailable in Qatar and the region.” – H.H Sheikha Moza bint Nasser, Chairperson of Qatar Foundation 

Sidra Medicine represents the vision of Her Highness Sheikha Moza bint Nasser who serves as its Chairperson. This high-tech facility is home to world-class patient care, scientific expertise, and educational resources.

Sidra Medicine  is an exciting and dynamic medical, education and research facility in which to work, learn and contribute.  

We provide opportunities for professionals to build rewarding careers.  No matter where you work in our hospital, you’ll have great benefits and the satisfaction of caring for those in need in our community.

Exercise physiology is the use of physical activity for therapy, treatment, and prevention of chronic diseases. Responsible for safe implementation of standardized evidence-based practice specific to each individual. Therapy includes Implementation of lifestyle modification and behaviour pattern changes to facilitate physical wellbeing.

  • Performs evaluation of patient specific needs and formulate a comprehensive holistic exercise physiology treatment plan.
  • Reviews and analyses patient chart for pertinent medical history, including test results and x-ray reports.

  • Educate the patient and family members on the patient’s functional status, predicted outcomes, appropriate preventative and or exercise physiology specific details for discharge purposes.
  • Administers treatment programs and services utilizing best evidence for skilled techniques and interventions related to biomechanics and functional wellbeing.
  • Monitor patient’s medical status, review and revise treatment plans, provide intervention if regression occurs and involve relevant health professionals.
  • Participate in multidisciplinary team meetings to determine best outcome for the patient.
  • Document required information pertinent to patient in an efficient and timely manner in the patient medical record following hospitals standards.

Key Responsibilities Antenatal Care

  • Conduct comprehensive antenatal assessments and risk screenings.
  • Obtain detailed obstetric, medical, surgical, family, and social histories.
  • Monitor maternal and fetal wellbeing throughout pregnancy.
  • Assess fetal growth, fetal heart rate, fetal movements, and maternal health status.
  • Recognize, document, and report high-risk pregnancy indicators.
  • Provide antenatal counseling and health education.
  • Educate women regarding:
    • Nutrition during pregnancy.
    • Birth planning.
    • Pain management options.
    • Breastfeeding preparation.
    • Newborn care.
    • Family planning.
    • Pregnancy warning signs.
  • Support emotional wellbeing and psychosocial needs of expectant mothers.
  • Facilitate referrals to physicians and specialists when required.

Intrapartum Care (Labor & Delivery)

  • Assess women during labor using established clinical guidelines.
  • Monitor maternal vital signs and labor progression.
  • Perform fetal surveillance and fetal heart rate monitoring.
  • Conduct vaginal examinations within scope of practice.
  • Interpret labor findings and identify deviations from normal progress.
  • Provide continuous labor support and advocacy.
  • Promote physiological and woman-centered childbirth practices.
  • Assist mothers with labor positioning, mobility, and comfort measures.
  • Support pharmacological and non-pharmacological pain management strategies.
  • Prepare laboring women for delivery procedures.
  • Conduct normal vaginal deliveries where permitted by regulatory and organizational policies.
  • Assist obstetricians during instrumental or operative deliveries.
  • Anticipate and respond appropriately to obstetric emergencies.
  • Maintain accurate labor and delivery documentation.

Postnatal Care

  • Perform comprehensive maternal assessments following delivery.
  • Monitor recovery during the immediate postpartum period.
  • Assess uterine involution, lochia, pain management, and overall maternal wellbeing.
  • Identify postpartum complications including:
    • Postpartum hemorrhage.
    • Infection.
    • Thromboembolic events.
    • Mental health concerns.
  • Support maternal physical and emotional adjustment following childbirth.
  • Provide discharge education and follow-up instructions.
  • Promote early mobilization and recovery.

Newborn Care

  • Perform immediate newborn assessment and stabilization.
  • Monitor neonatal adaptation during the transition period.
  • Assess newborn vital signs and physical condition.
  • Support skin-to-skin contact between mother and infant.
  • Promote early initiation of breastfeeding.
  • Recognize neonatal complications requiring escalation.
  • Assist with newborn examinations and screening procedures.
  • Administer prescribed medications and immunizations.
  • Educate parents regarding:
    • Newborn feeding.
    • Hygiene and cord care.
    • Safe sleeping practices.
    • Growth and developmental milestones.
    • Immunization schedules.

Breastfeeding Support

  • Encourage and promote exclusive breastfeeding.
  • Assess breastfeeding effectiveness and challenges.
  • Assist mothers with proper positioning and attachment techniques.
  • Support mothers experiencing breastfeeding difficulties.
  • Educate families regarding breast milk expression and storage.
  • Provide evidence-based lactation support and counseling.

Emergency and High-Risk Obstetric Care

  • Identify signs of maternal and fetal deterioration.
  • Initiate emergency interventions within scope of practice.
  • Participate in the management of:
    • Postpartum hemorrhage.
    • Eclampsia and pre-eclampsia.
    • Shoulder dystocia.
    • Cord prolapse.
    • Fetal distress.
    • Neonatal resuscitation.
  • Escalate concerns promptly to physicians and senior clinical staff.
  • Participate in emergency drills and mock code training.

Patient Education and Family Support

  • Provide individualized education to mothers and families.
  • Support informed decision-making regarding maternity care.
  • Promote healthy pregnancy and parenting practices.
  • Offer emotional support during pregnancy, labor, and postpartum recovery.
  • Respect cultural, religious, and personal preferences.
  • Advocate for patient rights and dignity.

Education

  • Bachelor of Science in Midwifery OR
  • Diploma in Midwifery with additional recognized nursing qualification.
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Nursing with recognized Midwifery Certification where applicable.

Licensure

  • Valid DHA / DOH / MOHAP Midwife License or Eligibility.
  • Active professional registration as a Midwife.
  • Basic Life Support (BLS) Certification.
  • Neonatal Resuscitation Program (NRP) Certification preferred.
  • Advanced Life Support in Obstetrics (ALSO) preferred.

Performs assessment and management of patients with an evidence-based approach, according to standards of care, and in compliance with Fakeeh Care bylaws, policies and procedures.

Key Responsibilities and Duties: 

  1. Performs clinical duties as per his / her assigned clinical privileges.
  2. Assesses his / her patients thoroughly (eg. clinical, socioeconomic, psychological and functional assessments) and documents patients’ assessment in patients’ medical records.
  3. Develops a plan of care for patients using an evidence-based approach and following standards of care, and documents the plan of care in patients’ medical record.
  4. Ensures that patients’ plan of care that is put by him/her is being implemented in a timely manner.
  5. Becomes the most responsible physician (MRP) for inpatients admitted under his / her name.
  6. For inpatients admitted under his / her name, develops discharge plan on day of admission and involves discharge-planning service as early as possible if warranted.
  7. Assesses inpatients that are admitted under his / her name at least once daily and ensures documentation of daily assessment and plan of care in daily progress notes using SOAP format.
  8. Responds to medical consultations in timely manner.
  9. Documents medical interventions that he / she performs on patients in a timely manner.
  10. Strictly follows Fakeeh care standards for documentation in medical records
  11. Responsible for timely completion and authentication of discharge summaries for patients admitted under his / her name. Also responsible for ensuring that indicated discharge instructions and education on take home medications is done prior to patients discharge.
  12. Attends to Fakeeh Health Care facility duties and responds to calls from the facility as per the departmental / section call schedule.
  13. Attends departmental and general staff meetings and contributes ideas for improving efficiency, productivity and patient satisfaction.
  14. Responsible for writing medical reports of his / her patients in a timely manner an das per Fakeeh care format
  15. Contributes to teaching rounds and teaching activities as requested by chairperson of medical department.
  16. Educates patients and their families about health conditions, treatments and preventative measures.
  17. Other duties as assigned within the scope of responsibility and requirements of the job.

All Fakeeh Care employees are responsible for continuous improvement, including:

  1. Performing all duties and tasks in a manner that supports Fakeeh’s Person-Centered care values.
  2. Actively contributing to continuous improvement initiatives, within the scope of the role.
  3. Adherence to safety protocols and proactively seeking to address any job-related safety concerns.
  4. Maintaining strict confidentiality of all sensitive information accessed or encountered during work.
  5. Complying with cybersecurity policies and standards to protect Fakeeh’s systems and participating in awareness training and initiatives to prevent cyber threats.
  6. Adhering to and upholding Fakeeh Care’s code of conduct, policies and ethical standards.
  7. Completion of mandatory education as per the requirement, at least one month prior to expiration.
Requirements

Skills and Abilities:     

  • Must be able to clearly communicate with patients and their families, physicians and non-medical staff.
  • Microsoft computer skills.
  • Should have good organization skills and be able to work in high stress situations.

Experience:    

Completion of experience according to the regional health regulatory authority (as mentioned in education) within the field of specialty, in recognized medical centers.

Education:    

Completion of structured training in the field of specialty or subspecialty in a recognized medical center, and obtaining the highest clinical degree in that field of specialty that can be granted by that medical center.

Language:    

Excellent command of oral and written English and Arabic.

Licenses / Certifications:    

License for practice as per the regional health regulatory authority e.g. (SCFHS / DHA), BLS and advanced license if applicable.

Key Responsibilities

Clinical Responsibilities

  • Provide comprehensive Family Medicine consultations for adult and elderly patients.
  • Diagnose and manage acute and chronic medical conditions in accordance with evidence-based clinical guidelines.
  • Perform medical assessments, formulate treatment plans, and coordinate ongoing care.
  • Manage patients with multiple chronic comorbidities through a holistic and patient-centered approach.
  • Prescribe medications and monitor treatment outcomes while minimizing risks associated with polypharmacy.
  • Order, interpret, and act upon diagnostic investigations and laboratory results.
  • Refer patients to other specialties and allied health services when clinically indicated.
  • Maintain accurate, complete, and timely medical records within the hospital EMR system.

Geriatric Responsibilities

  • Conduct comprehensive geriatric assessments, including medical, functional, cognitive, psychological, nutritional, and social evaluations.
  • Assess and manage frailty syndromes and age-related conditions.
  • Manage conditions commonly encountered in geriatric practice, including:
    • Dementia and cognitive impairment
    • Delirium
    • Falls and balance disorders
    • Osteoporosis
    • Polypharmacy
    • Urinary incontinence
    • Functional decline
    • Chronic pain
    • Nutritional deficiencies
  • Develop individualized care plans for elderly patients and coordinate multidisciplinary interventions.
  • Provide support and counseling to caregivers and family members.
  • Collaborate with physiotherapy, occupational therapy, dietetics, nursing, psychology, and other specialties to ensure comprehensive care.
  • Promote healthy aging, preventive care, and wellness initiatives for older adults.

Multidisciplinary Care

  • Participate in multidisciplinary team meetings and case review discussions.
  • Coordinate care for complex patients requiring multiple specialties.
  • Contribute to discharge planning and continuity of care initiatives.

Quality and Patient Safety

  • Adhere to all hospital policies, clinical guidelines, regulatory requirements, and accreditation standards.
  • Participate in quality improvement projects, audits, morbidity discussions, and patient safety initiatives.
  • Report and manage clinical incidents according to hospital policy.
  • Support continuous improvement of Family Medicine and Geriatric services.

Academic and Professional Responsibilities

  • Participate in Continuing Medical Education (CME) and professional development activities.
  • Contribute to teaching, mentoring, and training of junior medical staff as required.
  • Participate in departmental meetings and contribute to service development initiatives.
  • Support clinical research, publications, and community outreach programs where applicable.

Authority

The post holder is authorized to:

  • Independently assess, diagnose, and manage patients within the approved scope of practice.
  • Prescribe medications as per DOH regulations and hospital policies.
  • Request diagnostic investigations and specialist consultations as clinically indicated.
  • Participate in the development of geriatric and family medicine pathways and protocols.

Minimum Qualifications

Education

  • MBBS or equivalent medical qualification recognized by the Department of Health (DOH), Abu Dhabi.
  • Completion of an accredited Family Medicine Residency Program.

Professional Qualification

  • Specialist qualification in Family Medicine recognized by DOH Abu Dhabi.

Preferred

  • Fellowship, Diploma, Certification, or substantial clinical experience in Geriatric Medicine.
  • Additional training in dementia care, frailty assessment, elderly rehabilitation, or chronic disease management.

Experience

  • Minimum 3 years of post-specialization experience in Family Medicine.
  • Demonstrated experience managing elderly patients within outpatient, hospital, or integrated care settings.
  • Experience working in a multidisciplinary healthcare environment.

Core Competencies

Clinical Competencies

  • Family Medicine
  • Chronic Disease Management
  • Geriatric Assessment
  • Preventive Medicine
  • Evidence-Based Practice
  • Patient Safety

Behavioral Competencies

  • Patient-Centered Care
  • Teamwork and Collaboration
  • Communication Skills
  • Professionalism
  • Leadership and Accountability
  • Compassion and Empathy

Key Working Relationships

Internal

  • Family Medicine Department
  • Internal Medicine
  • Rehabilitation Services
  • Nursing Services
  • Pharmacy
  • Nutrition Services
  • Quality Department
  • Allied Health Professionals

External

  • Patients and Families
