About the Role


As a VIP Homecare Nurse, you will provide exceptional one-to-one nursing care within private residences and luxury environments, ensuring the highest standards of clinical care, patient safety, and service excellence.


You will play a key role in supporting continuity of care, managing ongoing healthcare needs, coordinating with healthcare professionals, and accompanying patients during domestic and international travel.


This role combines the clinical responsibilities of an experienced nurse with the professionalism, flexibility, and discretion expected within a highly confidential VIP environment.


Key Responsibilities

Deliver personalised one-to-one nursing care to VIP patients
Administer medications and prescribed treatments
Monitor patient health, vital signs, and clinical progress
Maintain accurate clinical records and documentation
Coordinate care with physicians and multidisciplinary healthcare teams
Support chronic disease management and ongoing healthcare needs
Accompany patients during international travel and overseas assignments
Attend medical appointments and coordinate follow-up care
Build trusted relationships with patients and family members
Maintain the highest levels of professionalism, confidentiality, and discretion
Adapt to changing patient requirements and travel schedules
Ensure continuity of care across multiple international locations


Travel & Lifestyle Considerations


This role is ideally suited to nurses seeking a highly mobile international career rather than a traditional clinic or hospital-based position.


While Dubai will be your primary home base, successful candidates should be comfortable with:


Frequent international travel throughout the year
Travel arrangements that may arise at short notice
Accompanying patients on overseas trips and extended stays
Spending significant periods of time outside the UAE when required
Working within private residences, luxury hotels, and international healthcare settings
Flexibility around travel schedules and changing itineraries


For nurses with a passion for travel and delivering exceptional personalised care, this opportunity offers a unique alternative to conventional nursing roles.


Ideal Candidate Profile


We are particularly interested in professionals who demonstrate:


Strong clinical judgement and decision-making abilities
Experience within hospital, community, rehabilitation, homecare, private nursing, or long-term care settings
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
Emotional intelligence, cultural awareness, and adaptability
Professional maturity and sound clinical judgement
A proactive and patient-centred approach to care
The ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with a wider healthcare team
High levels of discretion and professionalism


Previous experience within VIP healthcare, concierge medicine, executive health, private household nursing, or international patient care environments would be advantageous, although not essential.

Consultant Anesthesiologist at Kanad Hospital shall provide consultation and administer Anesthesia and sedation services to surgical and non-surgical patients using full range of agents, methods, and techniques for effective and safe conduct of anesthesia. He /She should maintain high-level and professional performance and assists the Head of Anesthesiology Department (HOD) by assuming responsibilities in his/her absence or as designated. He/she shall receive professional and administrative direction from the HOD Anesthesia to ensure adherence to existing Hospital and Department policies. He/she should be capable of independent work without any professional supervision

Essential Job Functions and Key Accountabilities
Safe Conduct of Anesthesia Care:
The Consultant’s responsibilities include preanesthetic evaluation and care, medical management of the anesthetic procedure and the care of the patients during and after the surgery. The anesthesiologist should fulfill these responsibilities to the patient in accordance with the ASA Guidelines for the Ethical Practice of Anesthesiology and ethical policies of the Kanad Hospital. As a member of the hospital medical staff, Consultant anesthesiologist is subject to and must observe, as well as be accorded the benefits of, the medical staff bylaws, rules and regulations generally applicable to all physicians granted privileges in the hospital. Participating in the development of, and enforcing policies and procedures relating to the functioning of anesthesia personnel and the administration of anesthesia throughout the hospital.
Safe Conduct of Minimal, Moderate and Deep Sedation : Consultant Anesthesiologist should ensure safe sedation practice and be involved directly or supervision of sedation services throughout the hospital. 
He /She should be responsible and capable of monitoring and management of any adverse events during these procedures.
General Requirements as a physician:

  1. Shall be dedicated to providing competent medical service with compassion and respect for human dignity.
  2. Shall deal honestly with patients and colleagues and strive to expose those physicians deficient in character or competence, or who engage in fraud or deception.

  6. Shall, in the provision of appropriate patient care except in emergencies, be free to choose whom to serve, with whom to associate and the environment in which to provide medical services.

To support and demonstrate our NMC Nursing Mission, Vision, and Values: 

Our Nursing Vision: At NMC Healthcare, we are committed to providing clinical excellence through safe, compassionate, and individualized care to every patient, every time. 

Our Nursing Mission: To exemplify clinical excellence, every NMC nurse will seek to: 

  • Do the right thing 
  • Be the patient’s advocate 
  • Be open and transparent 
  • Deliver safe, compassionate care 
  • Recognize the uniqueness of each patient 
  • Contribute to an outstanding patient’s experience 
  • Engage with and contribute to, a learning culture 
  • Lead and influence changes in healthcare 

Our Nursing Values: We will achieve this through our core values: 

  • Safety 
  • Excellence 
  • Ethics 
  • Trust 
  • Collaboration 

The post holder will work collaboratively with other team members, uphold and live the NMC Nursing Strategy in order to provide safe and outstanding care to their patient, to the patient’s bystanders all the time, every time.

Responsibilities

Registered Nurse will:  

  • Be responsible for providing and coordinating patient care, educating patients and the public about various health conditions, and providing advice and emotional support to patients and their family members. 
  • Assess and identify patients’ needs and implement and monitor the patient’s medical plan and treatment. They will work with a team of physicians and other health care specialists or allied health in various settings. 
  • Perform systematic patient assessment, re-assessment and collect pertinent data about the patient’s health or situation. 
  • Understand and analyse the assessment information and data. 
  • Determine actual and potential nursing diagnoses, problems, and issues. 
  • Define the predicted and expected outcomes of the patient’s planned care. 
  • Create and evaluate patient care plans with the interprofessional team, in collaboration with the patient and patient’s bystanders. 
  • Record vital signs, recognize, address and escalate all abnormalities. 
  • Maintain and update technical and clinical skills related to nursing practice. 
  • Employ strategies to promote patients’ health and a safe environment. 
  • Understand different diagnostic tests and laboratory examinations. 
  • Perform essential life support as per regulatory requirements and scope such as but not limited to Basic Life Support, Pediatric Advanced Life Support, Advanced Cardiac Life Support, Neonatal Resuscitation etc. 
  • Prepare patients for medical examination and treatment.  
  • Administer medications and monitor patients for any side effects and reactions. 
  • Administer treatments such as IV fluids or blood products and monitor patients for any reactions.  
  • Provide wound care management. 
  • Assist in medical procedures invasive or non-invasive as needed.  
  • Facilitate the process of safe patient`s admission, transfer and discharge. 

Qualifications

Essential: the post holder must 

  • Have an appropriate license to work as a registered nurse in the relevant regulatory health authority with all the qualifications and experience these mandates. 
  • Manage their own professional re-licensure. 
  • Hold a valid American Heart Association Basic Life Support Provider card.  
  • Be willing to work across departments when necessary.  
  • Be able to communicate clearly and effectively in English (spoken and written) 

DESIRABLE: The post holder should have: 

  • Evidenced ability to work as part of an inter-professional team. 
  • Organizational and administrative skills with which to use the electronic medical record platform for clinical documentation. 
  • Be able to communicate effectively in Arabic

Responsible for delivering high-quality nursing care that transforms lives through excellent evidence-based practices to patients in a clinical setting. The role includes assessing patient health problems and needs, developing and implementing nursing care plans, and maintaining medical records. The Registered Nurse works closely with physicians, other nurses, and healthcare professionals to ensure optimal patient care and outcomes.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES & DUTIES:

1. Clinical Duties:

  • Conducts initial and ongoing assessments of patient’s health, including physical examinations, taking vital signs, and monitoring symptoms.
  • Develops, implements, and updates individualized care plans based on patient assessments and in collaboration with other healthcare professionals.
  • Administers medications and treatments as physicians prescribe and monitor for side effects or adverse reactions.
  • Provides care for wounds, including cleaning, dressing, and monitoring for signs of infection.
  • Assists physicians and other healthcare professionals during medical procedures and diagnostic tests.
  • Educates patients and their families about health conditions, treatments, and preventive measures.
  • Observe and record patients’ conditions, including changes in symptoms or behaviors, and report any significant changes to the medical team.
  • Respond to medical emergencies and provide immediate care as needed.
  • Conducts purposeful rounding for patients to ensure their needs are met, prevent complications, and improve overall care quality.
  • Adhere to strict infection control standards, including hand hygiene, personal protective equipment (PPE) use, and proper handling of hazardous materials.
  • Participate in infection control surveillance and reporting to help prevent facility-acquired infection.
  • Maintain the cleanliness of the patient items and equipment as per Fakeeh Care policies.
  • Follow established protocols for different emergencies (e.g., codes, and RRT), ensuring patient safety and effective response.
  • Innovate in patient care and implement evidence-based practices to enhance patient outcomes.
     

.

2. Administrative Duties:

  • Maintains accurate and detailed patient care records, including observations, interventions, and responses.
  • Communicates effectively with patients, families, and the healthcare team to ensure coordinated and comprehensive care.
  • Collaborates with other healthcare professionals to ensure that patient care is continuous and integrated.

3. Supportive Duties:

  • Provides emotional support to patients and their families, addressing concerns and offering reassurance during stressful times.
  • Advocates for patients’ needs and preferences, ensuring that their rights are respected, and their voices are heard.
  • Participates in ongoing education and training to stay current with medical practices and advancements.
  • Respect diverse cultural backgrounds and incorporate patient values and beliefs into care planning.

4. Oversees the work of junior staff and nursing students and provides guidance and support as needed
5. Collaborates with a multidisciplinary team, including physicians, therapists, and social workers, to provide comprehensive care
6. Identifies and addresses issues or challenges in patient care and contributes to solutions and improvements in practice
7. Other duties as assigned by the nursing manager within the scope of the job
 

.

  • Minimum 2 years of continuous nursing experience in Labor and Delivery and Post Natal Unit in UAE or from home country
  • Previous overseas experience is advantage but not required

Licenses / Certifications:

COMPETENCIES:

  • Adaptability & Resilience
  • Accountability & Role Understanding with Accreditation Knowledge
  • Teamwork and Relationship Building with Cultural Alignment
  • Talent Management and Development
  • Compassionate and Effective Communication

As a Phlebotomist at Ketone Clinical Laboratory, you will be responsible for providing safe, professional and efficient blood sample collection services, both at the laboratory and during home or on-site visits. You will play an important role in ensuring a positive patient experience while maintaining high standards of sample identification, collection, handling and transport. Working closely with our laboratory and operations teams, you will help ensure samples reach the laboratory promptly and in suitable condition for accurate testing.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform venipuncture and other authorised specimen collections safely and efficiently across a range of patients.
  • Carry out sample collections at the laboratory and during scheduled home, clinic and corporate visits.
  • Verify patient identity, test requests and collection requirements before each procedure.
  • Explain collection procedures clearly, obtain appropriate consent and help patients feel comfortable throughout.
  • Accurately label, document and track specimens in accordance with laboratory procedures and traceability requirements.
  • Ensure appropriate sample tubes, collection techniques, processing conditions and transport arrangements are used.
  • Follow infection prevention, hand hygiene, sharps disposal and occupational health and safety procedures.
  • Monitor patient wellbeing during and after collection, and respond appropriately to adverse reactions.
  • Coordinate with the laboratory and operations teams to manage appointments, collections and timely sample pick-up.
  • Maintain collection equipment, consumables and stock levels, reporting shortages or issues promptly.
  • Maintain accurate records and patient confidentiality in line with laboratory policies and applicable regulations.
  • Identify and escalate collection difficulties, sample quality concerns and incidents in a timely manner.
  • Support ongoing quality improvement initiatives and adhere to the laboratory’s standard operating procedures.

About You

  • Recognised qualification or training in phlebotomy, nursing or an equivalent relevant healthcare discipline.
  • Valid DHA licence or eligibility for the relevant role, as applicable.
  • Practical experience in venipuncture and specimen collection, preferably within the UAE healthcare sector.
  • Confident in handling patients with difficult venous access and maintaining a reassuring bedside manner.
  • Sound understanding of specimen identification, handling, transport and infection control requirements.
  • Excellent communication skills, professionalism and a patient-centred approach.
  • Strong attention to detail, reliability and ability to manage scheduled collections independently.
  • Ability to work collaboratively within a dynamic team and adapt to changing operational needs.

What’s On Offer?

  • Competitive salary package in line with market trends.
  • Progressive environment.
  • Opportunity to grow within the business and upskill in your areas of interest.

This position is responsible for evaluating patients referred to Speech Therapy, organizing and implementing individualized therapeutic programs with patients, and recording patient progress and response to treatment.

PRIMARY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Patient Care

  • Assesses complex/undifferentiated abnormalities (e.g. Second Opinions) and develops the necessary treatment plans
  • Implements process flows improvements for safer and more efficient patient care across the areas they lead.
  • Adopts a patient centered approach to practice
  • Performs a comprehensive evaluation on each patient utilizing recognized and standardized assessment protocols relevant to the patient’s condition.
  • Uses standardized outcome measures to quantify the patient’s status.
  • With the relevant qualifications and experience, performs videofluoroscopic studies, videoendoscopic evaluations, and videolaryngoscopic evaluations to contribute in evaluation of Dysphagia and Dysphonia.
  • Interprets and reports test results to facilitate medical diagnosis in partnership with the referring physician
  • Determines therapeutic plan, including the need for therapy, frequency of treatment, focus for intervention and duration of therapy
  • Administers therapeutic interventions that are evidence based to address highlighted problems.
  • Selects assistive devices to improve patient’s communication, inclusive of speaking valves for tracheotomized patients and voice prosthesis for laryngectomized patients.
  • Facilitates active participation of the patient in service provision
  • Acts as an advocate on behalf of the patient to protect the patient’s health, safety and rights.

Clinical/Professional Knowledge

  • Coordinates and Supervises all Operational Medical and Clinical aspects of the Speech-Language Pathology, Swallowing and Tacheostomy Programs. Participates in the development of departmental programs, policies, systems and procedures; and is responsible for their effective implementation.
  • Oversees skills/competencies assessments and managing clinical performance of junior staff members
  • Supervises the work of junior staff in the delivery of care to patients and provides advice and support as required.
  • Assists with conduction of performance appraisals of junior staff members
  • Utilises and allocates SLT staff to enable the whole service to run smoothly
  • Ensures appropriate staffing levels within specialty-specific teams before approving leaves of junior staff members, including but not limited to, personal leaves, business leaves, training & development leaves, and so forth.
  • Audits of clinical documentation to ensure compliance with regulatory guidelines and frameworks
  • Gives feedback to the departmental manager for budgeting purposes
  • Produces and maintains legible, accurate, and appropriate records, in keeping with regulatory requirements.
  • Adheres to appropriate protocols for the care of the patient populations in which assigned.
  • Adheres to the CCAD Inpatient Therapies and Rehabilitation core standards of care.
  • Incorporates the CCAD Professional Practice model and patient safety principles into clinical practice; reports errors and near-misses
  • Adheres to HAAD recommendations of attaining 20 CME every two years through continued professional development activities to maintain licensure.

Professionalism

  • Provides services within Speech Pathology scope of practice and personal competence
  • Participates in multidisciplinary management of patients, ensures coordination of treatment goals and discharge planning
  • Provides services upholding professional ethical values (e.g., adheres to professional codes of ethics and standards of practice when making decisions with client).
  • Maintains confidentiality regarding patient and family information by promoting professional interdisciplinary communication.
  • Engages in activities that support the development of the therapy profession (e.g., participates in in-service presentations, local and national conferences, professional committees, and public education of other health care professionals).

Interpersonal Communication

  • Provides support, teaching, specialist advice to other staff within the team on a planned and spontaneous basis. e.g. less experienced Therapists; technical instructors / assistants, medical or work experience students on observational visits
  • Provides counseling and education to patients and their families about the patient’s diagnosis and associated impairments (swallowing, voice, motor speech and/or communication impairments), as well as importance of oral hygiene, any necessary diet modifications, compensatory treatments, and tube feeding (as necessary)
  • Communicates effectively with multi-disciplinary team members in a responsive and responsible manner that supports a team approach to maintaining health and treatment of disease.
  • Provides patient care information as requested to contracted insurers and/or reimbursement entities within the guidelines of the confidentiality information policy
  • Communicates results and recommendations for improving communicative function to referral sources and outside agencies if required

Practice-Based Learning; Personal Development

  • Utilizes self-evaluation and feedback from clients and other provider’s to reflect upon actions and decisions to continuously improve knowledge and skills.
  • Engages in professional development and lifelong learning activities (e.g., actively participates in the acquisition of new knowledge and skills; integrates new knowledge, skills and behaviors into practice).
  • Incorporates own experiences, education, research, and best available resources to plan and deliver therapy services.
  • Participates in the orientation, competencies and appraisals of junior speech and language therapists.
  • Identifies the development needs of junior speech and language therapists and ensures opportunities to apply their developing knowledge and skills.

System-Based Learning; System Improvement

  • Identifies opportunities to improve the service in order to provide the best patient care within resources available and make recommendations for change.
  • Takes a lead in the development and the implementation of local evidence based policies on matters relating to diagnosis and treatment, in response to local and national guidance.
  • Contributes to quality assurance and service development projects.

TECHNICAL SKILLS

Core

  • Ability to conduct an oral, pharyngeal, laryngeal, and respiratory function/expiration examination.
  • Ability to administer standard and nonstandard speech/ language assessment procedures .
  • Ability to conduct a clinical bedside swallowing evaluation.
  • Ability to develop and implement intervention strategies appropriate to individual’s medical condition, speech, language, swallowing and/or feeding disorder, cognitive status and behavioral status.
  • Knowledge of and skill in selecting and implementing aided and unaided augmentative or alternative communication systems.

Advanced (Essential)

  • Ability to conduct an oral, pharyngeal, laryngeal, and respiratory function/expiration examination.
  • Ability to administer standard and nonstandard speech/ language assessment procedures .
  • Ability to conduct a clinical bedside swallowing evaluation.
  • Ability to develop and implement intervention strategies appropriate to individual’s medical condition, speech, language, swallowing and/or feeding disorder, cognitive status and behavioral status.
  • Knowledge of and skill in selecting and implementing aided and unaided augmentative or alternative communication systems.

Advanced (Essential)

  • Ability to perform Video fluoroscopic Swallow Study (VFSS)
  • Ability to manage tracheostomized patients

Advanced (Preferred)

  • Ability to perform Fiberoptic Endoscopic Evaluation of Swallowing (FEES)
  • Ability to manage laryngectomized patients.
  • Ability to evaluate objectively and subjectively and treat patients with Voice Disorders.
  • Ability to evaluate and provide treatment to patient with hearing disabilities/cochlear implants.

QUALIFICATION & EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Speech & Hearing, or Speech Language Pathology, Speech or Communications Sciences & Disorders is required

Experience

  • Minimum of six (6) years of postgraduate experience in the field of adult Speech-Language Therapy/ Pathology.

Primary Duties And Responsibilities

Physician responsibilities:

  • Monitors and provides care to patients at CCAD within the MSI
  • Prescribes or administers medication, therapy and other specialized medical care to treat or prevent illness, disease or injury
  • Provides specific treatments and/or performs operations to treat patient medical conditions
  • Evaluates patient and records applicable notes about patient’s condition for purposes of serving as a record of treatment and/or making a possible referral to another member of the health care professional team
  • Liaisons with other medical and non-medical staff at CCAD to ensure quality patient treatment
  • Supplies, provides and manages care in a culturally appropriate and sensitive manner
  • Adheres to individual approved clinical privileges, as well as to all policies and procedures of the Medical Staff

Leadership responsibilities:

  • Develops a strategic plan for the Department/Section that supports the strategic direction of CCAD
  • Defines the Department/Section’s scope and direction in the areas of patient care, education and research
  • Creates a vision and supports members of the Department/Section in their pursuit of excellence in the areas of patient care, education and research
  • Recommends criteria for selecting the department’s or services professional staff and choose or recommend individuals who meet those criteria.
  • Recommends space, medical technology, equipment, staffing, and other resources needed by the department or service and have a process in place to respond to shortages.
  • Provides orientation and training for all staff of the duties and responsibilities for the department or service to which they are assigned.
  • Responsible for recommending and monitoring outside sources of services that relate to the specialty.
  • Promotes the retention of employees
  • Assesses the cost effectiveness of practice at CCAD and recommends methods by which the most economical use of equipment, supplies and pharmaceuticals can be assured without compromising the medical necessities of treatment
  • Develops and implements, in cooperation with Nursing, Administration and the Medical Staff, patient care policies, procedures, guidelines and protocols and periodically updates them as needed
    • Cooperates with leadership of other Departments/Sections in setting strategy and providing care to patients
    • Participates as a member of the Medical Executive Committee (MEC) and assumes administrative responsibilities on behalf of the organization as required.
  • Operational responsibilities:
    • Oversees and resolves issues relating to resource utilization and productivity including but not limited to meeting inpatient, outpatient and RVU targets as determined by CCAD Leadership.
    • Monitors and evaluates the quality and appropriateness of patient care provided within the Institute/Department while monitoring Quality Metrics and make recommendations to pursue excellence in the areas of patient care.
    • Ensures that the Institute/Department provides appropriate clinical outcomes data and physician level performance metrics to allow for an objective evaluation of clinical performance
    • Holds and participates in departmental and inter-departmental meetings to identify opportunities for Institute/Departmental performance improvement from both a clinical and administrative perspective and works toward enhancing performance to meet or exceed standards.
    • Manages physician outage within the department including Annual Leave and CME requests and ensure minimum coverage to achieve operational inpatient and outpatient targets.

Fiscal responsibilities:

  • Adheres to budget for the Department/Section and analyzes and explains budget variances
  • Ensures that all Department/Section expenditures are in accordance with current CCAD policy

The Orthotist – Prosthetist I is a junior clinical role requiring a minimum of 2 years of post-graduate experience in the field. The post holder is responsible for providing safe and effective clinical orthotic/prosthetic care to pediatric patients with low to moderate complexity at Sidra Medicine.                                                   

Key elements of this role include substantial clinical and technical judgment in the application of:

  • Biomechanics and pathomechanics
  • Gait analysis and kinesiology
  • Anatomy and physiology

The Orthotist – Prosthetist I is tasked with assessing pediatric patients with low to moderate complexity and single-pathological needs. Using clinical reasoning, they plan, implement, monitor, and repair a standard range of orthotic interventions with both custom and off-the-shelf orthotic devices. S/he has a reduced level of clinical autonomy compared to the Orthotist II (Specialist), working independently within their scope of low to moderately complex patients, and seeking guidance and supervision for more complex cases. The incumbent involves frequent collaboration with other multidisciplinary healthcare team members, essential to provide evidence-based treatment and care planning, typically in a supporting role.

The Orthotist – Prosthetist I supports continuous improvement initiatives within the service by generating innovative ideas within orthotic/prosthetic practice and maintaining a commitment to lifelong learning. They create, utilize, and disseminate new knowledge to patients, families, the public, and other professionals, both internally and externally. Additionally, the Orthotist – Prosthetist I provides teaching to colleagues on a wide range of clinical and professional subjects and supports quality improvement initiatives and performance improvement activities. They are not responsible for the supervision of colleagues.

Responsibilities

Clinical

Provides in-patient and/or out-patient orthotics or prosthetics care for patients with low to moderate complexity, single – pathological needs, requiring core clinical reasoning.

  • Makes limited scope of clinical decisions independently, using the best available evidence in relation to a limited range of orthotic/prosthetic devices and formulates a program of patient care related to these devices. 
  • Seeks guidance and supervision for clinical reasoning in relation to more complex patients.
  • Patient profile:
    • Individuals with routine or lower risk needs, such as plantar fasciitis, mild foot drop, or basic knee instability.
    • Patients requiring standard orthotic devices, like off-the-shelf insoles, simple AFOs (ankle-foot orthoses), or 3D printed insoles.
    • Those with stable conditions or mild deformities requiring limited reassessment and adaptation.
  • Undertakes biomechanical assessment of patients, including those with low to moderately complex presentations (e.g., foot pain, toes walking, mild cerebral palsy etc.) and moderate level of needs across the age span from birth to 18.
  • Provides accurate measurements for orthosis at initial appointment or pre-operative assessment.
  • Formulates an individualized orthotic or prosthetic treatment plan using a standard range of treatment options to formulate a program of care with support from the Specialist Orthotist (Orthotist-Prosthetist II), where required, for more complex cases.
  • Designs and specify appropriate custom and prefabricated prosthetic & orthotic devices and arrange for manufacture. 
  • Takes casts or 3D scans for manufacture of appropriate orthoses/prostheses according to agreed management plan.
  • Performs necessary adjustments to custom or prefabricated braces as required for patient comfort and function.
  • Monitors patient progress and modifies treatment plans according to changing clinical outlook. 
  • Ensures use of appropriate clinical outcome measures to evaluate effectiveness of care.
  • Maintains clear and accurate paperwork for all orders to enable correct manufacturing within the specified time frame.
  • Completes positive cast rectification where appropriate if a manufacturing workshop is available. 
  • Ensures orthosis fulfills technical specification and quality aspects, before supplying it to the patient. 
  • Determines the need to return the orthosis to the manufacturer if it does not meet the required specification.
  • Demonstrates and teaches the safe use of devices to clients and/or caretakers.
  • Communicates with patients and caretakers to ensure understanding of prosthetic & orthotic use, wear, and care.
  • Documents all relevant information correctly, appropriately and in a timely manner as per orthotics documentation standards. 
  • Works within multidisciplinary teams when required in key areas such as rehabilitation medicine, orthopedics and plastics/craniofacial.
  • Responsible for care and adjustment as necessary and maintenance of equipment as appropriate. 
  • Maintains patient information confidentiality whether formally or informally recorded.
  • Maintains compliance with all infection control and safety regulations and policies when dealing with equipment and patients. 
  • Works towards the achievement of agreed key performance indicators for self and unit by ensuring self-accountability in competing required information to inform these KPI’s. 
  • Supports the achievement of cost efficiency savings in the service and maintains an awareness of resource utilization, demonstrating care in the ordering and use of equipment and materials.
  • Reports on equipment failures, safety and security issues, and/or reduction of supply inventory.
  • Participates in quality improvement activities and committees related to the service as assigned to create care that is optimal for patients and families.
  • Demonstrates an understanding of evidence-based healthcare methodology and its ability to positively impact patient outcomes.
  • Participates in the integration and evaluation of research into practice.
  • Participates in patient education programs.
  • Promotes a safe environment and safe patient care by embracing a safety culture and identifying areas of risk to Occupational Therapy Supervisor. Compliant with policies for personal and patient safety and for the prevention of healthcare associated infections.

Professional Practice

  • Provides documented evidence of own performance and maintenance of skills with appropriate continuing professional development activities consistent with the specialty post. 
  • Responsible for maintaining a Department of Health Care Practitioners Continuing Professional Development Profile for licensure. 
  • Responsible for maintaining up to date mandatory Life Support Training requirements as directed by MoPH and Sidra (e.g., BLS, AED etc).
  • Participates in service activities that contribute to excellence in outcomes, a positive patient experience and a healthy professional environment. 
  • Contributes to the achievement of clinical quality outcome indicators and patient satisfaction. 
  • Leads service-based Performance Improvement activities and organizational committees as assigned.
  • Participates in quality improvement activities linked to orthotics strategic priorities and professional practice model. 
  • Reports back to the Specialist Orthotist (Orthotist-Prosthetist II) and the OT supervisor regularly about day-to-day operational needs (e.g., clinical services provision, equipment requirements etc.) in the specialty service and assist with ad hoc operational service planning activities as needed. 
  • Participates in the continued development, implementation, and evaluation of Sidra Policy and Procedures to align with international best practices.
  • Supports orientation for new staff aimed at developing competence and performance.
  • Maintains a suitable learning environment, supporting and teaching staff to develop. This includes mentoring, coaching, and providing formal clinical supervision to junior or less experienced orthotics staff such as technicians/PCP’s along with providing ongoing formal and informal education (e.g., conferences, in-services, journal club etc.)
  • Coordinates with the Specialist Orthotist (Orthotist-Prosthetist II) and OT supervisor regarding staff absences (e.g., sickness, annual, study, maternity). 
  • Participates in the promotion and maintenance of effective communication and teamwork. Treats colleagues, patients, and visitors with dignity and respect always.
  • Responsible for completing their supervision agreements, readiness for supervision sessions and maintaining accurate supervision records. 
  • Follows all organizational policies and procedures.
  • Adheres to Sidra’s standards as they appear in the Code of Conduct and Conflict of Interest policies.
  • Adheres to and promotes Sidra’s Values

In view of the evolving needs and opportunities within Sidra, this position may be required to perform other duties as assigned and reporting relationships may vary.

Qualifications
